title: Mission Solutions & Payload – Payload Technical Director
description:
Date Posted:

2026-08-25

Country:

United States of America

Location:

US-CA-EL SEGUNDO-E01 ~ 2000 E El Segundo Blvd ~ BLDG E01

Position Role Type:

Onsite

U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date.​ U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance​

Security Clearance Type:

DoD Clearance: TS/SCI

Security Clearance Status:

Active and existing security clearance required on day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

This position is an onsite role located in El Segundo, CA and will require travel (25%-50%).

What You Will Do

As the Payloads Technical Director for Mission Solutions and Payloads, you will provide strategic technical leadership across our space payload portfolio, shaping the technologies, architecture, products, and talent needed to meet current and future mission needs. You will:

  • Establish and drive the technical vision, strategy, and technology roadmaps for the space payload portfolio.

  • Provide technical leadership for mission concepts and architecture development to drive competitive pursuit offerings.

  • Shape next-generation payload architectures and lead technical trades that balance mission performance, affordability, schedule, risk, producibility, and technology maturity.

  • Partner with MSP leadership, programs, engineering, strategy, and requirements and capabilities leaders to shape pursuits and develop differentiated solutions for emerging customer needs.

  • Engage directly with customers and partners to understand mission challenges, influence future requirements, and translate operational needs into executable technical solutions.

  • Guide IRAD and technology investments, identifying critical technology gaps and accelerating maturation and transition of differentiating capabilities.

  • Promote common architecture, reusable technologies, open interfaces, and product-line approaches that enable rapid and affordable capability insertion.

  • Provide senior technical oversight for critical program decisions, technical reviews, architecture trades, and resolution of significant technical risks.

  • Champion systems thinking, modeling and simulation, MBSE, data-driven decision making, and disciplined engineering practices across the organization.

  • Connect payload development with spacecraft, ground, communications, mission processing, and other elements to optimize end-to-end mission performance.

  • Develop and mentor technical directors, architects, technical fellows, and emerging technical leaders while strengthening the organization's technical talent pipeline.

  • Foster collaboration and technology sharing across programs and organizations to accelerate innovation and transition proven solutions.

  • Represent the organization in senior-level customer engagements, technical interchange meetings, industry forums, and executive reviews.

  • Position will require travel (25%-50%).


What You Will Learn

In this role, you will gain broad exposure to the technologies, missions, customers, and business strategies shaping the future of space payloads. You will:

  • Develop a deep understanding of the organization’s space payload portfolio, technologies, products, and mission applications.

  • Expand your knowledge of emerging customer missions, operational needs, threats, and future space architecture.

  • Develop deeper relationships with customers, industry partners, suppliers, and technical leaders across the space community.

  • Strengthen your technical leadership capabilities in ways that shape long‑term mission and program success.

  • Tackle some of the most challenging technical problems in the industry, expanding your ability to innovate and solve complex issues.

  • Grow in a highly visible role that allows you to influence outcomes and elevate your impact across the enterprise.

  • Build a broader understanding of the business, including strategic planning, new business pursuits, competitive positioning, and technology differentiation.

  • Broaden your technical horizons and gain exposure to a portfolio of advanced products and technologies.

  • Expand your leadership skills through mentoring technical leaders, building collaborative teams, and shaping the technical talent needed for future missions.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a Bachelor's Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 14 years of prior relevant experience prohibited by local laws/regulations.

  • Technical leadership experience in complex space payloads, sensors, mission systems, or related technologies, with strong systems engineering and architecture experience.

  • Experience leading and influencing across programs and organizations, making sound technical decisions balancing performance, cost, schedule, and risk, and develop technical talent.

  • Ability to travel 25-50% as required to support customers, programs, technical reviews, and business activities.

  • Active and transferable U.S. government-issued Top Secret/SCI security clearance is required before the start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


Qualifications We Prefer

  • Broad technical experience across multiple space payload, sensor, or mission areas.

  • Strong communication and customer engagement skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts and influence senior leaders, customers, and key stakeholders.

  • Strong systems engineering background with the ability to understand and influence complex system and mission architectures.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end space mission architectures, including payloads, spacecraft, communications, ground systems, mission processing, and command and control.

  • Experience developing or leading advanced space payload architectures from concept development through integration, test, and deployment.

  • Experience with advanced sensors, signal processing, mission data processing, or related payload technologies.

  • Familiarity with model-based systems engineering (MBSE), modeling and simulation, digital engineering, and data-driven engineering approaches.

  • Experience applying product-line architectures, modular open systems approaches, common interfaces, and reusable technologies across multiple programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to make sound technical decisions by balancing performance, cost, schedule, risk, and technology maturity.

  • Experience developing technical strategies, technology roadmaps, architectures, or investment plans.

  • Experience developing technology and product roadmaps and shaping IRAD or other strategic technology investments.

  • Demonstrated success transitioning advanced technologies from research and development into programs, products, or operational capabilities.

  • Experience leading technical teams and influencing across programs, functions, and organizations.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence across organizational boundaries and build effective partnerships with programs, customers, suppliers, and industry partners.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop technical talent and build strong technical teams.

  • Experience mentoring systems architects, technical fellows, and other senior technical leaders.

  • Experience supporting new business activities, including customer engagement, concept development, technical proposals, or competitive pursuits.

  • Experience shaping customer requirements and developing technical solutions for new business pursuits and competitive captures.

  • Strong executive-level communication skills with experience presenting complex technical strategies and recommendations to senior customers and business leadership.

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

  • Relocation Eligibility.

Learn More & Apply Now!

Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role.

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

This position requires a security clearance. DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. title: Facilities Project Manager
description:
WE ARE THE NRO
For sixty years, the NRO has developed, acquired, launched and operated the satellites that are the foundation for America’s advantage and strength in space. Using a diversified architecture of spacecraft, NRO collects and delivers the best space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance content on the planet.
Learn more at .

Basic Eligibility For A Position With The NRO
  • You must be a U.S. Citizen
  • You must be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance
  • You will be subject to pre-employment and periodic drug testing
  • You will be subject to pre-employment and periodic polygraph examinations
Where You Will Work
Management Services & Operations (MS&O) is responsible for delivering integrated service and support solutions that ensure the NRO mission. MS&O is responsible for facilities, emergency management, logistics and resource management to name a few. MS&O has opportunity for an experienced facility program manager to join the team. This position will work within the Facilities Logistics Service Division (FLSD) and is responsible for the execution of design/build construction projects. Projects range in scope and complexity supporting all facets of a facility to include, but not limited to, power, people spaces, and cooling.

What makes working in the Facilities Logistics Service Division (FLSD) exciting? The variety of projects executed provides a unique experience that allows program managers to utilize their subject matter expertise while increasing their breadth of knowledge across all aspects required operating a facility. The ever-changing type of projects keeps daily work activities exciting and refreshing.

The NRO Cadre is collecting resumes for consideration against current and future opportunities for Non-Supervisor, Facilities Project Manager, GG-13, occupational series 0340. More information on the occupational series can be viewed on the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) website.

Your resume may be considered for other positions which your skills and experience may be a good match.

This is a full-time position that is open from 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-09. Resumes must be submitted by 11:59 PM EST on 2026-09-09.

Who May Apply
  • This position is open to the public.
  • Federal government employees MUST currently be at the grade level or higher as indicated in this announcement. This is NOT a promotion opportunity for current Federal government employees. If selected for the position, Federal government employees will transition laterally at their current grade level and step.
  • Federal applicants who exceed the advertised grade may voluntarily request acceptance at the lower grade per IAW DoWI 1400.25 Volume 2006.
  • The NRO is only accepting external applicants for this job announcement. Current NRO Cadre employees should apply internally.
  • This position MAY qualify for the appointment of a reemployed federal annuitant IAW DoWI 1400.25 Volume 300.
What You Will Be Doing
Serves as an ADF-C Facilities Program Manager and as such, the incumbent is responsible for the overall management, control, coordination, and execution of assigned projects. In his/her capacity, the incumbent implements corporate decisions, guidance, laws, regulations and policies in the course of the project and intermediate products in support of the project. Develops an integrated management plan/project schedule for each work breakdown milestone. Within this work breakdown schedule, to include milestones, budgets, responsibilities of the participating parties, and to incorporate assumptions and risks, contingencies, and performance measurement criteria. Tracks and maintains detailed communications such as project meeting minutes, e-mail correspondence, and phone and verbal conversations and project status weekly report for component/customers and management.

Reviews cost reports to assure charges are authorized and appropriate; identifies unauthorized charges and assures corrective actions are taken to correct inappropriate charges. Reviews project progress, measuring performance and taking necessary corrective actions to maintain agreed upon scope, schedule and cost. Reconciles sponsor/customer concerns, assuring that all participating parties are informed of project progress, issues and impacts.

Provides status reports on projects assigned (progress, issues and trends) to apprise corporate leadership weekly. Serves as the Contracting Officer's Technical Representative (COTR) for project and facility management related issues.
Applicant must have direct applicable experience that demonstrates the possession of the knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies necessary for immediate success in the position.
  • Reviews rough-order-of-magnitude (ROM) costs for out-year projects to facilitate future budgeting.
  • Determines project requirements, scope, and deliverables in order to develop and review Government statements of work (SOW). Reviews independent Government cost estimates (IGCE) for the SOW.
  • Develops technical evaluations for project proposals. Determines validity of cost, schedule, and technical approach in these evaluations.
  • Develops, maintains and manages all documentation relating to construction projects.
  • Leads, plans, implement, and coordinate all activities in regards to facilities projects.
  • Serves as Contracting Officer Technical Representative (COTR) responsible for a full range of contracting activities in coordination with the contracting officer, on all facilities related construction projects.
  • Efficiently utilizes computerized maintenance management systems.
  • Monitors maintenance contractors’ work.
  • Maintains knowledge and awareness of basic heating and cooling systems and appropriate software and system controls for the management of these systems within a facility.
  • Maintains knowledge and awareness of energy and utilities management and institutional policies related to energy usage and conservation.
  • Manages facility operations and maintenance activities.
  • Manages, maintains, and updates existing data records as related to high-risk facilities space and maintenance.
  • Build and maintain mutually beneficial relationships, facilitates communications and coordinates activities among Buckley Space Force Base, Utility providers and the ADF-C.
  • Detect collaborative opportunities, securing stakeholder buy-in for various collaborations, and overseeing negotiations to help the ADF-C receive the maximum benefit possible.
  • Relay the organization's interests and work to further these through collaborative efforts.
  • Secures classified information in accordance with E.O. 13526.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
What You Will Need
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Microsoft Project and Microsoft Visio.
  • Skill in the design and use of automated databases and spreadsheet software to develop and improve the validity and accuracy of data collection, storage, and reporting and to explain the use of established databases for historical reference and analysis.
  • Skill in written communications to prepare plans, and briefings. Skill in oral communications for presentations and briefings.
  • Skill in maintaining effective working relationships with internal and external customers, and to serve as a point of contact for assigned work efforts.
  • Interpersonal abilities including skill to establish and maintain good working relationships with a wide variety of individuals involved in various aspects of assigned projects.
  • Ability to develop and integrate multiple project schedules into an integrated master schedule.
  • Ability to execute projects within established financial and time constraints.
  • Qualifying experience may have been acquired in any public or private sector job, but will clearly demonstrate past experience in the application of the particular competencies/knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to successfully perform and is typically in or directly related to the duties of the position as described above.
Qualifying experience may have been acquired in any public or private sector job, but will clearly demonstrate past experience in the application of the particular competencies/knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to successfully perform and is typically in or directly related to the duties of the position as described above. Experience must be reflected in your resume.

Applicants submitting a resume that exceeds the two-page limit per OPM Memorandum, “Merit Hiring Plan,” dated May 29, 2025, will not be eligible for consideration. For more information regarding resume writing, see “Guidance for Applicants on 2-Page Resume” and visit the Resume Help Center.

Other Information
  • Overtime Statement: MAY be required to work other than normal duty hours, which may include evenings, weekends, and/or holidays.
  • Travel Statement: MAY be required to travel in military or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
  • Financial Disclosure: MAY be required to file an OGE Form 450, Confidential Financial Disclosure Report, upon appointment and will be required to file annually.
  • Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) coded positions: If selected for a DAWIA coded position, the incumbent must meet appropriate certification requirements IAW the Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) no later than 24 months after accepting this position. Individual shall maintain, at a minimum 80 continuous Learning Points every 24 months via the services acquisition management system. DAWIA requirements may be located at the Defense Acquisition University website.
  • Geographic Mobility Agreement: MAY be subject to directed reassignment as required to address mission effectiveness, and/or career development.
  • Information Assurance (IA): Must achieve the appropriate IA certification within six months of assignment.
  • Emergency Essential: Certain positions MAY be deemed emergency essential and incumbents must be willing to meet all position requirements.
Location

Aurora, CO

Telework is not available and you must be able to work at the specified location(s).

Salary

2026 salary range for the Denver, CO area:
GG-13: $118,675 - $154,280

The NRO is accepting applications from U.S. Citizens and current federal government employees for this position. To qualify for the position, federal government employees MUST currently be at the GG-13 grade level and may ONLY apply for a lateral reassignment at their current grade level and step. Federal applicants who exceed the advertised grade may voluntarily request acceptance at the lower grade per IAW DoWI 1400.25 Volume 2006.

Hiring Incentives

The NRO may offer hiring incentives and other entitlements at management’s discretion.

Trial Period

All new DCIPS employees will be required to serve a 2-year trial period.

Veterans’ Preference

DoW Components with DCIPS positions apply Veterans’ Preference to preference eligible candidates as defined by Section 2108 of Title 5 USC, in accordance with the procedures provided in DoW Instruction 1400.25, Vol 2005, DCIPS Employment and Placement. If you are a veteran claiming veterans’ preference, as defined by section 2108 of Title 5 USC, you must submit documents verifying your eligibility upon request.

Reasonable Accommodation Policy

Federal agencies must provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process should follow the instructions in the job opportunity announcement. For any part of the remaining hiring process, applicants should contact the hiring agency directly. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

A reasonable accommodation is any change to a job, the work environment, or the way things are usually done that enables an individual with a disability to apply for a job, perform job duties or receive equal access to job benefits.

Under the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, federal agencies must provide reasonable accommodations when:
  • An applicant with a disability needs an accommodation to have an equal opportunity to apply for a job.
  • An employee with a disability needs an accommodation to perform the essential job duties or to gain access to the workplace.
  • An employee with a disability needs an accommodation to receive equal access to benefits, such as details, training, and office-sponsored events.
You can request a reasonable accommodation at any time during the application or hiring process or while on the job. Requests are considered on a case-by-case basis. Please send your request to Hiring@nro.mil.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

title: Full Time - Sales Associate - Hardware - Day
description:
Your Impact at Lowe's

As a Customer Service Associate, you combine top-notch customer service skills with genuine care for people to help customers feel comfortable while shopping at Lowe's. This is an excellent role for those who want to engage with customers and help them solve their home improvement challenges.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.

  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.

  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.

  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.

  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.

  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

Your Day at Lowe's

As a Customer Service Associate, you will welcome customers to Lowe's and help them find the right products and services for their home improvement needs. You will interact with customers throughout the day, help them find and select products, occasionally load merchandise, and ensure all customer needs are met.

While you will spend most of your time listening to customers, answering questions, and organizing merchandise, your daily responsibilities may vary by department.

Customer Service Associates work in one of the following departments, based on hiring needs and skillsets: Appliances, Cabinets, Flooring, Live Nursery, Inside Garden, Hardware, Tools, Millwork, Building Materials, Plumbing, Electrical, Paint, Home Décor, Tool Rental, or Pro Services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome customers to Lowe's, answer questions, and deliver friendly and professional customer service.

  • Assist customers with locating and handling merchandise

  • Down stock merchandise by looking for empty areas on shelves and replenishing supplies

  • Process orders and deliveries accurately so customers receive merchandise as expected and on time

  • Cross-functionally train in other areas of the store to help deliver the best customer service

  • Prepare merchandise in your department based on customer needs (e.g., tint and mix paint, cut and thread pipe, cut and bundle wood, cut drywall, cut blinds)

  • Guide customers through shopping or checkout

  • Complete other duties as assigned


Minimum Qualifications

  • 6 Months Experience using a computer, including inputting, accessing, modifying, or outputting information

  • 6 Months Experience using common retail technology, such as smart phones and tablets

  • Reading, writing, and performing basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction)

  • Able to perform duties that may require prolonged standing, sitting, and other activities necessary to perform job duties

  • Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without an accommodation


Preferred Qualifications

  • 6 months of Retail and/or customer service experience

  • Bi-lingual skills

  • Certification in trade related to department (e.g., hardware, kitchen, plumbing, electrical, lawn and garden, and lumber/building materials)


Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

About Lowe’s

Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 50 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

title: HGV Class 1 Driver - Days
description:
We’re looking for experienced HGV Class 1 Drivers to join our Great Bear team in Desborough, supporting deliveries for key customers including a leading international chocolate and confectionery manufacturer.

This is a fantastic opportunity to secure a permanent, full-time driving role with a 24/7 operation, delivering palletised goods to Regional Distribution Centres nationwide.

If you take pride in safe driving, reliable service and professional customer delivery standards, we’d love to hear from you.

Shift patterns available:

Monday-Friday Days
4 On / 4 Off Days

We have increased our pay rates, with hourly rates now starting at £16.19 (for days) plus shift supplements and overtime paid at hourly rate plus 30% depending on your shift

What you’ll be doing

  • Carry out safe, professional deliveries to customer premises.
  • Complete palletised general haulage deliveries to Regional Distribution Centres, with most deliveries completed as backdoor tip.
  • Support occasional driver tipping or multi-drop deliveries depending on customer demand.
  • Occasional Night out may be required
  • Report to the Transport team at the start of each shift and communicate any delays, delivery issues or load discrepancies promptly.
  • Complete all paperwork accurately and ensure PODs are signed and returned to the Transport Office.
  • Follow company rules and procedures, including health, safety and hygiene standards.
  • Manage your working time in line with the Road Transport Directive and adhere to tachograph rules and regulations.
  • Complete daily vehicle checks in line with company procedure and report defects correctly.
  • Take responsibility for the unit and trailer, including temperature checks where required.
  • Maintain a high standard of behaviour, appearance and customer service at all times.

What we’re looking for

  • Valid C+E Licence.
  • Minimum 12 months’ HGV Class 1 driving experience preferred; unfortunately, we cannot accept new pass drivers for this contract
  • OR drivers who wish to consider transitioning from Class 2 to Class 1
  • No more than 6 points on your licence and no DD or DR code convictions.
  • Current valid DCPC and Tachograph cards.
  • Good understanding of Driver’s Hours and Working Time Directive legislation.
  • Ability to complete vehicle checks and report defects correctly.
  • Commitment to on-site health and safety requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills and a professional approach.

As part of our drive to make Great Bear a great place to work. We are proud to be an inclusive and diverse organisation where we are committed to employee development and recognising success for hard working performers.

Our dedicated learning and development programmes are open to every employee to give you the opportunity to shape your own future within logistics and continue to work in an environment where team culture thrives.

Our People are the driving force behind our success, which is why we offer a wide range of benefits which include:

  • Pension scheme - We want colleagues to enjoy a comfortable retirements so we offer a great contribution of 4% employee and 4% employer.
  • Life Assurance - x 2 your annual salary.
  • Wellness – Via our Employee Assistance Programme we offer immediate access to a confidential telephone counselling and legal information service that operates 24 hours a days, 365 days a year.
  • Eye Care Vouchers – We can provide you with substantial savings with free eye tests and discounts on prescription glasses.
  • Reward & Recognition – We recognise that employees have gone the extra mile via Employee of the month and year, special recognition and long service awards.
  • Everyday discounts - Via our benefit platform you will have access to over 50 retailer discounts for everyday savings!

If you meet the requirements for the above role and are looking for your next career opportunity please apply now and become a part of our #WinningTeam!

title: Construction Supervisor - Mechanical
description:
Job Type: Full-time | Location: Sweetwater, Texas | Department: Construction | Reporting to: Associate Director, Construction | Work Location: #onsite

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

Step into a role where your mechanical expertise helps power the future. As the Construction Supervisor - Mechanical, you will oversee the installation of some of the most advanced mechanical and liquid cooling systems used in next-generation data centers. You’ll guide field teams, partner with engineers and electricians, and ensure every system performs flawlessly in high-demand compute environments. If you’re a hands-on leader who enjoys solving tough technical challenges and wants to make a visible impact on major infrastructure projects, this is a chance to elevate your career while helping build the foundation of sustainable, high-performance compute.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and supervise mechanical technicians, fitters, and subcontractors working on liquid cooling systems (e.g., direct-to-chip cooling, rear-door heat exchangers), piping, pumps, valves, and HVAC systems.

  • Monitor team performance and ensure workforce compliance with project goals, quality requirements, and safety standards.

  • Oversee the installation of mechanical systems and ensure all work aligns with project drawings, specifications, and manufacturer guidelines.

  • Coordinate mechanical activities with other trades—including electrical, plumbing, and structural—to support seamless integration of systems.

  • Collaborate with engineers, vendors, and QA/QC teams to resolve technical issues and maintain project progress.

  • Ensure all mechanical installations meet data center standards, industry codes, and client requirements.

  • Verify compliance of materials and equipment with approved submittals and project specifications.

  • Support QA/QC inspections and address non-conformance issues promptly and effectively.

  • Supervise pressure testing, flushing, and balancing of liquid cooling loops to ensure leak-free operation and optimal system performance.

  • Oversee functional and performance testing of cooling systems to validate thermal, flow-rate, and reliability performance.

  • Assist commissioning teams in validating mechanical system operation under real or simulated load conditions.

  • Enforce OSHA regulations, company safety protocols, and site-specific safety requirements.

  • Conduct safety audits, toolbox talks, and job-site inspections to promote safe work practices.

  • Investigate and report incidents or near-miss events and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

  • Monitor daily and weekly work schedules and adjust manpower or resources to meet project deadlines.

  • Track installation progress and provide updates to the Construction Manager and project management team.

  • Manage material and equipment inventories to avoid delays and ensure timely availability of resources.

  • Provide technical guidance on installation, integration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of liquid cooling and mechanical systems.

  • Identify and resolve field challenges—including design conflicts and equipment malfunctions—using practical, timely solutions.

  • Stay current with advancements in liquid cooling and data center mechanical technologies and help integrate best practices into field operations.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in mechanical construction or supervision on industrial or large commercial projects; minimum 3 years of experience working with liquid cooling systems in data centers or similar high-tech facilities.
  • Journeyman or Master Mechanical License, AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI), or equivalent preferred.
  • OSHA 30 certification required; First Aid/CPR certification preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, P&IDs, and project specifications.
  • Strong understanding of liquid cooling technologies, heat transfer principles, and data center mechanical infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with mechanical testing tools such as pressure gauges, flow meters, and thermal imaging equipment.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and maintain professionalism in fast-paced environments.
  • High attention to detail with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Other important requirements:

  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
  • Must provide own steel-toed work boots; other PPE will be supplied.
  • Must be able to reliably commute to the work site daily or have plans to relocate before starting work.
  • Must be comfortable working a rotational schedule, which includes day and night shifts as well as weekend work, based on project needs.
  • Employees working night shifts will receive a 15% premium added to their hourly rate only for hours worked during night shifts.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a comprehensive, market-competitive total rewards package designed to support employees’ well-being, career advancement, and financial wealth. Our offerings reflect our commitment to Proceed with Purpose while rewarding high performance and long-term growth.

Compensation
  • The expected hourly rate for this role is $55.00 USD.

  • 15% night-shift premium for eligible roles, when applicable

  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance

Retirement & Financial Wealth

Time Off & Leave Programs

Growth & Development

title: Ostaja, T-DRILL Oy
description:
T-DRILL Oy on maailman johtavia putkentyöstökoneiden valmistajia ja ratkaisutoimittajia. Yrityksen patentoidut ratkaisut putken liitoksiin ja katkaisuun sekä putken pään muotoiluun soveltuvat lukuisiin teollisuussovellutuksiin eri asiakastoimialoille. T-DRILLin juuret ovat Suomessa, markkinat maailmalla. Tuotteita viedään vuosittain yli 50 maahan ja viennin osuus on 98 %. Pääkonttori sijaitsee Laihialla, osavalmistus Isossakyrössä ja tytäryhtiö Atlantassa, USA:ssa. Työntekijöitä on kaikkiaan n. 150. T-Drill Oy kuuluu Leinolat Group konserniin. Lue lisää T-DRILL ja Leinolat Group

T-DRILL Oy hakee hankinnan tiimiinsä ostajaa, joka haluaa kehittää toimittajayhteistyötä, vahvistaa toimitusvarmuutta ja rakentaa kustannustehokkaita ratkaisuja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Meillä avoimuus, yhteistyö ja yhdessä onnistuminen eivät ole pelkkiä sanoja, vaan arjen tapa toimia. Tässä tehtävässä tiimityö on luonnollinen osa jokaista päivää.

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Ostajana vastaat omasta toimittajaryhmästäsi ja sen pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä. Työsi ytimessä on toimittajayhteistyön vahvistaminen ja hankinnan kokonaisuuden kehittäminen.

Arjessasi kartoitat, arvioit ja valitset toimittajia sekä suunnittelet ja viet läpi neuvotteluja ja tarjousprosesseja. Vastaat sopimusasioista sekä seuraat kustannuksia, toimitusvarmuutta ja laatua sovittujen mittareiden mukaisesti. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tuotannon, suunnittelun ja laadun kanssa ja huolehdit, että hankintaketju toimii sujuvasti.

Seuraat markkinoita, arvioit riskejä ja kehität toimittajaverkostoa suunnitelmallisesti. Osallistut hankintaprosessin kehittämiseen ja viet kehitystoimia käytäntöön. Lisäksi vastaat ostotilausten tekemisestä, tilausvahvistusten käsittelystä ja toimitusten seurannasta, jotta kokonaisuus pysyy hallinnassa ja läpinäkyvänä.

Kyseessä on vakituinen kokopäivätyö liukuvalla työajalla (klo 6.30–9.00 / 15.00–17.00), työsuhde solmitaan suoraan T-DRILL Oy:n kanssa. Pääasiallinen työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee Laihialla ja sinulla on käytössäsi osittainen etätyömahdollisuus tai mahdollisuus ajoittaiseen työskentelyyn Seinäjoen toimipisteellämme.

Mitä etsimme?
Etsimme henkilöä, joka viihtyy yhteistyössä ja haluaa kehittää toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti. Toivomme sinulta kokemusta hankinnan, logistiikan tai toimitusketjun tehtävistä sekä ymmärrystä toimittajayhteistyöstä ja sopimusneuvotteluista. Arvostamme kykyä tarkastella kustannuksia, toimitusvarmuutta ja laatua kokonaisuutena sekä hyödyntää järjestelmiä ja dataa päätöksenteon tukena.

Työotteeltasi olet järjestelmällinen ja vastuullinen. Viet asiat loppuun saakka ja uskallat tarttua uusiin toimintatapoihin. Toimit avoimesti ja rakentavasti eri sidosryhmien kanssa, ja tiimityö on sinulle luonteva tapa onnistua.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, sillä toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä kotimaisten sidosryhmien sekä kansainvälisten toimittajien kanssa.

Mitä tarjoamme?
Tarjoamme sinulle paikan osaavassa ja yhteisöllisessä hankintatiimissä, jossa tukea ja sparrausta on aina saatavilla. Saat mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa yrityksen toimittajaverkoston ja hankinnan kehitykseen sekä jättää oman kädenjälkesi toimintatapojen kehittämiseen.

T-DRILL tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä kansainvälisessä yrityksessä, jossa luottamus, yhteistyö ja kollegoiden tuki näkyvät aidosti arjen tekemisessä. Pääset kehittämään osaamistasi uusimman teknologian parissa osana asiantuntevaa, rentoa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, jolle on myönnetty Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti.

Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten laajan työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa, ePassin liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin sekä mahdollisuuden käyttää kuntosalia. Meillä omaa osaamista arvostetaan ja kehittymishalua tuetaan pitkäjänteisesti.

Kiinnostuitko?
Laitahan hakemusta tulemaan! Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 9.9.2026. Hakuprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan T-DRILL Oy:n omille kirjoille.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä saat Johannalta Biisonilta, johanna.paloneva@biisoni.fi

title: Senior Transformation Lead
description:
Organisaties staan voor complexe opgaven op het gebied van digitalisering, wendbaarheid en schaalbaarheid. Denk aan grootschalige IT‑programma’s, nieuwe operating models, proces‑ en ketenoptimalisatie en veranderende vormen van samenwerking.

Als Senior Transformation Lead binnen de practice Transformation Management help jij organisaties om deze veranderingen integraal te begeleiden: van strategie en visie tot executie en borging. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol leiden van complexe (digitale) transformatie‑ en veranderprogramma’s en fungeert als trusted advisor voor senior stakeholders.

Deze rol draait om inhoud, leiderschap, delivery en samenwerking. Je staat zelf in het veld, stuurt teams en programma’s aan en bouwt actief mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze consulting‑praktijk.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan transformatieprogramma’s bij klanten in zowel de publieke als private sector. Afhankelijk van de context en je senioriteit vervul je rollen zoals transformation lead, programmamanager, projectdirecteur of strategisch adviseur.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Leiden van complexe digitale transformatieprogramma’s en ‑projecten, van visie tot uitvoering;
  • Vertalen van organisatiestrategie naar concrete initiatieven, roadmaps en programma‑structuren;
  • Adviseren van directie‑ en managementteams over digitale strategie, operating models en prioriteiten;
  • Aansturen en begeleiden van multidisciplinaire teams (consultants, klantteams, leveranciers);
  • Inrichten en bewaken van project‑ en programmasturing (scope, planning, budget, risico’s);
  • Stakeholdermanagement op strategisch niveau (senior management en C‑level;
  • Verbinden van processen, technologie, governance en organisatieverandering;

title: Product Manager UX Orchestration
description:
Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.


Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.
But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions.

Our Solutions:

→ Actirise: the display tech designed for performance
→ FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes
→ Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks
→ Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution
→ Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

  • FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.

  • We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins.

  • We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.

  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

The Mission

As the Product Manager UX Orchestration, you own the no-code configuration layer of the Actirise solution: the tools that let publishers activate ad formats, configure the video player, and set up the CMP/Paywall experience — without a single line of code. You are the guardian of a consistent, controlled self-serve experience across every surface: back-office, client-facing UI, native platform, and WordPress plugin alike.

Your mission: make configuration effortless for publishers while keeping Actirise in control of what's truly self-serve versus internally managed — turning orchestration into a growth lever, not an operational bottleneck.

Your key responsibilities:

1. No-Code Configuration Strategy

  • Define which configuration flows are self-serve vs. internally-managed, and design the framework that governs that boundary.

  • Own the roadmap for the tagging plan (ad format activation), enabling publishers to activate and manage formats without dev intervention.

  • Continuously simplify configuration paths — remove friction, reduce support tickets, increase adoption of self-serve tools.

2. Player & Video Catalog Configuration

  • Own the player template configuration experience: enable publishers to customize player behavior and appearance without engineering support.

  • Design and evolve the video catalog management tools (upload, organization, metadata) to keep the catalog scalable and easy to maintain.

3. CMP / Paywall Template Configuration

  • Own the CMP/Paywall template configuration layer to deliver an easy configuration experience that respects both constraints.

  • Ensure publishers can configure consent/paywall templates consistently, regardless of the surface they use.

4. Cross-Surface Consistency

  • Guarantee that the configuration experience is coherent whether accessed via back-office, client-facing platform, or the WordPress plugin.

  • Ensure design system application to keep configuration UI patterns consistent across surfaces.

  • Define and maintain clean data contracts and ACLs for every configuration action.

5. Agentic Exposure

  • Apply an agentic-first principle to every configuration capability: whatever a publisher or an internal user can do through the UI must also be executable by an AI agent not just clickable in a screen.

  • Continuously audit existing configuration flows to close the human/agent parity gap ("can an agent already do what a human can do here?") and prioritize closing the biggest gaps.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sparteo Account squad to ensure configuration is part of a smooth time-to-activation journey.

  • Coordinate with PM Engagement on shared UI/UX and compliance boundaries.

  • Partner with Tech/Engineering to ship configuration tools that are reliable, fast, and scalable.

The Profile We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is obsessed with simplicity and control at the same time — who believes a great configuration tool should feel invisible to the person using it.

  • PM Expertise: 3+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally on self-serve platforms, admin/back-office tools, or no-code/configuration products.

  • UX Sensibility: Strong instinct for simplifying complex configuration flows into intuitive, guided experiences. Comfortable partnering with design systems.

  • Technical Literacy: Understanding of API-first design, WordPress plugin environments. You don't need to code, but you need to speak engineering's language.

  • Systems Thinker: Able to design frameworks (self-serve vs. managed) rather than one-off features — you think in guardrails, permissions, and consistency across surfaces.

  • Cross-Functional Operator: Comfortable working at the intersection of multiple squads where boundaries require coordination, not competition.

  • Agentic Mindset: Naturally designs every capability with a dual interface in mind — human UI and agent-executable action. Understands agent tool-calling patterns and can define clean, well-scoped tool interfaces rather than exposing raw UI logic.

  • AdTech / Video Culture: Familiarity with ad format activation, video players, or CMP/consent tooling is a strong plus.

  • Communication: Excellent communication skills — you can align Tech, Design, and client-facing teams around a shared configuration vision.

  • A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints. You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.

  • 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process!

Here are the stages in our recruitment process

  • Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  • Analytical and business logic tests

  • Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager

  • Taking up references

Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

RTX Corporation is an Aerospace and Defense company that provides advanced systems and services for commercial, military and government customers worldwide. It comprises three industry-leading businesses – Collins Aerospace Systems, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon. Its 185,000 employees enable the company to operate at the edge of known science as they imagine and deliver solutions that push the boundaries in quantum physics, electric propulsion, directed energy, hypersonics, avionics and cybersecurity. The company, formed in 2020 through the combination of Raytheon Company and the United Technologies Corporation aerospace businesses, is headquartered in Arlington, VA.

What You Will Do

Discover an extraordinary opportunity to accelerate your engineering career and develop into a future operational leader at RTX. Our Operations Leadership Development Program (OLDP)-Quality Engineering Track provides challenging, high-visibility assignments across the enterprise, allowing you to build a powerful global network. You will receive high-caliber training, professional mentoring, and frontline, hands-on engineering experience directly on our manufacturing shop floors. This fast-paced path expands your business acumen, sharpens your technical expertise, and prepares you to make a lasting impact on our global operations. Actively recruiting for the next cohort and program that begins June 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete three 8-month rotational assignments across various U.S. locations, adapting quickly to new manufacturing facilities, business units, and operational quality teams.
  • Execute core engineering duties and technical milestones within one or more specialized quality disciplines, including Operations Quality, Supplier Quality, Regulatory Compliance, Escape Management, Continuous Improvement, and Customer/Program Quality.
  • Participate in frontline, hands-on shop floor assignments to identify, analyze, and resolve technical quality challenges.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and drive performance, process safety, and product quality improvements across production environments and development labs.
  • Support regulatory compliance audits, escape management investigations, and root-cause analysis to ensure product integrity and minimize operational risk.
  • Leverage engineering and data analytics tools to optimize quality planning, evaluate operational metrics, and eliminate process waste.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) major. Degree must be obtained by start date.
  • Willing and able to operationally relocate to various RTX geographic locations across the United States for three distinct 8-month program assignments.
  • Experience using data analysis and discrete event simulation tools—such as advanced Excel (including pivot tables and macros/VBA), Minitab, Power BI, Simio, FlexSim, or MATLAB
  • Experience applying continuous improvement methodologies and core quality tools, such as 8D structured problem solving, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Control Plans, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kaizen events, or 5S implementation frameworks or other relevant methods and tools.
  • Relevant internship/co-op or work experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations quality, production environment or related experience

Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • Clear, honest, and proactive communication style with the capability to contribute constructively to cross-functional team discussions.
  • Quick learner with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, prioritize tasks strategically, and remain completely committed to operational objectives.
  • Proven leadership capability paired with strong decision-making skills and a highly collaborative mindset.
  • Strong analytical problem-solver who naturally challenges existing processes and thinks critically to develop innovative engineering solutions.
  • Self-motivated and team-oriented work style with the agility to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic manufacturing environment.
  • Prior RTX internship, co-op, or work experience

What We Offer

  • Whether you’re just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement and work/life benefits; career development and recognition programs. Some of the benefits we offer include parental (including paternal) leave, flexible work schedules, achievement awards, educational assistance and child/adult backup care
  • RTX leadership, functional and business acumen training
  • Upon program completion, LDP graduates possess a solid platform of skills & experiences to launch a successful RTX career & receive continued mentorship

Learn More & Apply Now!

  • Applicants MUST be willing/able to relocate for all rotations & have flexibility to travel/live anywhere
  • Click and scroll to download a LDP Overview and map of onsite locations
  • Rotation locations will vary & may be onsite, hybrid, or remote

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 59,000 USD - 139,000 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.

Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

title: Account Director
description:
ACCOUNT DIRECTOR

We’re looking for an experienced Account Director to help lead a multi-market and culture-embedded home furnishing brand and their creative and varied creator-led campaigns powering the brand’s presence across multiple global markets.

This is a key leadership role at the centre of their creator output. You’ll shape a creator-led content engine, spanning TikTok and Instagram activity through to culture-led campaigns, collaborations and more. The team delivers locally relevant creator campaigns whilst maintaining a consistent global brand identity.

Sitting at the intersection creator marketing and cultural storytelling, this role plays a key part in evolving the client - identifying opportunities to expand, deepen partnerships and scale impact.

It’s ideal for someone who is genuinely passionate about social-first thinking, creators and culture, and who thrives on turning platform insight into standout content and commercial growth.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead senior client relationships across global and local stakeholders

  • Own the creator ecosystem and ensure consistent, high-performing output

  • Strong strategic and creative judgement: able to shape, elevate and push creator-first ideas

  • Strong performance and growth mindset: confident using insights to optimise content, demonstrate impact and identify opportunities to grow the account

  • Proven experience delivering social-first, creator-led programmes, including influencer strategy and campaign execution

OUR VALUES

title: Head of Commercial Development
description:
Role: Head of Commercial Development

Reports to: Customer and Commercial Director

Location: Leeds / Hybrid

Magnet Group is going through a period of real transformation, and this role sits right at the heart of it. As Head of Commercial Development, you'll lead the specialist function that gives our Retail, Projects and B2B businesses the commercial frameworks, tools and insight they need to grow profitably and trade smarter.

This is a senior, high-impact role for someone with strong commercial acumen and the influencing skills to match - you'll be working closely with senior leaders across the business, shaping strategy and turning it into action. It's not just about setting direction; it's about getting things done, embedding commercial discipline and driving measurable results across a complex, matrixed organisation. You'll also lead a team, so strong people leadership matters as much as commercial firepower.

What you'll be doing

  • Setting the strategy - developing a commercial development strategy aligned to Magnet's wider business goals, and working with senior leadership to spot and deliver profitable growth across Retail, Projects and Partnerships.

  • Building commercial capability - creating the frameworks, governance and tools that improve pricing, proposition development, category optimisation and investment decisions across the business.

  • Shaping our propositions - leading the development and ongoing optimisation of Magnet's commercial propositions, backed by market, customer and competitor insight.

  • Owning market and competitive insight - overseeing the collection and analysis of market, customer and competitor data, and translating it into commercial recommendations that drive growth and competitive advantage.

  • Partnering with the business - acting as the go-to commercial partner for Retail, Projects and Partnerships, including strengthening propositions for housebuilders, developers and commercial customers, and developing compelling commercial models for strategic partners.

  • Driving performance - establishing KPIs and dashboards, reporting to senior stakeholders, and making sure commercial initiatives deliver real financial and customer benefit.

  • Spotting opportunity and driving innovation - identifying new routes to market, partnerships and revenue streams, evaluating emerging retail trends and technologies, and building the business cases to back strategic investment.

  • Leading and developing your team - managing a team, setting clear direction, building their commercial capability and creating a culture of high-quality execution and constructive challenge.

  • Influencing at pace - working across Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Product and the wider business to embed commercial thinking into everyday decision-making.

Who we’re looking for:

  • Experience in commercial strategy, trading, category management or business development in a senior leadership role.

  • Background in a merchant or retail business is essential - ideally retail, given the pace and customer proximity of the environment we operate in.

  • A strong track record of building and executing commercial strategies that deliver profitable, sustainable growth.

  • Real depth in pricing, proposition development, commercial planning and working capital optimisation.

  • Exceptional strategic and analytical thinking, paired with strong financial acumen.

  • The gravitas and influencing skills to work with, and get buy-in from, senior stakeholders across a large, matrixed organisation.

  • Proven experience leading and developing a small team, with a genuinely hands-on approach to coaching and people leadership.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset - someone who challenges convention and isn't afraid to make the case for change.

  • A degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Finance or equivalent; an MBA or relevant commercial qualification is a plus.

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive salary, Car Allowance, 20% bonus and Private Medical Insurance

  • Fantastic company discounts: Up to 80% off our stylish kitchen ranges and products

  • Access to Retail Trust

  • Flexible holidays: Buy up to five extra days with our holiday purchase scheme

  • Wellbeing support: Access to our virtual GP service and employee assistance platform 24/7

  • Lifestyle perks: Cycle to work scheme and savings on hundreds of top brands via our benefits app

  • A collaborative culture built on care, inclusion, and continuous improvement

Why choose Magnet?

At Magnet, we bring over 100 years of heritage, but our focus is firmly on the future. As the UK's leading kitchen specialist, our success is driven by the expertise, insight and innovation of our people - and right now, we're evolving how we work, grow and deliver for our customers, with real momentum behind the change.

This role sits right at the heart of that. It's a rare opportunity to shape commercial strategy with real visibility at senior level and genuine scope to influence Magnet's future. If you're commercially sharp, comfortable operating strategically, and know how to turn plans into delivery, we'd love to hear from you - and because we're always open to fresh thinking and new perspectives, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match, we'd still encourage you to apply.

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:

Are you a JavaScript engineer who thrives on understanding how things work under the hood rather than just gluing framework APIs together? Do you get excited about low-level engine mechanics, browser internals, and designing resilient, high-availability systems that handle serious data volumes?

We value a go-getter attitude, a drive to get things done, and the empathy to truly understand our clients’ needs. Our team takes pride in working hard – and having fun while doing it. We believe in the power of collaboration and bringing like-minded people together to build great things.

Your role

As a Senior Full Stack JavaScript Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain high-availability systems handling large data volumes with strict uptime requirements. You will take ownership of backend services end-to-end, drive core system architectures, and ensure high engineering standards across the stack.

We are looking for an engineer who possesses a deep, foundational understanding of core JavaScript and TypeScript principles without relying heavily on abstract frameworks. You know what happens under the hood, from browser mechanics to backend runtime execution and you bring strong Computer Science fundamentals to solve complex scalability and performance challenges.

Tech stack & Core concepts

  • Languages/Frameworks: Modern JavaScript (Vanilla JS), TypeScript, Node.js

  • Architecture & Backend: Distributed Systems, Event/Data Streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.), Messaging Queues (RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.)

  • DevOps & Infra: Docker/Containers, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • Fundamentals: Data structures, algorithms, browser engines/inner workings

What we expect

Core technical expertise

  • Vanilla JavaScript & TypeScript Deep Understanding: True mastery of core JS/TS concepts, event loops, memory management, and browser inner workings beyond just using framework-level abstractions.

  • High Availability & Distributed Systems: Proven, hands-on experience designing, building, and operating high-availability backend systems in production handling large data volumes.

  • Event & Message Architectures: Strong familiarity with event/data streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) or message queue systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, SQS).

  • DevOps Ownership: Comfortable with containerization, building modern CI/CD pipelines, and working with Infrastructure as Code.

Ways of working

  • LLM Tooling & AI-Assisted Development: Good leverage of LLM tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to enhance productivity within your daily engineering workflow.

  • Engineering Excellence: Ability to take complete ownership of complex subsystems, mentor team members, and communicate technical decisions clearly.

Optional Advantage (nice to have)

  • Experience with performance optimization at scale.

  • Prior involvement in architecting event-driven microservices architectures.

  • A CS degree (or equivalent practical experience) with a solid grasp of core data structures (e.g., binary trees, hash maps) and the ability to articulate trade-offs and real-world application scenarios.

What we offer

  • Choose how you work: Remote-first culture with the option to work remotely, hybrid, or on-site (Croatia, Serbia, or Bosnia and Herzegovina).

  • Flexible working hours: Balance your work and life on terms that suit you best.

  • Growth & Mentorship: Opportunity to work on complex, high-scale global projects with modern tools and continuous learning opportunities.

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Private health insurance and 100% paid sick leave.

  • Financial Perks: Third-pillar retirement savings, referral rewards, seasonal bonuses, and travel allowances.

  • Well-being & Community: Subsidized sports cards (MultiSport/PassSport), internal workshops, meetups, and team-building events.

Salary range

title: Tuotantotyöntekijä, Steelcomp Oy
description:
Steelcomp on ensiluokkaista palvelua ja korkeatasoisia metallitöitä tarjoava nykyaikainen metallipaja ja sopimusvalmistaja. Vahvuutemme on alan pitkässä kokemuksessa sekä asiakaslähtöisessä asenteessa. Henkilökohtainen palvelu sekä pitkälle automatisoitu konekantamme takaavat laadukkaan ja luotettavan palvelun joka kerta.

Tarjoamme kokonaisvaltaista valmistuskumppanuutta aina ohutlevytuotteiden osavalmistuksesta hitsattuihin teräsrakenteisiin ja tuotekokoonpanoihin. Haluamme olla osa tuotteenne elinkaarta ja varmistaa omalta osaltamme lopputuotteenne erinomaisen laadun. Vaalimme pitkäikäisiä asiakassuhteita, ja siksi teemme kaikenlaiset metallityöt aina laadusta tinkimättä. Toimimme Vaasassa ja Kauhavalla ja palvelemme asiakkaitamme ympäri Suomen.

Etsimme Steelcompille kahta tuotantotyöntekijää Kauhavalle

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?

Työtehtävät koostuvat särmäyksen avustavista tehtävistä kokeneemman ammattilaisen rinnalla. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka avulla pääset vähitellen ottamaan enemmän vastuuta ja kehittymään itsenäiseksi särmääjäksi. Steelcompilla panostetaan henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämiseen, ja tehtävä tarjoaa erinomaisen mahdollisuuden oppia arvostettu metallialan ammatti pitkällä tähtäimellä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Arvostamme ennen kaikkea oma-aloitteista työotetta, oppimishalukkuutta ja sitoutumista työhön. Aiempaa kokemusta metallialalta ei vaadita, mutta tekninen kiinnostus, käytännönläheisyys sekä hyvä 3D-hahmotuskyky auttavat tehtävässä onnistumisessa. Suomen kielen taito on työssä tarpeellinen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Steelcomp tarjoaa mahdollisuuden vakituiseen ja pitkäaikaiseen työhön vakaassa yrityksessä, jolla on hyvät tulevaisuuden näkymät. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kokeneiden kollegoiden tuen, joten pääset rauhassa oppimaan uuden ammatin ja kehittämään osaamistasi.

Työtä tehdään kaksivuorotyössä. Aamuvuoro on klo 6.00-14.00 ja iltavuoro klo 14.00-24.00 maanantaista torstaihin, jolloin perjantait ovat vapaita. Käytössä ovat myös liukuvat työajat, ja työnantaja tunnetaan joustavasta toimintatavastaan.

Työsuhde solmitaan vakituisena Biisonin kanssa, ja työ tehdään Steelcomp Oy:n tuotannossa.

Työympäristö on siisti, moderni ja työntekijät huomioiden suunniteltu. Steelcompilla viihdytään pitkään, ja yritys panostaa henkilöstönsä osaamisen kehittämiseen sekä pitkien työurien rakentamiseen.

Hakuprosessi:

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 10.9.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Susanna Tallbacka, puh. 050 471 4129 tai sähköpostitse susanna.tallbacka@biisoni.fi.

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

Pratt & Whitney Compression Systems Engineering (CSE) team is looking for an experienced and highly motivated Project Engineering Professional. The Project Engineer will be responsible for part-level ownership, task planning, and execution to ensure the IPT achieves goals for the Component Integrated Product Team (CIPT). The IPT has responsibility for the entire life cycle of the part and as such the Project Engineer will be engaged in activities ranging from validation testing to Engineering Changes, from production delivery support to field support and investigations. Qualified candidates need to be able to effectively lead a team of individuals to meet requirements and achieve goals. Candidates need to be technically proficient, communicate effectively, and be customer focused.

  • Provide project management and leadership to the Integrated Product Team (IPT) that includes design, structural, durability, aero, materials and manufacturing engineers.

  • Lead the IPT through successful technical and program reviews, including the management and closure of key technical risks and issues

  • Plan and manage IPT budgets, schedule, and technical metrics to requirements in collaboration with the CIPT.

  • Be accountable to CIPT for part level ownership, including communication, risk management, and execution to program requirements.

  • Participate with the CIPT in communicating to engineering and program management.

  • Coordinating designs (Engineering Changes), Fabrication (manufacturing/suppliers/vendor trips), validation (Engine Build-Test-Teardown, ACIs- Analytical Condition Inspection, FMRs- Failure Malfunction Report), and sustainment (Component Field Limits, Merlins-Field Inquiries, Deviation Requests) activities.

  • Travel is up to 10%.

  • English (read, write, speak) is required when communicating with customers, co-workers, or supervisors who only speak English.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.

  • 8 years of engineering experience or an Advanced degree in Engineering or MBA with 5 years of experience

  • 4 years of project engineering or project management experience

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Minor in Aerospace.

  • Project Management Certification

  • Trained CAM & Proficiency with Teamcenter, MS Project or other scheduling software and SAP

  • Demonstrated successful experience using Agile

  • Engineering experience in design, manufacture, development, validation, entry into service and support of field service issues.

  • Demonstrated success in leading multi-functional teams and effectiveness in working across functions, organizations, and levels of management.

  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets and schedules.

  • Focus on results with the ability to drive projects to successful completion.

  • Experience executing Engineering Changes through the Product Change and Incorporation Review process (PCIR).

  • Demonstration of skills consistent with the Pratt & Whitney Leadership Operating Model.

  • Working knowledge of continuous improvement principles (e.g., CORE, QCPC, Process Certification).

What We Offer:

  • Employee Scholar Program

Learn More & Apply Now!

  • Compression Systems Engineering is responsible for the design, development, and in service support of all fans low-pressure and high-pressure compressors for commercial and military engine models. CSE is responsible for the identification and maturation of new technologies for these products.
