title: Senior Azure Platform Engineer
description:
The opportunity

We are continuing a significant transformation of our technology estate, moving towards a predominantly cloud-native operating model built around Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Fabric and the wider Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

The Senior Azure Platform Engineer will therefore provide broad Azure platform engineering capability while also developing sufficient depth within Microsoft Fabric and data-platform technologies to provide resilience alongside our existing Cloud & Data Engineer.

The role offers:

  • Significant ownership of a growing Azure environment.

  • Hands-on involvement with Microsoft Fabric as it becomes a core enterprise data platform.

  • The opportunity to shape our cloud engineering standards and practices.

  • Significant scope for Infrastructure as Code and automation.

  • Exposure to identity, networking, security, data, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform technologies.

  • Direct involvement in cloud architecture and technology decision-making.

  • The opportunity to lead technical projects rather than simply receive implementation tasks.

  • A modernisation programme progressively reducing reliance on legacy and on-premises infrastructure.

  • Close working relationships with senior IT leadership, engineers, data specialists and external technology partners.

  • A senior technical career path that does not require moving into people management.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Azure Platform Engineering

Design, implement, maintain and improve services across the Azure estate. The role is not expected to personally administer every Microsoft technology but should have sufficient breadth to understand how services interact across a modern Microsoft cloud environment.

Microsoft Fabric & Data Platform

Work alongside the existing Cloud & Data Engineer to provide engineering resilience for Microsoft Fabric. The role is not intended to replace BI developers or become responsible for business reporting and visualisation. Instead, it supports the engineering platform on which those capabilities operate.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation, Integration

Help move the organisation towards repeatable, controlled and automated infrastructure management. The engineer should actively look for opportunities to replace fragile manual processes with reliable automation.

Identity, Security & Governance

Work with IT leadership and other technology teams to ensure Azure platforms are appropriately secured and governed. The engineer will be responsible for technical implementation of security controls, working alongside governance and assurance functions rather than replacing them.

Technical Project Delivery

Take technical ownership of projects and workstreams.

Operational Engineering

Although primarily an engineering/project role, the position will also act as a senior escalation point for complex platform issues. This is not intended to be a traditional infrastructure support position, but senior engineers are expected to retain operational ownership of the platforms they build.

Technical Skills

We are particularly interested in experience across the following areas.

Azure

  • Azure architecture and administration.

  • Azure networking.

  • Azure identity and RBAC.

  • Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.

  • Azure Policy and governance.

  • Key Vault.

  • Private networking and Private Endpoints.

  • Azure security and Defender.

  • Azure storage and platform services.

  • Backup, resilience and disaster recovery concepts.

Engineering & Automation

  • Terraform and/or Bicep.

  • PowerShell.

  • Azure CLI.

  • Git.

  • CI/CD.

  • Infrastructure as Code.

  • Automated deployment and configuration management.

  • DevOps engineering practices.

Data Platforms

Experience with some combination of:

  • Microsoft Fabric.

  • Azure Databricks.

  • Azure Synapse.

  • Data Lake technologies.

  • Data pipelines and orchestration.

  • Notebooks.

  • Medallion/lakehouse architecture.

  • Data-platform security and identity.

  • Deployment and environment-management patterns.

Microsoft Cloud

Useful wider exposure includes:

  • Microsoft Entra ID.

  • Microsoft 365.

  • Microsoft Defender.

  • Power Platform.

  • Microsoft Purview.

  • Power BI/Fabric integration.

  • Deep expertise across every Microsoft service is not expected.

title: SENIOR IT ANALYST – ADIP SUSTAINMENT, SECURITY & REGULATORY LEAD
description:
At OAS, we deliver innovative solutions that advance mission success for federal agencies. Our team combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to collaboration, integrity, and excellence. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and the ability to contribute to critical aviation modernization efforts that impact the National Airspace System.

Join Objective Area Solutions

Objective Area Solutions (OAS) is seeking an experienced Senior IT Analyst to support the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Airports Data and Information Portal (ADIP). This senior technical leadership position supports ADIP sustainment, development, security and privacy, and advisory and regulatory activities across the application portfolio. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience leading operations and maintenance for enterprise or cloud-connected systems, maintaining federal cybersecurity authorization and privacy documentation, coordinating cross-functional technical teams, and developing regulatory or policy guidance. This role helps ensure ADIP remains reliable, secure, compliant, and responsive to FAA and airport stakeholder needs across the National Airspace System (NAS).

Primary Responsibilities

ADIP Sustainment, Development & Support

  • Provide senior program oversight and operational and technical direction for the ADIP portfolio using Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
  • Oversee operations and maintenance across development, test, and production environments, including system monitoring, optimization, and technical issue resolution.
  • Direct maintenance of APIs, web services, integrations, data quality processes, performance metrics, and operational reporting.
  • Maintain and update system documentation, including the Project Management Plan (PMP), Functional Requirements Document (FRD), System Design Document (SDD), Interface Control Document (ICD), installation guides, release notes, and user guides, on FAA-approved sites.
  • Support release planning, readiness reviews, deployment coordination, and release automation in collaboration with the AIT Production Support team.
  • Coordinate across engineering, development, security, data, and program teams to ensure deliverables are accurate, complete, timely, and provided in COR-approved formats.

Security & Privacy Support

  • Develop, update, and maintain federal security and privacy documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Privacy Threshold Analysis (PTA), Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA), Security Development Approach (SDA), and Security Concept of Operations or related security documentation.
  • Support Certification and Accreditation activities and maintain the system's Authority to Operate (ATO).
  • Manage Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) in the DOT FISMA inventory or Cyber Security Assessment and Management system (CSAM).
  • Conduct or support security impact analyses, security control assessments, vulnerability reviews, and remediation planning.
  • Prioritize and track flaw remediation activities in accordance with applicable NIST requirements, FAA Order 1370.121B, SI-2 Flaw Remediation, and the DOT Security Weakness Management Guide.
  • Coordinate security and privacy requirements with technical teams to maintain compliance throughout the system lifecycle.

Advisory & Regulatory Support

  • Provide technical writing support for the development, revision, and maintenance of FAA airport and ADIP guidance documents.
  • Draft and update technical content supporting AC 150/5300-16, AC 150/5300-17, AC 150/5300-18, AC 150/5300-19, FAA Order 5010.4, Engineering Briefs, and Engineering Memorandums.
  • Coordinate reviews with program, technical, security, regulatory, and stakeholder teams as applicable.
  • Submit all draft deliverables for COR review and approval before publication or implementation.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Systems, Management Information Systems, IT Management, or another IT-related field. Degrees in Engineering, Mathematics, or Science may also be acceptable.

Experience

  • Fifteen (15) or more years of relevant professional experience in information technology, systems analysis, enterprise application support, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory support, or a related technical discipline.

Demonstrated Experience

  • Operations and maintenance of enterprise, cloud-connected, or hybrid IT platforms and web applications.
  • Federal information security and privacy programs, including ATO sustainment, POA&M management, security documentation, and NIST or FISMA compliance.
  • Security control assessment, vulnerability prioritization, remediation tracking, and security impact analysis.
  • SDLC and Agile delivery, configuration management, release management, and cross-functional technical coordination.
  • Technical writing and development of federal regulatory, policy, advisory, security, or program guidance documentation.
  • Preparation and delivery of accurate, timely, and compliant technical deliverables for government review and approval.
  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application sustainment, system integration, cloud-connected environments, and operational performance management.
  • Knowledge of federal cybersecurity and privacy frameworks, including NIST controls, FISMA, ATO processes, POA&Ms, and FedRAMP concepts.
  • Knowledge of FAA Order 1370.121B, FAA AIT software development guidance, and federal security weakness management practices.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility and WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards.
  • Ability to lead ADIP sustainment, security and privacy, and advisory and regulatory activities concurrently.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and translate technical, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements into actionable deliverables.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, technical writing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting the FAA, U.S. Department of Transportation, or another federal aviation, airport, transportation, or data program.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead for a federal enterprise system or multi-application portfolio.
  • Familiarity with airport data systems, aeronautical information, and geospatial or GIS data management.
  • Familiarity with FAA airport regulatory guidance, including FAA Order 5010.4 and the AC 150/5300 series.
  • Experience using DOT or federal cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance tools such as CSAM.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, ITIL, CompTIA Security+, CISM, PMP, or comparable credentials.

Location: Remote within the DC area

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary Range: $119,000 - $152,000

Clearance Requirement: Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance. FAA PIV card and access to Sensitive Unclassified Information (SUI) required.

title: 3rd Shift Smoke Master
description:

Smokemaster

Seltzer's Smokehouse is looking for our next Smokemaster as we head into a new chapter in our amazing story! This isn't your typical manufacturing job. As a Smokemaster, you'll play an essential role in creating traditionally smoked products by carefully managing our smokehouses, tending wood fires and monitoring each batch throughout the smoking process.

With a renewed vision from our next generation CEO, the iconic Seltzer's brand is preparing for national expansion through innovation, creativity, and forward thinking.

Role: Reporting to the Smokehouse Supervisor, you'll combine hands-on craftsmanship with precision-monitoring temperatures, measuring pH levels and maintaining accurate production records to ensure every product meets our high standards for safety, quality and flavor.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and record smokehouse and product temperatures every two hours
  • Take pH readings and determine when additional wood is needed
  • Tend and maintain wood-burning smokehouse fires
  • Verify the accuracy of smokehouse temperature probes
  • Calibrate and properly maintain the pH meter
  • Transport wood from outside storage and maintain an adequate supply for production
  • Accurately complete required food safety and production documentation
  • Support sanitation activities on second and third shifts when needed
  • Follow all food safety, food defense, GMP and workplace safety procedures
  • Communicate concerns or unusual readings promptly to the Smokehouse Supervisor

What We're Looking For

  • Dependable, detail-oriented and comfortable working independently
  • Strong observation, problem-solving and recordkeeping skills
  • Clear and effective communication
  • Comfortable using basic computers and production technology
  • Able to work in environments with varying temperatures
  • Able to safely perform the physical duties associated with transporting and handling wood
  • Flexible and willing to work evenings, nights, weekends or holidays when production requires it
  • Reliable transportation and consistent attendance

Preferred-but Not Required

  • Previous food manufacturing, production or warehouse experience
  • Experience using forklifts or pallet jacks
  • Familiarity with temperature monitoring, pH testing or food safety procedures

Experience is helpful, but reliability, attention to detail and a willingness to learn are what matter most. We'll teach the right person how to master the process.

We look for employees who effective, clear, and concise communication skills, computer/technology literacy and problem-solving skills. You must have day to day flexibility and be able to work in varying temperatures. The hours for this position are from 9:30 PM until 6:00 AM each week night.

If you take pride in hands-on work and want to help preserve a time-honored smoking tradition, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to become our next Smokemaster!

title: People Generalist
description:

We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.

We're now looking for a People Generalist to join our global People team and become our primary People representative in New York.


About the role

While most of our People team is based in Stockholm, you'll be our local People presence in the US, working closely with employees, managers, and key stakeholders in New York while collaborating with colleagues across our global organization.

You'll support our growing US team of 30+ employees, while also coordinating employment matters for our international employees through our Employer of Record (EOR) partners. From onboarding and benefits to employee support, workplace experience, and local office operations, you'll play an important role in creating a positive employee experience.

We're looking for someone who enjoys being the go-to person for employees. You're proactive, service-minded, and equally comfortable answering a benefits question, coordinating a new hire's first day, improving a People process, or helping make our New York office a welcoming place to work.

  • Act as the primary People contact for employees and managers in the US.

  • Manage the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employment changes, and HR documentation.

  • Administer US benefits, including annual renewals, enrollments, and employee support.

  • Support employees and managers with HR-related questions, policies, and day-to-day employment matters.

  • Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Payroll, and external partners to ensure compliant and efficient People processes.

Global Employment Operations

  • Support onboarding, offboarding, employment changes, and international employment setups.

  • Partner with EOR providers to ensure a smooth employee experience for our international employees.

  • Support consistent and compliant employment processes across our international workforce.

  • Support local onboarding, employee engagement initiatives, office events, and visitors.

  • Help create a welcoming, well-functioning workplace that reflects our culture and values.

People Operations

  • Maintain accurate employee data and HR systems.

  • Contribute to improving People processes, documentation, and ways of working.

  • Support global People initiatives as required.

What skills and experience we think you have

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in HR, People Operations, or a broad HR Generalist role.

  • A good understanding of US employment practices and benefits administration.

  • Experience supporting employees throughout the employee lifecycle.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • A proactive, flexible, and service-oriented mindset.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Experience with EOR providers or international employment is a plus.

  • Experience or interest in employer branding is a plus.

  • Experience working with HR systems such as HiBob, Deel, or similar is a plus.


Working at Natural Cycles

This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact as the local extension of our global People team. You'll work closely with colleagues in Stockholm while building strong relationships with employees and stakeholders across our New York office.

Although we work in a hybrid environment, this role requires regular on-site presence in our New York office (typically 2–3 days per week) to support employees, workplace operations, visitors, and other office activities. We're therefore looking for someone who is based within an easy commuting distance of our Manhattan office.

If you're excited about creating a great employee experience, enjoy working in a collaborative international environment, and love being the person others can rely on, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work

Sounds interesting?

If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.

title: Restoration Project Manager
description:
Restoration Project Manager

Pulliam Restoration – Columbia, SC
Full-Time | Hourly | Company Vehicle

Pulliam Restoration is seeking an experienced Restoration Project Manager to manage residential and commercial restoration projects throughout the Midlands and surrounding areas.

This is a hands-on project management position for someone who takes ownership of their work. Our Project Managers are responsible for assigned projects from initial response through completion and turnover for billing. This includes managing the scope, schedule, crews, equipment, subcontractors, customer communication, documentation, quality, and financial performance of each project.

We are looking for someone who can manage projects effectively while also leading and developing the people performing the work.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Manage restoration projects from initial response through completion.
  • Develop and execute project scopes, schedules, and work plans.
  • Coordinate technicians, Crew Chiefs, equipment, materials, subcontractors, and other project resources.
  • Monitor project progress, costs, labor, equipment usage, and overall financial performance.
  • Identify and address scope changes, delays, documentation issues, and other project problems before they become larger issues.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with customers, adjusters, consultants, property representatives, subcontractors, and internal teams.
  • Ensure project documentation is complete, accurate, and timely.
  • Review field work for quality, technical correctness, productivity, and compliance with Pulliam standards.
  • Lead, coach, and develop technicians and Crew Chiefs assigned to your projects.
  • Ensure completed projects are promptly and completely turned over for review and billing.
  • Participate in the Project Manager on-call rotation and emergency response when assigned.

What We're Looking For

We are interested in candidates with restoration, construction, mitigation, or related project-management experience. Direct restoration experience is strongly preferred.

A strong candidate will have:

  • Experience independently managing projects, crews, schedules, and customers.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage multiple active projects and changing priorities.
  • A sense of urgency and willingness to take ownership rather than wait for direction.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing technicians, subcontractors, or field crews.
  • An understanding of job costing, labor and material management, and project profitability.
  • The ability to identify problems early and take action to resolve them.
  • A track record of dependability and follow-through.
  • A willingness to coach and develop less-experienced team members.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where emergency projects can affect the planned schedule.

Experience with Xactimate, restoration documentation, water mitigation, fire/smoke restoration, mold remediation, structural drying, and reconstruction is valuable but will be evaluated based on actual depth of experience.

IICRC certifications are preferred but not required for an otherwise strong candidate.

Who Does Well at Pulliam

Technical knowledge matters, but so does how you work.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Cares about people and treats others appropriately.
  • Works with a genuine sense of urgency.
  • Pays attention to details and comes prepared.
  • Maintains a productive attitude when projects become difficult.
  • Is available and dependable when the team needs them.
  • Accepts accountability for mistakes and learns from them.
  • Wants to continue growing professionally.
  • Takes pride in both the quality of the finished work and the performance of the project.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation based on experience
  • Overtime eligibility
  • Performance/incentive opportunities
  • Company vehicle and fuel card
  • Company cell phone
  • Company laptop
  • PTO and company benefits
  • Company-provided tools, equipment, PPE, apparel, and safety footwear as applicable
  • Training and professional-development opportunities

About Pulliam Restoration

Pulliam Restoration is a Columbia-based restoration contractor serving commercial and residential customers. Our work includes emergency water mitigation, structural drying, fire and smoke restoration, mold remediation, reconstruction, and complex commercial restoration projects.

We operate using the EOS® framework and believe strongly in accountability, clear expectations, continuous improvement, and developing people. Our Project Managers are expected not only to successfully complete projects, but to help build stronger teams underneath them.

Schedule: Full-time. This position includes participation in an on-call rotation and may require evenings, weekends, travel, and extended hours based on emergency project needs.

Location: Columbia, South Carolina

title: Senior Product Manager - Asphalt Legends
description:
Job description

As Senior Product Manager for Asphalt Legends, you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.

Together with the Game Manager and key stakeholders, you will orchestrate the revenue strategy across the product lifecycle, balancing aggressive growth in engagement and monetization with AAA player experience.

You are not just managing a product; you are scaling a global racing phenomenon.

YOUR CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Vision: Partner with Game Leadership (Game Manager, Design, and Marketing) to define the roadmap for future years, ensuring the game’s vision aligns with aggressive commercial targets.
  • Live Ops Excellence: Drive a high-performance Live Operations strategy focused on two pillars:
    • Data-Driven Growth: Continuous optimization of events and offers to maximize LTV and ARPU.
    • Operational Efficiency: Streamlining workflows and automating processes to reduce production times and costs.
  • Monetization Innovation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of new monetization systems—from conceptual design to post-launch optimization—while constantly auditing existing systems for untapped potential.
  • Data Leadership: Lead hypothesis-driven development by overseeing A/B testing, deep-dive data analysis, and KPI forecasting models to de-risk major business decisions.
  • Mentorship & Influence: Act as a force multiplier for the product team, mentoring junior PMs and fostering a culture of excellence.
  • Organizational Evangelist: Serve as the primary business voice for Asphalt 9 to internal and external stakeholders, elevating the game’s profile across the entire organization.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience in Product Management of F2P games (Mobile, PC, or Console).
  • Proven Impact. A track record of significantly moving the needle on monetization and retention for top-tier live titles.
  • Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected.
  • Excellent presentation and documentation skills, with the ability to distill complex strategies into compelling narratives for executive leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field.
    An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience as Product Manager or similar role in other markets.
  • Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.
  • Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games.
  • Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console.
  • Experience in a role that implied team management duties.

Why Join the World of Gameloft?

  • Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
  • Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
  • Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
  • Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
  • Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

Benefits:

  • Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
  • 25 vacation days per year
  • Private medical health insurance
  • Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
  • Flexible work from home hybrid model
  • Free language courses
  • Birthday day off!
  • 1 month of remote work
  • Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
  • Career-development opportunities.
  • Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
  • ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

title: Djurskadereglerare
description:
Är du en person som sätter kunden i fokus och vill vara med och göra skillnad? Har du dessutom ett stort djurintresse och motiveras av att arbeta på ett bolag med en stark företagskultur där du får vara med och påverka, utveckla och bidra tillsammans med engagerade kollegor? Då kan rollen som Djurskadereglerare hos oss på Svedea vara nästa utmaning för dig!

Om tjänsten
På Svedea är kunden alltid i fokus och vi vill att alla kundmöten ska präglas av personlig service, snabbhet och expertkunskap. Som djurskadereglerare har du en viktig roll att fortsätta leverera förstklassig service under våra skadeärenden.

Du kommer att bli en del av vårt skadeteam som består av 7 djurskadereglerare, en gemensam nämnare för oss alla är att vi har en stor passion för djur.

I rollen kommer du att:

  • självständigt handlägga skadeanmälningar från både privatpersoner och djurkliniker

  • ta egna beslut och kommunicera dessa på ett tydligt och trevligt sätt mot kunder och andra intressenter, både muntligt och skriftligt

  • ha daglig kontakt med kunder via telefon och mejl

  • hjälpa våra säljare och kundtjänst med riskbedömningar

  • hantera förhandsbesked från djurkliniker

  • delta i projekt och på mässor

Det är också viktigt att du håller dig uppdaterad om nyheter, produkter, villkor, instruktioner och försäkringslagar.

Tjänsten är på heltid med placering på vårt huvudkontor i Stockholm, start sker enligt överenskommelse.

Din bakgrund
På Svedea lägger vi stor vikt vid personlighet och potential. Vi söker dig som brinner för att göra skillnad och vill överträffa kundernas förväntningar genom att göra det lilla extra. Att prioritera kunderna och vara angelägen om att de är nöjda är en förutsättning för att lyckas i rollen. Du organiserar och planerar ditt arbete väl, vågar utmana nuvarande arbetssätt samt kommer med egna förslag på förbättringar. Slutligen är du en lagspelare som sprider positiv energi och arbetsglädje.

Andra krav för tjänsten är att du:

  • har minst några års erfarenhet av att arbeta med djurskadereglering eller har jobbat flera år inom djursjukvården

  • har erfarenhet av att tolka och läsa journaler

  • behärskar svenska obehindrat och kan uttrycka dig på engelska i såväl tal som skrift

Vi erbjuder dig

  • En inspirerade företagskultur som kännetecknas av laganda med passionerade och engagerande kollegor som förstår vikten av att hjälpas åt och att ha kul tillsammans. Mer om vår kultur hittar du här! 💙

  • Möjlighet till visst distansarbete med minst 3 dagar på kontoret/vecka

  • Ett riktigt schysst förmånspaket och möjlighet till en årlig bonus. Här kan du läsa mer om våra förmåner!

  • En arbetsplats som befinner sig i en spännande expansiv fas där dina tankar och idéer uppmuntras 🚀

  • Kontor högst upp i ett av Kungsholmens häftigaste hus med 360 graders vy över stan och terrasser i flera väderstreck. Spana in vår Office tour här!

Låter det intressant?
Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi arbetar löpande med urval så vänta inte utan skicka in din ansökan redan idag, sista ansökningsdag är den 16 september. Observera att vi enbart tar emot ansökningar via länken i annonsen. Har du frågor om tjänsten eller processen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Alexander Valsberg via mejl: Alexander.Valsberg@svedea.se eller tel: 072-142 72 89.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Om Svedea
Svedea är en framgångssaga. Våra första 16 år har gjort oss till det ledande bolaget inom försäkring av fritidsfordon som motorcykel, båt och snöskoter och vi är en stark utmanare inom bil-, djur- och företagsförsäkring. Efter önskemål från våra kunder erbjuder vi nu även hem- och villaförsäkring. Idag har vi omkring 430 000 kunder, är över 300 anställda och fortsätter att växa snabbt.

Vår vision är att förändra försäkringsbranschen genom att finnas tillgängliga och göra allt för våra kunder. Hemligheten bakom vår framgång är engagerade medarbetare som trivs på jobbet i kombination med en tydlig företagskultur. Nu ökar vi tempot för att fortsätta växa, behålla de mest engagerade medarbetarna och de nöjdaste kunderna*. Vår resa har bara börjat!

*Svenskt Kvalitetsindex (SKI) har tilldelat Svedea utmärkelsen Sveriges nöjdaste kunder i kategorin fordonsförsäkring 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 och 2024 samt i kategorin djurförsäkring 2023. Vi är även stolta vinnare av SKI för båtförsäkring 2025.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? What You Will Do:

The Space & Airborne Center within Systems Integration & Test seeks talented Systems Engineers. Our Space & Airborne team members located in El Segundo, CA integrate hardware and software, develop test plans and procedures, debug and evaluate system functions and interfaces, and verify system requirements in support of final sell-off to the customer. We put our systems together, exercise them in the lab or in the field, measure and analyze performance, and make sure our products work the first time and every time. Every day is a different set of challenges to overcome. You'll be expected to collaborate across disciplines and partner to implement solutions. In this role, you'll get to know a little bit about every aspect of the system and have a direct hand in making it all work together supporting teams of engineers engaged in integration and test efforts. Our center focuses on back end sustainment and repair design and sustainment development as well as transitioning systems through integration and test from production to warranty/sustainment. You will also perform functional / physical analysis, allocation, and trade studies.

You will support Radar Mode requirement verification, engineering testing, integration and flight-testing, production, system deployment, and post deployment support across the product lifecycle. Through Digital Transformation (DTx), you will perform these functions using a variety of methods and enabling technologies, which may include Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Agile product development.

This position is an onsite role in El Segundo, CA. Test event support activity may require travel which is not expected to exceed 10%.

  • Support planning and execution of Integration, Verification, or Troubleshoot Test activities in our labs, in the field, or at a Depot facility

  • Experience with tools, such as Microsoft Office, MATLAB or Python, for data analysis and automation

  • Experience with troubleshooting technical issues with electronics in an academic or internship setting, including the use of common commercial test equipment (oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, etc.)

Experience may be obtained through on‑the‑job experience, research, coursework, or projects

  • Provide advanced systems administration support for enterprise virtual environments, servers, storage, and associated infrastructure.

  • Monitor system performance, availability, capacity, and operational health across SIPR and NIPR environments.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, network operations, engineering, and operations teams to maintain secure and compliant environments.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, implementation plans, operational procedures, and system configurations.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to system administrators and support personnel.

  • Extensive hands-on experience supporting VMware VDI and enterprise virtualization platforms.

Work Location

title: Battery Modelling Intern
description:
Are you passionate about fighting climate change? Do you want to work on creating a world where everyone can breathe clean air? Are you looking for an opportunity to apply your engineering skills to real-world challenges? Do you want to work on cutting-edge battery technology and learn from experienced engineers?

Who we are

At Breathe, we believe an electrified future is key to achieving this, which is why we are building battery technology to help brands do more with the power they have.

Our physics-based battery management software helps some of the world's largest and most iconic automotive and consumer electronics brands deliver products with faster charging, longer life and zero compromise on safety. Put simply, we make batteries better. And we want you to join us.

What we will give you

You will join a talented and cohesive team who everyday go to work to do more with the power we have. Why? Because we dream of a world where everyone can breathe clean air.

As our intern you will get a proper look at how battery models are built, parameterised and validated, working alongside experienced modelling engineers. You will help us push the industry forward by helping make the complex simple and in return you have an opportunity to gain real industry experience and learn from and with a room full of experts working at the cutting edge of the industry.

We’re genuine people who want to do good and are driven by passion, coffee and a mutual love of dogs – and yes, our office in London is dog friendly and we would love to add more dogs to our pack.

Sounding great right?

We know it isn't always 9-5, but we do know that family and a good work-life balance are key to innovation, so we offer flexible and hybrid working to try to accommodate your needs.

We believe in keeping energy levels high and we have a constant supply of office snacks to help you with that.

What you will be doing

This is an exciting time to join Breathe. Having proven the value of our products across a range of industries, we are looking for an intern to join our modelling team this year to help reshape how we get models out of the door.

Right now, that process takes our engineers through a series of manual steps, and the team has already started building automation to take some of that off their hands. Your job is to bring those two things together into one workflow, so that AI can run through the pipeline from start to finish and only pull a person in when there is a real decision to make or something has gone wrong. This is a live problem rather than a set exercise, and it is yours from the first map of the pipeline to the final write-up. Whatever you build here will shape how we approach modelling as a company.

You'll work closely with our modelling, embedded software, and battery teams, with Claude and Claude Code as your main tools. We will give you real experience and training in AI-assisted engineering, workflow automation, and the practical judgement of deciding where a human still belongs in the loop.

Your day to day

  • Develop a working knowledge of how our models are built, tested, and released

  • Learn to use Claude and Claude Code to do real engineering work, with guidance from the team

  • Map our current model pipeline and pinpoint the steps that are slow, repetitive, or error-prone

  • Extend the team's automation prototype so more of the pipeline runs without manual input

  • Build in checks that pause the process and alert the right person when approval is needed or a step fails, rather than letting it break quietly

  • Track the time saved against the current manual process and document what does and doesn't automate well

  • Assist the modelling, embedded software, and battery teams as you get to grips with how the pipeline fits together

  • Any additional work that may from time to time be deemed critical to product or company success.

Your background

  • Studying towards, or a recent graduate of, a strong undergraduate or master's degree in a relevant subject, for example electrical or mechanical engineering or computer science. PhD students will also be considered.

  • Strong software and scripting skills, with a genuine interest in automation and applying AI to practical workflows.

  • Experience with coding in Python, with good use of AI tools in your development work.

  • Have examples of projects where you have improved a process through AI automation, whether through university work or personal initiatives.

  • A basic understanding of battery models and how they are parameterised is preferred, but gaps here should not deter you from applying.

  • A practical, self-directed approach, and the confidence to ask questions when a problem is unclear.

  • A team player with a proactive attitude, good attention to detail, strong communications skills and the ability to work autonomously.

  • Right to work in the UK for the full internship. Students whose visa permits the work are welcome, though please note term-time hours may be capped, typically at 20 per week.

This is a full-time internship for 8 to 12 weeks, targeting a start date in September 2026. You will report to W. Dhammika Widanage, Head of Battery Modelling. Paid at the London Living Wage. Where a visa permits only 20 hours per week during term time, that can be accommodated.

We want to add the best talent to our incredible team, and we want to find you tomorrow. We will do our best to process your application as quickly as possible and come back to you within 2 weeks as we appreciate communication is key. But we aren’t perfect so do reach out to us for an update.

At Breathe, we believe that having diverse perspectives within our team is an essential part of innovating quickly, thinking from first principles, and expanding our expertise. Ultimately, enabling us to deliver better products to our customers.

We aim to attract, nurture, and retain diverse individuals. Because that’s how we do our best work. And because that’s the kind of world we want to live in.

We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates and are happy to provide the accommodations you need within our recruitment process to enable you to demonstrate your skills. Just let us know what you need.

So, what are you waiting for? Come join us!

title: Transition-to-Work Coordinator
description:
Working at Regis University

As Regis employees, we embrace our Jesuit Catholic values of respect, inclusion and equity, and welcome employees, faculty and students from all faiths and cultures. Together, we perform our duties in alignment with the mission of the University and seek dedicated individuals to contribute to and strengthen that mission and our service to students. Why Work at Regis?

Job Summary:

The Transition-to-Work Coordinator supports students with intellectual disabilities as they prepare for the transition from college to post-graduation life. This role encompasses comprehensive transition planning, including job search and application support and coordination of independent living, community integration, emotional and physical wellness, and social engagement. The Transition-to-Work Coordinator serves as a strategic liaison between students and their support networks—including the Division of Vocational Rehabilitation (DVR), families, residential providers, benefits counselors, and employers—ensuring collaboration and person-centered planning throughout the transition process.

This position advances Regis University’s mission through the Jesuit value of Cura Personalis, or care for the whole person, by providing holistic, individualized support. The coordinator will empower students to become engaged community members and men and women for others.

The ideal candidate will be a skilled relationship builder committed to inclusion, with strong attention to detail and clear communication skills.

Please note that this position is contingent upon TIPSID grant funding. Employment for the duration of the grant (five years from October 1, 2025) is not guaranteed.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

Transition Planning & Coordination

  • Develops and facilitates person-centered transition plans in collaboration with students and their support networks, including the Division of Vocational Rehabilitation (DVR), families, residential providers, benefits counselors, employers, and community partners

  • Connects students and families to relevant community resources and support services to ensure student support post-graduation

Employment Support

  • Guides students through job search and application processes for post-graduation employment

Independent Living & Wellness Planning

  • Collaborates with students to identify and coordinate independent or residential living options that match their preferences and support needs

  • Develops individualized strategies with students for maintaining physical and emotional wellness post-graduation

  • Facilitates opportunities and strategies for meaningful social engagement and community integration beyond college

Other

  • Communicates regularly with stakeholders to ensure coordinated, student-centered support throughout the transition process

  • Maintains alumni network through outreach, outcomes assessment, and inclusive social programming

  • Oversees Individualized Learning Plans (ILPs) for GLOBAL Inclusive Program students, utilizing person-centered planning to monitor progress

  • Other duties as assigned

Working Conditions:

This position is based in an office setting and follows the University’s standard business hours. A substantial on-campus presence is required.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Education, Special Education, Psychology, Human Services, Rehabilitation Services, Disability Studies, Social Work, Business, Counseling or a related field

  • Experience working with people with disabilities

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, excellent written and verbal communication, high attention to detail and strong organizational skills, commitment to inclusive practices

Preferred: (Any of these would be helpful!)

  • Certified Transition to Work Coordinator (CTS) or Employment Support Professional (CESP) certification

  • Experience working with people with intellectual disabilities and knowledge of adult service systems (ex: DVR, SSI/SSDI, Medicaid)

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs

#RDT2026

À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.

Quelles sont nos attentes?

Pratt & Whitney continue d'investir dans de nouvelles technologies et conceptions de moteurs pour les futures installations aéronautiques. Avec ces nouveaux programmes stratégiques, nous écrivons le prochain chapitre des offres de moteurs sur plusieurs marchés. Cela conduit à la nécessité d'un leadership du service client pour une entrée en service réussie de ces nouveaux produits.

Dans l’organisation Programme Service à la Clientèle, nous croyons que tout commence avec nos employés. Nous favorisons une organisation ou l’apprentissage est de mise et encourageons la diversité et l’inclusion en offrant des opportunités de développement professionnel en s’assurant que nos gens ont tout le soutien nécessaire pour la prise de décision. Nous sommes responsables pour que nos produit et nos services rencontrent les plus hautes exigences de nos clients et voulons être perçu comme étant le leader mondial dans notre marché. Nous bâtissons une relation solide avec nos clients en gardant le cap sur les besoins de ceux-ci et ce en développant de nouvelles solutions spécifiques a leurs besoins. Nous facilitons cette tâche en s’assurant d’utiliser les nouveaux outils disponibles, nos actions sont base sur la proactivité, nous sommes commit à travailler ensemble avec intégrité et respect. Le programme du PW100 aide nos clients à voyager afin de tisser des liens ensemble et a générer des économies à travers le monde.

Ce poste à temps plein, du lundi au vendredi, offre un horaire flexible à Longueuil et requiert une présence exclusivement sur site.

Description de la fonction

Faisant partie de l’équipe Programme Service à la Clientèle, vous serez responsable de la mise en service de multiples nouveaux programmes moteurs stratégiques, en travaillant de manière autonome directement avec les manufacturiers, avec les services de l’ingénierie, du marketing, des opérations, ainsi qu’avec plusieurs équipes internationales pour offrir une expérience de classe mondiale à nos clients. Cela nécessitera une forte capacité à diriger par influence, à trouver des solutions et à susciter des consensus entre plusieurs parties prenantes, tout en mettant à l’avant plan l’expérience-client.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien?

  • Responsable du développement et de la mise en œuvre d’une stratégie novatrice visant à supporter les nouveaux programmes moteurs ou nouveaux opérateurs, tout en dirigeant des activités stratégiques pour améliorer la qualité de nos produits et services.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les services de l’ingénierie, du marketing, du développement des affaires et du service à la clientèle pour définir, suivre et influencer les requis et livrables des nouveaux programmes moteurs

  • Responsable de garantir le respect des accords de soutien produit des OEM, en gérant de manière proactive les engagements et en atténuant les risques

  • Diriger la gestion des nouveau produits et des offres commerciales, y compris les services DPHM, les campagnes de produits en service et les initiatives de soutien commercial.

  • Soutenir les révisions financières et développer des stratégies pour améliorer les performances de l'entreprise.

  • Responsable de trouver des solutions pour optimiser les couts d’opération.

  • Agir en tant que porte-parole du client et expert du marché afin de favoriser l’alignement interfonctionnel, tout en fournissant des analyses pour orienter la stratégie produit et soutenir les décisions commerciales.

  • Représenter les besoins de l’entreprise envers le programme

  • S’assurer que les organisations comprennent les stratégies spécifiques du programme dans une organisation matricielle

  • Tirer parti de la connectivité numérique pour surveiller les performances des moteurs, permettant l’analyse prédictive ainsi qu’un soutien proactif et personnalisé

  • Préparer des plans d’affaires et gérer des budgets

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir?

  • Baccalauréat avec 10 à 15 années d’expérience pertinente

  • Maîtrise avec 6 à 10 années d’expérience pertinente

  • Domaine d’études: aéronautique, génie aérospatial, génie mécanique, génie électrique

  • Fortes habiletés en gestion de projets

  • Bon sens des affaires

  • Bonne connaissance technique et du produit (moteurs)

  • Expertise en maintenance, réparation et révision de moteurs d’avion

  • Expertise à travailler directement avec les clients et les manufacturiers

  • Fortes habiletés interpersonnelles et de communication.

title: Product Manager Flashbid / Dynamic Yield
description:
Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.


Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.
But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions.

Our Solutions:

→ Actirise: the display tech designed for performance
→ FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes
→ Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks
→ Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution
→ Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

  • FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.

  • We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins.

  • We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.

  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

The Mission

As the Product Manager Flashbid / Dynamic Yield, you own the buy-side auction stack including our proprietary wrapper Flashbid on Actirise properties end-to-end. Your mission: continuously optimize yield while guaranteeing auction reliability and a fully compliant demand chain to drive incremental revenues and saving costs.

Your key responsibilities:

1. Wrapper & Auction Core

  • Own the Flashbid wrapper roadmap end-to-end: integration, evolution, and maintenance of the proprietary wrapper.

  • Monitor and optimize auction latency and performance — every millisecond of delay costs revenue.

  • Manage publisher demand connections: GAM, External RTB, and non-oRTB integrations.

2. Demand & Bidder Management

  • Own bidder setting configuration, integration, activation, and monitoring — both server-to-server (S2S) and client-side — including status monitoring and whitelisting per property.

  • Drive Shield: detect and block malicious or non-desired ads, and control the revenue impact of every blocking decision.

3. Yield Optimization

  • Own throttling and yield algorithms: pressure regulation, dynamic floor prices, smart refresh, and bid enrichment.

  • Partner with the Data team on AI-driven yield algorithms to push incremental revenue further.

  • Run structured A/B tests on yield levers (floor prices, bidder mix, throttling rules) and let data drive every decision.

4. Supply Chain & Compliance

  • Own SCHAIN: ads.txt management and vendor list curation to guarantee supply chain integrity.

  • Own the collection, processing, and transmission of consent signals (TCF, GPP) to demand partners.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with DPO on consent signal quality and compliance requirements feeding the auction.

  • Partner with PM Analytics to ensure auction/yield KPIs are properly tracked, benchmarked, and actionable.

  • Align with Supply, Data, and Tech/Engineering teams to prioritize the roadmap and ship reliably.

  • Act as the auction/yield product voice across Sparteo, translating technical trade-offs into clear business decisions for stakeholders and C-level.

Your profile for this job

We are looking for someone who treats every millisecond and every basis point of fill rate as money on the table — and who is as comfortable in a bid stream log as in a revenue dashboard.

  • PM Expertise: 4+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally on programmatic/header bidding products, SSPs, or yield management platforms.

  • Programmatic Expertise: Deep understanding of header bidding, RTB/OpenRTB, GAM, S2S vs. client-side bidding, and the SSP/DSP ecosystem.

  • Yield Mindset: Proven experience optimizing floor prices, throttling, or bidder mix to drive incremental revenue — you think in RPM, fill rate, win rate, and latency.

  • Supply Chain & Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with ads.txt/sellers.json, schain validation, and consent frameworks (TCF, GPP) as they apply to the demand chain.

  • Data-Driven: Strong analytical skills; comfortable running A/B tests on auction parameters and reading the results into concrete roadmap decisions. SQL basics are a plus.

  • Technical Literacy: Understanding of auction latency, bid streams, and wrapper architecture. You don't need to code, but you need to speak engineering's language fluently.

  • Performance Obsession: Treats auction reliability and latency as first-class product metrics, not afterthoughts.

  • Exceptional Communicator: Able to translate highly technical programmatic trade-offs into clear priorities for Tech, Supply, and C-level stakeholders.

  • A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints. You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.

  • 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process!

Here are the stages in our recruitment process

  • Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  • Analytical and business logic tests

  • Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager

  • Taking up references

Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

Lawsons is the UK’s largest independent supplier of timber, fencing and building materials. With over 35 branches and 700+ colleagues across London and the South East, we deliver quality products, expert advice and excellent customer service. We are recruiting for a Yard Operative based at our Salfords branch to join a busy local team that supports trade and retail customers.

Position Overview

We are looking for a reliable, hard-working Yard Operative to support day-to-day yard activities at Salfords. This hands-on role involves handling timber, fencing and building materials, preparing customer orders, maintaining yard presentation and ensuring safe working practices. The successful candidate will work closely with the branch team to deliver a positive experience for customers and contribute to efficient yard operations.

Main Responsibilities

  • Unload, load and safely stack timber, fencing and building materials by hand and using mechanical plant where trained

  • Pick and prepare customer orders accurately and promptly for collection or delivery

  • Maintain yard organisation, ensuring stock is presented tidily and accessible for customers and colleagues

  • Carry out basic stock checks and record stock movements to support accurate inventory control

  • Assist drivers with vehicle loading and securing of goods to ensure safe, compliant deliveries

  • Complete routine housekeeping tasks, including waste removal and keeping work areas clean and safe

  • Follow health & safety procedures, report hazards, and assist with routine checks and incident reporting

  • Operate forklifts, telehandlers or other plant only if qualified and authorised, and assist with training coordination where required

  • Provide friendly, helpful service to customers visiting the yard and support colleagues during busy periods

  • Undertake any additional reasonable duties required to support branch operations

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in a yard operative, warehouse or builders’ merchants role is essential.

  • Physically fit and able to carry, lift and move materials safely throughout the shift

  • Awareness of safe material handling practices and commitment to following health & safety procedures

  • Good communication skills and a customer-focused attitude

  • Basic numeracy and ability to complete simple records accurately

  • Willingness to learn to operate forklifts/plant and obtain relevant qualifications where required

  • Reliable, punctual and flexible with a practical, team-oriented approach

Working Hours

This is a full-time, permanent position. Typical hours are 44.5 per week Monday to Friday with 1 in 3 Saturday mornings required (08:00–12:00).

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive salary, dependent on experience (£30,175 - £32,500)

  • 25 days’ holiday plus UK Bank Holidays and an additional celebration day

  • Company pension scheme and Death in Service cover

  • Employee Assistance Programme and access to wellbeing support including online GP

  • Comprehensive induction and ongoing training with opportunities for career development

  • Supportive team environment within a leading independent supplier

Why Join Lawsons at Salfords?

  • Be part of the UK’s leading independent supplier of timber, fencing and building materials

  • Work in a varied, practical role with opportunities to develop new skills and progress internally

  • Contribute to a friendly local branch serving trade and retail customers

  • Join a business that values safety, customer service and colleague wellbeing

Lawsons is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you are a dependable team player with practical experience or the willingness to learn, we would like to hear from you. #MP

As Senior SAP Solution Architect – EAM, Logistics & Digital Platforms, you will design and optimize complex SAP landscapes that power Vattenfall’s operations across multiple countries. Stockholm

  • Academic degree in IT or related field

  • Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, EAM (PM), ePPM, Logistics (S2C, P2P), DMS, WCM
  • General understanding of CO Controlling
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. title: Scientist II, Analytical Chemistry
description:
Position: Scientist II, Analytical Chemistry

Salary Range: $90,000 - $120,000/yr.

Location: Coventry, RI (On-site)

About Pharmaron

Pharmaron is a global contract research and manufacturing organization (CRO/CDMO) helping pharma and biotech companies bring new therapies to life. With over 25,000 employees worldwide across 28 locations in the US, UK, China, and Singapore, we support drug discovery through to manufacturing with fully integrated high-quality services.

We're proud of the impact we make and just last year, we supported 887 discovery projects, 1,100+ CMC programs, and 1,397 clinical trials across all phases. Our teams are involved in everything from small molecules, ADC's, biologics, and gene therapies and we work with more than 3,300 global customers. To learn more, visit www.pharmaron.com.

What You'll Do

The Scientist II will support process chemistry and manufacturing activities through analytical method development, validation, transfer, and sample testing in compliance with all applicable guidelines. Will also solve moderate complexity analytical development issues for assigned projects and/or initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate expertise in the core analytical laboratory skills, support development and/or scale up of chemical processes in assigned projects.
  • Demonstrate and apply sound understanding of the application of all available analytical tools and techniques.
  • Design and execute core experiments, interpret results, and plan additional experiments in a timely manner to solve assigned problems of moderate complexity. More complex problems will require additional guidance from a scientific supervisor/line manager.
  • Review experimental data, notebooks, and instrument qualification protocols/reports.
  • Support client projects as an individual contributor and as an analytical project leader: performing analyses, reporting results, trending and presenting data at project meetings, delegating work, being accountable for project deliverables and demonstrating leadership behaviors. In addition, may supervise one or more individual contributors and oversee their technical progress.
  • System ownership of equipment and instrumentation, including supporting qualification activities. Participate in software validation.
  • Support departmental or site audits, as required.
  • Follow all policies governing the business activities, key internal business practices, and external regulations governing the role.

title: Lead Producer
description:
Pubity Group reaches one of the biggest Gen Z audiences in social. Most of what that audience watches is reactive, built around what’s already happening. This role exists to build the other half: a slate of formats that aren’t tied to a single moment, that can run week after week, and that viewers would come back for.

You’ll own the long and short-form development slate end to end. You’ll own the pipeline, set the standards and make the decisions around what gets built, piloted and scaled. You’ll build out a team, direct the producers and resources behind each format, set the bar for what a pilot needs to prove, and be the person the Head of Studio comes to for an honest view on what’s working.

Six months in, success isn’t “did we make some videos?” It’s “how many shows do we have, and what’s the pipeline behind them?”

Key Responsibilities

Slate Strategy & Development

  • Own the development slate: what’s in development, what’s piloting, what’s scaling, and what’s been paused or discontinued, and why.

  • Spot formats worth building from what’s already working across Pubity Group’s channels, trends and audience data, rather than starting from a blank page.

  • Set the bar for each format before it earns a production slot, including cost, what it needs to prove and what “working” looks like in numbers.

  • Keep a live pipeline of formats in progress at all times, sized to keep production consistently fed rather than developed one at a time.

Format Development

  • Shape loose ideas into shootable formats: define the hook, structure, cast or talent, and what makes someone watch episode two.

  • Direct the producers and development resource working on formats through the pipeline, reviewing and sharpening their thinking rather than just signing it off.

  • Decide where you develop a format yourself versus where you delegate it, and hold the standard from a distance.

Production & Pilots

  • Take formats from greenlight to shot pilot, booking time with the Pubity Production Hub to support the creation of the content.

  • Set the shoot plan and pilot brief, oversee the pilot batch, and get it edited and out inside a defined production window.

  • Manage the trade-off between speed and quality at pilot stage across multiple formats at once. A pilot needs to prove the format, not be the finished product.

Scaling & Performance

  • Read pilot performance against a defined bar, including views, retention, engagement and repeat watch, and make the call on what scales, what gets reworked, and what gets paused or discontinued.

  • Take anything that clears the bar into an ongoing run, adjusting format, cadence or platform based on what the pilot data actually showed.

  • Build the read-out on slate performance, not just format by format, so the Head of Studio sees where the pipeline is strong and where it’s thin.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Working

  • Work day to day with the Production Hub to plan and prioritise shoots across the whole slate, not just your own formats.

  • Keep the Head of Studio and Co-Founders close on pipeline status, pilot results and scaling decisions. This role sets direction on formats, not just executes them.

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategy and Productisation teams to ensure shows can be packaged and presented to commercial clients or as part of pitches as soon as they’re ready.

  • Set the standard for what good development looks like across the team and bring on or direct additional producers as the slate grows.

What we’re looking for

  • Track record developing or producing short-form video for a social-first audience at scale. You can point to a slate of formats you’ve built, not just content you’ve made.

  • Experience directing or mentoring other producers or developers, with the judgement to know when to get hands-on and when to hold the line from a distance.

  • Strong editorial judgement and a clear point of view on what makes a format compelling, repeatable and worth scaling.

  • Fluent in what makes short-form content perform on TikTok, Reels and Shorts specifically, and how that differs by platform.

  • Confident reading performance data across multiple formats at once and making the call from it. You’re comfortable pausing a format you like because the data says it isn’t working, and scaling one you didn’t expect to succeed.

  • Experience working through shared or hub-based production resources and prioritising that resource across competing formats.

What good looks like

  • A live pipeline of format ideas at any given time, sized to the slate rather than a single project worked in isolation.

  • At least six formats, with multiple episodes each, moved through pilot and into a clear scaling decision within the first six months.

  • Pilots get shot, edited and reviewed quickly across the slate. The bottleneck should never be a format sitting waiting for a decision.

  • A clear, honest read-out on why the slate is or isn’t working, backed by data rather than opinion, delivered without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Experience pitching formats to brands, creators or platform partners.

  • Hands-on shooting or editing experience, enough to brief a shoot properly and spot a problem on set.

  • Experience working across US and UK content styles or audiences.

  • Experience building or growing a development function from a small base.

We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As a leading Gen-Z social publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard.

title: HGV Class 2 Hiab
description:
Lawsons is the UK’s largest independent supplier of timber, fencing and building materials. With over 35 branches and 700+ colleagues across London and the South East, we deliver quality products, expert advice and excellent customer service. We are recruiting for an HGV Class 2 Hiab driver based at our AVS Havant branch to join a busy local team that supports trade and retail customers.

Position Overview

We are looking for a reliable and experienced HGV Class 2 (Category C) Hiab driver to join our AVS Havant branch on a permanent basis. This is a customer-facing driving and lifting role delivering timber, fencing and builders’ merchant products to trade and retail customers across the local area. You will operate an HGV Class 2 vehicle fitted with a Hiab crane, ensuring safe loading and unloading, secure load restraint and timely completion of deliveries while providing a high level of customer service. The role includes safe handling of materials, accurate completion of paperwork and adherence to company Health & Safety standards.

Main Responsibilities

  • Safely operate an HGV Class 2 vehicle and Hiab crane to load, transport and deliver goods on scheduled routes from the Havant branch.

  • Ensure all loads are properly secured and protected to prevent damage during transit and to comply with load restraint regulations.

  • Safely lift, manoeuvre and position goods using the Hiab crane in line with manufacturer guidance and company procedures.

  • Complete vehicle checks, Hiab pre-use inspections and report any defects or maintenance needs promptly.

  • Accurately complete delivery paperwork including delivery notes, vehicle checklists and any customer signatures or electronic checks.

  • Provide excellent customer service at all times, representing Lawsons professionally and courteously.

  • Follow all Health & Safety procedures, use appropriate PPE and apply safe manual handling techniques.

  • Report any damaged or compromised products and manage customer queries in a professional manner.

  • Work with branch colleagues to ensure efficient loading, route planning and customer communication.

  • Assist with yard duties when required, including basic stock checks and goods handling.

  • Carry out any other reasonable tasks as requested by your line manager.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • A full UK HGV Class 2 (Category C) licence (essential).

  • Valid Driver CPC and relevant HGV driving experience (essential).

  • Previous experience operating a Hiab or similar vehicle-mounted crane (essential) and/or relevant banksman or lifting experience.

  • Landscaping experience (desirable)

  • Good knowledge of safe manual handling, load securing and vehicle checks.

  • Strong customer service skills and a polite, professional manner.

  • Good time management with the ability to work to schedules and deadlines.

  • Basic numeracy and literacy to complete delivery paperwork accurately.

  • Willingness to work as part of a team and assist with yard duties when required.

  • Be vigilant and report any Health & Safety issues to the Line Manager immediately.

Working Hours

This is a full-time, permanent position. Typical hours are Monday to Friday 07.30 - 17.00, plus 1 in 2 Saturdays 08:00 - 12:00. Occasional flexibility may be required to meet customer needs.

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive annual salary (£36,000 - £38,000, dependent on experience)

  • 25 days’ holiday pro rata plus Bank Holidays and 1 Celebration day

  • Company pension scheme and Death in Service cover

  • Employee Assistance Programme and access to wellbeing support including online GP

  • Training and development opportunities including Hiab refresher training

  • Comprehensive induction and ongoing support with opportunities for career progression

Why Join AVS Havant?

  • Join a respected, long-established company with a strong regional presence and commitment to colleague development.

  • Work within a supportive team where your contribution is valued and recognised.

  • Opportunity to work in a varied, practical role with regular customer contact and scope to develop new skills.

  • Be part of a business that prioritises safety, customer service and colleague wellbeing.

Lawsons is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you meet the essential requirements and are available to work from our Havant branch, we would like to hear from you. #HP
