With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Architect the Next Generation of Avionics Networking

The Computing Products Department (CPD) at Collins Aerospace is building a next‑generation family of safety‑critical avionics Ethernet switches—and we’re looking for a Sr Principal Systems Engineer who wants to shape the networking architecture that future aircraft will rely on for decades. This role sits at the center of systems architecture, embedded networking, silicon strategy, firmware, software, safety, and cybersecurity. If you want to help define what comes after today’s AFDX‑based networks, this is the opportunity.

What You Will Do:

  • Architect the Next Generation of Avionics Networking Products

  • You will lead the architecture for a scalable family of deterministic avionics Ethernet switches—defining the technical roadmap, reusable building blocks, interfaces, configuration strategy, and engineering principles guiding multiple future platforms.

You’ll drive architectural decisions across:

  • Port count, topology, bandwidth, latency, jitter, buffering

  • Redundancy and availability strategies

  • Switch silicon, processors, memory, PHY/SerDes technologies

  • Copper/fiber interfaces, packaging, power, and thermal constraints

  • Hardware/software/firmware partitioning and growth paths

Lead the Evolution from AFDX to Deterministic Ethernet & TSN

You will define architectures that integrate today’s ARINC 664 Part 7 / AFDX with emerging deterministic Ethernet technologies such as TSN, IEEE 802.1DP/SAE AS6675, advanced time synchronization, QoS, mixed‑criticality traffic, and network health monitoring.

Engineer Deterministic Performance

You will lead analyses to prove the architecture delivers deterministic performance:

  • End‑to‑end latency, worst‑case timing, traffic flow

  • Buffer/queue behaviors, packet loss, burst analysis

  • Multicast load, congestion behavior

  • Failure detection, network recovery timing

  • Synchronization accuracy, scalability, capacity

Technical Leadership Across Disciplines

This role requires coordinating hardware, software, firmware, systems, test, safety, and cybersecurity engineering—guiding how all disciplines contribute to one coherent networking architecture. You will mentor networking engineers, shape design patterns, lead major reviews, and engage across customer, supplier, and cross‑functional teams.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field

The strongest candidates will have significant experience in several of the following areas:

  • Avionics network architecture and deterministic networking

  • Ethernet switching, bridging, Layer 2/3, IP networking

  • VLANs, QoS, priority management, multicast

  • Traffic policing/shaping, redundancy, sync

  • Switch/router/NIC/gateway configuration

  • Network performance analysis, packet capture, troubleshooting

  • Network simulation and automated testing

  • Embedded HW/SW integration

  • Requirements development, system architecture, interface definition

  • Integration, verification & validation, trade studies, root‑cause analysis

  • Particularly relevant experience includes:

  • ARINC 664 Part 7 / AFDX

  • IEEE 802.1 TSN, aerospace TSN (IEEE 802.1DP / SAE AS6675)

  • Precision time synchronization

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Paystack

Paystack’s mission is to power African ambition. Over 300K of some of the most renowned businesses in Nigeria, as well as a growing number of merchants in South Africa, Ghana, and Kenya use Paystack’s modern payments gateway. They include the likes of MTN, Burger King, UPS, AXA Mansard Insurance, FairMoney, PiggyVest, FilmHouse Cinemas, Smile Communications, Air Peace Airlines, Crocs, Under Armour, Richemont Lifestyle Group (RLG), and many others.

In just over 9 years, our growing team has introduced a steady cadence of innovation within the online payments landscape, such as automated recurring payments, the ability for customers to pay directly from their bank accounts, automated chargebacks, and much more. We’ve been acquired by Stripe and are doubling down on the mission to help build out Africa’s payments infrastructure.

We’re obsessed with building the best place to work on the continent while accelerating digital commerce across Africa and we need your help!

About the Senior DevOps Engineer role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Paystack, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimise our development and deployment processes, improve system reliability, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in DevOps practices, cloud technologies, automation tools, database management, networking, and a passion for solving complex technical challenges.

The selected engineer will join a team of DevOps engineers and report directly to the Lead DevOps Engineer. You will work closely with other members of the department including members of the larger infrastructure and security teams and quite heavily with other product engineering teams.

We’ll trust you to

  • Own projects end to end, often across teams.

  • Design technical solutions that are scalable and maintainable

  • Design systems for high availability and fault tolerance.

  • Build end to end automation pipelines.

  • Tackle ambiguous, high risk problems proactively.

  • Introduce new ideas and simplifies complex systems.

  • Design secure systems, manages secrets and implements zero trust models.

  • Participate in architectural evolution and software development activities.

  • Help debug and diagnose issues that may arise in an intertwined distributed system environment.

  • Own CI/CD architecture, minimises downtime and ensures security

  • Lead major incident response and postmortems

You’ll thrive in this role if you have

  • 5+ years of experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role.

  • Deep Expertise with a variety of AWS services

  • Experience with IAC and tools like Terraform, designing reusable modules and enforces standards

  • Real world experience with Kubernetes at scale

  • Experience writing scripts and automation using Python, Node.js, Bash, Golang

  • Experience with networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, VPNs, etc.

  • Experience building tooling to reduce occurrences of errors and improve engineering productivity

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling like ArgoCD, Github Actions, etc.

  • Experience working with and monitoring and alerting tools like Prometheus and Grafana.

  • Ability to clearly articulate, implement and document design decisions

Bonus points if you have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field might be beneficial but not required

  • Experience in the fintech industry or with payment processing systems

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and compliance requirements (e.g., PCI DSS)

  • Experience with machine learning and data analytics.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package and benefits

  • 13th month bonus

  • TSG Equity compensation

  • Full medical coverage

  • Wellbeing stipend

  • Generous leave and sabbatical policies

  • Hybrid working environment

  • Smart, kind colleagues who are invested in your growth.

Paystack is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to providing employees with a work environment that is progressive and open-minded. Our employment philosophy is to hire the best people and empower them to do the best work of their lives. Employment decisions are based on business needs and individual merit without regard to race, color, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, gender or age.

title: Instructional Designer/Developer
description:
About the Role

ELB Learning is looking for a hands-on Instructional Designer/Developer to support a major enterprise transformation initiative for a large client in the events and experiential services industry.

This is a 20-hour/week contract opportunity, with an anticipated start in September 2026, supporting teams through new systems, updated processes, and broader business transformation initiatives.

The ideal candidate will be a well-rounded ID/Developer who can work comfortably across technical and non-technical audiences, translate complex processes into clear learning experiences, and help employees adapt to new ways of working.

A major part of the work will involve developing eLearning, simulations, software demonstrations, job aids, handouts, and other performance-support materials that employees can use as new systems and processes go live.

The client operates primarily on Central Time.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design and develop engaging learning solutions for software implementations, system changes, and business process transitions.

  • Create eLearning, job aids, handouts, process guides, simulations, demonstrations, and other performance-support materials.

  • Develop learning that helps employees understand not only what is changing, but how to perform their work successfully in the new environment.

  • Translate complex technical processes into clear, practical and learner-friendly content.

  • Support software/system training initiatives, including SAP and NetSuite-related transformation work.

  • Develop materials that allow learners and facilitators to practice and run simulations independently.

  • Create learning for both asynchronous and synchronous environments.

  • Partner with SMEs, project teams, communications, technical teams and business stakeholders throughout the development process.

  • Work closely with communications partners to incorporate appropriate change messaging and business context into learning materials.

  • Help teams transition from established processes to new ways of working while keeping the messaging positive and focused on the benefits of the change.

  • Facilitate discovery conversations and gather information from SMEs and stakeholders.

  • Manage multiple learning deliverables and shifting priorities while maintaining quality and deadlines.

  • Review existing learning materials and determine what can be reused, updated or rebuilt.

  • Support learning initiatives surrounding enterprise system and process transformations.

  • Develop practical performance support that employees can reference at the moment of need.

  • Ensure learning materials are clear, accessible, visually engaging and aligned with the client's business goals.

Key Projects

The role may support several enterprise initiatives, including:

SAP Conversion

  • Supporting the transition of the Sparks brand from NetSuite to SAP.

  • Helping employees understand differences between existing Sparks processes and Freeman's processes.

  • Developing learning and performance support as the project moves toward implementation.

ServiceNow

  • Supporting a longer-term ServiceNow initiative involving Deloitte.

  • Potentially updating existing learning materials and adapting content to new branding and processes.

Freeman Next

  • Supporting a large enterprise transition from an existing environment to a new operating model.

  • The initiative impacts event management and operations teams.

  • A major focus will be helping employees who have been accustomed to existing processes successfully adopt new ones.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of hands-on Instructional Design/Development experience.

  • Experience designing learning for software implementations, systems training, process changes, or technical environments.

  • Strong experience creating eLearning and performance-support materials.

  • Experience developing job aids, process guides, handouts, simulations and software demonstrations.

  • Experience working with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Comfortable collaborating with SMEs, project managers, communications teams, technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to take complex information and make it simple, clear and practical.

  • Experience working with organizations or teams that may be resistant to change or hesitant to adopt new processes.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to frame change positively and create learning that helps people understand the "why" behind the change.

  • Able to work independently while also collaborating closely with a larger project team.

  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities and working in a changing project environment.

Preferred Technical Skills

Experience with some or all of the following is highly desirable:

  • Articulate Rise 360

  • SAP

  • NetSuite

  • Powtoon

  • Synthesia

  • Other eLearning authoring and multimedia development tools

  • Software simulation/demo tools

Experience with SAP and/or NetSuite is strongly preferred, particularly experience supporting system implementations or conversions.

Success in This Role

The successful candidate will be someone who can step into a complex business environment, quickly understand how people currently work, identify what needs to change, and turn that information into clear, practical and engaging learning.

You should be comfortable asking questions, working with SMEs, challenging unclear information when needed, and helping teams move through change without making the learning feel overwhelming or negative.

title: Nightshift Warehouse Operative

This is a hands-on role where you will play a key part in picking stock, keeping stock moving safely, accurately and efficiently while working as part of a supportive and dependable team.

In return for your hard work and dedication we offer the added bonus of an excellent benefits package, which include – but are not limited to – the following:

  • Recognition schemes for our exceptional employees – monthly winners receive £100 of shopping vouchers

description:
The Project Manager - Construction leads the construction execution of complex, technically demanding projects for CRB clients, with accountability for safety, field coordination, subcontractor performance, schedule, cost, quality, change management, and client communication. This role is construction-forward: the Project Manager is expected to drive work in the field, coordinate closely with superintendents, trade partners, design/engineering teams, project controls, procurement, and commissioning stakeholders, and ensure the project is delivered in alignment with CRB’s standards for technical execution, client service, and financial performance. Single or multiple project assignments may be required.

  • Lead construction projects through planning, preconstruction, field execution, turnover, and closeout while maintaining alignment with project objectives, contract requirements, CRB standards, and client expectations
  • Drive site-level coordination with superintendents, trade contractors, suppliers, project controls, safety, quality, procurement, design, and commissioning teams
  • Manage project scope, budget, schedule, change events, RFIs, submittals, procurement status, construction documentation, risk items, and project reporting
  • Promote and enforce a strong safety culture, ensuring construction activities are planned and executed with safety, quality, and operational discipline at the forefront
  • Lead subcontractor and trade partner coordination, including performance management, issue resolution, sequencing, productivity tracking, and alignment to project milestones
  • Serve as a primary client-facing construction leader, maintaining clear communication, building trust, and creating a project experience that supports long-term client relationships
  • Coordinate closely with CRB’s integrated design and construction teams to resolve constructability issues, manage field changes, and support efficient project delivery
  • Maintain accountability for project financial performance, including cost forecasting, change management, schedule impacts, and timely escalation of risks or constraints

title: Merchandising Part Time Days
description:
Your Impact at Lowe's

As a Lowe's Merchandising Services Associate, you are a key connection point between Merchandising and Store Operations, allowing us to deliver a great shopping experience in every Lowe's store. If you want to build eye-catching displays and implement strategies that showcase in-demand products, you'll enjoy working with our Merchandising Services Team.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Keep your weekends free with a set weekday schedule. *
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

Your Day at Lowe's

As a Merchandising Services Associate, you ensure our store's signage, pricing information, and displays are accurate so merchandise is easy to locate. You create product displays that are safe, clean, visually appealing, and easy for customers to access.

While most of your time will be spent on activities that don't involve customer interaction, you may be expected to engage with customers when the opportunity arises. You'll be expected to listen to customers and answer questions, communicate product or warranty information, and assist in locating or handling merchandise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Confirm product pricing information is clearly visible and replace any missing price labels
  • Help drive add-on sales by staging clearance products, sorting products in proper locations, and ensuring displays are placed appropriately throughout the store
  • Repair/replace damaged or missing items, including signage, merchandise and displays.
  • Communicate project priorities, schedule, and needs with Merchandising Services Team and Manager

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing product merchandising tasks, including reading planograms and setting up and tearing down displays.

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. title: Network Security Engineer
description:
About Us:

ClearRoute is an engineering consultancy bridging Quality Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Developer Experience. We help enterprises reliably bring high-impact digital products to market faster, cheaper, and safer, working with technology leaders facing complex business challenges.

We take as much pride in our people, culture and work-life balance as we do in making better software. We’re not just making better software. We’re making the making of software better. Collaborative, entrepreneurial and dedicated to problem solving, we bring the step change our customer need to sustain innovation. Our values challenge us to do the best we can for ClearRoute, our customers and most importantly our team. This is an opportunity for you to build the organisation from the ground up, use your voice to drive change and help transform organisations and problem domains.

Role:

ClearRoute is looking for a Network Security Engineer to take ownership of firewall policy management and network security operations across our client estate, with AlgoSec at the centre of the toolset. You'll be the go-to specialist for administering the AlgoSec Security Management Suite, using it to automate policy governance, risk analysis, and compliance reporting across large, multi-vendor firewall environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work directly within regulated, enterprise-scale environments, reviewing and optimising firewall rule bases, running recertification exercises, and building the automation that takes manual, error-prone policy work off engineering teams' plates. You'll sit at the intersection of security engineering, operations, and governance, translating firewall and network security requirements into practical, auditable controls that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

Alongside the technical delivery, you'll be a trusted voice with both technical and executive stakeholders identifying where security posture, operational resilience, and business need are in tension, and helping clients navigate that trade-off with clear, well-reasoned recommendations.

Required Experience:

AlgoSec & Security Policy Management

  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting the AlgoSec Security Management Suite, including: Firewall Analyser, FireFlow, ObjectFlow, AppViz.

  • Experience utilising AlgoSec to automate firewall policy management, risk analysis, access recertification, change governance, and compliance reporting.

  • Strong understanding of application connectivity mapping, traffic flow analysis, and security policy optimisation.

Firewall & Network Security Technologies

  • Extensive experience managing large-scale, multi-vendor firewall environments, including: Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Cisco ASA / Firepower, Check Point.

  • Strong understanding of firewall architecture, policy administration, NAT, VPN technologies, segmentation, and micro-segmentation.

  • Experience performing firewall rule reviews, recertification exercises, policy optimisation, and risk reduction initiatives.

  • Knowledge of network access controls, intrusion prevention systems (IPS), intrusion detection systems (IDS), DDoS protection, and secure web gateway technologies.

Network Security Operations

  • Strong operational experience supporting enterprise network security environments.

  • Experience managing security incidents, firewall requests, policy exceptions, and operational support within regulated organisations.

  • Understanding of firewall compliance management, governance processes, audit requirements, and regulatory controls.

  • Experience working within ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Management frameworks.

Security Automation & Engineering

  • Experience automating network security processes, including; Firewall rule lifecycle management, Policy validation, Compliance reporting, Security control enforcement, Operational workflows.

  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Bash, and API-based integrations to support automation objectives.

  • Experience with automation platforms and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Chef, or equivalent solutions.

Additional Professional Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills across technical and executive audiences.

  • Ability to influence and drive security improvements across infrastructure, cloud, engineering, and operational teams.

  • Strong analytical approach to risk identification, remediation, and operational optimisation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical issues in a clear and concise manner.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance security, operational resilience, regulatory obligations, and business requirements.

Additional Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience implementing enterprise firewall governance programmes using AlgoSec or equivalent policy management platforms.

  • Experience with Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA), SASE, and Security Service Edge (SSE) technologies.

  • Experience within large-scale financial services, banking, or other highly regulated environments.

  • Knowledge of regulatory frameworks including PCI-DSS, ISO27001, NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Controls, and relevant financial industry regulations.

  • Experience supporting network security transformation, cloud migration, and hybrid networking programmes.

  • Familiarity with software-defined networking (SDN), network segmentation strategies, and modern secure connectivity solutions.

Working at ClearRoute
We have grown from six founders to 200+ people across five countries in three years, and what sets us apart isn't the pace, it's how we grow.

  • Real flexibility, in practice. We trust you to perform at your best and still have a life outside of work, with genuine hybrid working, a home office budget, an open feedback culture where your voice shapes decisions, and time off when life needs it (birthday included).

  • When ClearRoute wins, you win. We offer profit share so success is shared, meaningful recognition for great work, and benefits that look after you and your family, including private healthcare, competitive salary benchmarking, and a confidential employee assistance program covering counselling, mental health support, and financial wellbeing.

  • A community you'll genuinely want to be part of. Interest based communities like running and book clubs, Women in Tech group, monthly socials, and cross regional events bring people together across the company. An inclusive, collaborative culture where you don't need to conform to succeed, where people support one another and feel comfortable being themselves.

  • Where meaningful work meets real growth. You will tackle complex, real world problems at the forefront of platform engineering, AI, security, and scalable systems. Your growth is supported by learning budgets, Udemy access, a clear career framework, internal mobility, and thought leadership opportunities that take your impact beyond ClearRoute.

At ClearRoute, we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes, and inclusion creates the conditions for everyone to thrive. We are proud to have built a family friendly working environment and have many employees who have caring responsibilities alongside work. We welcome applications from people who require flexibility and will be happy to discuss needs on an individual basis.

We are committed to fostering a culture where all team members feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We celebrate individuality and our differences and understand that some differences may mean that you require changes made to the interview process. We are happy to cater to your needs to make the interview accessible, if this is something you require please let us know by emailing us at join@clearroute.io

title: Price Reporter, Forest
description:
The Role

To produce price assessments and market intelligence that are critical to the North American softwood industry. To cement our standing as the most trusted source of softwood pricing information for more than 80 years. To support and develop new avenues that further imbed our data and news across the industry.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assess hundreds of prices each week using our proprietary MInD database while adhering to our published methodologies and IOSCO principles.
  • Provide indispensable market commentary that provides context to the prices reported each week.
  • Produce market news and analysis for our Random Lengths Weekly Report, Random Lengths Midweek Report, Random Lengths Lumber and Panel Report, as well as the Fastmarkets dashboard.
  • Cultivate new sources for market data while maintaining our vast network of industry contacts.
  • Edit copy and peer review price assessments to ensure compliance with our published methodologies.
  • Attend industry conferences and events, represent the business through speaking engagements and industry outreach.

KEY INTERFACES

Work within an experienced team of reporters to produce softwood publications. More broadly collaborate with colleagues in other parts of the Forest Products business, including analysts and economists. Work with marketing and events teams to expand the reach of our price data and market reporting. Reports to softwood team leader.

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

  • Some professional writing experience, preferably in newspapers or other trade journals.
  • Ability to be self-motivated in a remote-work environment while also working collaboratively with teams across the organization.
  • Strong, concise writing and editing skills; ability to write authoritatively and to the point.
  • Comfort with numbers, statistics, and data-driven prose.
  • Strong interviewing skills and phone, email etiquette.
  • Ability to meet multiple weekly and daily deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
  • Prior knowledge of softwood industry a plus

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Reward and benefits at Fastmarkets

We believe in fair pay and benefits that support you both inside and outside of work. Through Fastmarkets Rewards, you'll have access to a range of core benefits and a flexible allowance, giving you the freedom to tailor your package to suit your lifestyle, wellbeing and financial priorities. We know that everyone's needs are different, so we've designed our benefits to support our diverse global team wherever they're based.

Specific benefits may vary by country and role.

If the position is listed as remote this opportunity is available to applicants based in the following states:


• Illinois
• Oregon
• New York
• Pennsylvania
• Texas*


* Denotes states with office locations to support hybrid working.

Otherwise the position will be located as shown in the advert.

You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!

If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day.

It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

title: Health & Safety Coordinator **Internal Applicants Only**
description:
We are currently seeking a Health & Safety Coordinator to join our Health & Safety team at our Oldham site on a full time permanent basis.

Salary: £27,123 per annum.

Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm.

As a Health & Safety Coordinator you will work closely with our internal Health and Safety, Quality and compliance teams to ensure the company maintains all required certifications (ISO 9001, OHSAS 18001 & ISO 14001) and is legally compliant in all its health, safety and quality activities.

Key Duties of a Health & Safety Coordinator:

  • Implementing improvement actions raised in connection with MAH (Major Accident Hazard).
  • Ensuring a suitable risk assessment process to establish MAH scenarios is implemented.
  • Keeping control and records for appointed contractors and planned site maintenance.

title: EHS Specialist | Marshall, NC
description:
Who We Are

FedUp Foods, one of the nation's early producers of kombucha through the Buchi brand, and one of the largest functional beverage manufacturers in America, offers a diverse portfolio of organic private label functional beverages for top global retailers.

Position Summary

The Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist supports site-level safety culture and compliance by leading assigned EHS programs and helping strengthen day-to-day EHS execution at their facility. This role partners with cross-functional site leadership to identify risk, strengthen compliance activities, improve safety systems, and promote proactive employee engagement under the guidance of the Sr EHS Manager. The EHS Specialist leads or supports routine incident investigations, job safety analysis (JSAs), risk assessments, training development and delivery, audit follow-up, and corrective action tracking based on scope and severity, while escalating complex regulatory, high-risk, or unresolved matters to the Sr EHS Manager.

  • Flexibility: Schedule is subject to change to meet demands. Candidates must be open to schedule adjustments based on operational needs.

An ideal applicant will be highly skilled, consistently punctual and enjoy working with a variety of skilled individuals who share similar values and goals.

General Duties/Responsibilities

  • EHS Program Execution, Risk Management, and Compliance

    • Lead routine safety inspections and audits; document findings, recommend corrective actions, track completion, and verify closure in partnership with area leaders
    • Lead or support investigations of workplace incidents, near-misses, and unsafe conditions based on severity; facilitate root cause analysis and recommend preventive actions in partnership with site leadership
    • Lead job safety analyses (JSAs) and risk assessments for new and existing processes; recommend practical controls to reduce risk
    • Maintain EHS documentation for training, inspections, incidents, and corrective actions; review records for completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness
    • Support and improve assigned OSHA, SQF, and other applicable compliance activities; identify gaps, recommend corrective actions, and escalate unresolved or high-risk items to the Sr EHS Manager
    • Prepare, analyze, and present safety performance metrics and updates to site leadership and the Senior EHS Manager; identify trends and recommend continuous improvement actions

    Environmental, PPE, and Emergency Readiness

    • Coordinate and lead assigned environmental compliance activities and escalate risks as needed
    • Coordinate and maintain the site PPE program, including inventory oversight and distribution
    • Coordinate emergency response preparedness activities and conduct regular drills in partnership with site leadership; document outcomes and track follow-up activities

    Safety Culture, Employee Engagement, and Cross-Functional Partnership

    • Facilitate site safety committee activities and employee engagement initiatives that promote proactive safety behaviors
    • Partner with all departments to coach safe work practices, support adherence to EHS procedures, and escalate gaps when needed
    • Serve as a site EHS resource for questions related to EHS procedures; coach employees and leaders while encouraging open communication about safety

Food Safety and Quality Responsibilities

  • Follow GMP policy when in the production facility and encourage your team to do the same.
  • Understand our SQF policies relating to pest control, visitors, allergen management, and cleaning and sanitation.
  • Demonstrate awareness of Management's Commitment to SQF and work towards Food Safety and Quality and help the company meet this commitment.
  • If there is a problem that involves food quality and safety, report to the Quality Assurance Manager so that the CAPA (corrective action, preventative action) log may be filled out, the situation be investigated, and resolved with the goal of continuous improvement of food quality and safety.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Leads by example and promotes a proactive, welcoming safety culture where employees feel comfortable raising concerns
  • Strong problem solver with the ability to assess risk, prioritize needs, and guide practical solutions
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify safety, compliance, and efficiency gaps
  • Positive, professional, and team-oriented attitude; builds trust and communicates clearly across departments
  • Proficient with company systems, spreadsheets, reporting tools, and EHS software needed to manage records and track action items
  • Able to develop, update, and implement EHS policies, programs, procedures, and training materials with guidance from the Sr EHS Manager
  • Flexible and able to respond to significant safety needs or incidents outside normal working hours when required
  • Must be flexible and able to respond to safety needs or incidents outside of normal working hours if required
  • Must complete required emergency response training, including CPR and First Aid, within 6 months of hire

Education and Experience

  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, or related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of hands-on EHS experience coordinating safety programs or supporting project-based assignments in manufacturing is preferred
  • Applied knowledge of OSHA general industry requirements required
  • Working experience with incident investigations, JSAs, risk assessment, inspections/audits, corrective action follow-up, training, and EHS recordkeeping required
  • Exposure to environmental compliance, emergency response, PPE programs, and safety committee facilitation preferred

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Work is performed in office and beverage production and warehousing environments
  • May be exposed to elevated noise levels, wet or slippery surfaces, temperature fluctuations, manufacturing dust, strong product aromas, fermentation byproducts, carbon dioxide (CO₂), cleaning and sanitation chemicals, and other manufacturing-related hazards
  • Ability to work in a crowded, noisy manufacturing facility, tolerate temperature and moisture extremes, walk on uneven or slippery surfaces, and maintain awareness of moving and stationary hazards
  • Ability to work at a desk with computer equipment approximately up to 60% of the time
  • Ability to lift, carry, and maneuver up to 50 pounds regularly and occasionally up to 100 pounds with a team lift
  • Ability to travel 10-15%; including twice a month to our Erwin, TN warehousing facility and annually to our Wilmington, NC facility.

Our Values

Agility • Collaboration • Communication • Lifelong Learning • Community • Gratitude

Our Benefits

  • Health Insurance (80–90% of individual premium covered)
  • Group Term Life Insurance (100% company-covered)
  • Short-Term Disability (100% company-covered)
  • Long-Term Disability (50% company-covered)
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) with Employer Match
  • 9 Paid Holidays, PTO & Sick Time

In this role, you’ll work on mission‑critical technologies with experienced engineers, with strong long‑term stability and advancement potential. Take a quick look at the area in this short video.

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. The Test Solutions (TS) Center within the Hardware Engineering Discipline is a multi-discipline organization responsible for developing Production and Engineering test equipment (TE) solutions for all Raytheon products. We are hands-on designers using the latest technologies and tools to integrate state-of-the-art test solutions.

TS products are utilized in engineering labs, foreign and domestic depots, and in production testing environments utilized for tactical products. TS has work opportunities across all phases of the engineering lifecycle, including demonstrations, early engineering tests, design verification tests, production, and post-production sustainment.

The Test Solutions Center seeks a Test Solutions, Senior Principal Program Lead to oversee multiple project teams who are responsible for the execution of capital TE scope.

Capital Execution Leaders are responsible for all elements of capital TE scope through all lifecycles, budget, metrics and Estimates At Completion (EACs).

The selected candidate will support and drive the development of capital execution rigor and long-range planning for engineering and operations capital. You will establish meaningful and measurable goals and communicate effectively with your team to ensure alignment with the department and directorate.   • Follow TE EAC process for scope execution and metric generation
  • Lead by example, adhere to, and ensure alignment with Raytheon values and behaviors
  • Collaborate with multi-discipline teams in the operation, testing, and troubleshooting of systems

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 10 years of prior relevant experience or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years relevant experience
  • At least ten (10) years of leadership experience overseeing mid- to large-scale technical teams and projects
  • Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM), and baselining Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) of projects
  • Experience with bidding proposals and long-range planning

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience working with Program Configuration Management principles and tools such as IMS, PMX tools, or tracking books
  • Knowledge of business and program improvements through process improvement methodologies
  • Experience supporting technical issue resolution, and mentoring early career staff members, or managing project teams of various sizes

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. DIRECT COUNSELING AND CASE MANAGEMENT

  • Provides short-term and ongoing counseling for enrolled students who present with emotional, personal, or psychological concerns.
  • Provides counseling for enrolled students with focus on bereavement, depression, anxiety, eating disorders, family relations, interpersonal relationships, reconciliation, relationship violence, sexual assault, stress management, substance abuse, suicide prevention, and addictions under the supervision of the Director of Counseling Services or designee.
  • Provides individual, group, couples, and family counseling for enrolled students.
  • Conduct intake interviews, develops treatment goals, and evaluates client progress under the supervision of the Director of Counseling Services or designee.
  • Prepare clients for transition out of counseling through discharge planning. Maintains confidentiality of records relating to client treatment in accordance with FERPA requirements & legal, ethical, professional standards.
  • Administer, interpret, and provide feedback results of psychological screening tools and assessments under the supervision of the Director of Counseling Services or designee.
  • Consult and collaborate with university personnel and off-campus mental health and psychiatric services.
  • Offer consultation to faculty, administrators, and other university employees related to student concerns.
  • Refer to appropriate professionals for assessment, treatment and follow-up as needed.
  • Maintain complete, organized, and timely electronic health record in accordance with legal, ethical, professional standards, and prudent professional practice.
  • Manage caseload through the use of scheduling software.

CRISIS AND EMERGENCY INTERVENTION

  • Assist with emergency interventions and coordination of treatment plans with necessary campus and community resources under the supervision of the Director of Counseling Services or designee.
  • Assist and/or manage crisis intervention according to procedures, with referral to campus and community resources as needed.
  • Provides follow-up support for the campus community, providing services as needed.
  • May be asked to assist with emergency duties during and after the regular office hours.
  • Conduct email or phone outreach to students as designated by Director of Counseling Services.
  • Remain informed of emergency policy and procedures for the unit as well as the University.

PSYCHO-EDUCATIONAL PROGRAMMING

  • Assist in maintaining the Counseling Services web site to keep students up to date on resources and programs available for support.
  • Provide psycho-educational programming for students, employees, faculty, and the campus community.
  • Plans and implements campus-wide promotional print and education materials for mental health maintenance and promotion.
  • Provides consultation and training to student development staff, student services staff, faculty and other Viterbo employees regarding psychological development and behavioral health matters.
  • Provide and displays information to students and/or families at events such as STAR registrations, new student orientation programs, Athletic team trainings, RA and OA trainings and the Welcome Back Bash.

OTHER

  • May be asked to serve on the PROMISE Committee along with Director of Counseling Services; assists in implementation of initiatives.
  • May be asked to serve on CARE Committee along with Director of Counseling Services.
  • Ensure compliance with university, local, state and federal regulations and guidelines and maintain complete, accurate and updated records.
  • Keep abreast of current developments in college and university counseling services including regulations and guidelines.
  • Uphold professional license in good standing, remain in compliance with requirements for continuing education based on state and ethical guidelines.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development opportunities to maintain understanding of evidence-based practices.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in a Counseling or like program.
  • LPC, LPC-IT or an equivalent license in a mental health field required.
  • Must be licensable in the state of Wisconsin.
  • Experience or interest in working with individuals struggling with substance use and other addictive types of behavior are preferred.

To Apply: Please complete the online employment application form and upload a letter of interest highlighting your experiences to support your candidacy., CV/resume, and three professional references.

Alignment: Viterbo University seeks employees who will embrace the University mission and incorporate our values into their day-to-day work.

Mission: The Viterbo University community prepares students for faithful service and ethical leadership.

Values: In keeping with the tradition of our Franciscan founders, we hold the following core values:

  • Contemplation, reflecting upon the presence of God in our lives and work
  • Hospitality, welcoming everyone we encounter as an honored guest
  • Integrity, striving for honesty in everything we say and do
  • Service, working for the common good in the spirit of humility and joy
  • Stewardship, practicing responsible use of all resources in our trust

About the University: Viterbo University is a private, not-for-profit, Catholic, Franciscan institutions founded by the Franciscan Sisters of Perpetual Adoration in 1871. Viterbo offers a student-centered liberal arts education with a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs. Located in La Crosse, Wisconsin, the university is nestled along the scenic Mississippi River and surrounded by the stunning bluffs. The local area combines natural beauty with a vibrant, welcoming community, offering opportunities for outdoor recreation, arts and culture. title: Senior Solution Delivery Manager
description:
A bit about the team and what you'll deliver...

We’re looking for a Senior Solution Delivery Manager to lead our regional Pre-Sales, Customer Onboarding and Technical Account Management teams across APAC.

As part of our global Solutions Delivery organisation, you'll combine technical expertise, customer leadership and people management to ensure our customers successfully adopt, implement and grow their use of Trustonic solutions.

You'll work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to shape regional strategy, lead complex customer engagements, improve our ways of working and ensure we deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

You'll be a trusted technical advisor to our customers, bringing a deep understanding of the Trustonic Platform, device locking, OEM integration and secure technologies, while also developing a high-performing regional team.

The role covers APAC and involves approximately 25–40% travel for customer meetings, trade shows and company events globally.

As the Senior Solution Delivery Manager, you will:

Team leadership & operational excellence

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional Pre-Sales, Customer Onboarding and Technical Account Management teams.
  • Set and track team objectives aligned to customer success and business goals.
  • Build a high-performance culture through regular 1:1s, feedback, coaching and development.
  • Develop scalable operating models, playbooks and best practices across Pre-Sales, Delivery and TAM.
  • Identify and remove operational bottlenecks to improve team efficiency and customer responsiveness.
  • Monitor customer health, adoption, KPIs and account risks, providing regular reporting to the VP Global Solutions Delivery.
  • Identify and develop tools that improve internal processes and customer engagement.

Strategic Pre-Sales & customer engagement

  • Lead technical engagement for strategic and complex opportunities alongside Sales leadership.
  • Own regional qualification criteria and prioritisation for Pre-Sales engagements.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing and the Pre-Sales Centre of Excellence to adapt global strategies to the APAC market.
  • Lead technical discovery with strategic customers, understanding their technical, functional and security requirements.
  • Represent Trustonic at industry conferences, technical forums and customer events.
  • Use customer and market insight to identify competitive risks, common technical blockers and opportunities to influence Product and Engineering roadmaps.

Customer delivery & technical leadership

  • Act as a senior technical advisor across Trustonic's services and solutions.
  • Support complex customer onboarding and implementation programmes, ensuring successful delivery with available resources.
  • Build strong relationships with strategic customers and understand their technology strategies and business objectives.
  • Oversee customer engagement across the lifecycle, from Pre-Sales and onboarding through to adoption, growth and technical support.
  • Manage and coordinate technical escalations, working closely with Commercial, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams.
  • Ensure the regional team is kept up to date with Telecoms Platform product updates, best practices and relevant training.
  • Help reduce time-to-revenue by improving qualification, handovers, onboarding and delivery processes.

Who you are...

A strategic, technically strong and customer-focused leader who enjoys solving complex problems, developing people and building strong relationships with customers.

You're equally comfortable leading a team, discussing technical architecture with engineers, working through complex customer challenges and influencing senior stakeholders.

You bring structure to complex environments and enjoy finding ways to make teams more effective. You're proactive, curious and commercially aware, with the ability to balance the needs of customers, your team and the wider business.

You're comfortable operating in a fast-moving international environment where priorities evolve and collaboration across regions is essential.

What makes you, you...

Experience

  • Experience leading Pre-Sales, Solutions Delivery, Customer Onboarding, Technical Account Management or similar technical customer-facing teams.
  • Strong experience managing and developing technical teams.
  • Proven experience working with strategic enterprise customers and complex customer relationships.
  • Experience planning and delivering multiple complex customer rollouts, often with limited resources.
  • Experience working in a SaaS and/or System Integration environment.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and technical solution delivery.
  • Experience working with secure systems and technologies, ideally including device locking.
  • Experience with OEM integration, software update management and device security.
  • Experience working within the smartphone, telecoms or wider mobile ecosystem would be highly desirable.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong technical and commercial understanding of customer solution delivery.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
  • Strong influencing, negotiation and mediation skills.
  • Ability to motivate and drive progress across teams without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, creative approach.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with project management tools such as Wrike and customer platforms such as Zendesk would be beneficial.
  • An understanding of AI and Agentic AI and their potential application in a technical/customer environment.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

It would be great if you also have...

  • Experience working across APAC markets, particularly India, Pakistan, Malaysia, Philippines or Indonesia.
  • Experience in the telecoms industry or smartphone ecosystem.
  • Experience with device locking technologies and OEM environments.
  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent level of skill, experience and knowledge.
  • Experience and knowledge in Computer Science and Information & Technology.

What we can provide you in return for your investment...

Competitive compensation

  • A base salary that reflects your expertise and impact.
  • Bonus scheme to share in our success.

Financial security & wellbeing

  • Private medical insurance for you from day one.

Flexibility & work-life balance

  • Remote working arrangements to support your lifestyle.
  • An open holiday policy with no upper limit—take the time you need, when you need it.
  • Support for volunteering and causes that matter to you.

Growth & development

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Exposure and interaction with global teams.

Inclusive, supportive culture

  • A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • A collaborative environment where your voice is valued and your wellbeing is prioritised.

Impact & purpose

  • The chance to work on technology that drives global economic inclusion and makes a real difference in people’s lives.

#LI-Remote

Trustonic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on any grounds. We empower, engage, enable and value differences between people, including; different races, ethnicities, genders, ages, religions, disabilities and sexual orientations, with differences in education, backgrounds, skill sets, experiences and knowledge.

title: Chef(fe) d’équipe, Industrialisation avancée  / Team Lead, Advanced Industrialization
description:

Country:

Canada

Emplacement / Location:

CA-QC-LONGUEUIL-J01 ~ 1000 Blvd Marie-Victorin ~ J01 BLDG

English will follow

Titre du post e : Chef(fe) d’équipe, Industrialisation avancée

À propos de & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ?

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) leader expérimenté(e), proactif(ve) et mobilisateur(trice) pour soutenir et accompagner une équipe de responsables de l’industrialisation avancée. Cette équipe pilote les stratégies d’approvisionnement et de fabrication de nouveaux composants durables, de l’assemblage des moteurs et des activités d’essais, tout en soutenant la préparation des programmes en matière de MRL.

Avec votre équipe, vous veillerez à assurer la maturité industrielle des futurs programmes en vous assurant que les fournisseurs, partenaires, sites de fabrication ainsi que les sites d’assemblage et d’essais de P&WC sont capables, compétitifs, dotés de solutions numériques et alignés sur les échéanciers des programmes et les exigences techniques. Ce rôle stratégique nécessite une approche axée sur les risques ainsi que la capacité à orienter l’innovation au sein de chaînes d’approvisionnement mondiales dans un environnement hautement réglementé et axé sur la performance.

Vous travaillerez directement avec les équipes d’ingénierie, les producteurs, la gestion des approvisionnements, le MED, l’assemblage et les essais, les partenaires, les équipementiers (OEM), la qualité, l’après-marché ainsi qu’avec d’autres parties prenantes clés afin de faire progresser les livrables des programmes en matière de sécurité, de qualité, de livraison, de satisfaction client et d’environnement, de santé et de sécurité (EH&S).

Ce poste vous offre l’occasion de travailler avec des technologies de propulsion et de fabrication de pointe, de collaborer avec des chaînes d’approvisionnement internationales et de travailler étroitement avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de marketing, d’après-marché et des opérations. Vous rejoindrez une équipe performante et innovante, évoluant dans un environnement techniquement riche et offrant de solides possibilités de développement de carrière.

Joignez-vous à une équipe dynamique et tournée vers l’avenir, au cœur de l’innovation aérospatiale. Vous contribuerez aux décisions stratégiques en matière de fabrication avancée, collaborerez avec des partenaires et fournisseurs internationaux et participerez à l’élaboration de la stratégie industrielle de systèmes de propulsion durables. Il s’agit d’une occasion unique de contribuer à une transformation à fort impact dans un environnement collaboratif qui valorise l’excellence technique, l’innovation et l’amélioration continue.

Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ?

  • Gérer le développement du matériel de projet en pilotant les activités liées à l’approvisionnement stratégique, aux coûts, à la capacité de fabrication et à la fabricabilité.

  • Documenter et suivre les exigences du produit, notamment les coûts, le poids, la fabricabilité et les coûts directs de maintenance, ainsi que la planification des ressources et le développement et le suivi des plans et échéanciers des jalons.

  • Effectuer le suivi et gérer les risques liés au programme identifiés dans le cadre du processus de gestion des risques.

  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement d’affaires hautement dynamique.

  • Assurer l’interface avec les gestionnaires de programme concernant tout écart potentiel par rapport aux échéanciers et aux coûts de référence, soutenir la planification des mesures d’atténuation, le cas échéant, et contribuer à l’identification de solutions.

  • Veiller à ce que les fournisseurs, partenaires et sites disposent de plans de maturation du niveau de préparation à la fabrication (MRL) et d’échéanciers de livraison soutenant les jalons du programme et la montée en cadence, tout en sécurisant les capacités, compétences, infrastructures et ressources futures.

  • Identifier les projets et investissements en dépenses d’investissement (CapEx) requis pour l’outillage, les procédés spéciaux, les infrastructures d’essai et le déploiement de nouvelles technologies; collaborer avec les OPE et les contrôleurs de coûts afin de finaliser les analyses de rentabilité.

  • Soutenir les évaluations des niveaux de préparation technologique (TRL) et de préparation à la fabrication (MRL) pour les nouvelles technologies.

  • Fournir un soutien en gestion de projets et aux activités interfonctionnelles du programme : travailler en étroite collaboration avec les membres du PMT, de l’ingénierie de projet et des équipes d’ingénierie, d’après-marché, de chaîne d’approvisionnement, de fabrication ainsi que d’assemblage et d’essais afin d’assurer l’alignement et de faciliter le développement, de la phase conceptuelle jusqu’aux jalons du programme ou à l’achèvement du projet.

  • Soutenir l’équipe dans l’ensemble des activités d’approvisionnement et de fabrication des composants critiques de moteurs, des modules, de l’assemblage, de l’outillage et des systèmes d’essai pour les nouveaux programmes jusqu’à l’achèvement du projet (programmes de démonstrateurs, archétypes 1 à 4) ou jusqu’au jalon C du RLPM (archétypes 5 à 10).

  • Diriger, avec l’OPE d’industrialisation avancée, les responsables et les ingénieurs industriels, la planification et l’exécution des jalons RLPM et des livrables liés à la préparation à la production, en cohérence avec le plan de production.

Développer les stratégies d’approvisionnement et de fabrication :

  • Soutenir l’équipe dans la définition des stratégies de fabrication interne, d’achat ou de partenariat pour l’ensemble des nouveaux composants, en comprenant les exigences techniques et opérationnelles et en intégrant de nouveaux partenaires, fournisseurs et technologies de fabrication avancées (p. ex. moulage de précision, usinage de superalliages, revêtements, fabrication additive).

  • Collaborer avec les ingénieurs d’industrialisation afin d’évaluer les fournisseurs, partenaires ainsi que les sites de production et d’assemblage et d’essais selon des critères de qualité, de coût, de fiabilité, de capacité, de compétences et de technologies futures.

Gérer et soutenir l’équipe dans les négociations des ententes critiques à long terme avant l’attribution de nouveaux contrats de production :

  • Incluant les prix des produits, les coûts non récurrents, les échéanciers de développement, les ententes de réparation et de révision, l’outillage ainsi que les modalités et conditions.

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe des partenariats afin de développer des modèles de partage des risques pour les projets de développement industriel.

Assurer la sécurité des livraisons : initier les lancements d’approvisionnement ou de production des composants, modules et activités d’assemblage et d’essais des moteurs; mobiliser les fournisseurs, partenaires et sites afin qu’ils respectent les dates de livraison prévues; gérer les rapports de ligne d’équilibre et de travaux en cours (WIP) et communiquer avec précision l’état d’avancement aux parties prenantes.

Optimiser avec l’équipe la préparation à l’approvisionnement, à la fabrication et à l’assemblage et aux essais :

  • Mobiliser les fournisseurs, partenaires et sites dès les premières étapes du développement produit afin d’identifier des possibilités d’optimisation de la conception, d’amélioration de l’efficacité et de réduction des coûts grâce à l’ingénierie de la valeur (DfC, DFM, DFA).

  • Collaborer avec l’ingénierie du contrôle des coûts et les responsables de l’industrialisation avancée afin d’établir la référence de coûts du programme, de suivre l’évolution du FSC et d’identifier des solutions alternatives de conception et de fabrication permettant d’améliorer les marges et d’atténuer les risques, en faisant appel au PMT au besoin.

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?

  • Baccalauréat en aéronautique, chaîne d’approvisionnement, génie mécanique, génie manufacturier, génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • De 8 à 12 ans d’expérience en gestion de la chaîne d’approvisionnement de composants de moteurs aéronautiques, en fabrication, en industrialisation ou dans un secteur industriel hautement spécialisé similaire.

  • Solide connaissance des procédés de fabrication aéronautique (moulage, usinage, revêtements, fabrication additive) et des matériaux (Inconel, alliages de titane, céramiques, composites), ou expérience dans des secteurs réglementés.

  • Expérience démontrée en collaboration interfonctionnelle, en communication, en évaluation des risques, en résolution de problèmes et en gestion de projets (planification technique, contrôle des coûts, atténuation des risques).

  • Connaissance des cadres TRL/MRL, des modèles de maturité industrielle et des méthodes d’évaluation des risques.

  • Expérience avec des systèmes ERP (SAP, Oracle), des outils d’approvisionnement ainsi que des systèmes de suivi de la performance des fournisseurs et des partenaires.

  • Expérience avec des programmes de moteurs aéronautiques, civils ou militaires.

  • Capacité à travailler sous pression et à gérer des situations urgentes.

  • Capacité à diriger des équipes au sein de réseaux multisites et internationaux de fournisseurs et de partenaires.

  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement d’affaires hautement dynamique.

  • Les certifications Six Sigma, Lean ou PMP constituent un atout.

  • Connaissance pratique des applications logicielles pertinentes, notamment les outils Microsoft Office (Excel, Project et PowerPoint) ainsi que MS Project.

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme de régime de retraite et d’épargne avec cotisation de l’employeur

  • Programme d’assurance collective

  • Possibilités d’avancement (progression de carrière)

  • Programme de mérite ou programme de reconnaissance

  • Programme de santé et bien-être, y compris la télémédecine

  • Club récréatif et sportif

  • Garderies à proximité

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés.
