Job title : Team Lead, Advanced Industrialization

About Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters.

For nearly 100 years, our teams have been at the forefront of propulsion technology, pushing boundaries to make flight more efficient and reliable. Our engines support missions that truly matter, from transporting people and essential goods, to enabling emergency medical services, humanitarian operations, and wildfire suppression around the world.

An Employer of Choice

Pratt & Whitney Canada was named one of Canada’s Best Employers for 2026 by Forbes, marking the 11th consecutive year the company has earned this recognition. Pratt & Whitney Canada also ranked #1 employer in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. In addition, our headquarters continues to be recognized among the top employers in the Montreal region. Together, these distinctions reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, across Canada, and around the world.

Why join our team?

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and cross-functional leader to support and coach a team of Advanced Industrialization Leads. This team drives sourcing and manufacturing strategies for new sustainable components, engine assembly, and testing, while supporting program MRL readiness.

You and the team will ensure the industrial maturity of future programs by making sure P&WC’s suppliers, partners, manufacturing, and Assembly & Test sites are capable, competitive, digitally enabled, and aligned with program timelines and technical requirements. This strategic role demands a risk-based mindset and the ability to guide innovation across global supply chains in a highly regulated, high-performance environment.

You will work directly with the Engineering, Producers, Supply Management, MED, A&T, Partners, OEMs, Quality, Aftermarket, and other key stakeholders to drive program deliverables on safety, quality, delivery, customer satisfaction and EH&S.

This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge propulsion and manufacturing technologies, engage with international supply chains, and collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, aftermarket, and operations teams. You will join a high-performing, innovative team in a technically rich environment with strong career growth opportunities.

Join a dynamic, forward-looking team at the heart of aerospace innovation. You will contribute to strategic decisions in advanced manufacturing, collaborate with international partners and suppliers, and help shape the industrial strategy for sustainable propulsion systems. This is a unique opportunity to drive high-impact transformation within a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The position is based at our Longueuil location, from Monday to Friday, with flexible hours and exclusively on-site.

What will your day-to-day look like?

  • Manage project development hardware by driving activities related to strategic sourcing, cost, manufacturing capacity, and producibility.
  • Document and monitor product requirements, including cost, weight, producibility, direct maintenance costs, as well as resource planning and the development and monitoring of milestone plans and schedules.
  • Track and manage program risks identified through the risk management process.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a highly dynamic business environment.
  • Interface with Program Managers regarding any potential variances from baseline schedule and cost; support mitigation planning, where appropriate, and contribute to identifying solutions.
  • Ensure suppliers, partners, and sites have Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) maturation plans and delivery schedules supporting program gates and ramp-up, while securing future capacity, capabilities, infrastructure, and resources.
  • Identify required Capital Expenditure (CapEx) projects and investments for tooling, special processes, test infrastructure, and new technology deployment; collaborate with OPEs and Cost Controllers to finalize business cases.
  • Support Technology Readiness Level (TRL) and Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) assessments for new technologies.
  • Provide project management and cross-functional program support: work closely with PMT members, project engineering, engineering, aftermarket, supply chain, manufacturing, and assembly & test teams to ensure alignment and facilitate development from the concept phase through program gates or project completion.
  • Support the team in all procurement and manufacturing activities for critical engine components, modules, assembly, tooling, and test systems for new programs through project completion (demonstrator programs, Archetypes 1–4) or RLPM Gate C (Archetypes 5–10).
  • Lead, with the Advanced Industrialization OPE, Leads, and Industrial Engineers, the planning and execution of RLPM gates and production readiness deliverables, aligned with the production plan.

Develop Sourcing and Manufacturing Strategies:

  • Support the team in defining make, buy, or partner strategies for all new components by understanding technical and operational requirements and onboarding new partners, suppliers, and advanced manufacturing technologies (e.g., precision casting, superalloy machining, coatings, additive manufacturing).
  • Collaborate with Industrialization Engineers to evaluate suppliers, partners, and production and assembly & test sites based on quality, cost, reliability, capacity, capabilities, and future technologies.

Manage and Support the Team in Negotiating Critical Long-Term Agreements Prior to New Production Awards:

  • Including product pricing, non-recurring costs, development schedules, repair and overhaul agreements, tooling, and terms and conditions.
  • Collaborate with the Partnership team to develop risk-sharing models for industrial development projects.

Ensure Delivery Assurance: initiate procurement or production launches for components, modules, and engine assembly & test activities; drive suppliers, partners, and sites to meet committed delivery dates; manage line-of-balance and work-in-progress (WIP) reports and communicate status accurately to stakeholders.

Optimize, with the Team, Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Assembly & Test Readiness:

  • Engage suppliers, partners, and sites early in product development to identify opportunities for design optimization, improved efficiency, and cost reduction through value engineering (DfC, DFM, DFA).
  • Collaborate with Cost Control Engineering and Advanced Industrialization Leads to establish the program cost baseline, track FSC evolution, and identify alternative design and manufacturing solutions to improve margins and mitigate risks, leveraging the PMT as needed.

What do you need to be successful?

  • Bachelor’s in Aerospace, Supply Chain, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering.
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in aerospace engine component supply chain management, manufacturing, industrialization, or similar high-spec industries.
  • Strong knowledge of aerospace manufacturing processes (casting, machining, coatings, additive manufacturing) and materials (Inconel, titanium alloys, ceramics, composites), or experience in regulated industries.
  • Proven skills in cross-functional collaboration, communication, risk assessment, problem-solving, and project management (technical planning, cost control, risk mitigation).
  • Familiarity with TRL/MRL frameworks, industrial maturity models, and risk assessments.
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), sourcing tools, and suppliers/partner performance tracking systems.
  • Experience with aerospace engine programs (civil or military).
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage urgent situations.
  • Ability to lead teams across multisite and international supplier and partner networks.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a highly dynamic business environment.
  • Certifications in Six Sigma, Lean, or PMP are an advantage.
  • Practical knowledge of relevant software applications, including Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Project, and PowerPoint) and MS Project.

This position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a very good knowledge of English to read and understand, on a daily basis, documentation and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.

What do we offer?

  • Pension and savings plan with employer contributions

  • Group insurance program

  • Opportunities for advancement (career progression)

  • Merit or recognition program

  • Health and wellness program, including virtual health care

  • Recreational and sports club

  • Nearby daycares

  • Transportation accessibility or public transit program and free parking

Working at Pratt & Whitney Canada

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, we combine passion, boldness, and precision to design, manufacture, and maintain the most advanced and reliable aircraft engines in the world. Our work and the quality of our products contribute to the success of our customers, who in turn save lives, support commerce, connect communities, and protect freedoms.

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, you have the opportunity to make a difference every day—just look up. Are you ready to go beyond?

title: Account Assistant, Lifestyle
description:

With a strong presence in fashion capitals such as Milan, London, Paris, and New York, the agency has built a reputation for representing some of the most prestigious names in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle.

In 2017, Karla Otto merged with K2 to form THE INDEPENDENTS, a global marketing, design, and communications group. This collective brings together industry leaders who share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and thoughtful collaboration across the luxury and lifestyle sectors.

At Karla Otto, our team of expert strategists, designers, planners and publicists are dedicated to delivering exceptional results and establishing long-term partnerships with our clients. We are passionate about the world of fashion, beauty, and luxury, with everyone bringing their unique expertise and insights to the table. We are driven by a shared commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the ever-evolving industry landscape.

To help support our future growth as an agency, we are looking for an Account Assistant, Lifestyle to join our team based in our New York office.

Key Responsibilities

Client services

  • Prepare agendas, meeting minutes and media updates for client calls

  • Collaborate with the account team to identify opportunities to increase product/brand visibility.

  • Aid in the development and execution of PR campaigns, including product launches, events and media activations

Coverage & reporting

  • Compile and review editorial clippings to clients

  • Monitoring and sharing coverage across print, online and social media with clients

  • Compile client reports on a weekly, monthly and quarterly basis that highlight success or opportunities against the agreed key performance indicators for individual clients

Events

  • Build and cultivate relationships with members of press by supporting with showroom appointments, events, and press meetings.

  • Managing the guest list for events,

  • Provide essential support at events, with projects and shows including evening/weekend support as required.

  • Managing guest list for events, sending/tracking RSVP’s and producing post event recaps for both internal teams and clients

Business requirements

  • Keeps up to date with developments in the media, staying on top of industry trends and competitors.

  • Updating and maintaining contact database and industry moves

  • Ad hoc administrative tasks across the communications department.

Key Attributes

  • Experience as public relations and/or communications, marketing intern.

  • Interest in home and product design, interior design/architecture, culture, arts, fashion, hospitality and lifestyle and can talk confidently and make suggestions about how these elements can be used to enhance our clients offering

  • Strong communication skills (both written and oral), research, and organization skills

  • Ability to work under pressure, to meet deadlines and prioritize in a fast paced environment

  • Confidence to make suggestions, bring ideas to the wider team that focuses on client experience and work as part of a team.

  • You have experience in monitoring and tracking global media coverage and utilizing tools to measure impact and report back to the business

  • Positive attitude to challenging situations and a willingness to go above and beyond the call of duty in order to complete a project accurately and on time

  • Highly motivated and enthusiastic

  • Strong work ethic

  • Must be efficient in Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint

What We Offer

  • Commuter Benefits

title: Director of Operations with heavy Civil Construction (Arizona)
description:

  • The Ideal candidate would be someone that is from the AZ market.

This person will:

  • Work directly with Project Managers and Superintendents to drive successful project execution
  • Maintain accountability for project financial performance, schedule, safety, quality and staffing
  • Review monthly project cost and revenue projections and support company revenue forecasting
  • Oversee manpower and equipment planning across projects
  • Maintain strong relationships with owners, clients, subcontractors, architects and engineers
  • Support projects from preconstruction through completion and help resolve complex operational and contractual issues
  • Review and negotiate change orders and identify and mitigate project risk
  • Partner with leadership on business development, proposal and preconstruction efforts

  • Support recruiting, performance management and succession planning for operational teams

REQUIREMENTS:
  • We are looking for someone who brings both strong construction knowledge and the leadership ability to operate at a broader business level.
The ideal candidate will have:
  • 15+ years of progressive construction experience, including significant Project Management and operational leadership responsibility
  • Experience leading multiple projects and project teams
  • Strong understanding of project financials, forecasting, cost control, scheduling, change management and risk
  • Proven ability to lead and develop Project Managers, Superintendents and project staff
  • Experience developing and maintaining relationships with owners and clients
  • Experience supporting business development and preconstruction efforts
  • Strong negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills
  • Working knowledge of construction technology including HCSS, Primavera, Bluebeam and Microsoft Office
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered

title: Personlig assistent 64% rad - främst kväll & helg
description:
På Inre Kraft arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

OM TJÄNSTEN

Vi på Inre Kraft söker nu personlig assistent till en av våra barnkunder i Sävast. Vi erbjuder just nu en fast tillsvidareanställning på 64%. Du arbetar främst kvällspass och helger, men även enstaka dagpass förekommer.

Arbetstiderna är följande:

  • Kl. 16.00-21.00

  • Kl. 07.15-16.00

  • Helg kl. 09.00-21.00

På kvällar och helger så arbetar du med flickan i hennes hemmiljö och under dagtid vardagar följer du med henne till skolan. Du arbetar nära henne i alla moment och bidrar till att skapa trygghet, utveckling och livskvalitet i hennes vardag.

Detta är ett uppdrag med ett omfattande omvårdnads- och tillsynsansvar, där du som assistent behöver vara närvarande, uppmärksam och trygg i din roll.

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse där vi gärna ser att du kan påbörja introduktion omgående.

OM KUNDEN

Du kommer att arbeta med en härlig flicka i 8-årsåldern som tycker om sång, böcker och lek. Hon uppskattar närvaro, trygghet och att få dela små och stora stunder tillsammans med sin assistent.

Vid födseln drabbades hon av syrebrist, vilket har lett till omfattande hjärnskador, flerfunktionsnedsättning, intellektuell funktionsnedsättning och epilepsi. Hon har ett omfattande vårdbehov och behöver ständig tillsyn samt stöd i alla delar av sin vardag.

Det innebär att du som assistent ansvarar för både grundläggande omvårdnad och medicinska moment. Hon behöver hjälp med:

  • Personlig hygien, av- och påklädning samt måltider

  • Förflyttningar samt medicinering

  • Kommunikation och socialt samspel

  • Dagliga rutiner i hem och skola

Hon använder hjälpmedel såsom lyft, slemsug och sond, och du får introduktion och stöd för att känna dig trygg i samtliga moment.

ÄR DU DEN VI SÖKER?

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint engagemang för att arbeta med barn och som ser värdet i att skapa trygghet och livskvalitet i en annan människas vardag. Du är lyhörd, lugn, trygg och ansvarstagande person som känner dig bekväm med ett uppdrag som innebär ett omfattande vård- och tillsynsansvar.Detta är ett uppdrag som ställer krav på ansvar, noggrannhet och engagemang – men som samtidigt ger en unik möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i ett barns liv. Om du känner att detta stämmer in på dig, kan du vara den vi söker!

KRAV

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska språket i tal och skrift

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som personlig assistent/annan vårderfarenhet

MERITER

  • Vårdutbildning

Sysselsättningsgrad: 1 st tillsvidareanställning 64%

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal.

Din ansökan kommer att läsas av medarbetare på Inre Kraft, kund och anhörig.
Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen.
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

För anställning hos oss på Inre Kraft behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och/eller lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ner på Skatteverkets hemsida. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent behöver du vara minst 18 år.

Om du ska arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdraget beställs av via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

title: Senior CORE Pracitioner
description:
Date Posted:

2026-08-24

Country:

United Kingdom

Location:

Glenrothes, Fife

Position Role Type:

Onsite

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defence company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defence.

Raytheon UK

At Raytheon UK, we take immense pride in being a leader in defence and aerospace technology. As an employer, we are dedicated to fuelling innovation, nurturing talent, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Joining our team means being part of an organisation that shapes the future of national security whilst investing in your growth and personal development. We provide a collaborative environment, abundant opportunities for professional development, and a profound sense of purpose in what we do. Together, we are not just advancing technology; we're building a community committed to safeguarding a safer and more connected world.

Summary of Role:

“Customer Oriented Results & Excellence (CORE for short), is the RTX operating system, focusing on the drivers of competitive excellence — our people and our work processes. Our CORE Operating System puts customers first by aligning priorities, accelerating integration, and delivering measurable value. Using a shared language and methodology, we strengthen how we work together and empower employees to improve their work—every day.”

Based at our Livingston site, the Senior CORE Champion is a stand-alone role focussed on continuous improvement in the Manufacturing environment. Using CORE improvement methodologies and working alongside our CORE Lead, you will be a champion for creating a culture of continuous improvement with Manufacturing.

Lead the development and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes, standards and systems to improve safety, people, quality, delivery and cost performance.
Own and facilitate CORE improvement activities, applying structured problem solving and continuous improvement methodologies to eliminate waste, improve flow and increase operational performance.
Partner with cross-functional teams to design, implement and sustain robust manufacturing processes, ensuring improvements are embedded through effective standards and governance.
Coach and develop employees at all levels in CORE principles, problem solving and continuous improvement to build organisational capability and maturity.
Use data, process observation and performance analysis to identify opportunities, prioritise improvement activity and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Champion a culture of accountability, standardisation and continuous improvement through regular Gemba engagement, process confirmation and collaborative leadership.

What your days will look like:

  • Facilitating Value Stream Mapping workshops from planning and data collection through to future state design and implementation planning, helping teams transform how value flows to the customer.

  • Leading CORE engagements to solve operational challenges, coach teams through structured problem solving and deliver sustainable improvements in manufacturing performance.

  • Spending time on the shop floor coaching, observing work, verifying standards through Process Confirmation and supporting teams to identify and eliminate barriers to performance.

  • Developing and maintaining manufacturing standards, process maps, PFMEAs, Control Plans and other operational documentation to support robust and repeatable processes.

  • Working alongside Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain and Programmes to identify improvement opportunities, coordinate implementation activities and track delivery of measurable benefits.

  • Supporting the development of manufacturing capability through training, coaching and practical application of CORE tools such as 5S, standard work, process capability assessment and continuous improvement techniques.

Candidate Requirements:

Essential:

  • Experience of manufacturing, engineering, operational excellence or continuous improvement within a complex production environment, with the ability to identify opportunities and deliver sustainable improvements.

  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data, collaborate with stakeholders and influence positive change across multiple functions.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation and coaching skills, with confidence engaging colleagues at all levels from the shop floor to senior leadership.

  • Self-motivated, organised and accountable with the ability to manage multiple improvement activities and see them through to successful implementation.

  • Commitment to professional development, including completing the CORE Expert accreditation programme. This includes international training and the successful delivery of practical improvement engagements demonstrating competence across CORE methodologies.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salaries.

  • 25 days holiday + statutory public holidays, plus opportunity to buy and sell up to 5 days (37hr)

  • Contributory Pension Scheme (up to 10.5% company contribution)

  • Company bonus scheme (discretionary).

  • 6 times salary ‘Life Assurance’ with pension.

  • Flexible Benefits scheme with extensive salary sacrifice schemes, including Health Cashplan, Dental, and Cycle to Work amongst others.

  • Enhanced sick pay.

  • Enhanced family friendly policies including enhanced maternity, paternity & shared parental leave

Work Culture:

  • 37hr working week, although hours may vary depending on role, job requirement or site-specific arrangements.

  • Remote, hybrid and site based working opportunities, dependant on your needs and the requirements of the role.

  • A grownup flexible working culture that is output, not time spent at desk, focussed. More formal flexible working arrangements can also be requested and assessed subject to the role. Please enquire or highlight any request to our Talent Acquisition team to explore the flexible working possibilities.

  • Up to 5 paid days volunteering each year

For this role the successful hire will need to be a permanent UK resident and successfully complete a baseline (BPSS) security and background check.

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.

This position is classified as:

Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

Requires broad management and leadership knowledge to lead project teams.

RTX

Raytheon UK is a landed company and part of the wider RTX organisation. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, USA, but with over 180,000 employees globally across every continent, RTX provides advanced systems and services for commercial, military and government customers worldwide and comprises three industry-leading businesses – Collins Aerospace Systems, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon.

Supporting over 35,000 jobs across 13 UK sites, RTX is helping to drive prosperity. Each year our work contributes over £2.7bn to the UK economy and offers a wealth of opportunities to 4,000 suppliers across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. We’re investing in all corners of the country, supporting 29,040 jobs in England, 3,040 in Northern Ireland, 1,900 in Scotland and 1,600 in Wales.

title: Adoptions Coordinator
description:
Position: Adoptions Coordinator

Department: Operations

Pay: $20/hr

Exempt/Non-Exempt: Non-exempt, full time position

Immediate Manager: Adoption Program Manager

Availability: The schedule for this role will start Monday - Friday and will move to Tuesday - Saturday when the interim adoptions office is ready. Work hours may be affected by special events, adoption events or other department requirements.

General Position Summary: The Adoption Coordinator is often the first point of contact between the public and Brother Wolf. They are responsible for answering phone calls, returning emails, and greeting people with warmth and enthusiasm when they walk through the doors.

The Adoption Coordinator oversees the day-to-day coordination of the adoption process, including scheduling and facilitating adoption appointments and providing thoughtful, individualized adoption counseling.

They also support a variety of administrative tasks, including maintaining accurate and engaging animal bios, updating adoption-related information, keeping records current, and preparing documentation for adoption packets.

Who We Are: Founded in 2007, Brother Wolf Animal Rescue enhances the lives of companion animals and the people who love them. Through adoption and pet retention programs to extensive volunteer and foster networks, Brother Wolf Animal Rescue impacts the lives of thousands of animals each year in the Western North Carolina region. Brother Wolf Animal Rescue envisions a community where all companion animals are valued, cared for and thriving, and where lives are enriched by the special bond between people and animals.

Essential Function/Major Responsibilities:

  • Customer Service & Communication
    • Greets all visitors with a warm, positive, and non-judgemental attitude
    • Responds to phone, email, and in-person communications with compassion and kindness in a timely manner
    • Connects community members with resources to support their needs and overcome challenges
  • Adoption Counseling
    • Collaborates with adopters to gain an understanding of their wants and needs, and help them understand the needs of their potential new pet
    • Helps adopters navigate the adoption process with clarity, confidence, and joy
    • Engage in collaborative conversations with adopters to set them and their new pet up for success
    • Finalizes adoptions, including completing necessary paperwork
    • Seeks to find creative and practical solutions to support adoption matches for both adopters and pets, such as navigating potty-training for full-time workers or providing resources for managing separation anxiety.
    • Supports with coordination and attends off-site adoption events as needed
  • Administration & Record Keeping
    • Ensures files are appropriately maintained and organized
    • Ensures adoption paperwork is accurate and up-to-date with the latest medical and behavioral information available
    • Updates shelter animal database to accurately capture animals' locations, statuses, and other relevant information
    • Provides administrative support across functions and departments
    • Operates register and completes a daily report and cash out at the end of each shift
    • Fill in for other areas and performs other tasks/functions as needed

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Ability to read, write, and understand English with excellent written & verbal communication required
  • 1+ year of experience in customer service, office administration, hospitality, or similar
  • Proficiency in basic computer skills & programs including Google G Suite required
  • Physical ability to walk and or stand on your feet throughout a normal workday required. Ability to bend and squat. Physical ability to engage in repetitive motions of legs, arms, and hands and to hear and see clearly.
  • Allergic conditions, which may be aggravated when handling or working with animals, may be a disqualification.

Strongly Encouraged to Apply:

  • Experience in nonprofits or animal welfare organizations

Working conditions:

Conditions may include working alone, working inside or outside during varying weather conditions, frequent interruptions, and some evenings/weekends meetings and classes.

Educational Requirements:

High school graduation required.

title: Department SupervisorOutlets at Sparks
description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

  • You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
  • Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
  • Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
  • Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
  • Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
  • Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
  • Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way


Fashion & Trend Awareness

  • Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
  • Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions


Team & Development

  • Retain and share your knowledge and skills with the Store team
  • Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
  • Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
  • Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
  • Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed


Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

  • Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
  • Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
  • Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
  • Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
  • Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
  • Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
  • Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
  • Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

  • To be a successful and effective Department Supervisor, you’ll be an emerging leader who enjoys taking responsibility.
  • You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
  • You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.


Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community

Compensation: expected base salary range is $19.22 - $22.39 hourly**
EEOC Code: SLS
Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly


*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. Olivia är ett inkluderande företag. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och även du som har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd genom arbetsförmedlingen. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

Som medarbetare omfattas du av kollektivavtal och självklart är du försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa. Förutom friskvårdsbidrag och en rad andra förmåner anordnar vi aktiviteter som riktar sig både till dig som anställd och till kunden du arbetar med.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
The Quality Engineer coordinates resources to support manufacturing operations, leads quality and cost-improvement projects, and supports new product launches. This role drives quality improvements across the entire value stream, from vendors to the end customer.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Communication:

  • Coach and develop Quality Technicians, Monitors, Analysts, and Group Leads.
  • Lead daily communications during Operations Huddle Board meetings.
  • Deliver timely updates across all appropriate plant functions.

Problem Solving & Quality Improvement:

  • Drive problem-solving efforts using containment, root cause analysis, and CAPA / 8D methodologies.
  • Execute improvement projects leveraging PDCA, Six Sigma, and data-driven priorities (WAR teams).
  • Implement permanent corrections to eliminate process and product failures.
  • Translate feedback from the customer, process, and business into actionable plant improvements.

Process Control & Safety:

  • Audit manufacturing steps against standardized work, Process FMEAs, and Control Plans to fix gaps.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with customers, purchasing, suppliers, engineering, and operations.
  • Investigate incidents and support facility-wide plant metrics.
  • Prioritize safety by immediately addressing safety or ergonomic issues with a "safety first" attitude.

    A successful Plant Quality Engineer will have:

    • Education: 4-year degree from an accredited university (Quality or Engineering preferred).

title: Data Scientist - CDI
description:
ABOUT DESCARTES UNDERWRITING

Join Descartes and contribute to our mission: Building Resilience in a World at Risk.

Descartes is a corporate insurance group for worldwide companies and institutions. Descartes was born from a conviction that the growing complexity of corporate and climate risks demands a new approach to insurance. At the forefront of AI and Data analysis, Descartes utilises cutting-edge technology combined with a new generation of data sources, to model, assess and manage risks.

Since 2019, Descartes has secured a leading position in parametric (re)insurance combining scientific & technological expertise with a new approach. Parametric insurance, also known as index-based insurance, indemnifies clients within days based on pre-defined payout structures when a specific triggering event occurs, the payout process is both fast and transparent. The company has been financed with over $141M by investors including Highland Europe, BlackFin, Serena, Cathay, Eurazeo and Battery Ventures.

Our highly diverse and specialized team of 250+ people includes the largest modelling team in the industry featuring tech and modeling innovators, scientists in physics and climatology, as well as insurance veterans and underwriters. With a global footprint and strong US presence, Descartes serves a diverse portfolio of clients in more than 60 countries, with 20+ offices spread across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin and North America.

Find out more on .

ABOUT YOUR ROLE

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking to expand our Data Science team across our Underwriting functions, and we are looking for Data Scientists to join our team in Paris. As a Data scientist, your missions will focus on making direct contributions to the development of new climate models or forecasting tools.

The Underwriting team takes action subsequently in modeling, structuring and pricing of parametric insurance covers to deliver insurance products to a worldwide based public sector and corporate clients in a few day to a year timeframe.
These roles will allow you to gain knowledge of the insurance industry and the emerging risks (natural catastrophes, cyber...), all while collaborating closely with other internal teams (Software, Operations, Legal and Commercial) and our external partners.

Your key missions will include:

  • Improving or developing new algorithms, new risk models and products for our B2B client;

  • Identifying, implementing and deploying new statistical and machine learning methods to differentiate Descartes from its competitors;

  • Participating in the development of Descartes’ technological platform;

  • Collaborating with the business team to understand client needs and issues to further strengthen our technical excellence;

  • Taking on management responsibilities as both you and the company develop;

  • Working autonomously and pragmatically to make appropriate technical decisions.

ABOUT YOU

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s student in data science, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics or meteorological studies or related;

  • Ideally a previous experience (long-term internship) in data science or climate modeling is valued.

SKILLS

  • Proficient in statistics, applied mathematics and machine learning methods;

  • Capable of building high-performance algorithms;

  • Proficiency in Python (e.g. scikit-learn);

  • Fluency in English (written and verbal communication) is required;

  • Good command of one additional language (e.g. Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish…) is valued.

MINDSET

  • Interested in weather and natural perils modeling (wildfires, hail, tsunamis, earthquakes etc);

  • Excellent team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and value of diversity;

  • Highly motivated, able to meet deadlines set;

  • Strong desire to learn and commitment to the organization’s mission;

  • Results oriented, high energy, with the ability to work in a dynamic and multi-cultural environment;

  • Eager to learn more about the insurance industry.

WHY JOIN DESCARTES UNDERWRITING?

  • Opportunity to work and learn with teams from the most prestigious schools and research labs in the world, allowing you to progress towards technical excellence;

  • Commitment from Descartes to its staff of continued learning and development (think annual seminars, training etc.);

  • Work in a collaborative & professional environment;

  • Be part of a dynamic international team, passionate about diversity;

  • Join a company with a true purpose – help us help our clients be more resilient towards climate risks;

  • A competitive salary, bonus and benefits;

  • You can benefit from punctual home office days.

At Descartes Underwriting, we cherish the value of diversity whatever it may be. We are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination and for equal opportunities. We foster an inclusive work environment that respects all differences.

With equal skills, all our positions are open to people with disabilities.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • Step 1: HR Interview with our Talent Recruiter

  • Step 2: Technical online test on Github

  • Step 3: Remote technical interview with a Data Scientist

  • Step 4: In-person team interview to meet our Data Scientist team and discover our offices (held remotely if you are abroad)

title: Islamic Content & Research Assistant
description:
Islamic Research & AI Content Specialist

Company: Future Group
Employment: Full-time
Location: Remote
Department: Islamic Intelligence & Trust

Position Overview

Future Group is building an AI-powered platform designed to provide users with accessible, trustworthy, and responsibly sourced Islamic knowledge.

We are looking for an Islamic Research & AI Content Specialist to work closely with the Head of Islamic Intelligence & Trust in developing, reviewing, and maintaining the organization's Islamic knowledge and trust framework.

The role combines Islamic scholarship, research, content verification, structured knowledge development, and AI quality assurance. The successful candidate will help ensure that Islamic information is accurate, properly sourced, consistent, responsible, and aligned with Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jamaa'ah.

This is an opportunity to help build Future Group's Islamic knowledge and trust framework from the ground up and contribute to the responsible application of Islamic scholarship within AI technology.

Key Responsibilities

Islamic Research & Source Verification

  • Research and verify Islamic information using trusted and recognized sources.

  • Review Islamic claims, rulings, references, quotations, and supporting evidence.

  • Research and review content relating to Qur'an, Hadith, Fiqh, Aqeedah, Seerah, and other Islamic disciplines.

  • Document the methodology and trusted sources used for each topic.

  • Help establish clear standards for source selection and content inclusion.

  • Identify content that requires further scholarly review.

Islamic Knowledge Structuring

  • Organize Islamic knowledge into clear domains, subdomains, topics, and user questions.

  • Build and maintain structured Islamic content and question datasets.

  • Develop and refine topic taxonomies, use cases, and knowledge structures.

  • Ensure Islamic content is organized in a way that supports both scholarly accuracy and practical user needs.

AI Content Review & Quality Assurance

  • Review and improve questions, use cases, prompts, and sample answers.

  • Evaluate AI-generated answers for:

    • Islamic accuracy

    • Source quality

    • Citations and attribution

    • Consistency

    • Appropriate handling of scholarly differences

    • Clarity and suitability for users

  • Compare AI-generated answers with other AI tools to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.

  • Identify unsupported claims, hallucinations, weak sourcing, and potentially misleading content.

  • Help develop processes for ongoing Islamic content quality assurance.

Scholarly Review & Risk Identification

  • Review Hadith, Fiqh, and other Islamic content for accuracy and appropriate context.

  • Identify areas of recognized scholarly disagreement.

  • Flag questions and topics that require review by qualified scholars.

  • Distinguish between matters of broad scholarly agreement and legitimate differences of opinion.

  • Help ensure disputed matters are not presented as universally agreed upon.

  • Escalate sensitive, complex, or insufficiently supported content appropriately.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with product, engineering, and AI teams to ensure Islamic content is correctly represented within the AI system.

  • Translate scholarly requirements into clear, structured content and review criteria.

  • Help identify issues arising from how Islamic knowledge is retrieved, structured, or presented by AI.

  • Participate in testing and evaluation of new AI features and behaviors.

  • Provide clear feedback and recommendations to product and engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Shariah, Islamic Studies, or a related field from a recognized institution.

  • Strong grounding in Islamic studies and clear adherence to Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jamaa'ah.

  • Strong Arabic, including the ability to read and understand classical Islamic sources.

  • Good professional English, both written and spoken.

  • Strong research, analytical, and source-verification skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate sourcing.

  • Comfortable working with Microsoft Excel, Word, structured templates, and datasets.

  • Interest in or experience with AI, chatbots, prompts, or AI-generated content.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate:

  • Has approximately 5–7 years of relevant experience, although strong candidates with different levels of experience may also be considered.

  • Is comfortable working across both Islamic scholarship and technology.

  • Notices when a source or claim is unclear, incomplete, or insufficiently supported.

  • Can identify gaps, inconsistencies, and potential inaccuracies.

  • Knows when an issue requires further scholarly consultation.

  • Communicates problems clearly, constructively, and early.

  • Understands the importance of representing legitimate scholarly differences accurately.

  • Can maintain scholarly rigor while thinking about the needs of real users.

  • Is organized, proactive, analytical, and comfortable working in a technology-driven environment.

Working Environment

  • Full-time

  • Remote

  • Professional

  • Religiously oriented

  • Collaborative environment combining Islamic scholarship, AI, product, and engineering.

Why This Role Matters

You will be part of the team building Future Group's Islamic knowledge and trust framework from the ground up.

Your work will help establish the sources, standards, research methodologies, review processes, and knowledge structures needed to represent Islamic knowledge responsibly within an AI environment.

The role offers a unique opportunity to combine traditional Islamic scholarship with modern technology while maintaining scholarly rigor, accuracy, responsible sourcing, and trust.

title: Kommunikationsstudent til Miljøpolitik & Cirkulær Økonomi i DI
description:
Om os
DI er Danmarks største erhvervs- og arbejdsgiverorganisation, som hver dag arbejder for, at Danmark skal være verdens bedste land at leve og drive virksomhed i. Her spiller den grønne omstilling en stor rolle. I DI’s enhed for miljøpolitik og cirkulær økonomi er vi 10 konsulenter, tre studenter og to chefer. Vi arbejder for bedre rammevilkår for virksomheder, så det bliver nemmere at skabe bæredygtige forretninger og etablere cirkulære forretningsmodeller. Udover miljø- og ressourcepolitiske spørgsmål hjælper vi DI's medlemsvirksomheder inden for miljø-, plan- og kemilovgivning.

Arbejdsopgaver

Du vil få en række opgaver, som spænder bredt mellem alt fra at hjælpe afdelingens konsulenter med research, udarbejde præsentationer eller skrive indlæg, til at opdatere vores hjemmeside. Du vil komme til at bidrage med kommunikation på alle vores kanaler, herunder:

· Løbende opslag på Linkedin – medlemskommunikation og politisk kommunikation

· Opdatering af hjemmeside herunder nyhedsskrivning og nyhedsbrevsudsendelse.

· Bidrage til planlæggelse og afholdelse af netværksmøder, konferencer og andre møder.

· Forskellige ad hoc-opgaver – fra at ringe rundt til 10 medlemmer med et spørgsmål, til at give en praktisk hånd med ved store medlemsarrangementer

· Medlemskontakt, som kan være besvarelse af medlemsvirksomhedernes forespørgsler.

· Udarbejdning af virksomhedscases om cirkulære forretningsmodeller

Om dig
Du er sidst på din bacheloruddannelse eller i gang med din kandidat med mindst 1 år tilbage. Du har i dit studie et stærkt fokus på kommunikation og gerne politik og/eller erhvervsliv. Du har en interesse for miljøpolitik både nationalt og internationalt.

Vi forventer, at du er sprogligt stærk (primært på dansk, også gerne engelsk), engageret, har gode samarbejdsevner samt er fagligt nysgerrig. Det er derudover også vigtigt, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret med dine arbejdsopgaver og følge dem til dørs i perioder med mange opgaver.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Den ugentlige arbejdstid er 15 timer, som bliver tilrettelagt i samarbejde med dig. Du bliver en del af et studenterteam, og der er mulighed for fleksibel arbejdstid i forbindelse med eksamensperioder.

Vi sidder i et moderne og inspirerende kontormiljø i Industriens Hus centralt placeret ved Rådhuspladsen i København. Du bliver en del af DI’s netværk på 100 studenter, som arrangerer forskellige aktiviteter.

Interesseret?
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte Fagleder for EU miljøpolitik Louise Bünemann på tlf. 40706911 eller lobu@di.dk .

Send din ansøgning, CV og eksamenspapirer via ansøgningslinket senest den 14. september 2026.

Der indkaldes til samtaler efter endt ansøgningsfrist med henblik på start hurtigst muligt. Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger sendt pr. mail.

title: IT Engineer
description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is searching for an IT Engineer that is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and enhancing the organization’s IT infrastructure, including computer systems, networks, and servers. This role supports both on-site and remote employees by ensuring the smooth operation of hardware, software, and networking equipment. The IT Engineer will work closely with the IT team to implement security measures, perform system upgrades, and manage user support requests.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Google Workspace (Gmail) Administration:

  • User Account Management: Creating, managing, and de-provisioning user accounts, groups, and aliases within Google Workspace.
  • Email Security & Filtering: Configuring and managing SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email authentication and protection against phishing and spam.
  • Gmail Configuration: Managing Gmail settings, including email routing, filters, forwarding, and retention policies.
  • Google Admin Console: Proficiency in navigating and managing various Google Workspace services through the Admin Console.
  • Google Vault: Setting up and managing email archiving, e-discovery, and retention rules.
  • Mobile Device Management (MDM): Managing mobile devices using Google Workspace MDM features to ensure security and compliance.

2. Identity and Access Management:

  • Okta or other SSO (Single Sign-On) integration experience for managing user authentication and access control.
  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Configuring MFA within Google Workspace and integrating it with other identity providers like Okta.
  • User Provisioning: Automating user provisioning and de-provisioning across multiple platforms integrated with Google Workspace.

3. Networking and Connectivity:

  • DNS Configuration: Managing DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM, etc.) for seamless email delivery and proper domain validation.
  • Google Workspace Connectivity: Troubleshooting network issues that could affect access to Google services (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, etc.).
  • VPN and Remote Access: Setting up and managing VPNs for secure remote access, especially for distributed teams.

4. Data Backup and Recovery:

  • Google Drive & Gmail Backup Solutions: Experience with third-party backup tools for Google Workspace, such as Backupify or Spanning.
  • Disaster Recovery Planning: Ensuring data redundancy and developing strategies for quick recovery in case of data loss or email outages.

5. Security and Compliance:

  • Google Workspace Security Best Practices: Implementing security policies (password requirements, MFA, access control) to protect organizational data.
  • Endpoint Protection: Managing endpoint security for devices connecting to Google Workspace services.
  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Configuring and managing DLP policies to prevent the unauthorized sharing of sensitive data through Gmail or Drive.

6. Collaboration Tools:

  • Google Meet & Chat: Managing video conferencing and messaging settings, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring smooth communication for users.
  • Google Drive & Docs: Managing file permissions, sharing policies, and collaboration settings for shared files and folders.

7. System Monitoring and Reporting:

  • Google Workspace Reporting: Using audit logs and security reports to monitor account activity, track suspicious behavior, and ensure compliance.
  • Alerting and Monitoring Tools: Configuring and using third-party monitoring tools like JumpCloud or G Suite Security Center for enhanced visibility into system status and security.

8. Endpoint Support:

  • Cross-Platform Expertise: Experience supporting both Mac and Windows devices in a Google Workspace environment, including troubleshooting sync issues, email clients, and browser configurations.
  • BYOD Policies: Configuring and managing BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) policies for secure access to Gmail and other Google Workspace services on personal devices.

9. Integration and Third-Party Tools:

  • Third-Party Apps Integration: Managing integrations with third-party apps that sync with Google Workspace (e.g., CRM systems, Slack, etc.).
  • Workspace Marketplace: Familiarity with Google Workspace Marketplace and evaluating third-party tools for compatibility and security.

10. AI Tooling, Automation, and Development:

  • Claude and Claude Code: Daily use of Claude and Claude Code as core working tools for scripting, log and configuration analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation. Comfort working in an agentic command-line environment is expected, not optional.
  • Automation Development: Designing, building, and maintaining scripts and internal tooling with AI assistance to automate user provisioning and de-provisioning, access reviews, reporting, and other repetitive IT operations work.


REQUIREMENTS

1. Technical Skills:

  • High proficiency with Windows and Mac operating systems, including troubleshooting and user support.
  • Experience with Gmail, Okta, DNS management, Crowdstrike, JumpCloud and VPN technologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).
  • Proficiency in managing and configuring endpoint security solutions (e.g., antivirus, malware).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools, ideally Claude and Claude Code, applied to real automation and integration work rather than casual use.
  • Working proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Google Apps Script) sufficient to read, modify, test, and debug AI-generated code.
  • Sound judgment about when AI output can be trusted, when it must be verified, and what data must never be shared with an AI tool.

2. Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in IT support, systems engineering, or a related role.
  • Experience providing support for both on-site and remote employees.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and IT service management platforms.

3. Problem Solving:

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical issues.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant IT certifications.

title: Head, Strategic Accounts
description:
We’re looking for a Head, Strategic Accounts to join our team at Pandora. You will lead our regional Strategic Accounts team, which is focused on driving best-in-class account management of our highest value accounts regionally (~10-15% of business for markets where accounts are present) & locally across our 16 markets (across Europe/Asia) / 3 brands (Foodpanda, Foodora & Yemeksepeti).

You and your team will not only build strong relationships with & unlock value in our regional restaurant partners, but also drive the development of best in class tools, products, and ways of working/processes to be implemented across all of our markets. Further, a key priority will be to 1) drive the identification of use cases for how AI can improve our strategic account management, 2) work with data/analytics and product teams to develop those into tangible tools/products and 3) manage the successful rollout, adoption and impact across our markets. Finally, you will also take the lead on signing any regional (cross-market) partners/restaurants that might be currently missing from our platform (across multiple markets).

Reporting to the Senior Director, Partner Growth, the ideal candidates will possess experience in developing/managing high-value commercial partners and relationships, excellent analytical/problem solving skills and data-backed decision making, as well as experience in go-to-market/roll-out across multiple geographies. Experience and knowledge of F&B commercials/operations or leveraging AI for impact is a plus, but not a requirement.

Team & leadership:

  • Build strong knowledge of all aspects of the business model, the online food ordering market & F&B
  • Devise the department’s long-term strategy/plan, align and set out priorities and goals and performance manage the team against them
  • Hire top talent, help them perform, grow and develop as professionals - in local and regional teams

Build robust & efficient operating processes & tools:

  • Develop best in class account management tools, products, and ways of working/processes and leverage/use key data insights to elevate business/vendor actions
  • Work with a cross-functional & local teams and lead GTM/rollout/ implementation and make sure we achieve impact across all Strategic Account Teams in Pandora

Strategic account management:

  • Build best in class ways of working & relationships with key regional partners with structured communications, long term Joint Business Planning and recurrent Quarterly Business Reviews
  • Maximize Gross Merchandise Value, revenue and gross profit growth of strategic accounts through constructing and negotiating commercial terms, marketing endeavors, operational excellence; achieve and exceed KPIs/business goals
  • Get into details, deep-dive and problem solve. You will make things happen together with your team
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders within global strategic accounts

Identification, development and embedding of AI:

  • Cooperate with other commercial teams to identify the AI use cases with highest impact on the work of strategic account management (regional or local)

  • Focus and drive the rollout, embedding (in how strategic accounts teams work) of those AI tools/products, so that value / impact is realised

Signing of regional dreambrands

  • Partner with regional and local sales teams to identify brand gaps and lead regional-level negotiations to secure new partnerships
  • Expected 6yr+ of work experience with at least 1yr+ experience in managing commercial / growth topics (i.e., experience in leading negotiations of large-scale contracts and building relationships with C-level of other organizations)

  • Bachelor in Business Administration, Economics, Operations Management is a plus
  • Experience in FMCG, Retail or on-demand delivery industry is a plus
  • Business acumen: proven track record of building strong relationships and partnerships with international companies & senior stakeholders s in order to create joint strategies & deliver value through collaboration
  • Partner collaboration: Proven experience in working with external partners to align on strategic initiatives, foster mutual growth, & ensure seamless collaboration on account-related matters
  • Problem solving skills with strong commercial and analytical skills
  • Data-driven mentality / takes decision based on data and makes business judgment when necessary
  • Great communication and interpersonal skills
  • Negotiation skills: Know how to negotiate /build your way into a deal with big players in the market
  • Project management skills, highly organized and detail-oriented approach
  • Excellent knowledge of Google Suite and/or MS Office, Excel
  • Excellent written and spoken English skills
  • Be driven to build & grow; you have a natural bias for action, always pushing for things to happen, objective and deadline oriented; you are always a step ahead, proactive with potential problems/opportunities and always thinking how to be better
  • You ensure the highest standards for you and your team with the deliverables and business objectives

title: Transformatie Consultant
description:
Organisaties staan voor ingrijpende (digitale) veranderingen: nieuwe technologie, andere manieren van samenwerken, aangepaste processen en veranderend gedrag. In de practice Transformation Management begeleiden wij deze transformaties end‑to‑end, waarbij change & adoptie geen bijzaak is, maar een integraal onderdeel van het programma.

Als (Senior) Transformatie Consultant help jij organisaties om veranderingen niet alleen te ontwerpen, maar ook te laten landen, werken en beklijven. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie, uitvoering en menselijk gedrag en zorgt ervoor dat technologische en organisatorische veranderingen leiden tot duurzame business‑impact.

Deze rol draait om inhoud, delivery en samenwerking. Je staat zelf in het veld, werkt nauw samen met klanten en bent een trusted advisor voor management en directie.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan complexe transformaties bij organisaties in verschillende sectoren, vaak in een digitale of IT‑gedreven context. Afhankelijk van de opdracht vervul je rollen zoals change lead, transformation consultant of adoptie‑lead binnen grotere programma’s.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen, uitvoeren en begeleiden van change‑ en adoptiestrategieën binnen (digitale) transformaties;
  • Zorgen dat veranderingen worden geïmplementeerd, omarmd en verankerd in de organisatie;
  • Leiden van change‑trajecten als onderdeel van bredere transformatieprogramma’s;
  • Adviseren van leiders en sleutelstakeholders over hun rol in verandering en gedragsverandering;
  • Actief stakeholdermanagement op meerdere niveaus (van medewerkers tot directie);
  • Integreren van change‑aanpak in programma‑ en projectsturing;
  • Weerstand signaleren en ombuigen naar betrokkenheid en eigenaarschap;
  • Faciliteren van workshops en sessies om draagvlak, inzicht en actie te creëren.

Naast je werk bij klanten:

  • Draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van de Transformation Management‑propositie;
  • Werk je mee aan voorstellen, pitches en offertes;
  • Deel je kennis en coach je junior consultants binnen de practice.

Je bent een inhoudelijk sterke change professional die zich comfortabel voelt in complexe omgevingen en energie krijgt van het werken met mensen én systemen.
Je hebt:

  • Een afgeronde HBO‑ of WO‑opleiding;
  • Minimaal 3 jaar consultancy-ervaring in change management, organisatieadvies of (digitale) transformaties;
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met grootschalige verander‑ en adoptietrajecten;
  • Diepgaande kennis van change‑ en adoptieframeworks (bijv. ADKAR / Prosci of vergelijkbaar certificering (zoals Prosci, is een pré);
  • Affiniteit met digitale transformaties, IT‑programma’s en agile omgevingen (ervaring met Agile, Scrum, SAFe, DevOps, Lean en/of Obeya is een pré);
  • Sterke stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden op verschillende niveaus;
  • Vermogen om complexiteit en weerstand te overzien en te vertalen naar concrete acties;
  • Ondernemende houding: je bouwt mee aan team, propositie en change‑capability;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands & Engels, organisatiesensitiviteit en empathie.

Klaar om jouw ervaring in te zetten voor digitale transformaties met impact?
Sopra Steria Consulting brengt transformatie consulting, technologie en organisatieverandering samen in vier functionele Areas, waarbij jij onderdeel bent van de Area Business Transformation met 27 consultants. Je profiteert van brede ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden in Nederland en in ons Europese netwerk. Bij Sopra Steria maak je deel uit van een dynamisch netwerk van 51.000 professionals, waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract en een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3500,- en € 5500,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week);
  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
  • Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

title: Program Specialist - Service Activities
description:
We’re in the business of Good.
Lions International is the largest service club organization in the world. Our 1.4 million members are
serving locally and globally to help take on some of the biggest challenges facing humanity.

Every Lion and club are supported by our international association. More than 300 Lions
International staff members are constantly working on tools and technology to enhance Lions’
service. When caring people join together, roll up their sleeves and take action to make their
community better, it’s an incredible feeling for everyone involved.

Here's how you can help -- we are currently looking for a Program Specialist to join our Service Activities team, rise to the challenge of empowering service, and fill a vital role in our Service Programs and Initiatives Division. As a Program Specialist, you'll develop, oversee, evaluate and improve service programs, initiatives and resources within the eight Lions International global causes (childhood cancer, diabetes, disaster relief, environment, humanitarian, hunger, vision, and youth). You'll collaborate with colleagues throughout the organization to promote these programs and initiatives to Lions and Leos around the world and support their volunteer service. You'll also monitor both Lion and Leo service impact, identifying and sharing successes and best practices.


What You’ll Do:
  • Manage the full life cycle of various service programs and initiatives, including development, launch, maintenance and evaluation.
  • Maintain current knowledge of the Lions International global causes and trends related to volunteer humanitarian service to provide input on potential service engagement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Lions and Leos around the world to learn about their service activities and highlight their projects through case studies and promotional material.
  • Collaborate with the Lions International Marketing team on the creation and delivery of resources that support the service of Lions and Leos.
  • Ensure Lions and Leos are aware of service programs, initiatives and resources through the development of communication plans, collaboration with the field team (Global Action Team) on webinars and other stakeholder engagement, and collaboration with the Marketing team on campaigns and promotions.
  • Liaise with IT to ensure reporting products meet program needs. Pull and analyze service reporting data to measure program success, participation and insights. Prepare regular reports on program engagement and impact.
  • Conduct intake meetings with potential partners and evaluate partnership opportunities. Contribute to the development and maintenance of partnership plans that increase the service impact of Lions and Leos.
  • Support manager in preparation of board meeting materials, reports and budgetary requests related to service programs and initiatives.
  • Ensure quality customer service to Lions, Leos, LCI/LCIF staff and external partners, by maintaining organization standards related to the LCI mission and values.
  • Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

We’re Looking for Someone With:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Degree in nonprofit management, international development, business administration, communications or a related field is a plus. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience working with not-for-profit and / or membership organizations or associations.
  • Experience with project management skills, including organizational skills, critical thinking, attention to detail, research skills, ability to coordinate input from multiple sources for project completion, and ability to use data to make informed decisions about future program development.
  • Experience with program management, volunteer engagement, and / or communications is a plus.
  • Experience with humanitarian or social service or public health programming is a plus.
  • Experience with global trends related to humanitarian service. Knowledge of Sustainable Development Goals is a plus.
  • Experience with customer service skills, applying sensitivity to the unique needs of an international membership organization.
  • Experience with computer skills, including intermediate or better skills with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat, Salesforce and database applications.
  • Experience with writing and communication skills for drafting service project narratives, crafting promotions, composing and proofing correspondence and other written materials.
Compensation: Exempt: $65,000-70,000

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Lions International has excellent benefits for you and your family. We believe in a balanced work-life and have programs and benefit plans to support our employees, such as:
  • Three weeks paid time off
  • Flexible and hybrid work schedules (2-3 days per week in office).
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans
  • Flex spending accounts for medical and dependent care
  • 401K with employer match

identity, or lived experience – feel welcomed, respected and empowered to serve. Our strength
comes from the diversity of our members and staff, and the inclusive spirit that unites us in service.

2. Understanding of ACGME requirements, an experience with ERAS.

3. Strong organizational skills. Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and multi-task.

4. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to present on behalf of the Vice Chair of Education.

1. Demonstrated ability managing/supervising others preferability Residency/Fellowship coordinators.

2. Proven experience handling Education budgets.
