title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

The Maintenance Coordinator provides administrative, clerical, and organizational support to ensure smooth day‑to‑day operations. This role supports maintenance supervisors, technicians, and management by coordinating work orders, maintaining records, managing communications, and assisting with scheduling, purchasing, and compliance documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Administrative & Clerical Support

  • Prepare, maintain, and update departmental documents, reports, and spreadsheets.
  • Handle incoming calls, emails, and internal requests related to maintenance activities.
  • Maintain organized filing systems—digital and physical—for work orders, PM schedules, vendor information, and compliance documents.

Work Order & System Management

  • Enter, track, and close work orders in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Monitor preventive maintenance schedules and notify supervisors of upcoming tasks.
  • Generate weekly and monthly performance reports (e.g., work order backlog, downtime, PM completion rates).

Scheduling & Coordination

  • Schedule maintenance activities, PM tasks, equipment shutdowns, and contractor visits.
  • Coordinate meetings, calendar appointments, and department communications.
  • Assist with organizing training, safety meetings, and certifications for maintenance staff.
  • Assist department in managing Time & Attendance of team members

Purchasing & Inventory Support

  • Initiate purchase requests, track orders, and maintain documentation.
  • Work with vendors to obtain quotes, pricing, and delivery timelines.
  • Support inventory control by monitoring stock levels and verifying incoming materials.

Compliance & Safety Support

  • Maintain safety documentation, SDS files, and compliance checklists.
  • Assist in preparing audits, regulatory documentation, and inspection reports.
  • Track required certifications and training for team members.

General Department Support

  • Assist supervisors and the Maintenance Manager with administrative tasks and project support.
  • Help maintain communication between maintenance, operations, and other departments.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and department workflows.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or more up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant/office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet/slippery floors. However, the vast amount of work is conducted in a climate-controlled office. Travel may be required.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent (associate degree preferred).
  • 2+ years of administrative experience; maintenance or manufacturing environment experience preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).
  • Experience with CMMS systems (e.g., Somax, SAP, MP2, Fiix, eMaint) preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and within a team.
  • Basic understanding of maintenance terminology, equipment types, and processes (preferred).

At RTX, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon’s Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) Surface Radars & Sensors Center is seeking talented Senior Reliability Engineers to join the Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) team. LCE is responsible for ensuring our products are Safe, Reliable, Maintainable, Sustainable and delivered on time. LCE consists of multiple disciplines that support engineering, our program offices and our customers. Life Cycle Engineers participate in the total life cycle of our products from conception to deactivation. In this role, you will develop reliability and maintainability analyses and models to ensure our products and systems are highly reliable and sustainable throughout their life.

What You Will Do

  • Conducting Reliability, Availability, and Maintainability (RAM) analyses, including reliability predictions and maintainability predictions.
  • Performing Failure Modes Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA) and Fault Detection/Fault Isolation (FDFI) analyses.
  • Defining/allocating RAM requirements.
  • Assessing RAM performance: Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time Between Critical Failure (MTBCF) & Operational Availability (Ao).
  • Interpreting data and analyzing results.
  • Performing Probability Risk Assessment.
  • Ensuring performance compliance with requirements.
  • Maintaining complex Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD) and system models.
  • Performing Failure Reporting Analysis and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) tasks, including trend analysis and failure investigations and presenting to internal and external stakeholders at program meetings and Failure Review Boards (FRB).
  • Supporting the proposal process in developing Basis of Estimates (BOEs) for RAM work.
  • Tracking Earned Value (EV) and providing accurate status on the schedule and budget for the RAM/FRACAS scope.

title: Senior Vice President of Distribution
description:
Job Title: Senior Vice President of Distribution

Reports To: Executive Vice President of Distribution

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Job Purpose

Owns Threaded Fasteners Inc.'s Commercial Distribution growth strategy, driving profitable sales expansion, market share growth, and branch performance across all regions. Sets company-wide standards for commercial sales execution, leadership accountability, customer development, pricing discipline, and operational alignment while developing Regional Vice Presidents and Branch Leadership Teams to achieve sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Business Outcomes:

  • Commercial sales growth and net profit growth consistently meet or exceed Company objectives.
  • Regional and Branch sales plans are established, monitored, and executed to support long-term growth strategies.
  • Same-Branch growth is achieved through new customer acquisition, increased customer share-of-wallet, and improved sales execution.
  • Consistent sales & operation's processes, performance expectations, and accountability standards are implemented across all commercial branches.
  • Pricing and margin strategies are effectively executed to maximize profitability while maintaining competitiveness.
  • Regional Vice Presidents and Branch leadership teams are developed through coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Business performance is measured through standardized scorecards, operating metrics, and branch profitability reviews.
  • New market, territory, and expansion opportunities are identified, evaluated, and executed to support growth objectives.
  • Collaboration between Sales, Operations, Purchasing, Finance, and Human Resources supports customer service, profitability, and organizational growth.

Job Results & Accountabilities:

  • Develops and executes the Company's commercial sales and growth strategy.
  • Provides leadership for all Regional Vice Presidents by establishing priorities, developing talent, and ensuring consistent execution of Company sales strategies.
  • Establishes annual sales, gross profit, and net profitability objectives for regions and Branches.
  • Develops and maintains measurable regional and branch growth plans aligned with Company objectives.
  • Creates and maintains Company standards for sales management, customer development, pricing discipline, and performance accountability.
  • Monitors branch and regional performance through scorecards, key performance indicators, and financial results.
  • Identifies underperforming operations and develops corrective action plans in partnership with Regional Vice Presidents.
  • Identifies and implements best practices across regions to improve sales growth, profitability, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Supports strategic customer relationships, major customer opportunities, and key account development activities.
  • Evaluates and recommends Branch expansion, market development, and territory growth opportunities.
  • Ensures Purchasing and Inventory strategies support customer demand and sales growth.
  • Partners with Operations leadership to improve service levels, delivery performance, inventory availability, and branch efficiency.
  • Contributes to the development of budgets, forecasts, profitability initiatives, and performance measurement processes.
  • Partners with Human Resources to meet compliance requirements, recruit, develop, and retain effective sales and operational team members.
  • Promotes the Company's culture, values, and employee-owned philosophy throughout the Commercial Distribution business.
  • Partners with Finance, Operations, Manufacturing, and Sales to ensure purchasing strategies support the Company's operational and financial goals.

Division of Ownership:

The Senior Vice President, Commercial Distribution develops and maintains the Company's commercial growth strategy, sales management & profitability standards, leadership expectations, and performance accountability systems. Regional Vice Presidents are responsible for executing within these standards and remain accountable for the performance of their respective regions and Branches.

Performance Measurement:

Performance is measured through commercial sales growth, gross profit growth, branch profitability, budget achievement, market share expansion, customer acquisition, retention of existing customer business, pricing discipline, and leadership development. Success is demonstrated by sustainable sales growth, improved profitability, strong branch performance, and the development of a high-performing commercial organization.

Job Impact:

This role directly influences the Company's revenue growth, profitability, market position, and long-term strategic success. By developing commercial strategy, strengthening leadership capabilities, improving sales performance, and expanding market opportunities, this position plays a critical role in supporting the growth and value of our Employee-Owned Company.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Sales Management or related field is a plus.
  • Minimum of ten years in commercial sales leadership experience
  • Minimum of five years leading multi-location sales or distribution operations.

Preferred Education, Experience, and Skills:

  • Extensive knowledge of industrial distribution, fasteners, and the commercial markets served by the Company.
  • Proven record of profitable multi-location sales growth.
  • Strong understanding of branch operations, pricing strategies, margins, and P&L management.
  • Demonstrated success developing sales leaders and building leadership succession.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and strategic planning skills.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, coaching, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to analyze business performance data and translate information into actionable plans.
  • Strong business judgment, accountability, and decision-making skills.

Physical Requirements: Qualified applicants must be able to perform the following physical job requirements, with or without reasonable accommodation:

  • Primarily office environment with regular Branch and customer visits.
  • Ability to communicate and exchange information.
  • Ability to comprehend and interpret documents, financial reports, and operational data.
  • Ability to travel regularly between branch locations and customer sites.

Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

description:
ABOUT US:

Startec Compression & Process is dedicated to providing innovative solutions to meet your unique challenges and opportunities. We are an integrated project and engineering equipment fabricator specializing in the modularized design and packaging of process, refrigeration, and rotating equipment solutions.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Startec Compression & Process is currently recruiting a Vessel Fitter to work at our Shepard Shop (9423 Shepard Rd SE, Calgary, AB, T2C 4R6).

This role is responsible for the accurate fitting, assembly, and preparation of Pressure Vessel components, ensuring all work meets quality, safety and production standards. The Vessel Fitter works closely with fabrication teams to deliver high-quality products in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience in a manufacturing or fabrication environment is an asset

Fabrication & Assembly

  • Accurately measure, mark, and prepare materials for fabrication

Quality & Productivity

  • Identify and address fit-up issues or inconsistencies prior to welding

SAFETY (Weighting 20%)

  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment
  • Use proper lifting techniques and equipment to handle heavy materials

Compliance

description:
The Broadlawns Medical Center campus includes an acute care hospital, primary and specialty care clinics, urgent care and emergency services, lab, radiology, dentistry, inpatient and outpatient mental health, crisis team, and community-based behavioral support services. Broadlawns accepts all forms of insurance and its approach to healthcare and quality outcomes earned a Level 3 rating from the National Committee for Quality Assurance, the highest achievable status for a medical delivery model.

We are a safety net hospital and our Patients are our North Star! Pediatrician

We are looking for an enthusiastic, skilled BC/BE Pediatrician to join our well established and growing practice. We currently have 3 full time Pediatricians and one nurse practitioner who provide full-scope pediatric care for children from birth through 18. We are a teaching hospital with Family Practice Residents, medical students from local osteopathic college and occasional Pediatric Residents from local Pediatric Hospital. title: Director, AI Transformation
description:
Adven is a dynamic energy group driving the energy transition by developing sustainable and competitive solutions in partnership with customers, municipalities, and suppliers. Together, our 600+ employees provide households and businesses with district heating and geoenergy solutions, and industries with steam, heating, cooling, and infrastructure services that improve resource efficiency.

With over 50 years of experience, we operate more than 350 sites across Europe, delivering a total energy volume of 5.1 TWh. Our annual revenue is €424 million, and our total assets amount to €1,480 million.

We are looking for a Director, AI Transformation to join our Strategy & M&A team

As Director, AI Transformation, you will lead Adven’s company-wide AI transformation and play a central role in integrating AI into our daily business. You will be responsible for ensuring that AI is implemented effectively across the Group, creating measurable business value and continuously developing how we use AI.

You will work across the organization to identify opportunities, build momentum, and drive AI initiatives from concept to execution. As the owner of Adven’s AI solutions and functionalities, you will work closely with senior stakeholders and teams across the business to ensure that AI becomes a practical and value-adding part of everyday operations.

This is a newly established role with significant visibility and responsibility. You will have the opportunity to shape Adven’s AI agenda from the ground up and influence how a growing international energy group leverages emerging technologies.

The position is based at Adven’s office in Vantaa, Finland or Stockholm, Sweden, with a possibility for 1–2 days working remotely. You will report to the SVP, Strategy & M&A.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Lead and drive Adven’s company-wide AI transformation and implementation

  • Develop and execute the Group’s AI agenda in close collaboration with senior stakeholders and business functions

  • Own Adven’s AI solutions and functionalities, ensuring their effective implementation, usage, and continuous development, supported by and in close cooperation with Adven’s IT department

  • Identify and prioritize AI opportunities based on business impact and measurable value creation

  • Manage a portfolio of AI initiatives, including budgets, milestones, dependencies, risks, and benefits realization

  • Build momentum around AI adoption and lead change across the organization

  • Ensure appropriate AI policies, governance, risk management, and responsible-use principles are embedded in the organization

  • Stay on top of developments in generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, machine learning, AI platforms, and other emerging technologies

  • Contribute to selected strategy projects based on business needs

To Succeed in This Role

You are a business-oriented and execution-focused transformation leader who is motivated by turning new technologies into tangible business results. You are comfortable navigating complex topics, working with multiple stakeholders, and driving initiatives forward in a dynamic environment.

You combine strong analytical and strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to execution. You can translate complex AI and technology concepts into clear business language and tailor your communication to different audiences.

You are curious about rapidly evolving technology, open to different perspectives, and able to build trust and momentum across the organization. Most importantly, you focus on measurable business outcomes rather than AI adoption for its own sake.

Key Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a relevant equivalent

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience, with a majority in business development, management consulting, or a similar transformation-oriented role

  • Proven experience from digital or AI transformation projects

  • Experience operating at senior management level and influencing senior stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to successfully bring transformative initiatives from conception to execution

  • Strong understanding of generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, machine learning, AI platforms, and emerging AI technologies

  • Good understanding of data architecture, governance, and data quality requirements

  • Good understanding of AI policies, governance, risk management, and responsible-use principles, as well as relevant regulatory and cybersecurity aspects

  • Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to manage a portfolio of initiatives, budgets, milestones, dependencies, risks, and benefits

description:
People Care Transformation Improvement & Scalability Product Manager

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Job Description

Hewlett Packard Enterprise advances the way people live and work. We bring together the brightest minds to create breakthrough technology solutions, helping our customers make their mark on the world.

One of our core principles is belief in the power of people. Recognizing that our people are HPE’s competitive advantage allows us to focus on ensuring that we keep the employee at the center of the programs and services we offer. The Human Resources (HR) division is responsible for the integral assistance of employees.

The Opportunity:

To successfully introduce AI augmentation within HR, it is essential to enhance and optimize existing processes, which will accelerate the adoption of new technologies while removing operational barriers, enabling advisors to dedicate more time to meaningful human interactions.

By strategically streamlining HR workflows and minimizing friction points, the Product Manager will help create an environment where automation and AI solutions effectively complement the expertise of HR advisors. This approach not only supports the efficient implementation of intelligent systems but also ensures that routine inquiries are handled seamlessly by AI, allowing advisors to focus on more complex and people-centric matters.

As these enhancements are integrated, the focus remains to balance technological advancement with the need for genuine human connection, ultimately elevating both the efficiency and quality of HR services.

The Role

Continuously improve AI performance, expand automation coverage, and ensure AI remains scalable, reliable, and aligned with business needs.

People Care will be the pilot case for AI integration, but this project manager will ensure AI is implemented in the entire CFHR & PC organization.

In addition, the Product Manager will drive the strategic expansion of AI applications across the broader CFHR & PC organization, leveraging insights from the People Care pilot to refine and scale solutions. Through ongoing evaluation and enhancement of AI systems, the role will proactively identify new opportunities for automation, adapt capabilities to evolving business requirements, and uphold standards of reliability and compliance. This forward-thinking approach ensures that as AI transforms HR processes, its integration remains responsive to organizational goals and workforce needs, positioning the company at the forefront of innovation in employee services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor AI accuracy, latency, error patterns, and operational impact

  • Define training data priorities

  • Identify opportunities for new automations and process expansion

  • KPI definition (Rework rate, corrections, precision, recall, etc.)

  • Run analysis for AI output issues or glitches

  • Conduct model feedback cycles aligned with HR volume trends

Building on these responsibilities, the Product Manager will also foster a culture of continuous improvement through iterative monitoring and refinement of AI-driven processes. By leveraging data-driven insights from accuracy, latency, and operational impact analyses, the role will proactively adapt workflows to address evolving HR needs and drive measurable improvements. Emphasis will be placed on identifying and prioritizing training data enhancements, expanding automation coverage, and defining KPIs that reflect the quality and reliability of AI outputs.

The Product Manager will help ensure that AI solutions remain resilient and responsive through targeted investigations of error patterns and feedback cycles that correspond to HR service volumes. This commitment to rigorous analysis and strategic optimization will lay the foundation for efficient escalation strategies and seamless integration of automation within the broader HR ecosystem, supporting the organization's vision of empowering people through technology.

About you:

  • First-level university degree or equivalent experience; advanced university degree preferred.

  • Typically, 4-8 years of related experience in HR Tech project management, process optimization, and collaboration with multidisciplinary functional teams.

  • Participation or collaboration on AI / Automation use cases – HR, Workforce, and Business outcomes.

  • Ability to communicate AI concepts to non-technical HR partners.

  • Experience in automation solutions.

  • Experience in process standardization and optimization.

  • Experience managing projects related to HPE global programs and partnering with designated program leads.

  • Able to understand data, create meaningful analysis, and share business insights. - Strong analytical skills.

  • An out-of-the-box mindset that does not hesitate to challenge the status quo.

  • Passion for customer experience and commitment to AI / Automation transformations

  • Commitment to honoring program/project deadlines and delivering a top-notch experience.

Bonus points if you are:

  • Passionate and curious about all aspects of the business, creating solutions and bringing proposals to the table.

  • A communicator that connects technology workflows with operational needs while observing user experience.

  • A Flawless consultant or similar certifications

  • Certified in Project Management.

  • Versed in AI and Automation implementation (with evidence).

We offer:

  • A competitive salary and extensive social benefits

  • A new integrated experience and network across HPE functions.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

title: Creative Specialist — Social Content  Ideation & Execution (Barcelona)
description:
Who we are

We are an international consulting firm specialized in driving the evolution of business models for large and medium-sized companies. We help our clients improve their competitiveness by connecting strategy, communication, design, technology, and data, always with a practical, impact-driven approach.

With a team of more than 2,000 professionals across different countries, we work on end-to-end projects, supporting our clients from strategic definition through implementation, measurement, and continuous optimization. Our goal is to turn data and insights into business decisions that deliver tangible results.

On this occasion, we are managing the recruitment process on behalf of Zurich Duo, who are looking to strengthen their team with a new addition to cover this position.

Our role is to lead the selection process, identifying and assessing candidates whose experience, skills, and profile best match the requirements of the position and the needs of Zurich Duo.

Therefore, while we are managing the recruitment and selection process, the successful candidate will join Zurich Duo directly and the position will be within the Zurich Duo team.

What is Zurich Duo?

Zurich Duo is Zurich’s in-house agency, responsible for conceptualizing, designing, and delivering creative, digital marketing, and customer experience projects across international markets.

Operating like a startup within a major global corporation, Zurich Duo combines an agile, dynamic, and entrepreneurial environment with the resources, expertise, and stability of a leading global company.

It brings together the best of both worlds: the energy and flexibility of a young, fast-moving company, with the scale, support, and opportunities of an established industry leader.

About the Role

We are looking for a Creative Specialist who excels at turning strategic direction into compelling social media content ideas and high-quality, executable assets.

In this role, you will bring Duo’s creative strategy to life across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, and emerging social channels. You will be responsible for developing platform-native content from concept through execution, adapting messages, formats, and storytelling to the specific characteristics of each channel while ensuring that every piece remains aligned with the original creative vision and brand voice.

What will your mission be?

To translate creative strategies and briefs into platform-native content, developing storyboards, post concepts, and visual proposals that are engaging, execution-ready, and aligned with each channel’s best practices.

Responsibilities & Key Tasks

  • Brief Translation: Transform Creative Strategist briefs into detailed creative ideas and platform-ready content executions.

  • Content Ideation & Scripting: Develop storyboards, scripts, post concepts, captions, and visual directions.

  • Asset Creation & Adaptation: Create, adapt, and optimize social media assets tailored specifically to TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, and other channels

  • Editorial Proposals: Build content proposals for editorial calendars based on defined content territories and strategic briefs.

  • Video Collaboration: Work closely with Videomakers to shape and produce high-impact short-form video executions.

  • Platform Native Adaptation: Adapt content seamlessly to each platform's unique codes, formats, audience behaviors, and emerging trends.

  • Quality & Brand Consistency: Ensure final assets are consistent with the original creative idea, brand voice, visual tone, and specific channel requirements.

Requirements & Key Skills

  • Experience: 3–4 years of experience creating content for brands, social media, or creative agencies.

  • Content Mastery: Strong understanding of platform-native formats, particularly short-form video, with a sharp eye for design, visual rhythm, hooks, and social trends.

  • Concept-to-Execution: Proven ability to take a project seamlessly from initial idea to storyboard and final execution asset.

  • Copywriting & Storytelling: Excellent copywriting, caption-writing, and visual storytelling skills.

  • Technical Tools: Hands-on experience with creation and editing tools such as CapCut, Canva, adobe Creative Suite, or similar.

  • Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Ability to collaborate smoothly with Strategists, Insights teams, Videomakers, Designers, and Project Managers.

  • Mindset & Languages: Highly organized, proactive, and execution-oriented, with a high level of English suitable for an international work environment.

What we value

  • Background in social media agencies or digital content creation.

  • Exceptional creative sensibility and visual taste.

  • Strong track record in creating native short-form video content.

  • Active interest in digital internet culture, emerging platforms, and viral content trends

What this role DOES NOT cover (Scope Boundaries)

To ensure clear alignment on responsibilities, the following tasks fall outside the scope of this position:

  • Defining the overall social media strategy or establishing content territories from scratch (led by the Strategist).

  • Owning performance analysis, reporting, or data monitoring.

  • Leading audience research or insights generation.

  • Managing overall project timelines and primary stakeholder coordination.

  • Owning final video production independently without production support

In line with our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we encourage everyone to apply, especially candidates from groups that have been traditionally underrepresented, including LGBTQ+ individuals and people with disabilities.

title: Stainless Steel TIG/MIG Fabricator
description:
Who We Are

Norchem builds the equipment that keeps the commercial laundry industry running cleaner and greener. For 40 years we've been the ones behind the industry's biggest leaps - low-temperature cleaning systems, single-VFD automated injection, crossflow membrane filtration and recycling, and plant utility/labor information systems. We don't copy what's out there. We build what's next.

Right now our fabrication shop is busy, and we need a skilled hand who can lay down clean stainless bead and fit like they mean it.

We are seeking a high-energy TIG-MIG Welder with strong experience in stainless steel fabrication who will lend themselves as a valuable team player to our customer-focused fabrication department.
Why Weld Here
  • Steady, full-time work. Position with a 45+ year company, consistent hours, consistent workload.
  • Skilled work, not repetition. Stainless TIG, tank fabrication, pipefitting, full projects from cut to polish.
  • You'll build the actual product. The systems you fabricate ship to real plants and run for years.
  • Competitive LA pay. $28–$34/hr depending on experience, with room to grow as your skills do.
  • A team that takes pride in the work and a shop that keeps its tools and standards sharp.
What You'll Do
  • Build projects end to end - cutting, welding, polishing, and pipefitting - as directed by the floor supervisor
  • Read and interpret blueprints and drawings to nail the exact welding requirements
  • Run MIG and TIG on stainless-steel components - pipe, frames, and tanks, to spec
  • Fabricate and weld stainless-steel tanks and vessels - rolling, fitting, seaming, and welding leak-tight assemblies
  • Operate fabrication equipment (shear, roller, brake/bender, chop saw) and support machine operators
  • Fit and weld to ISO, OSHA, and applicable QA welding standards
  • Follow, help create, and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications
  • Keep your area clean, your equipment cared for, and your work safe and to standard
  • Lift and move raw materials and finished product, manually or by hoist (up to 50 lbs)
  • Prep finished product for shipment and travel for installations and field work as needed
  • Pitch in where the team needs it
What You'll Bring
  • 3+ years of professional welding and fabrication experience
  • Strong hands-on TIG and MIG stainless-steel fabrication experience
  • Experience building stainless tanks/vessels (rolling, fitting, and welding leak-tight seams)
  • Ability to fit and weld - both, well
  • Pipe fitting experience
  • Advanced read on shop mechanics and blueprints
  • Sharp eye for flaws, steady hand-eye coordination, and the strength/stamina the job takes
  • Solid grasp of shop safety procedures
  • Able to lift/carry up to 50 lbs
  • Associate degree or AWS certification a plus (not required - we care that you can do the work)

Before You Apply

  • The interview includes a practical skills test. You'll lay out a basic shape on plate and produce an acceptable weld bead on stainless plate and pipe.

    If you can fit and weld stainless, you'll do great. If you can't yet, this isn't the right opening for you.

If you take pride in a clean bead and want a long-term home with a company that's been innovating for four decades, we want to meet you.

Apply today - bring your experience, your safety mindset, and your best stainless work.

Learn more about us at .

Norchem is an equal opportunity employer.

You’ll work closely with our VP of Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to deepen customer relationships, identify opportunities for expansion, and ensure clients are realising full value from their partnership with inforcer.

title: Principal Scientist, ML – Overall Architect
description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Applied Science & Machine Learning (ASML) is seeking a Principal Scientist, ML – Overall Architect to serve as the cross-cutting technical owner bridging our training and inference framework, ML model building, and data across Adobe's next-generation video and image foundation models.
In this role, you will operate as the principal-level architect responsible for end-to-end coherence — holding the full technical picture across large-scale distributed training systems, inference and deployment, model architecture, and data recipe design, and making the architecture decisions that keep all of them aligned. Rather than owning a single system or model, your scope spans the seam between infrastructure, modeling, and data, ensuring these interdependencies are resolved at the architecture level rather than through coordination overhead.
This role is intended for those who can operate with genuine authority at the intersection of systems, modeling, and data at scale — and whose technical judgment drives cross-team direction.

Job Responsibilities

End-to-End Architecture Ownership Own the overall technical architecture spanning the Training & Inference Framework, ML model building, and data — making principled design decisions that keep training systems, model architecture, and data pipelines coherent and mutually reinforcing.

Training & Inference Systems Leadership Provide principal-level technical direction for large-scale distributed training (FSDP, Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, checkpointing, fault tolerance) and inference/serving infrastructure, ensuring systems are performant, reliable, and cost-efficient at scale.

Model Architecture & Data Co-Design Drive the interaction between model architecture choices, training recipes, and data design — identifying co-design opportunities and resolving architectural tensions across modeling and data teams.

Cross-Team Technical Direction Serve as the primary technical authority connecting TIF, model building, and data teams — unblocking architectural seams, aligning on interfaces, and ensuring workstreams remain coherent as models scale.

Architecture Decisions for Next-Generation Models Own architecture-level decisions for GenRender6 / Gen6.5 and GenEdit1, spanning training execution, inference deployment, model design, and data pipeline integration.

Performance and Scalability Drive architecture choices that optimize for training and inference efficiency, model quality, and cost — translating scaling and deployment requirements into concrete architecture decisions.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Education: PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field, or equivalent depth demonstrated through research contributions or principal-level systems impact.

  • Principal-Level Technical Breadth: Demonstrated ability to reason authoritatively across distributed training systems, inference/deployment infrastructure, model architecture, and data pipelines — and to make architecture decisions that span all of them.
  • Deep Distributed Training & Inference Expertise: Hands-on expertise with large-scale distributed training (PyTorch FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism, checkpointing, fault tolerance) and inference/serving for large generative models.
  • Model Architecture & Data Understanding: Strong understanding of how model architecture decisions interact with training infrastructure and data recipes, with the ability to drive principled co-design across these areas.
  • Cross-Team Architecture Leadership: Proven track record of driving technical direction across multiple teams, resolving architectural conflicts, and delivering systems at the principal/staff level in a complex organization.
  • Senior-Level Judgment & Execution: Ability to cut through ambiguity, identify the highest-leverage architectural decisions, and drive them to completion with organizational credibility and technical rigor.

Preferred Experience

  • Research contributions or publication record in generative AI, computer vision, or large-scale ML systems.

  • Experience owning end-to-end architecture for video, image, or multimodal foundation models from training through production deployment.
  • Prior work as a technical anchor spanning systems and modeling teams in a large generative AI organization.
  • Track record of shipping large-scale generative models (video generation, diffusion, flow matching) to production.
  • Experience with cost-aware architecture decisions for large model deployments.

  • Lead assessments of cybersecurity controls and capabilities using the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, applicable NIST publications, Rule 60GG-2, F.A.C., and recognized cybersecurity and professional auditing standards.
  • Design and direct controlled Ground-Truth testing activities, including adversarial simulations, behavioral anomaly generation, access-control testing, monitoring validation, and detection and response capability assessments.
  • Provide technical leadership for Ad Hoc testing based on agency risk assessments, remediation plans, identified vulnerabilities, emerging threats, and other relevant cybersecurity risk information.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of security controls, cybersecurity tools, processes, and operational capabilities across network, endpoint, identity and access management, cloud, application, and infrastructure environments.
  • Develop detailed test procedures, test scripts, sampling methodologies, acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, and technical documentation necessary to support repeatable and defensible testing.
  • Analyze security logs, alerts, vulnerability scan results, configurations, system data, and other technical evidence to determine control effectiveness and identify cybersecurity weaknesses.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis of identified vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and operational weaknesses and develop actionable, risk-based recommendations for remediation.
  • Provide independent technical analysis and professional judgment to support audit findings, testing conclusions, risk determinations, and recommendations presented to the customer
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to Cybersecurity Analysts and other assessment personnel, ensuring testing activities are performed consistently, accurately, and in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Coordinate with customer leadership, IT personnel, and other authorized stakeholders to facilitate testing activities while maintaining appropriate security, access-control, confidentiality, and independence requirements.
  • Review and validate supporting evidence to ensure test results are complete, accurate, reproducible, traceable, and sufficient to support audit conclusions and reported findings.
  • Support development of executive-level reports, technical assessment summaries, lessons learned, knowledge-transfer materials, and recommendations for improving cybersecurity assessment methodologies, tooling, coordination, and testing practices.
  • Participate in quality assurance and knowledge-transfer activities, including technical peer reviews, workshops, briefings, job aids, and training designed to promote understanding and consistent application of cybersecurity testing methodologies and results.

Desired Education/Years of Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field of expertise
  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience

Additional Requirement(s):

  • Must be able to obtain a Public Trust

title: Pharmacy Automation & Compliance Technician
description:
SUMMARY:

The Automation and Compliance pharmacy technician is responsible for supporting medication safety, regulatory compliance, and operational integrity across the pharmacy department. This role oversees controlled substance management, automated dispensing systems, supply chain compliance, and regulatory tracking, ensuring adherence to federal, state, and organizational standards. This role supports regulatory compliance activities and audit preparation; ultimate regulatory authority remains with pharmacy leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor, investigate, and resolve controlled substance discrepancies, ensuring compliance with DEA and institutional policies

  • Perform routine narcotic reconciliations and support diversion prevention audits and documentation

  • Manage daily operations of automated dispensing cabinets, including user access, security controls, medication stocking, and discrepancy resolution

  • Provide staff training, troubleshooting, and support for workflow optimization within automated dispensing systems

  • Oversee Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) compliance, including transaction verification, tracing, and vendor coordination

  • Manage medication recalls, expired drug returns, and documentation processes through vendors such as Inmar

  • Support procurement and inventory functions by monitoring shortages, purchasing trends, and cost-containment initiatives

  • Participate in regulatory inspections, internal audits, medication safety initiatives, and performance improvement projects

  • Provide operational backup support and assist with departmental initiatives and other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate’s degree preferred)
  • Active Illinois Pharmacy Technician registration (or eligible)
  • Minimum 3–5 years of hospital pharmacy experience preferred
  • Demonstrated experience with automated dispensing cabinets
  • Experience with controlled substance management and reconciliation
  • Proficiency with pharmacy information systems and EMRs
  • Strong computer and documentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT)
  • Experience with DSCSA compliance programs
  • Experience managing recalls and returns (Inmar)
  • Knowledge of procurement and supply chain processes
  • Familiarity with Meditech, Cerner, EPIC or similar EMR systems
  • Experience supporting regulatory surveys and audits

title: Kravanalytiker inom IT
description:
Vi söker en Kravanalytiker inom IT till en myndighet inom elkraft.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag. Stationeringsort är Stockholm.

Tjänsten är på heltid.

Uppdraget innebär ett nära samarbete med kunden vilket ställer stora krav på flexibilitet och samarbetsförmåga.

Uppdraget

I rollen som Senior Kravanalytiker arbetar du med verksamhetsnära utveckling av IT- och beslutsstöd inom kraftsystem och elmarknad. Du leder och driver kravarbetet i projekt och uppdrag med IT-påverkan och ansvarar för att skapa en övergripande struktur för kravställningen samt säkerställa att den följs och vidareutvecklas genom hela projektets livscykel. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med bland annat verksamhetsspecialister, projektledare, processledare, lösningsarkitekter och testledare och kan omfatta såväl egenutvecklade lösningar som införande av standardsystem.

Arbetsuppgifter

Samla in funktionella och icke-funktionella krav genom workshops, dokumentera resultatet enhetligt samt säkerställa att kraven kommuniceras och förankras mellan olika kravställare

Koordinera krav med verksamhets- och IT-arkitekter samt tillsammans med arkitekter aktivt bidra i informationsmodellering och arkitekturella vägval

Samarbeta med testledare för att säkerställa kravtäckning i testfall samt delta i testplanering och tester för att verifiera kravuppfyllnad

Ge metodstöd inom kravhantering till olika intressenter samt bidra till att utveckla kravprocess och strategi tillsammans med andra krav- och testledare

Leda och samordna kravaktiviteter, hålla workshops och bidra till att fånga verksamhetens utvecklingsbehov samt formulera och driva krav på IT-lösningar

Vid behov arbeta med tester, testledning och arkitekturarbete i närliggande projekt samt andra arbetsuppgifter inom enheten eller avdelningen som ligger nära rollen som kravanalytiker

Krav (OBS, obligatoriska)

Du ska behärska svenska språket och kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Du ska ha en universitets- eller högskoleutbildning om minst 120 p/180 hp inom systemvetenskap, informatik eller ingenjörsutbildning inom el- eller datateknik, alternativt minst 10 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom IT-verksamhet.

Du ska ha minst 10 års erfarenhet av kravställning, såsom arbete med funktionella och icke-funktionella krav, att hålla workshops samt samarbeta med arkitekter, systemutvecklare och användare.

Du ska ha minst 5 års erfarenhet som kravanalytiker i projekt som involverar flera interna och externa intressenter. Erfarenheten ska omfatta projekt med minst 2 integrerade IT-system och inkludera hantering av beroenden mellan system, processer och datakällor.

Du ska ha minst 2 års erfarenhet av att arbeta i en agil kontext, exempelvis SAFe eller annan modell, där du har samverkat med ett eller flera utvecklingsteam relaterade till IT-intensiv systemutveckling.

Du ska ha minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ta fram och dokumentera arbetsflöden (verksamhetsarkitektur) och processer vid IT-förändringar.

Du ska ha minst 1 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att arbeta med ett eller flera kravverktyg, exempelvis Azure eller JIRA.

Meriterande

Minst 5 års erfarenhet av UX-design eller användbarhetskunskap.

Minst 5 års erfarenhet av framtagning av testfall baserat på krav.

Certifiering enligt IREB, REQB eller motsvarande certifiering.

Övriga krav

Säkerhetsprövning: Säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll krävs.

Om oss

Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt.

Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov.

Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerad personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet.

För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst.

Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se.

Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

What you'll be doing

Our Beauty Consultant is responsible for delivering outstanding customer service to all customers and for using appropriate sales techniques and product knowledge to reach sales targets. Our Beauty Consultant is accountable for counter cleanliness, stock replenishment, handling new launches, promotion of products, and merchandising. Our consultant is also required to maintain high levels of standards in terms of grooming.

  • Build and maintain guest experience standards to build strong loyalty

  • Address customers' queries about products, prices, availability, product uses, and services

  • Communicate with customers to assess their needs, provide assistance in satisfying those needs, and meet or surpass customers' expectations

  • Advise customers on the product ranges best suited to their needs

  • Demonstrate the usage and benefits of various brands and products

  • Generate sales while achieving line and sales targets, using makeup knowledge

  • Sell-out target tracking at the store level

  • Generate daily sales reports

  • Participate in achieving incentives

  • Track post-launch sales at the store level

  • Ensure merchandising levels in the store are met as per the brand guidelines

  • Ensure in-store stock replenishment in the appropriate shelves/counters, at appropriate times

  • Report stock shortages using the stock order form

  • Ensure stock receipt as per set procedures

What you'll need to succeed

  • Previous experience in luxury beauty retail

  • Flexible and adaptable, with the willingness to work retail hours and rotate to different store locations, as per business requirements.

  • Strong understanding of customer service and sales environments.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a passion for delivering personalized and authentic client experiences.

  • Results-driven mindset, with the ability to understand and achieve sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).

What we can offer you

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities, and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies, as well as exclusive employee discounts.

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities, and Perspectives to truly inspire, exhilarate, and delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin, or disability status.

title: Part-time Family Assistant- Tiburon, CA
description:
A highly organized and proactive part-time Family Assistant is sought for a busy family in Tiburon. The ideal candidate will serve as a trusted partner in managing the family's day-to-day logistics, including scheduling, errands, vendor coordination, transportation, and household administration. This role is ideal for someone who is calm under pressure, an excellent communicator, and naturally anticipates what needs to be done.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage family calendars, appointments, schedules, and day-to-day logistics.

  • Coordinate household vendors, service providers, repairs, and maintenance projects.

  • Run errands and assist with household-related tasks and purchases.

  • Provide occasional driving for the family's school-aged child, including transportation to and from activities and sports in San Francisco.

  • Coordinate care and appointments for the family's two dogs, including veterinary appointments, grooming, walking schedules, and other pet-related needs.

  • Monitor upcoming needs and proactively identify ways to make the household run more smoothly.

  • Assist with special projects, travel preparation, scheduling changes, and other family needs as they arise.

  • Maintain clear communication with the family and ensure commitments and follow-ups are completed.

  • Work collaboratively with the family's housekeeper, dog walker, and other household support professionals.

Qualifications:

  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Highly proactive and resourceful, with excellent follow-through.

  • Calm, flexible demeanor and the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling personal and family matters.

  • Comfortable managing multiple schedules, vendors, appointments, and competing priorities.

  • Confident and responsible driver with a clean driving record.

  • Comfortable around dogs and in a busy family household.

  • Tech-savvy and comfortable managing digital calendars, scheduling, communication, and household logistics.

  • Strong references and a clean background check required.

  • A long-term, dependable mindset is highly valued.

Schedule: 3 days per week / 24+ hours per week

I starten blir det dag- og kveldsvakter, men det er ønskelig at du på sikt også kan gå inn som vikar på natt.

Vi ønsker gjerne å høre fra deg om hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe, og hvilke vakter og tidspunkt som passer best for deg.

🧩 Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Bistand til personlig hygiene og daglige gjøremål

  • Følge meg på daglige aktiviteter og avtaler

  • Være med på fritidsaktiviteter, turer og reiser

  • Praktisk hjelp i hjemmet

  • Bidra til kommunikasjon og samspill i hverdagen

  • Samarbeide med familien min om struktur og planlegging

🌟 Hvem ser jeg etter?

Det viktigste for meg er at du er moden, trygg og ansvarsbevisst, og at du forstår hva det innebærer å være en stabil og pålitelig assistent.

Du får god opplæring i starten, men etter hvert forventes det at du kan jobbe selvstendig, ta initiativ og se hva som trenger å gjøres. Jeg ser derfor etter deg som møter forberedt på jobb, tar ansvar og ønsker å bli værende i stillingen over tid.

Jeg tror du vil passe godt inn dersom du er:

  • Trygg, moden og til å stole på

  • Selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Initiativrik og løsningsorientert

  • Tålmodig og lærevillig

  • Fleksibel når det er behov for det

  • Sosial og komfortabel med å by på deg selv

  • God på relasjoner og samarbeid

Erfaring fra BPA eller lignende arbeid er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Personlig egnethet og riktig innstilling vil veie tungt.

📋 Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B for manuelt gir er et krav, da vi per i dag kun har tre assistenter som kan kjøre bilen 🚗

  • På grunn av forsikringsvilkår knyttet til bil ønsker vi fortrinnsvis søkere som har fylt 23 år

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig

  • Politiattest må fremlegges før oppstart

Du får nødvendig opplæring og kurs slik at du blir trygg i rollen.

🤝 Hva får du hos oss?

  • En variert arbeidshverdag, ingen dager er helt like

  • En jobb hvor du får gjøre en viktig forskjell og bidra til mestring, utvikling og innhold i hverdagen min

  • Et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø

  • God opplæring og tett oppfølging

  • Mulighet for ekstravakter ved behov

  • Tett oppfølging fra arbeidsleder og BPA-koordinator

  • Lønn etter tariff, med aktuelle tillegg for kveld, helg og natt

  • Rabattavtaler via fordelsportal

Du blir en del av et trygt og godt team og jobber tett med meg og familien min. Vi ønsker oss assistenter som både kan bidra til et godt fellesskap og som etter opplæringsperioden er komfortable med å ta ansvar og stå på egne ben i arbeidshverdagen.

💬 Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Send inn en søknad hvor du forteller litt om deg selv, hvorfor du tror denne jobben kan passe for deg, og hvor mye og når du ønsker å jobbe.

About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

  • You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.

  • Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
  • Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
  • Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives

Fashion & Trend Awareness

title: Research Analyst
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a candidate, early in their career and eager to support leading companies and governments in navigating the critical minerals and metals markets.

The Research Analyst will be responsible for the collection, automation, cleaning, analysis and validation of data related to critical minerals and metals supply chains. Your efforts will make a real difference in helping Fastmarkets to achieve its ambitious growth plans and expand its critical minerals and metals coverage.

You will be joining a dynamic global team of researchers dedicated to understanding the rapidly evolving critical minerals and metals markets. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced and innovative environment, have a can-do attitude and can juggle a wide variety of tasks and projects. An exceptional candidate will look for opportunities to automate data collection and processing workflows, improving the speed and scalability of our research output.

You will have the chance to work closely with commodity analysts, consultants, project managers and data scientists — building valuable skills that can help you grow into one of these disciplines over time.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Collect, maintain, and produce data to support understanding of critical minerals and metals production across key regions
  • Monitor regulatory developments — trade policies, tariffs, incentives, and environmental regulations and analyse their impact on the critical minerals and metals value chain
  • Map and analyse market relationships, including ownership structures, offtake agreements, and key supply-chain dynamics across the critical minerals and metals industry
  • Collaborate with the consulting team to provide data, analysis and research support for client-facing advisory projects
  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate data collection, cleaning and validation processes using scripting, APIs or other tools.

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

  • Degree or experience in a relevant discipline (geology, mining, metallurgy, engineering, industrial manufacturing, economics or business)
  • Strong primary and secondary research skills with the ability to critically assess data quality
  • Proficiency with common office and productivity tools; experience with databases, scripting languages, or AI-assisted workflows is a strong plus
  • Experience or familiarity with the mining industry, manufacturing, production and recycling
  • Foundational understanding of business analysis and economic concepts
  • Verbal and written English fluency
  • Comfortable working in a diverse, multicultural team
  • Proactive, pragmatic and resilient.

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Reward and benefits at Fastmarkets

We believe in fair pay and benefits that support you both inside and outside of work. Through Fastmarkets Rewards, you'll have access to a range of core benefits and a flexible allowance, giving you the freedom to tailor your package to suit your lifestyle, wellbeing and financial priorities. We know that everyone's needs are different, so we've designed our benefits to support our diverse global team wherever they're based.

Specific benefits may vary by country and role.

You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!

If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day.

It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

title: Rock Truck - Wiggle Wagon Operator
description:

Slave Lake, Alberta | Full-Time

GrizzlyTrek is hiring wiggle wagon operators out of Slave Lake for aggregate haul on road building, lease construction and civil earthworks. GrizzlyTrek Group is a Technical Workforce and Indigenous Employment Partner. We recruit skilled trades across Canada's industrial sector and place them with reputable employers offering long term work, fair pay, and room to advance. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and proudly support Indigenous employment.

title: Specialist, Completions - Data Management
description:
Venture Global LNG (“Venture Global”) is a long-term, low-cost provider of American-produced liquefied natural gas. Specialist, Completions - Data Management

Located:

Houston

Provides data entry and analytical services utilizing raw data, meta data, and hard copy and in some cases retrieves and enters the information from multiple sources into relational data base systems. title: 27-024 Working Foreman - Water Treatment & Supply, Full-Time
description:
The Community Services Director is looking for a responsible individual to be responsible for the oversight, operation, and maintenance of the City’s water treatment facilities, well supplies, tank sites, recharge / booster stations. Provides technical leadership and direction to treatment staff while ensuring safe, reliable, and compliant system performance. Supports the operation, maintenance, and repair of the water supply. Assists with broader public works and facility maintenance activities when required to support department operations.

This is a full-time, 40 hour per week non-exempt position with excellent full-time benefit offerings. $33.62 to $48.66 per hour. Position is open until filled.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Except as specifically noted, the following functions are considered essential to this position. The listed examples may not include all duties found in this class):
1. Ensure the continuous production and delivery of safe, reliable, and compliant drinking water to all City water customers in accordance with state and federal regulations.
2. Lead the operation, monitoring, and maintenance of water supply wells, treatment plants, booster stations, storage tanks, and recharge facilities, including inspection of equipment, pumps, controls, and instrumentation to ensure proper and efficient operation.
3. Perform and oversee raw water and finished water sampling and testing; adjust treatment processes, chemical feed systems, and controls to maintain water quality, regulatory compliance, and system performance.
4. Plan, schedule, and implement preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and minor construction activities related to water treatment and distribution infrastructure.
5. Provide technical leadership and training to water treatment staff in the operation, maintenance, and repair of wells, treatment equipment, chemical systems, SCADA, electrical components, and mechanical systems.
6. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot treatment plant equipment, pumps, generators, analyzers, chemical feed systems, and related electrical and control systems, including integration with the SCADA environment.
7. Maintain accurate operational records including inspections, maintenance activities, chemical usage, process control data, compliance sampling, and laboratory results as required by regulatory agencies.
8. Conduct routine and advanced laboratory testing; evaluate and trend analytical data; prepare reports; and use results to support process optimization and regulatory compliance.
9. Order, receive, handle, and safely transfer treatment chemicals including bulk and day tank systems; ensure proper storage, inventory control, and safety practices.
10. Create, track, and manage work orders and maintenance documentation within the City’s maintenance management system.
11. Perform general facility upkeep and housekeeping to maintain clean, safe, and organized work environments at all water facilities.
12. Maintain emergency power systems including generators and fuel systems; inspect fluids, belts, batteries, and operational readiness.
13. Train and mentor new water employees to ensure competency in treatment operations, safety procedures, regulatory requirements, and equipment use.
14. Provide leadership and accountability for laboratory operations, including oversight of the Laboratory Technician, verification of analytical results, regulatory reporting, quality control practices, and integration of laboratory data into treatment and operational decision making.
15. Operate assigned motor vehicles and equipment in support of water treatment, maintenance, and emergency response activities.
16. Respond to and mitigate operational, environmental, and infrastructure emergencies affecting the water system, including extreme weather, equipment failure, water quality events, and power outages.
17. Assist with capital improvement planning, system upgrades, instrumentation projects, and process improvements related to water treatment and distribution.
18. Represent the City professionally when interacting with the public; respond to customer concerns related to water quality and system operations.
19. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with City staff, contractors, regulators, and other agencies to support water system operations.
20. Maintain familiarity with and enforce safe work practices, confined space procedures, chemical safety, and regulatory requirements associated with water treatment operations.
21. Perform other related duties as required to support the operation of the City’s water system.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILL AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS: Considerable knowledge of the operation, control, and maintenance of municipal water treatment facilities, supply wells, booster stations, recharge systems, and water distribution infrastructure. Thorough knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation systems associated with pumps, motors, valves, chemical feed systems, and automated process controls including PLC and SCADA environments. Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance practices for water treatment and production equipment, with working knowledge of underground water main installation and repair methods and general facility maintenance practices. Considerable knowledge of laboratory testing procedures related to drinking water treatment and regulatory compliance including sampling protocols, chain of custody, data validation, and reporting requirements, with the ability to interpret water quality data for operational decision-making. Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, electrical schematics, P&IDs, and construction drawings, write clear reports, maintain accurate records, and use computerized maintenance and data management systems. Ability to safely operate tools, machinery, vehicles, and heavy equipment and work effectively in changing indoor and outdoor environments with exposure to weather, confined spaces, chemicals, noise, and other hazards while following established safety procedures. Demonstrated ability to lead, train, and mentor staff in operational, maintenance, laboratory, and safety practices, establish effective working relationships with employees, contractors, regulatory agencies, and the public, and respond professionally to customer concerns. Ability to respond to man-made and natural emergencies within a reasonable response time, preferred within 30 minutes, and make sound operational decisions under pressure.

EDUCATION/LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: Minimum of a high school diploma or equivalent required. Five (5) or more years of progressively responsible experience in municipal water treatment, water production, distribution system operations, mechanical maintenance, electrical systems, instrumentation, and control systems related to drinking water facilities, including operation and maintenance of water treatment plants, groundwater wells, booster stations, storage facilities, chemical feed systems, SCADA, and laboratory compliance sampling; experience in wastewater systems is beneficial but not required. Must possess and maintain a New Hampshire Water Treatment Operator License Grade III OIT, at minimum. A New Hampshire Distribution System Operator License Grade II is preferred to support operation of the water distribution system. Must maintain OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER certification and possess a valid New Hampshire CDL Class B with Air Brake and Tanker endorsements (CDL Class A preferred). Must possess or be able to obtain required certifications related to chemical handling, confined space entry, and distribution system operations, and must complete ongoing training and continuing education to meet state and federal drinking water compliance standards.

  • You are analytical and capable of understanding technical concepts and processes.

  • You work in a structured and detail-oriented manner.

  • You are proactive, curious, and eager to learn.

  • You have a good command of English, both written and spoken.

We also appreciate

  • Experience with technical documentation, knowledge base systems, or CRM platforms.

  • Understanding of technical support processes or troubleshooting methodologies.
