title: Head of VIP
description:
Our client is seeking an experienced Head of VIP to take end-to-end responsibility for the commercial and operational performance of its VIP function. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong people-management capabilities, commercial judgement, and the ability to interpret data and use performance indicators to drive decisions.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building a high-performing VIP team, establishing strong communication and service standards, and ensuring that commercial decisions are driven by player value, retention and relevant performance data.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Take full ownership of performance management, coaching and quality reviews across the VIP Account Management team.

  • Establish and enforce high communication standards, including tone, personalisation, empathy and professionalism, supported by a structured and effective coaching programme.

  • Develop a proactive, relationship-focused approach within the team, ensuring VIP Account Managers actively manage their player portfolios rather than operating solely as reactive support agents.

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of VIP Account Managers, driving accountability and continuous improvement.

VIP Operations & Communication

  • Oversee how VIP players are communicated with across all relevant channels, ensuring consistency, personalisation and appropriate context.

  • Establish and maintain effective operational and shift structures, including clear priorities, workflows and service expectations.

  • Drive effective adoption and day-to-day use of the VIP technology and tooling stack.

  • Maintain high operational standards across the VIP function.

Commercial & Data Ownership

  • Own the VIP upgrade and segmentation strategy, ensuring clear prioritisation, consistent communication and appropriate account allocation.

  • Oversee bonus-granting discipline, ensuring agreed frameworks are applied consistently and that commercial decisions can be clearly justified.

  • Use KPIs, dashboards and performance data to manage team performance, workload and commercial outcomes.

  • Analyse key VIP metrics including player value, retention, bonus expenditure, lifetime value and other relevant commercial KPIs.

  • Ensure decisions are based on data and commercial judgement rather than instinct alone.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with relevant internal teams to improve VIP retention and overall player value.

  • Collaborate with Business Analysis and Business Intelligence functions on KPI definition, measurement and performance governance.

  • Represent the VIP function at management level, identifying risks, opportunities and areas for improvement.

Requirements

  • Proven experience leading and managing a VIP, high-value customer or comparable relationship-management team.

  • Strong people-management skills with demonstrable experience in performance management, coaching and quality assurance.

  • Commercially minded, with a strong understanding of player/customer value, lifetime value, retention and the commercial trade-offs involved in managing high-value relationships.

  • Highly numerate and comfortable using dashboards, KPIs and performance data to make informed decisions.

  • Strong understanding of high-net-worth or high-value customer relationship management.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to establish and maintain high standards of personalisation, empathy and professionalism.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage team performance, operational processes and commercial priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience within iGaming or sportsbook is a must, particularly within VIP management, player development or high-value customer operations.

Team & Reporting Structure

  • Reports directly to C-Level.

  • Manages a team of VIP Account Managers.

  • Holds responsibility for team performance, coaching, communication quality, VIP segmentation, account allocation, bonus discipline and operational standards.

Location & Working Arrangement

  • The role is based in Malta.

  • Hybrid working arrangement of four days per week in the office and one day working from home, with some flexibility.

  • Employees may have the opportunity to work from abroad for up to one month, subject to company policy and approval.

Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration package including commission.

  • Free parking.

  • Company-provided lunch once per week.

  • Health insurance.

  • Hybrid working arrangement.

  • Opportunity to work abroad for up to one month.

Our client is looking for a proven VIP leader rather than simply a strong individual VIP Account Manager. The successful candidate should demonstrate meaningful team-management experience, a structured approach to coaching and quality assurance, strong commercial awareness and confidence working with data.

title: Ohjaaja (sosionomi), Humana Lastensuojelupalvelut, Aatula Pori
description:
Etsimme nyt ohjaajaa (sosionomi) lastensuojeluyksikkö Aatulaan Porin Vähäraumalle!


Humanan lastensuojelupalveluille yhteinen kuvaava tekijä on asiakaslähtöisyys. Uskomme, että jokaisen perheen ja lapsen haasteet ovat ratkaistavissa oikea-aikaisella ja tarpeen mukaisella tuella, hoidolla ja kasvatuksella. Toiminnassamme korostuu vastuullisuus, inhimillisyys ja yksilöllisyyden kunnioittaminen. Meillä jokainen työntekijämme on hyvinvaikuttaja ja elämänarvon kasvattaja.

Aatula tarjoaa 7 lapselle kodinomaisen ja turvallisen kasvuympäristön. Tarjoamme yksilöllisiin tarpeisiin perustuvaa tukea ja hoivaa. Työskentelemme nuoren kanssa dialogisesti, hänen ihmisarvoaan ja itsemääräämisoikeutta kunnioittaen.


Millainen työ sinua odottaa?

Haemme nyt sosionomia ohjaajan sijaisuuteen 16.6.2027 saakka. Työ on kokoaikainen, jaksotyö 115h/3vko. Työtä tehdään kolmessa vuorossa, ja työvuorot painottuvat iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin. Pyrimme myös joustavasti mahdollistamaan eri elämäntilanteisiin sopivia työjärjestelyitä. Työ alkaa välittömästi kun löydämme sopivan tekijän.

Tehtävässä pääset tukemaan ja kannustamaan lapsia ja nuoria arjen haasteissa sekä osallistut nuoren hoidon ja kasvatuksen arviointiin. Työtä tehdään aina tiiviissä yhteistyössä huoltajien, lähiverkoston, koulutoimen ja sosiaaliviranomaisten kanssa.

Sinulla on mahdollisuus olla suunnittelemassa ja luomassa yksikön tarinaa kanssamme! Hyvinvoiva ja ammattitaitoinen tiimimme koostuu lähihoitajista, sairaanhoitajista ja sosionomeista. Meidän tiimimme puhaltaa yhteen hiileen ja saat tiimin sekä vastaavan ohjaajan ja yksikönjohtajan tuen työssä.

Viimeisimpien kyselyiden perusteella työpaikallamme on välittävä ilmapiiri ja työssä tuetaan onnistumisiin. Meillä työvire on erinomainen.

Voit lukea lisää Humanassa työskentelystä ja hyvinvaikuttajistamme täältä.


Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Koemme Humanassa erittäin tärkeänä tukea henkilöstömme kehittymistä ja uramahdollisuuksia. Omien kattavien sisäisten kouluttautumismahdollisuuksiemme lisäksi voimme neuvotella palkallisista koulutusvapaista sekä työnantajan osallistumisesta koulutuksesi kustannuksiin. Osaamisemme vahvistaminen on meidän kaikkien etu!

  • Humanan työntekijänä olet oikeutettu kattavaan työterveyshuoltoon.

  • Epassin liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu on Humanassa 400 euroa vuodessa (työaikaehdon täyttyessä). Tällä edulla hankit teatteriliput ja kuntosalikortit, tai piipahdat vaikkapa suuhygienistillä!

  • Humanasta saat itsellesi arvovastuullisen työnantajan. Uskomme vahvasti mahdollisuuksiimme hyvinvaikuttaa ihmisiin ja yhteiskuntaan. Olemme ylpeitä arvoistamme: sitoutuminen, vastuullisuus sekä kohtaaminen ja ilo.


Palkkaus

Työsuhteen ehdot ja palkkaus määräytyvät yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaan. Tehtävän peruspalkka sijoittuu G24D-vaativuusluokassa 2 811,09–3 071,09 eur/kk välille riippuen aiemmasta soveltuvasta työkokemuksestasi. Palkan päälle maksetaan TES:n mukaiset vuorolisät. Palkkaan on myös mahdollista vaikuttaa työn kannalta oleellisilla täydennyskoulutuksilla.


Minkälaista työkaveria etsimme?

Odotamme sinulta sosiaalialan AMK-tutkintoa (sosionomi). Työnkuva rakennetaan yhdessä kanssasi ja pyrimme huomioimaan osaamisesi sekä kiinnostuksen kohteesi.

Arvostamme aikaisempaa kokemusta lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelystä, erityisesti kokemusta lastensuojelutyöstä. Lisäksi arvostamme vahvaa ammattitaitoa ja kohtaamisen taitoja. Tärkeintä tehtävän menestyksellisessä hoitamisessa on aidosti asiakaslähtöinen työote; rohkeus kohdata jokainen lapsi yksilönä hänen omista lähtökohdistaan, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä joustavuus muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rikosrekisteriote (laki 504/2002). Lisäksi valitulla henkilöllä tulee olla hankittuna sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattikortti työsuhteen alkaessa.


Seuraavaksi haluaisimme kuulla sinusta!

Tartu tilaisuuteen ja hae helposti verkkosivuillamme viimeistään 20.9.2026. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajan puitteissa, ja valinta tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa yksikön johtaja Elina Sunnari p. 040 673 3921 tai sähköpostilla elina.sunnari@humana.fi.

Huomioithan, että tietoturvasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse. Jätä oma hakemuksesi suoraan hakulinkkimme kautta.

Humana on johtava pohjoismainen sosiaalialan toimija, joka tarjoaa yksilöllisiä sosiaalipalveluita lähellä ihmistä ja perheen arkea. Meitä on Suomessa 2 300. Autamme ja tuemme 5 000 ihmistä erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa. Visiomme mukaisesti uskomme siihen, että jokaisella on oikeus hyvään elämään - ja tätä visiota toteutamme hyvinvaikuttamalla ihmisiin ja yhteiskuntaan.

title: Admissions Coordinator - Hospital Outpatient
description:
The Admissions Coordinator oversees the full referral to admission process, ensuring timely follow up, accurate intake documentation, and a smooth transition for incoming clients. This role manages referral conversion by promptly engaging with referral sources, assessing eligibility, gathering required information, and coordinating scheduling. The coordinator maintains detailed records, communicates closely with clinical and operational teams, and provides clear, supportive guidance to clients and families throughout the intake journey. Their work ensures efficient workflow, high quality customer service, and strong relationships with community partners, coordinating the referral intake process through to admission; tracking outstanding authorizations and ensuring timely patient admissions. Assists with registration functions to include, patient registration, scheduling, insurance verification and authorization, general clerical, receptionist and project-based work. Demonstrates a professional, positive image both in-person and on the telephone.

Key Responsibilities
Referral Management & Conversion
•Receive, track, and manage all incoming referrals from hospitals, physicians, case managers, community partners, and direct inquiries.
•Conduct timely follow-up with referral sources, prospective clients, and families to gather necessary information and assess eligibility.
•Evaluate referral readiness and work proactively to remove barriers to admission.
•Provide clear, compassionate communication about services, program requirements, and next steps.
•Maintain high conversion rates by ensuring prompt response times and consistent follow-through.
•In coordination with Community Educator, reconciles referral log; admissions resulting from referrals.
•Presents results to clinic director.
Admissions Coordination
•Complete pre-admission screenings, insurance verifications, and required documentation.
•Collaborate with clinical, financial, and operational teams to determine appropriateness for admission.
•Schedule admissions and coordinate logistics, including transportation, room readiness, and handoff to care teams.
•Ensure all required forms, consents, and records are obtained prior to admission.
•Deliver a seamless, positive experience for clients and families throughout the intake process.

Referral Intake Timeliness Standards:

  • Referral entered WCMD within ≤ 1 hour of receipt
  • Insurance authorization initiated within ≤ 4 hours
  • Once authorization received:
    • Patient contacted within ≤ 2 hours
    • Appointment scheduled within ≤ 24–48 hours

Call Attempts Standard:

  • Minimum 3 contact attempts within 24 hours
  • Minimum 5 attempts within 72 hours before escalation


 
Relationship Building & Customer Service
•Serve as the primary point of contact for referral partners and prospective clients.
•Build strong relationships with hospitals, case managers, and community organizations to support ongoing referral growth.
•Provide timely updates to referral sources regarding referral status and admission decisions.
•Represent the organization professionally in all interactions.
Data Tracking & Reporting
•Accurately document all referral and admissions activity in the CRM or EMR system.
•Monitor referral trends, conversion metrics, and barriers to admission.
•Prepare reports for leadership on referral volume, conversion rates, and opportunities for improvement.
•Ensure compliance with HIPAA and all regulatory standards.
Patient Registration
•Assists registration with the following as needed:
Answers telephones and transfers calls to appropriate staff members, announcing call.
Welcomes patients and visitors professionally; adheres to HIPAA regulations.
Schedules patients, establishes appointments in timely manner.
Registering all patients upon arrival to the center; validating responsible payer information.
Contact patients with reminder of next day's appointment and reschedules appropriately if needed.
Follow up with clinicians to ensure completion of documentation.
Responds to issues resulting from information uploads.
Validates information, logs referrals, and communicates information to authorization department.
Works closely with hospital's Patient Access department to support denial resubmissions.
Participates in daily huddle, weekly case management meeting and monthly staff meetings to remain informed and perform at a high level of competency.

Follow-ups daily with Authorization Department regarding outstanding authorizations.
Facilitates upon requests, patient appointments with ancillary services.
Performs clerical duties to include but not limited to, scanning, photocopying, faxing, mailing, etc.
Appropriately discharges patients from EMR at the time of discharge.
Requests medical records at referral intake from referring physician and/or facilities.

Must complete and pass required medical screening, background checking and drug test

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Science Data Frameworks
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Applied Science Data Frameworks team responsible for building the foundational infrastructure that powers large-scale multimodal AI training and inference. This role is ideal for someone with strong distributed systems and data engineering fundamentals who is eager to work in an ML-adjacent environment, contributing to training data loaders, distributed inference frameworks, feature enrichment pipelines, and dataset management systems that enable ML teams to train foundation models at petabyte scale. You'll work on high-impact projects involving distributed data loading for PyTorch training workloads, batch inference pipelines for feature enrichment, semantic search infrastructure for dataset discovery, and production-grade ML data pipelines that support generative AI model development. Your systems will process billions of images,

videos, and multimodal content across large-scale GPU clusters.

If you're excited about building distributed data frameworks, optimizing data pipelines at scale, and growing your expertise in ML infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to building and maintaining distributed training data loaders that handle multi-source data ingestion, temporal sampling, and real-time transformations for large-scale model training workflows.
  • Help implement and maintain feature enrichment pipelines and dataset registry systems that support multimodal model training across images, video, documents, and text.
  • Build and maintain batch inference pipelines for large-scale feature extraction,
  • processing assets through distributed GPU clusters with queue management and fault tolerance.
  • Develop data processing systems using frameworks like Apache Ray, Spark, DuckDB, or similar distributed computing tools for SQL-based data ingestion and Apache Arrow-based storage formats.
  • Support semantic search capabilities and vector database infrastructure (e.g.,
  • OpenSearch, LanceDB) for dataset discovery and embedding-based retrieval.
  • Contribute to CI/CD infrastructure for ML systems including self-hosted runner
  • management, Docker image builds, automated testing pipelines, and deployment automation.
  • Collaborate with ML research teams to translate training requirements into reliable, scalable data loading and preprocessing infrastructure.
  • Write reusable framework components, SDKs, and documentation to help accelerate platform adoption across modeling teams.
  • Optimize data pipeline performance across dimensions like startup latency, throughput, memory footprint, and GPU utilization.
  • Contribute to observability and reliability standards for production data systems
  • supporting 24/7 training workloads.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 5-6 years of professional experience building and operating distributed systems or data infrastructure in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of distributed computing concepts and experience with framework like Apache Spark, Ray, Dask, or equivalent.

title: Senior Product Manager – GPU Products
description:

Experience required: 12 Years

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager – GPU Products to lead the strategy, development, and lifecycle management of next-generation GPU cloud products and services. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong product leader who understands AI, HPC, accelerated computing, and large-scale cloud infrastructure.
In this role, you will work across product, engineering, sales, marketing, and external technology partners to define the vision and roadmap for GPU instances, clusters, and services. You’ll translate complex customer and workload requirements into scalable products while balancing technical capabilities, market needs, and business objectives.

What You’ll Do
Define the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for GPU instances, clusters, and cloud services.
Align product positioning, requirements, and priorities with customer needs, market trends, and business objectives.
Manage the full product lifecycle, from initial planning and launch through ongoing optimization and eventual end-of-life.
Develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, profitability analyses, and TCO models to support product investments and decisions.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, including product messaging, positioning, launch plans, and customer engagement in partnership with marketing, sales, and solutions engineering.
Partner with GPU technology and ecosystem providers to align roadmaps, integrations, and technical requirements.
Translate AI, HPC, graphics, and other accelerated-computing workloads into product specifications, performance requirements, and technical architectures.
Guide the evolution of GPU infrastructure and make data-driven decisions around platform investments and lifecycle management.
Represent the needs of customers, engineers, and data scientists by identifying opportunities to improve usability, automation, monitoring, support, and maintenance processes.
Build strong relationships with engineering teams and secure alignment around product goals, technical requirements, and future GPU capabilities.
What We’re Looking For
12+ years of relevant product management, technology, or engineering experience and a bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Strong technical understanding of GPU architectures, CUDA, and accelerated computing platforms.
Experience with GPU resource management and cluster orchestration for AI and high-performance computing workloads.
Knowledge of cloud networking, GPU interconnects, infrastructure redundancy, and large-scale GPU deployments.
Experience developing both technical and business models for GPU/cloud products, including pricing, profitability, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.
Understanding of AI workload patterns, enterprise security requirements, and hardware-level APIs related to GPU infrastructure.

Proven ability to collaborate with highly technical engineering and data science teams and gain buy-in for new product initiatives.
Strong communication, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to balance complex technical requirements with customer needs and business objectives.

Why This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI and accelerated computing in the cloud. You’ll play a key role in defining GPU products and services designed to support demanding AI, HPC, graphics, and enterprise workloads at global scale.
You’ll work at the intersection of product strategy, AI infrastructure, cloud computing, and advanced GPU technology, partnering with engineering and technology leaders to bring innovative products to market.

Remote & Flexibility
This is a remote position offering flexibility and the opportunity to work with a highly distributed team. The company supports employees in working in the environment where they can do their best work.

If you’re a technically minded product leader with deep experience in GPUs, AI infrastructure, cloud computing, and accelerated workloads, and you’re excited about building products that enable the next generation of AI applications, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager to join our crew at QOCO Systems!

What if you could directly shape how airlines and engine manufacturers plan and run their maintenance operations?

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our product team and turn real aviation maintenance problems into software that is critical to making their maintenance processes more efficient. Your job is not to manage a feature factory or simply pass requests to engineering. It is to deeply understand our customers, make sharp prioritization calls and build things that actually matter.

You will work closely with our commercial team to decide which problems are worth solving, why they matter now, and how we will know we got it right.

Our products are already trusted by the likes of Finnair, Lufthansa and Rolls-Royce, with more leading names across global aviation. The market opportunity is proven and we are still early enough that the right person will have a real impact on where this goes. It is an exciting time to join.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the product outcomes: vision, direction, roadmap, backlog and priority decisions linked to company strategy and commercial opportunities

  • Run continuous discovery with airline & MRO customers to increase customer understanding and form strong product sense: join commercial engagements, observe real work, interview users and buyers and analyse product data

  • Create points of view, demos, prototypes, experiments and product bets by leveraging AI (Claude Design, Claude Code...) to visualize, communicate and validate value with customers prior to delivery

  • Leverage evidence, strategic fit, customer reach, commercial potential, risk, and effort to prioritize

  • Ensure the problems we solve and solutions we build scale across existing and new customers

  • Work daily with your product team to clarify direction, support with open questions and document releases and features

What we’re looking for

You may come from different backgrounds, but you recognise product management as the key discipline responsible for product outcomes. We expect:

  • Several years of product management experience in modern B2B SaaS, preferably serving industrial enterprise environments

  • A track record of shipping meaningful products with measurable customer and business value

  • Strong business acumen as you understand it’s PM decisions that make or break product growth and where we allocate our investments

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in written and verbal (English) to engage with customers, internal stakeholders and product team

  • Strong discovery skills: customer interviewing, observation, problem framing, data analysis, hypothesis creation, prototyping, experimentation, and validation.

  • High on curiosity and taking ownership, to make product decisions and courage to challenge assumptions and say no with reasoning

Nice to have

  • Experience in one or many: aviation, airline TechOps, MRO (maintenance, repair and overhaul), workforce planning, optimisation, or another safety-critical industry

  • Hands-on experience taking a product through the full lifecycle: from early discovery and customer validation through launch, adoption, and iterations to secure commercial growth

  • Experience working in a scale-up, an international customer environment, or a product-led organisation operating with a sales-driven go-to-market motion.

About QOCO

We build software that helps airlines and MRO organizations forecast, plan and optimize their maintenance operations. Our mission is to reduce aircraft downtime and help aviation teams make better decisions with their data. We are a fast-growing scale-up with a collaborative culture and real impact on an industry that keeps the world moving. Between 2021 and 2025 we more than doubled from 25 to over 65 people, and today our crew represents over 15 nationalities.

At QOCO, you’ll enjoy

  • Real ownership and impact in your work

  • An experienced, collaborative, and international development team

  • Opportunity to grow as the company grows

  • Scale-up energy with global customers

  • Performance that makes a difference is recognized and rewarded, not just appreciated

  • Flexible hours and hybrid work model

  • Great benefits: lunch & sport perks, occupational healthcare, 24/7 gym and free breakfast at the office

If aircraft, hangars, and the complexity behind keeping fleets flying spark your curiosity, we would love to hear from you.

Please note: our Talent Acquisition Specialist is currently on holiday. Application review may be slower than usual during this period, but we will be in touch as soon as we can. Thank you for your patience!

title: Broadcast Engineer
description:
Title: Broadcast Studio Engineer
Location: Alexandria, Va (On-Site)
Travel: Flexibility in working hours, including occasional evenings and weekends, based on project needs.
Clearance: Public Trust

Job Overview:
The Broadcast Studio Engineer is responsible for the setup, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of all broadcast and studio equipment. This role ensures that the technical aspects of broadcasts and recordings run smoothly, adhering to the highest quality standards. The engineer collaborates closely with the production team to deliver high-quality audio and video content.
Key Responsibilities:
  1. Technical Operations:
    • Set up, operate, and monitor broadcast equipment, including cameras, lighting, audio consoles, and video switchers.
    • Manage live broadcasts, ensuring seamless transitions between video sources, graphics, and audio feeds.
    • Monitor and adjust audio levels, video signals, and other technical aspects during live and recorded productions.
  2. Equipment Maintenance and Troubleshooting:
    • Regularly inspect, maintain, and repair broadcast and studio equipment to ensure optimal performance.
    • Troubleshoot technical issues quickly and efficiently during live broadcasts or recordings to minimize disruptions.
    • Maintain an organized inventory of all equipment and gear, ensuring everything is properly stored and readily available.
  3. Graphic Management:
    • Oversee and manage graphic systems for monitors and kiosks, ensuring content is displayed correctly and aligns with broadcast requirements.
    • Regularly update and maintain the graphics on monitors and kiosks to ensure they are current and visually appealing.
  4. Building and Equipment Management:
    • Conduct multiple daily studio walkthroughs and rounds to ensure the overall health and functionality of the broadcast studio, identifying and addressing any issues.
    • Ensure all equipment is properly maintained, functioning correctly, and safely stored.
  5. Collaboration and Support:
    • Work closely with producers, audio techs, and other members of the production team to understand and meet the technical requirements of each project.
    • Provide technical support during walk-thrus and live events, offering solutions and adjustments as needed.
    • Support the setup of offsite shoots, ensuring all necessary equipment is transported, set up, and functioning correctly.
  6. Network Management:
    • Oversee and manage the broadcast studio's network infrastructure, ensuring reliable connections for live streaming and remote operations.
  7. System and Software Management:
    • Manage and configure broadcast automation systems, ensuring they are updated and functioning correctly.
    • Ensure all software used in the broadcast studio is up to date and compatible with current systems.
  8. Training and Documentation:
    • Train staff on the proper use of broadcast equipment and studio protocols.
    • Develop and maintain technical documentation for all equipment and systems within the studio.
    • Stay updated on the latest broadcast technologies and recommend upgrades or improvements to existing systems.
  9. Reporting and Compliance:
    • Prepare and submit weekly and monthly reports on equipment status, broadcast quality, and any technical issues encountered.
    • Ensure all broadcast operations comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications:
  • Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a broadcast engineering role, with hands-on experience in live broadcast environments.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with broadcast equipment, IP-based systems, network management, and automation software.
  • Signal Flow: Knowledgeable in signal flow in a broadcast environment and proficiency in patching audio and video connections.
  • Other Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work under pressure during live events.
Work Environment:
  • This role may require working outside regular business hours, including evenings and weekends, depending on the production schedule.
  • The position may involve occasional travel for remote broadcasts or equipment servicing.

Benefits at Red Carrot:

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. Together, we can solve our client’s biggest challenges. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.
  • Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.
  • 401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.
  • Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.
  • Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.

About Us:

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join a dynamic data engineering team and contribute to the development of modern, scalable data solutions within a Microsoft Azure and Databricks environment.

  • Practical experience of using DABs (Declarative Automation Bundles, nee Databricks Asset Bundles) for deployment
  • Practical experience using git repositories and CI/CD pipelines (preferably with GitHub and ADO)

Nice to Have

title: Data Analyst
description:
Location: Kings hill/hybrid

Salary: £40,000 per annum

Contract Type: Permanent

Hours: 37 hours per week

Are you a data professional who enjoys turning complex information into meaningful insight that drives better decision-making?

As a Data Analyst within HR Connect, you'll play a key role in developing the reporting, dashboards and workforce intelligence that support both our customers and our internal teams. This is an opportunity to make a real impact, helping shape how data is collected, analysed and presented across a growing HR services business.

This role would suit an experienced Data Analyst, MI Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst or Reporting Analyst looking for a position where they can combine technical expertise with stakeholder engagement, delivering insights that influence operational performance, service improvement and strategic decision-making.

Who we are

HR Connect is part of Commercial Services Group (CSG), one of the UK's largest local authority-owned trading organisations, operating 35+ businesses across education, energy, IT, procurement, HR and more.

HR Connect delivers expert HR advisory, employment law, payroll and strategic people services to schools, academies, local authorities and public sector organisations. Data and management information sit at the heart of the service we provide, helping our customers make informed workforce decisions.

Why this role matters

You will play a key role in transforming workforce data into accurate, meaningful management information, ensuring colleagues and customers have access to reliable insight that supports planning, decision-making and continuous improvement.

This is a role where analytical thinking, attention to detail and collaboration are essential, with responsibility for developing reports, improving data quality and helping shape the future of HR data and reporting across the organisation.

What you'll be doing

· Extracting, cleansing and combining data from multiple HR and business systems to create reliable reporting datasets.

· Designing, building and maintaining reports and dashboards that provide clear and actionable insight.

· Developing and maintaining robust data models and reusable datasets that support business reporting.

· Analysing workforce data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

· Providing timely and accurate management information to support operational and strategic decision-making.

· Automating and standardising recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and consistency.

· Monitoring and improving data quality, integrity and governance standards.

· Working closely with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and develop effective data solutions.

· Supporting the ongoing development of HR systems, reporting capability and data-driven decision making.

· Ensuring all data is handled securely and in line with GDPR and organisational policies.

What we're looking for

· Proven experience in a Data Analyst, MI Analyst, Reporting Analyst or Business Intelligence role.

· Experience working with HR, payroll or workforce data would be highly advantageous.

· Experience extracting, cleansing, transforming and combining data from multiple systems.

· Strong experience designing and building reports and dashboards using Power BI or a similar BI platform.

· Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables and working with large datasets.

· Experience developing and maintaining data models and reporting datasets.

· The ability to translate complex data into meaningful insight for non-technical audiences.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.

· Experience of reporting automation using SQL, Power Query, data flows or similar technologies.

· The ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work to deadlines.

· A collaborative approach and the confidence to work independently when required.

· Knowledge of education or public sector environments would be beneficial.

What you'll get in return

· Salary of £40,000 per annum

· 25 days annual leave, rising in line with policy for the role

· Birthday Day Off

· One concessionary day during the Christmas period

· Pension scheme with 4% employer contribution

· Life assurance cover

· Access to Learning & Development opportunities via our CSG Academy

· Health cash plan

· Employee discounts and benefits platform

· Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing support

· Annual volunteer day

· Referral scheme

· The opportunity to help shape how data is used to improve services across a growing HR business.

Why CSG?

CSG is the UK's largest local authority-owned trading company (LATCO), generating over £700 million in revenue per annum and supporting more than 16,000 education and public sector customers globally.

We are growing through a combination of organic development, acquisitions and strategic partnerships. Our businesses deliver services across education, IT, HR, legal, energy, procurement and more, all focused on delivering meaningful impact.

As a locally owned organisation, we take pride in reinvesting a significant proportion of our profits into frontline services, helping strengthen the communities we serve.

Inclusion & Accessibility

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We encourage applications from suitably qualified people of all backgrounds.

As a member of Inclusive Employers with Silver Accreditation, we are actively building an environment that supports inclusion, flexibility and belonging for all colleagues.

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout our application and interview process; please let us know if you require any.

title: Embedded Software Engineer II
description:
We are seeking a highly engaged junior to mid-level Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. This role offers a fast-paced environment where you will work with senior personnel to develop advanced skills and contribute to critical projects. We are looking for individuals with strong technical fundamentals in low-level systems programming who are eager to learn our product deeply and assist in system integration. This position requires working primarily onsite with some hybrid flexibility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop embedded software using C/C++ within constrained environments.
  • Implement state machines and handle asynchronous events (e.g., interrupts, signals).
  • Work with operating system concepts including process scheduling, resource sharing, and synchronization.
  • Integrate networking capabilities into embedded devices (basic IP/MAC layer knowledge required).

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 1-3 years of professional experience in embedded systems development
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Core OS Knowledge: Solid understanding of fundamental OS concepts (kernel vs. user space, task scheduling, memory management, and synchronization primitives).
  • Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python, C and/or C++, including object-oriented principles.
  • Networking Basics: Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, MAC addresses, packet inspection tools).
  • Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to solve problems independently within assigned tasks.
  • Documentation: Proven track record of learning from specification documents and adapting to new protocols or standards.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with containerized Linux user space applications.
  • Exposure to Yocto or kernel driver development (not mandatory, but beneficial).
  • Experience with space networking technologies and standards.
  • DoD Secret clearance.

Compensation: Base salary range is $90,000-115,000/ year, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA.

title: Vil du hjælpe dansk industri med at navigere i Bruxelles?
description:
Bruxelles er centrum for mange af de beslutninger, der former danske virksomheders muligheder for at konkurrere, investere og udvikle sig i Danmark såvel som i udlandet. Som praktikant hos DI bliver du en del af arbejdet med at bringe dansk erhvervslivs perspektiver ind i de europæiske beslutningsprocesser og får et særligt førstehåndsindblik i politisk interessevaretagelse i Bruxelles.

DI arbejder i Bruxelles med en lang række politiske områder. Det gælder brede dagsordener som det indre marked, digitalisering, industripolitik og grøn omstilling til mere specifikke dagsordener som energieffektivitet og sundheds-, miljø- og handelspolitik. Kort sagt, alt hvad der berører erhvervslivets interesser.

DI’s kontor i Bruxelles er knudepunkt og brobygger mellem vores kolleger i København, DI’s medlemsvirksomheder og beslutningstagere i Bruxelles.

Som praktikant på DI’s kontor i Bruxelles får du ansvar for at følge den politiske proces helt tæt indenfor områder, der har stor betydning for danske virksomheder, europæisk erhvervsliv og samfundet som helhed.

Et praktikforløb hos DI i Bruxelles giver dig indblik i den politiske interessevaretagelse over for Europa-Parlamentet, Rådet og Europa-Kommissionen i en periode, hvor forslag til ny og ændret lovgivning drøner ud af Berlaymont-bygningen. Du vil udbygge din viden om EU’s institutioner og lære, hvilke vinduer for indflydelse der er vigtige i den politiske interessevaretagelse.

Praktikforløbet er en unik mulighed for at skabe et fagrelevant netværk på tværs af EU’s landegrænser og bane vejen for en EU-karriere. Samtidig vil du opleve, at Bruxelles er et socialt miljø, der er fyldt med andre EU-begejstrede europæere. Du vil opleve, at det faglige og sociale ofte flyder sammen.

Praktikperioden løber over 6 måneder fra 1. februar 2027 til 30. juli 2027.

Dine opgaver
Du vil i samarbejde med kontorets øvrige medarbejdere komme til at beskæftige dig med mange forskellige opgaver. Det drejer sig blandt andet om analyser, mødeforberedelse, deltagelse i møder, informationsovervågning og -søgning, aktiv interessevaretagelse, planlægning og afvikling af events, oplæg for besøgende samt opgaver knyttet til kontorets løbende drift.

Opgaverne afhænger af de aktuelle politiske sager, der behandles i første halvår af 2027.

Du vil blive koblet på den konsulent, som arbejder med dit interesseområde. Jo mere engageret du er, jo mere ansvar får du mulighed for at løfte.

Vi forventer, at du

  • har interesse i at arbejde for erhvervslivets brede interessevaretagelse

  • har erfaring med politisk arbejde

  • har et basalt kendskab til EU-beslutningsprocesser

  • får energi af at være en del af et miljø, hvor der tales politik og EU – både i og uden for kontortiden

  • er service-minded

  • er på et relevant videregående studie, som under praktikopholdet ikke er afsluttet

  • taler og skriver flydende engelsk.

Du kan forvente

  • at være teamet op med en anden praktikant

  • at blive tilknyttet konsulenter, som arbejder med det politikområde, der har din interesse

  • at få kendskab til EU’s beslutningsprocesser og en lang række politikområder af central betydning for danske virksomheder

  • at opnå erfaring med at samarbejde i et internationalt miljø

  • at være en del af et yderst kompetent team fordelt over DI’s kontorer i Bruxelles og på Rådhuspladsen i København.

  • at blive en del af et dynamisk kontor i Bruxelles, som består af 6 DI-konsulenter, chefen for kontoret og gode kollegaer fra København, der er på kontoret i kortere eller længere perioder.

  • at vi deler kontor og frokoststue med Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening.

  • at modtage boligtilskud fra DI og hjælp til det praktiske i forbindelse med praktikopholdet.

Er du interesseret?
Du kan få yderligere oplysninger om stillingen hos konsulent Mikkel Kragh Sager på mksa@di.dk eller +32470565258 eller konsulent Frederik Filtenborg på frfi@di.dk eller +32470170892.

Send dit CV og relevante bilag via ansøgningslinket og svar på nogle spørgsmål om din motivation for at søge stillingen.

title: Staff Engineer, Reliability
description:
Venture Global LNG (“Venture Global”) is a long-term, low-cost provider of American-produced liquefied natural gas. The company’s Louisiana-based export projects service the global demand for North American natural gas and support the long-term development of clean and reliable North American energy supplies. Using reliable, proven technology in an innovative plant design configuration, Venture Global’s modular, mid-scale plant design will replace traditional designs as it allows for the same efficiency and operational reliability at significantly lower capital cost.

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position:

Staff Engineer, Reliability

Located:

Houston

Summary

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position of Staff Engineer, Reliability located in Houston, TX.

We are seeking a high-performing Staff Engineer – Reliability with strong expertise in RAM (Reliability, Availability & Maintainability) modeling, reliability assessments and Equipment Criticality Analysis (ECA) to join our Reliability team supporting LNG operations. This role will focus on performing RAM and Ad-hoc Reliability studies, supporting in Equipment Criticality Analysis workshops and report development and reliability data collection. The position requires periodic travel to our two operational LNG Plants in Louisiana.

General Description Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support Equipment Criticality Analysis (ECA):
    • Review P&IDs, equipment datasheets, and process information.
    • Support and co-facilitate ECA workshops with cross-functional teams at LNG plants.
    • Assist in consolidation of criticalities from ECA workshops and Process Safety reports, post-population of criticality rankings, and report development.
  • RAM Modeling & Simulation
    • Extract equipment and maintenance data from engineering documents and databases.
    • Develop and run RAM models for LNG Plants in DNV MAROS or similar software.
    • Evaluate design and operational scenarios (redundancy, spares, maintenance strategies).
    • Translate model outputs into business-impact insights.
  • General Responsibilities:
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data integrity and process alignment.
    • Support Ad-hoc reliability assessments and reliability improvement initiatives.
    • Travel to LNG sites in Louisiana as required for data collection, workshops, and field validation.

Qualifications

Required experience

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in process industries.
  • Reliability Certification is desirable (e.g. CMRP, ASQ CRE).
  • Strong hands-on experience in RAM modeling and reliability analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Reliability tools (e.g., DNV Maros, Relyence, Weibull)
  • Knowledge of standards like IEEE 762, ISO 14224, or ISO 20815.
  • Familiarity with CMMS systems (SAP preferred) and data handling tools (Excel, Power BI, etc.).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication skills and stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Experience

  • A
  • B

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

title: Machine Learning Engineer 4
description:
About the Role

Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide.

In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring.

The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences.

  • Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning.

  • Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent).

  • Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs.

  • Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization.

  • Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI.

  • Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.

  • 8+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data collection to deployment and monitoring.

  • Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fraud detection, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.


Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.


Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

title: SHIPPING & CRATING WORKING LEAD
description:
Shipping & Crating Working Lead

Department: Shipping, Crating & Final Assembly Reports To: Shipping/Transportation Manager or Plant Manager Position Type: Full-Time, Hourly Schedule: Monday–Friday, with overtime, early starts, and occasional Saturdays as production and shipping schedules require

Position Summary

Custom Sign Center is seeking an experienced, hands-on Shipping & Crating Working Lead to coordinate daily shipping and crating activities while actively working alongside the department.

This position is responsible for building custom wood crates and pallets for finished signs and components, preparing shipping documents and labels, operating forklifts, and safely loading box trucks, dry-van trailers, and flatbed trailers.

The Working Lead must lead by example, organize the daily workload, train employees, hold the department accountable, and ensure every shipment is complete, properly protected, accurately labeled, and loaded onto the correct truck or carrier.

This is not a desk-only supervisory position. The Working Lead will spend most of the workday actively building crates, packaging products, operating equipment, and loading shipments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Leadership and Department Coordination

  • Review the daily and weekly shipping schedule and establish department priorities.
  • Assign work to shipping and crating employees based on shipment deadlines.
  • Work alongside the team while providing direction, training, and support.
  • Lead by example in productivity, quality, attendance, organization, and safe work practices.
  • Hold employees accountable for completing assigned work accurately and on time.
  • Train employees on proper crating, packaging, labeling, material handling, loading, and forklift procedures.
  • Monitor workload and communicate labor, material, equipment, or scheduling concerns to management.
  • Coordinate with production, project management, installation, and other departments when products, hardware, or paperwork are missing.
  • Ensure completed products are staged and organized according to shipping priority.
  • Help develop and maintain written SOPs for crating, packaging, labeling, loading, and shipping verification.

Custom Crating and Packaging

  • Review work orders, drawings, measurements, and finished products to determine the proper crate or pallet design.
  • Measure, cut, and assemble custom wood crates and pallets in different shapes and sizes.
  • Build crates and pallets capable of protecting signs, sign cabinets, channel letters, faces, poles, hardware, and other components during transportation.
  • Determine appropriate blocking, bracing, padding, foam, wrapping, banding, and securement methods.
  • Make efficient use of lumber, plywood, fasteners, packaging materials, and department labor.
  • Inspect finished products for visible damage before packaging.
  • Protect painted, printed, acrylic, polycarbonate, aluminum, and other finished surfaces from scratching, bending, rubbing, or impact damage.
  • Ensure all loose parts, hardware, installation components, and accessories are included and secured.
  • Clearly identify crate contents, job numbers, customer names, destinations, handling instructions, and crate orientation.
  • Verify that crates and pallets are properly constructed before they are moved or loaded.

Shipping Documentation and Labeling

  • Prepare and verify bills of lading, packing slips, shipping labels, crate labels, and other required shipping documentation.
  • Create UPS and FedEx shipping labels using the appropriate shipping software.
  • Verify customer name, delivery address, job number, number of pieces, carrier, shipment method, and special delivery instructions.
  • Confirm all items for the job have been pulled, packed, labeled, and staged before shipment.
  • Identify and clearly document any backordered or missing items.
  • Maintain organized shipping records and completed paperwork.
  • Communicate with carriers, drivers, and internal departments regarding pickup and loading requirements.
  • Report shipping damage, shortages, incorrect information, or carrier concerns immediately.

Loading and Material Handling

  • Safely load and unload box trucks, company trucks, dry-van trailers, flatbed trailers, and carrier vehicles.
  • Determine safe loading order, weight distribution, product orientation, blocking, bracing, and securement.
  • Use forklifts, pallet jacks, carts, dollies, straps, chains, blocking, and other material-handling equipment.
  • Ensure freight is loaded on the correct truck and positioned to prevent damage during transportation.
  • Assist drivers with locating, staging, and securing loads.
  • Perform portions of loading work outdoors in heat, cold, wind, rain, or snow.
  • Maintain clear staging areas, aisles, loading docks, and access to overhead doors.
  • Complete daily forklift inspections and report equipment problems immediately.

Tools and Equipment

The Working Lead must be able to safely operate and maintain:

  • Forklifts and pallet jacks
  • Chop saws and miter saws
  • Circular saws and other woodworking tools
  • Pneumatic nail guns and staplers
  • Cordless and corded screw guns
  • Drills, impact drivers, sanders, and hand tools
  • Banding, wrapping, and packaging equipment
  • Tape measures, squares, levels, and other measuring tools

Required Qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in shipping, industrial packaging, custom crating, woodworking, warehousing, manufacturing, or a related position preferred.
  • Previous lead-person or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Strong custom woodworking, crate-building, or pallet-building ability.
  • Ability to accurately read a tape measure and work from drawings, dimensions, work orders, or verbal instructions.
  • Experience preparing bills of lading, packing slips, freight labels, UPS labels, and FedEx labels.
  • Previous forklift experience; certification is preferred, or the ability to complete company forklift certification.
  • Ability to plan and organize multiple shipments with different deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly with job numbers, quantities, delivery addresses, and shipping documentation.
  • Ability to train employees, give clear instructions, and address performance concerns professionally.
  • Basic computer and data-entry skills.
  • Dependable attendance and willingness to work overtime when shipping deadlines require it.
  • Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

Physical and Work-Environment Requirements

  • Regularly lift and carry up to 50 pounds independently.
  • Team-lift or mechanically handle heavier and oversized products.
  • Stand and walk for most of the workday.
  • Frequently bend, reach, kneel, climb, push, pull, and work around large products.
  • Work around sawdust, wood products, pneumatic tools, forklifts, manufacturing noise, and moving equipment.
  • Work indoors and outdoors during loading operations in varying weather conditions.
  • Wear required PPE, including safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves when appropriate, and safety-toe footwear.
  • Follow all company safety procedures and equipment lockout requirements.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Shipments leaving complete and on schedule.
  • Accurate BOLs, labels, addresses, and shipping paperwork.
  • Reduction in freight damage and shipping errors.
  • No products loaded onto the wrong truck or sent to the wrong destination.
  • Proper use of lumber and packaging materials.
  • Employee productivity and accountability.
  • Safe forklift, tool, and loading practices.
  • Clean and organized shipping, crating, and staging areas.

Timely communication regarding missing parts, delays, damage, and backorders

title: Group Lead - DPQA
description:
To lead Drug Product Quality Assurance activities and provide strategic quality oversight for aseptic manufacturing operations, ensuring commercial and clinical drug product batches are manufactured, reviewed, and released in compliance with cGMP, global regulatory requirements, and internal quality standards. The incumbent shall be responsible for maintaining a state of control over manufacturing processes, sterility assurance programs, contamination control strategies, data integrity, inspection readiness, and quality systems while driving continuous improvement and fostering a strong quality culture across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

1. Manufacturing Quality Assurance

  • Provide QA oversight for Drug Product manufacturing operations, including aseptic processing, filling, visual inspection, and packaging activities.
  • Ensure compliance with cGMP, GDP, Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and regulatory requirements on the manufacturing shop floor.
  • Review and approve batch manufacturing records and support timely batch disposition and release.
  • Act as authorized QA representative for product disposition decisions.
  • Drive real-time quality oversight and escalation of critical compliance issues.

2. Batch Release & Product Disposition

  • Ensure all quality and GMP requirements are fulfilled prior to batch release.
  • Review deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, and impact assessments associated with product batches.
  • Support risk-based decision-making for batch release, rejection, reprocessing, or rework.
  • Review and approve market complaint investigations, recalls, and mock recall reports.

3. Validation & Qualification Oversight

  • Provide quality oversight for:
    • Process Validation
    • Cleaning Validation
    • Aseptic Process Simulation (Media Fills)
    • Equipment Qualification
    • Hold Time Studies
    • Continued Process Verification (CPV)
  • Ensure validated state is maintained throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Review and approve validation protocols, reports, and associated risk assessments.

4. Quality Systems Management

  • Lead timely closure of:
    • Deviations
    • Investigations
    • CAPAs
    • Change Controls
    • Quality Risk Assessments (QRM)
  • Review and approve SOPs, protocols, reports, product quality reviews, and GMP documentation.
  • Ensure effectiveness verification of CAPAs and continuous improvement initiatives.

5. Sterility Assurance & Contamination Control

  • Lead implementation and continuous improvement of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS).
  • Monitor aseptic practices, environmental monitoring trends, utilities, and cleanroom compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Annex 1, FDA, EMA, WHO, and other applicable regulatory expectations for sterile manufacturing.
  • Support investigations related to microbial contamination, environmental excursions, and objectionable organism recoveries.
  • Provide oversight for sterility assurance programs and contamination prevention activities.

6. Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness

  • Maintain a constant state of inspection readiness.
  • Lead and support regulatory inspections, customer audits, due diligence audits, and self-inspections.
  • Review audit observations and ensure timely implementation of remediation activities.
  • Support preparation of regulatory submissions and health authority responses.
  • Drive proactive compliance monitoring and risk mitigation across DP manufacturing operations.

7. Product Quality Review

  • Lead preparation, review, and approval of Annual Product Quality Reviews (APQR/PQR).
  • Ensure timely collection, analysis, and trending of quality metrics.
  • Present quality trends, compliance risks, and improvement opportunities to site leadership.

8. Vendor & External Manufacturing Oversight

  • Support supplier qualification, contractor qualification, and quality agreement management.
  • Review quality aspects of outsourced manufacturing, testing, and service activities.
  • Participate in supplier audits and ongoing performance monitoring.

9. Leadership & People Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the DPQA team.
  • Build a culture of quality, accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Manufacturing, QC, MSAT, Engineering, Validation, and Regulatory Affairs.
  • Support succession planning and capability development within the QA organization.

Educational Qualification

  • M.Pharm / B.Pharm / M.Sc. (Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences) or equivalent.
  • Advanced qualification or certification in Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, or Pharmaceutical Management is preferred.

Experience

  • 15-20 years of experience in Biopharmaceutical, Sterile Injectable, Vaccine, or Aseptic Manufacturing environments.
  • Minimum 5 years of leadership experience in Drug Product Quality Assurance or Manufacturing Quality Assurance.
  • Hands-on experience supporting global regulatory inspections including USFDA, EMA, MHRA, ANVISA, PMDA, Health Canada, or equivalent agencies.
  • Strong experience in aseptic processing, contamination control strategy, sterility assurance, validation, and batch disposition.

Technical Competencies

  • cGMP and Global Regulatory Requirements
  • Data Integrity and Quality Systems
  • Aseptic Processing and Annex 1 Compliance
  • Sterility Assurance Programs
  • Contamination Control Strategy (CCS)
  • Process and Cleaning Validation
  • Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, and QRM
  • Product Quality Review (APQR/PQR)
  • Regulatory Inspection Management
  • Root Cause Investigation and Risk Assessment

Leadership Competencies

  • Strong quality and compliance mindset
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen
  • Critical decision-making and risk-based judgment
  • Team leadership and people development
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Effective communication and coaching capabilities
  • Strong drive for inspection readiness and operational excellence

Educational Qualification

  • M.Pharm / B.Pharm / M.Sc. (Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences) or equivalent.
  • Advanced qualification or certification in Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, or Pharmaceutical Management is preferred.

We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. title: Game Engineer (Tech Pod)
description:
Game Engineer - Tech Pod

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer for our Tech Pod to make sure the game and the technology behind it keeps running.

As a Game Engineer - Tech Pod, you’ll work closely with engineers and other disciplines to develop the systems, integrations, and technical foundations behind Subway Surfers. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve the game, its technology, and the way we build it.

Nothing’s worse than playing an unstable game. If unstable gaming annoys you, make you'll take enjoyment in making stable games for others. More below!

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain systems, platform capabilities, and SDK integrations that enable us to deliver new features and content for Subway Surfers using Unity, C#, and native code

  • Collaborate with other Engineers to take technical solutions from concept through implementation and release

  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase

  • Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality

  • Debug and resolve issues across Unity, native platform code, backend integrations, and live systems

  • Integrate Subway Surfers with SYBO's platform and backend services, bringing shared platform capabilities into the game

  • Integrate and maintain third-party SDKs and services across iOS and Android

  • Contribute to improving our CI/CD pipelines, tools, workflows, and development practices, including Jenkins

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner and other Engineers in the Tech Pod, familiarize yourself with the codebase, development and release pipelines, platform integrations, and key technical systems, and start making your first contributions.

In your first three months, you’ll be contributing independently to systems and integrations and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll work with both SYBO platform services and third-party SDKs, participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture, and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers technology stack.

In your first twelve months, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to technical systems and integrations from planning through release. You’ll help shape solutions across the game, platform integrations, and development pipeline that allow us to reliably deliver Subway Surfers to hundreds of millions of players.

Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#

  • Solid experience developing games in Unity, ideally for mobile

  • Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns

  • Experience writing native code for iOS and Android

  • Experience working with version control systems such as Git

  • Experience integrating client applications with backend services and APIs

  • Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

  • Experience with mobile build and release processes for the App Store and Google Play

  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins

About SYBO

We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Warehouse Supervisor - Days
description:
The Role:

As a Supervisor within our warehouse, you'll be responsible for leading and developing Warehouse Operatives and Trainee Supervisors, providing coaching, performance management, and support to achieve operational goals. Working closely with the Section Manager and wider Warehouse Leadership team, the position focuses on delivering key performance metrics, ensuring customer demand is met on time and in full, maintaining the highest safety standards, managing labour planning, addressing performance gaps with clear action plans, and supporting culture change initiatives to improve engagement and reduce turnover.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Direct line management and coaching of Warehouse Operatives / Trainee Supervisors including 1:1's to discuss performance vs expectation, identifying SMART goals when performance not met in any of the key functional areas within responsibility
  • Working with the Section Manager for your department to monitor delivery to plan and key areas for your shift improve
  • Driving performance on key metrics ensuring an efficient warehouse operation which can fulfill customer web and store demand on time and in full
  • Driving the highest standards of safety on site, working with the Safety team to ensure adherence to all safety routines/procedures (e.g. Floor Safety Inspections, Hazard Spotting, Safety Gembas, Risk Assessments, Audits)
  • Reviewing weekly labour plan to ensure cover is adequate, sharing with Section Manager, highlighting issues/feedback.
  • Providing detail when daily/weekly targets are not met and creating plan to bridge
  • Alongside the Warehouse Leadership team, you'll partner with other key stakeholders to ensure all strategic activity is on track and supported
  • Supporting the successful implementation of culture change and turnover reduction
  • Experience in Warehousing, Logistics or Supply Chain
  • High potential for people and change management
  • Good systems skills
  • Customer focused approach to operational management
  • Resilient, flexible and approachable
  • Problem solving ability in a fast paced business

Along with your benefits package we also offer a wide range of perks for our colleagues:

Frasers Champion- Our employees are at the heart of our business and we ensure individuals are recognised every single month for their hard work. Frasers Champion is a peer nominated scheme where 8 winners will receive double their pay for a month where they have lived the Frasers Group values.

Retail Reconnect – In order to build the planets most admired and compelling brand ecosystem, all employees must understand our business, product and customers. Each financial year, head office employees will gain insights by spending one to two days in one of our stores or the warehouse. The goal is to learn how the work you do impacts our teams on the frontline, and to bring ideas back to the office which will improve how we work.

Fearless 1200 – Fearless 1200 is our way of recognising our growth. It’s bold, ambitious, and designed to reward colleagues across the business for living our values and delivering impact. Fearless 1200 links how we perform to how we're rewarded – check out the video link to find out more -

Employee Welfare

Frasers Fit – Our Everlast Gyms Team are on a mission to make our workforce the best, and fittest on the planet! We run free gym classes for employees as well as discounted memberships to our clubs. Frasers Fit is our wellbeing programme which aims to support and improve colleagues Physical, Financial & Mental wellbeing. The app is accessible for every employee and includes training, nutrition and lifestyle advice- all completely free.

Retail Trust – We know that its not just about physical health, mental wellness is equally important which is why all of our employees get free access and support from the Retail Trust charity. This includes a 24 hour wellbeing helpline, wellness hub, counselling and financial/legal support.

What’s next?

Our Recruitment Team will be reviewing applications and all candidates will receive a response, whether you are successful or unsuccessful. Shortlisted applicants may be asked to confirm a few key details before being booked in for a first stage interview with the Recruiter - this will be behaviourally focussed and centred around how you align with our Culture and Values. If successful we anticipate one or two further interview stages with the Hiring Manager/wider team which will be more technically focussed and could include a presentation/task so we can see your skills in action.
