title: SNAP Boys Youth Clubs Facilitator
description:
August 26, 2026

Who we are

As the need for mental health services grows, Child Development Institute (CDI) continues to be the steadfast support and leading provider of specialized mental health services for children and youth aged 0-18 and their families. All of our services are guided by a strength-based approach that incorporates the family and the community into the journey of supporting children and youth.

Trusted with the mental well-being of our community's most sensitive members, infants and children, all of our programming is backed by rigorous research. Science is the backbone which informs our work as we evolve alongside the needs of our community.

We are committed to providing services that are respectful of racial, cultural, religious, ethnic and linguistic diversity, as well as sexual orientation, age, gender and family differences. All our services are delivered by a deeply caring and compassionate team that guides children, youth and families along a mental health journey in a safe, respectful and welcoming space.

Who we need
CDI is seeking a knowledgeable and competent Casual SNAP Boys Youth Clubs Facilitator to join the SNAP Boys Youth Clubs from October 1, 2026 to June 18, 2027.

The SNAP Boys Youth Clubs Facilitator is an integral part of the SNAP Boys Youth Clubs. The SNAP Boys Youth Clubs Facilitator is responsible for facilitating one of the two weekly SNAP Boys Youth Clubs which serve a diverse group, many of whom are racialized youth. This group component, which corresponds with the school year schedule, utilizes the SNAP Framework to address various challenges youth experience at home, school, or in the community. The focus is on providing a positive, therapeutic environment to explore youth related issues, practice SNAP skills and social skills, develop prosocial future oriented plans, attain life skills, and have access to caring adults with whom they can connect and mentor.

This is a non-bargaining, casual contract position that requires flexible evening availability. Working hours will range from 5 to 10 hours per week, based on operational needs.

What the role is all about...
  1. Accepting and working within the Institute’s stated vision, mission, values and goals, the SNAP Boys Youth Clubs Facilitator reports directly to the SNAP Boys Youth Leadership Services Coordinator.
  2. Assists in developing and implementing weekly Youth Leadership Clubs for SNAP Boys Youth Leadership Services participants 11-18 years of age, supporting youth to develop confidence, leadership and social skills.
  3. Lead Facilitator in one of the two weekly SNAP Boys Youth Clubs from 4:00pm to 7:30pm.
  4. Regularly communicates with families and contacts youth’s parents/caregivers on a weekly basis to provide progress updates.
  5. Facilitates assignment, coaches and supports youth in leadership roles at CDI and works to enhance healthy personal development and employment/volunteer skills of youth in those positions.
  6. Accompanies youth on field trips and outings in the community.
  7. Works collaboratively with staff, volunteers, parents, and participants to ensure youth have a safe and fun educational experience.
  8. Supervises and facilitates activities in a manner that ensures safety and inclusion of all participants.
  9. Problem solves issues pertaining to positive growth and development (i.e. personal interactions and behaviour, interpersonal conflicts, application of good judgement and conflict resolution skills, etc.)
  10. Completes documentation in a timely manner (i.e. program plans, program reports and evaluations, incident and serious occurrence reports, etc.).
  11. Maintains positive professional relationships with youth, campers, parents, staff, community members and other Child Development Institute patrons and visitors.
  12. Adheres to the Child Development Institute’s Policies and Procedures and maintains a safe and healthy working environment.
  13. Performs other assigned duties in the interests of the organization.
What we hope you will bring…
  • A University or College Diploma, preferably in Child and Youth Work, or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of progressive experience in child and youth work.
  • Proficient with MS Office Suite.
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication and influencing skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask, probe, analyze and problem solve issues.
  • Be a dedicated and flexible team player able to interact with team members and colleagues at all levels of the organization.
  • Personal connection to and experience with diverse backgrounds and racialized groups is an asset

Other Requirements

  • All applicants are advised that offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a Vulnerable Sector Check.
  • Credential verifications & References required.

Mental Effort

  • Mental effort required in multi-tasking and handling interruptions that require constant refocusing.
  • Mental flexibility required to lead a group program with a number of components (briefing, meet & greet, dinner, interactive, group, goodnight, documentation, debriefing) requiring ability to support and adapt to client and team needs
  • Manage crisis situations, as needed following agency policies, child welfare and health and safety standards

Physical Effort

  • Standing and moving for the majority of the shift
  • Lifting or moving up to 20lbs may be required

Working Conditions

  • Governed by concurrent and dynamic deadlines, despite conflicting priorities and frequent interruptions.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate but may be elevated at times.
  • Fast paced and work environment that requires flexibility and adaptation.
  • Frequent handling of queries and calls from youth, colleagues, and managers.

Type of supervision and/or Assistance Given

Provides support, guidance, informal training or instruction to co workers, volunteers and students.

Compensation
$25 per hour.

Apply now

If you're excited about this role but your experience aligns differently with every requirement, we encourage you to apply. While specific qualifications are strictly required, others can be based on various experiences, backgrounds, and knowledge. We can't promise an interview, but we will consider your whole application. We thank all interested parties but only those selected for an interview will be contacted

CDI is firmly committed to diversity within its community and welcomes applications from racialized persons/persons of colour, Indigenous People of North America and the world, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ persons, and those who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas. We are committed to providing equitable opportunities in employment and to providing a workplace which is free from discrimination and harassment. We are equally committed to providing an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations, please reach out to us at careers@childdevelop.ca

title: Merchandising Part Time Days
description:
Your Impact at Lowe's

As a Lowe's Merchandising Services Associate, you are a key connection point between Merchandising and Store Operations, allowing us to deliver a great shopping experience in every Lowe's store. If you want to build eye-catching displays and implement strategies that showcase in-demand products, you'll enjoy working with our Merchandising Services Team.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Keep your weekends free with a set weekday schedule. *
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.
For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

*Live Nursery MST Associates may be required to work weekend shifts.

Your Day at Lowe's

As a Merchandising Services Associate, you ensure our store's signage, pricing information, and displays are accurate so merchandise is easy to locate. You create product displays that are safe, clean, visually appealing, and easy for customers to access.

While most of your time will be spent on activities that don't involve customer interaction, you may be expected to engage with customers when the opportunity arises. You'll be expected to listen to customers and answer questions, communicate product or warranty information, and assist in locating or handling merchandise.

Key Responsibilities
  • Complete merchandising resets and service-related projects according to Lowe's specifications and provide proof of completion for assigned tasks
  • Verify buyback items and ensure they are pulled, prepped, and ready for shipping
  • Update/validate wayfinding and product location signage, as well as digital maintenance of this information throughout the store
  • Confirm product pricing information is clearly visible and replace any missing price labels
  • Help drive add-on sales by staging clearance products, sorting products in proper locations, and ensuring displays are placed appropriately throughout the store
  • Repair/replace damaged or missing items, including signage, merchandise and displays.
  • Communicate project priorities, schedule, and needs with Merchandising Services Team and Manager
  • Analyze metrics and provide feedback on project execution and in-store service to store, market, and corporate leaders
  • Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications
  • Read, write, and perform basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction)
  • Ability to hear, listen, and to communicate verbally with others
  • Utilize web-based computer programs to accomplish assigned tasks
  • Ability to sit and stand for long periods of time
  • Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without accommodation

Preferred Qualifications
  • Lowe's sales floor experience
  • Experience performing product merchandising tasks, including reading planograms and setting up and tearing down displays.
  • Experience operating power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • Working knowledge of essential tools (e.g., hand tools, drills, saws, etc.)

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

title: Legal Asst & Governance Coord
description:
A Day in the Life

  • Provide comprehensive legal and administrative support to the Chief Legal Officer and Assistant General Counsel, ensuring projects, assignments, and legal matters are completed accurately, confidentially, and on time.
  • Draft, review, coordinate, and manage a high volume of contracts, legal documents, correspondence, and corporate records while maintaining compliance with organizational standards and legal requirements.
  • Administer and maintain legal department systems and processes, including contract management software, DocuSign, document retention, records management, and tracking of key deadlines and approvals.
  • Coordinate board, governance, and committee activities by managing meeting logistics, preparing agendas and materials, recording minutes, maintaining governance records, and supporting board nomination and survey processes.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for subpoenas, guardianships, and other legal inquiries, facilitating communication among healthcare staff, courts, outside counsel, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Manage departmental operations, including invoice processing, vendor payments, correspondence management, attorney scheduling, and support for healthcare advocacy, compliance, and governance initiatives across the organization.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in a legal support role, with demonstrated expertise in corporate, real estate, and/or litigation matters.
  • Legal Assistant or Paralegal degree and/or certificate preferred.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook (required), Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Lexis, and internet-based legal research tools.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain a high level of accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong customer service, and professional correspondence.

title: People and Office Coordinator
description:
ABOUT US
Ancient + Brave is a female founded, mission-driven wellness brand with an award-winning range of collagen, supplements and functional blends. Rooted in ancient wisdom and validated by science, our simple daily rituals support our community in nurturing whole body health.

Ancient + Brave has been recognised in The Sunday Times 100 fastest-growing private companies for three consecutive years - most recently placing 7th - and ranked 4th in the Oresa Retail Growth Index in 2025. It's a reflection of the quality of what we build, the community we serve, and the discipline with which we operate.

Social and environmental responsibility has always been at the heart of the business and woven into how we operate. We're a certified B Corp, a member of 1% for the Planet, and through the Made By Brave Foundation we direct 1%+ of all revenue to environmental and social causes.

As an equal-opportunity employer we are committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace culture, where we are brave, connected and intentional - and lead with integrity. Please find out more by reading our JEDI statement which can be found here.

We operate from beautiful head offices overlooking the river Ouse in Lewes, East Sussex.


THE ROLE


We are seeking a warm, brilliantly organised People & Office Coordinator to be the friendly face of Ancient + Brave and the engine room behind our People Team. This is a genuinely varied role, one moment you're making a new starter feel welcome on their first day, the next you're sorting a supplier query so the office runs without a hitch or helping our team update our monthly payroll.

You will sit within the People & Talent team, working closely with the Head of People and People Manager, People Ops & Talent Lead and our Executive Assistant to keep the employee experience seamless from offer to leaver, while also owning the day-to-day running of our Head Office – from health & safety to helping keep the place looking and feeling brilliant.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone early in their People or office management career who wants broad exposure across the employee life cycle, plus the satisfaction of running a workplace people genuinely love coming into.

This role is based full-time in our Lewes Head Office, with occasional possible travel to our Unit/Warehouse in Barcombe Mills.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Reporting to the Head of People initially you will be responsible for the following:

People & Employee Life Cycle Support

  • Support recruitment administration, including scheduling interviews, coordinating candidate communications and screening where necessary.

  • Work alongside our flexible recruitment partner, who provides extra hiring support as needed.

  • Lead on onboarding end-to-end including preparing offer paperwork and contracts, setting up new starters on our HRIS (Humaans), and ensuring from day one our employees have a warm welcome.

  • Liaising with our external IT provider to ensure new starters are set up with the necessary equipment.

  • Coordinate probation review reminders, right-to-work checks and reference requests, keeping records accurate and audit-ready.

  • Support the leaver process, exit paperwork, equipment returns and HRIS updates ensuring everything is handled with care and consistency.

  • Help maintain the Company Shared Sites such as the HRIS and G-Drive, keeping policies and key information accurate and easy to find.

First Line People Queries

  • Be a friendly first point of contact for everyday people questions from across the team – holidays, benefits, policies.

  • Triage queries and resolve the straightforward ones; escalate anything more complex to the relevant member of the People Team with a clear handover.

Office Management (with dotted line to Executive Assistant who leads in this area)

  • Supporting the day-to-day running of our Lewes Head Office, including ordering supplies, kit, deliveries, and keeping the space looking and feeling brilliantly on-brand.

  • Be the main point of contact for cleaners and office suppliers, resolving issues quickly.

  • Act as our office health & safety point of contact, arranging fire drills, first aid supplies, DSE assessments, helping keep us safe and compliant.

  • In EA’s absence supporting diary management for Founder and SLT.

  • Manage meeting room bookings and make sure the office is guest-ready for visitors, candidates and clients.

  • Main point of contact with our outsourced IT provider for all day to day enquiries.

Culture & Events

  • Plan and deliver team socials and wellbeing moments that bring our Ancient + Brave culture to life.

  • Support the Executive Assistant with the organisation and delivery of team gatherings throughout the year.

  • Support the People Team with internal comms and any all-team meetings or off-sites, logistics, catering, room setup etc.

Payroll, Compliance & Records

  • Keep employee records, contracts and policies accurate, complete and compliant.

  • Help the People team manage the administration behind our monthly payroll.

  • Support any audit activities with the right paper trail.

WHO YOU ARE

To be successful in this role, you will need the following skills / knowledge / experience

  • Experience in an office management, People/HR administration or coordinator role, ideally in a fast-growing or multi-site business.

  • Brilliantly organised, with a genuine love of ticking things off a list and keeping everything running smoothly.

  • Confident with systems (an HRIS or similar) and comfortable picking up new tools quickly.

  • Curious as to AI use and implementation and how we can use it responsibly to enhance the employee experience.

  • A warm, can-do communication style; people feel comfortable asking you anything, from a holiday query to a leaking tap.

  • Calm under pressure and happy juggling several things at once – from onboarding paperwork to an office supplier query.

  • Genuinely interested in developing a career in people and culture, with an eye for the small details that make a workplace feel special.

Further, to truly thrive at Ancient + Brave you will need to embody the spirit of our brand and align with our company culture. For us that is a series of shared beliefs:

WE BELIEVE IN BRAVERY — We are: Courageous, Bold, Experimental

WE BELIEVE IN INTEGRITY — We are: Honest, Accountable, Ethical

WE BELIEVE IN CONNECTION — We are: Collaborative, Inclusive, Open

WE BELIEVE IN INTENTION — We are: Purposeful, Proactive, Focused

WAYS OF WORKING

title: Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist till VB Energi
description:
Brinner du för att arbeta med miljö- och hållbarhet och vill vara med oss på resan mot en hållbar framtid? Just nu söker vi på VB Energi dig som vill kliva in i rollen som vår Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist på vårt huvudkontor i Ludvika.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en bred roll nära verksamheten, du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt tillsammans med chefer och övriga kollegor.

Vi letar efter dig som har djup kompetens inom miljö- och tillståndsfrågor och självständigt kan driva och företräda koncernen i dessa frågor, men även dig som trivs med att dela med dig av din kunskap för att utbilda och vidareutveckla vårt miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete.

Om rollen som Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist

I rollen som vår Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist kommer du arbeta brett med frågorna och du är den enda inom koncernen med denna expertis. Du arbetar nära arbetsmiljöspecialist, kvalitetsingenjör, chefer och övriga kollegor. Du sitter i staben och rapporterar direkt till VB Energis VD.

Du ansvarar för tillståndsfrågor, miljörapportering och tillsynsbesök. Du stöttar även personalen vid tolkning och utveckling av kontrollprogram samt målstyrning mot miljö och hållbarhet. Du bidrar med din kunskap i projekt och du håller dig uppdaterad kring gällande lagstiftning.

VB Energi har både elnät-, fjärrvärme- och entreprenadverksamhet, och du får kliva in och stötta inom alla verksamhetsområdena. I rollen kommer du även ha ansvar för att driva och samordna arbetet för vårt lokala vattenkraftbolag genom omprövningsprocessen inom den Nationella planen – från planering och utredning, via samverkan och myndighetsdialog, till framtagande och inlämning av ansökan om moderna miljövillkor till Mark- och miljödomstolen.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att innehålla:

  • Miljörapportering, tillståndshantering och myndighetsdialoger
  • Delta i samråd
  • Utbildning av kollegor
  • Utveckla koncernens miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete
  • Utredningar och utvecklingsprojekt
  • Säkerställa att ledningssystemet kopplat till miljö är uppdaterat
  • Administrera och dokumentera miljöarbete i enlighet med ISO 14001
  • Utveckling av vår kemikaliehantering i Ichemistry
  • Avvikelsehantering i ENIA
  • Utveckla och följa upp verksamhetens Egenkontrollprogram
  • Utveckla, och följa upp verksamhetens avfallshantering inkl farligt avfall och farligt gods
  • Utveckla, planera, genomföra och följa upp intern och externa revisoner

Du kommer att tillhöra en arbetsplats som präglas av engagemang, samarbete och öppenhet. Organisationen är liten och familjär, vilket skapar en stark gemenskap och högt i tak. Vi stöttar varandra och erbjuder en varierande vardag. Hos oss finns det goda möjligheter till utveckling och utbildning.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har minst fem års erfarenhet av brett och självständigt miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete. Du behöver kunna växla mellan praktiskt och administrativt arbete, och du behöver vara trygg i dig själv samt kunna prioritera det som är viktigast. Vidare är du noggrann och kommunikativ.

Vidare har du:

  • Arbetslivserfarenhet från miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete, gärna från energibranschen
  • Högskoleutbildning eller KY-utbildning inom miljö- och hållbarhet
  • Flytande svenska, i både tal och skrift, samt god förståelse för engelska krävs
  • God dator- och systemvana är ett krav då en stor del av arbetet görs i olika IT-system
  • Erfarenhet av ledningssystem, Internkontrollprogram och internrevision
  • Erfarenhet av miljö- och tillståndsprocesser, gärna inom fjärrvärme, elnät eller vattenkraft
  • Erfarenhet av dialog och samverkan med Länsstyrelsen, andra myndigheter, kommuner och övriga berörda aktörer
  • God förmåga att självständigt driva processer framåt, hålla ihop tidplaner och säkerställa att rätt underlag tas fram i rätt tid
  • God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att skapa förtroende och goda relationer med olika intressenter

Vi erbjuder

En möjlighet till att jobba i ett lokalt energibolag som arbetar tillsammans för en säker och stabil drift och därmed bidrar till att våra kunder får leverans av miljövänlig energi. Du får en varierande vardag med utmanande arbetsuppgifter, möjligheten att utveckla både dig själv och verksamheten genom att delta i olika projekt och arbeta med förbättringsåtgärder.

Det är viktigt att hela livet fungerar och därför är vi måna om att våra medarbetare upplever en god balans mellan arbete och fritid.

Placeringsort: Ludvika

För mer information om själva tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Johanna Walterson, johanna.walterson@vbenergi.se. . För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta rekryterare Kajsa Loman, kajsa.loman@vattenfall.com.

Fackliga representanter är Torbjörn Jonsson Unionen, Mikael Boström Sveriges Ingenjörer och Pertti Palonto SEKO. Du når dem genom växeln på 0240-876 00.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 18 september 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV.

Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. VB Elnät arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Warehouse Part Time Days
description:
Your Impact at Lowe’s

As a Receiver/Stocker, you help keep the store clean, safe, and ready for customers by accurately receiving freight, stocking shelves, and organizing merchandise and top stock. You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe’s is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe’s associate, you’ll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

Your Day at Lowe’s

You’ll keep shelves stocked and backrooms organized by unloading freight, moving products to the sales floor, and maintaining a clean, safe workspace. You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

Key Responsibilities

title: Excavator Operator
description:

Slave Lake, Alberta | Full-Time
Heavy Equipment Operation / Earthworks | Experienced | Day Shift
Hiring now. Qualified operators are being interviewed this week.
GrizzlyTrek is hiring excavator operators out of Slave Lake for lease construction, access roads and civil earthworks. The rate is $29.00 to $40.00 an hour based on experience, full time, with work booked through the season. Verifiable seat time on a hoe is what gets you the interview.

LocationSlave Lake, Alberta and surrounding area

OvertimeAvailable based on operational requirements
EquipmentExcavator. Time on dozer, loader or grader is an asset.
ExperienceVerifiable seat time on excavator in civil, oilfield or forestry construction
CertificationClass 5 licence, CSTS or equivalent, Ground Disturbance, H2S Alive, First Aid
ResidencyLocal to the Slave Lake area
StartImmediate
The Work
Work runs out of Slave Lake and across the Lesser Slave Lake region. Close in it is site prep and civil earthworks: stripping topsoil, cut and fill, trench and backfill, building pads, roads and parking areas, and grading to stakes. Out of town it is lease construction, access roads and reclamation, so some days start early and run long. Crews mobilize from Slave Lake and most days you are home at night.
What You'll Do
  • Run excavator on lease construction, access roads, site prep and civil earthworks
  • Strip topsoil, move cut and fill, and build pads, roads and parking areas to grade
  • Dig, slope and backfill trench for underground utilities and pipe
  • Work to grade stakes, laser and GPS machine control
  • Complete daily walkarounds, pre-trip inspections and greasing before the machine moves
  • Spot for ground crews, load trucks, and keep ground disturbance clear of buried facilities
  • Take part in pre-job safety meetings, hazard assessments and toolbox talks
What You Bring
  • Verifiable seat time on excavator in civil, oilfield or forestry construction
  • Ability to read grade stakes and hold elevation without someone standing over you
  • Valid Class 5 licence and reliable transportation to sites around Slave Lake
  • Common site tickets: CSTS or equivalent, Ground Disturbance, H2S Alive and First Aid
  • Able to pass a pre-employment drug and alcohol test and work outdoors through the season
  • Living in the Slave Lake area and comfortable working around ground crews and buried facilities
Nice to Have
  • Time on dozer, loader or grader as a second seat
  • GPS machine control experience (Trimble or Topcon)
  • Class 1 or Class 3 licence for equipment moves and float work
Why Operators Take This Job
The range is posted at $29.00 to $40.00 and where you land in it comes down to your seat time, not a number talked down after the interview. The work is booked through the season, so you are not running one job for three weeks and then calling around again. Sites are in and around Slave Lake, so you are home most nights and your money is not going to rooms and meals. Overtime is there through the busy season for anyone who wants the hours.
Pay is a gross hourly rate before deductions.
What We Offer
  • $29.00 to $40.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications
  • Overtime available based on operational requirements
  • Life insurance plus AD&D with critical illness and cancer coverage
  • Extended health: drugs, hospital, vision, and paramedical including mental health
  • Dental coverage, including orthodontic coverage for children

description:
Job Type: Full-time | Location: Childress, Texas | Department: Construction | Reporting to: Associate Director, Construction | Work Location: #onsite

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

The Construction Supervisor – Electrical offers an opportunity to elevate your electrical career while working on some of the most technically advanced, mission-critical data center projects in the industry. In this hands-on leadership role, you will oversee electrical construction activities involving medium-voltage systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), and critical power distribution infrastructure that supports high-performance computing environments. You will lead field crews, coordinate across trades, and ensure all work is executed safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with NEC and project requirements. If you are an experienced electrical professional ready to expand your leadership responsibilities and take on complex technical challenges in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, this role places you at the forefront of sustainable, high-performance infrastructure development.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain a safe working environment by administering and adhering to company safety protocols and OSHA requirements.
  • Delegate and perform work based on blueprints, charts, tables, work orders, and verbal instructions; organize assigned tasks from start to finish.
  • Supervise all activities of electricians and apprentices to ensure quality and efficiency.
  • Diagnose and repair electrical issues by installing or replacing wiring, devices, and components in a timely and effective manner.
  • Conduct routine jobsite inspections and evaluate the performance of the electrical team.
  • Communicate clearly with other trades, team members, subcontractors, and customers regarding job progress, needs, and concerns.

Requirements

  • Journeyman Electrician License
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical construction, with proven experience working on medium voltage systems, switchgears, and motor control centers (MCCs).
  • Strong ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, mechanical plans, and blueprints.
  • Exceptional supervisory and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with managers, peers, customers, and subcontractors.
  • Proficient in applying local electrical codes and the National Electrical Code (NEC).
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and reporting.
  • Valid state driver’s license required.

Other important requirements:

  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
  • Must provide own steel-toed work boots; other PPE will be supplied.
  • Must be able to reliably commute to the work site daily or have plans to relocate before starting work.
  • Must be comfortable working a rotational schedule, which includes day and night shifts as well as weekend work, based on project needs.
  • Employees working night shifts will receive a 15% premium added to their hourly rate only for hours worked during night shifts.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a comprehensive, market-competitive total rewards package designed to support employees’ well-being, career advancement, and financial wealth. Our offerings reflect our commitment to Proceed with Purpose while rewarding high performance and long-term growth.

Compensation
  • The expected hourly range for this role is $59.00 USD.
    • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications.
  • Per Diem amount of $155.00 and project allowance, when applicable
  • 15% night-shift premium for eligible roles, when applicable
  • Overtime compensation for non-exempt workers for hours worked over 40 per week
  • Relocation and Living-out-allowance (as applicable and based on successful candidate circumstances)

Health & Wellness

  • 100% company paid health insurance premiums (medical, dental, and vision) for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High-Deductible Health Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources

Retirement & Financial Wealth

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid professional development and access to financial planning and legal services

Time Off & Leave Programs

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays

Growth & Development

  • Professional development to support certifications, continuing education, or role related training

Community & Culture

  • Company events and team-building activities

We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

IE US Operations Inc., the employing entity and proud member of the IREN group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We are committed to evaluating qualified applicants and do not discriminate against protected characteristics under applicable legislation.

title: SIGINT Technical Analyst 2 *Multiple Positions*
description:
SIGINT Technical Analyst L2 *Multiple Positions*

Location: Ft. Gordon, GA | Onsite Clearance Required: TS/SCI with Polygraph Employment Type: Full-Time Salary Range: $162,900-$175,000

Join a Growing Team at Weeghman & Briggs

Weeghman & Briggs is seeking a motivated and mission-driven SIGINT Technical Analyst L2 to support critical government initiatives in Ft. Gordon, GA.

Founded in 2016 by Anthony Jordan, Weeghman & Briggs specializes in delivering high-impact analytical services to Government Agencies and private organizations. Since our founding, we have partnered with a range of federal entities and private corporations, earning a strong reputation as a trusted, results-driven company with an exceptional team of professionals.

As we continue to expand across current programs and upcoming contract awards, we are looking for talented individuals who want to contribute, grow, and build something meaningful alongside us.

At Weeghman & Briggs, you're more than a number, you're part of the team. We've built a culture where your opinion matters, your voice is heard, and your contributions make a direct impact on mission success. Our growth creates opportunity for advancement, leadership visibility, and long-term career development while maintaining the supportive, close-knit environment that sets us apart.

If you're ready to grow your career while supporting important national missions, we'd love to connect with you.

What You'll Do

  • Support mission-critical programs in secure government environments
  • Analyze requirements and translate them into actionable solutions
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality results
  • Ensure compliance with contract and security standards
  • Contribute ideas to improve processes, efficiency, and performance
  • Operate SIGINT collection and collection management equipment in accordance with user and position manuals.
  • Support Mission Management and Collection Management activities.
  • Support the implementation of collection-tasking strategies.
  • Provide operational assistance to users during upgrades/installation of new collection systems
  • Participate in discussions with Offices of Primary Concern (OPC) and customers to promote dissemination of accurate collection assessments.
  • Respond to collection requirements received from Data Orchestration Services.
  • Support the review of collection priorities submitted by the Information and Intelligence Analysis organization.
  • Gather collection related statistics and document operational activities in daily logs and collection summaries.
  • Optimize collection activities in accordance with standard operating procedures and government guidance.
  • Operate, demonstrate, and provide informal training on current or prototype intelligence systems, either deployed or in test.
  • Provide technical assistance necessary to meet collection-tasking strategies.
  • Conduct discussions between various TOPIs and other customers ensuring accurate collection assessments are received/shared.
  • Participate in the review and validation of collection priorities submitted by Information and Intelligence Analysis.
  • Support technical development of junior personnel in the area of SIGINT analytical tradecraft.
  • Provide technical direction and technical support for the development of training.
  • Collect, compile, and prepare drafts of information related to characteristics of signals based on Government identification of signals.
  • Conduct and document all-source research to identify the communications used by targets of interest.
  • Provide collection summary reports, statistics, and metrics via formal and informal communications.
  • Maintain knowledge of site capabilities to include end-to-end data flow to help recognize and define collection problems.

What You Bring

  • Active TS/SCI with Polygraph
  • Experience supporting government or DoD programs
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Fourteen (14) years of professional experience supporting a military and/or government cryptologic mission. Professional experience may include mission support as a military or government collector, language or Signal Analyst as it relates to acquiring, identifying, processing, and reporting on electromagnetic emissions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications (Security+, CISSP, PMP, AWS, etc.)
  • Agile, cloud, or modernization experience
  • Background in process improvement or analytical services

Compensation & Benefits

The projected salary range for this position is $162,900-$175,000, dependent upon experience, qualifications, and contract requirements.

At Weeghman & Briggs, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally.

Learn more about our comprehensive benefits here: 👉

Equal Employment Opportunity

Weeghman & Briggs is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Static Equipment Leader Egypt
description:
ISS International S.p.A. is looking for a Static Equipment Lead for an Oil & Gas Engineering Project based in New Cairo, Egypt.

The selected candidate will be responsible for leading and coordinating technical activities related to static equipment, including pressure vessels, columns, heat exchangers, tanks and related packages.

The role will involve engineering review, technical coordination, vendor documentation and support to project/site activities, in accordance with applicable international codes and standards.

The position is mainly office-based in New Cairo, with short-term missions to onshore and offshore sites in Egypt and abroad.

Here below you can find the main details:

  • Position: Static Equipment Lead;

  • Location: New Cairo, Egypt + missions to sites in Egypt and abroad;

  • Expected Starting Date: ASAP – candidates with approximately 2 weeks' notice can be considered;

  • Duration: until 30/06/2027, liable to extension until 31/12/2027;

  • Working Schedule
    New Cairo: 8 hours/day, 5 days/week;
    Onshore Missions: 10 hours/day, 6 days/week;
    Offshore Missions: 12 hours/day, 7 days/week;

  • Rotation: N/A – Resident position;

  • Foreseen Missions: approximately 30 days in Egypt and 60 days abroad during the assignment;

  • Contract: Consultant Agreement with ISS International S.p.A., Rome, Italy.

BOSIET certification is required for offshore activities. Candidates who do not currently hold a valid BOSIET must be willing to obtain it; the related documented expenses will be reimbursed by ISS International S.p.A.

Candidates should have solid experience in Static Equipment Engineering within Oil & Gas / EPC projects, preferably covering both engineering activities and technical support to construction, commissioning and/or operating facilities.

title: Senior Construction Project Manager
description:
Turner & Townsend Heery is seeking a Senior Construction Project Manager focused on public sector construction projects in Tri Cities Washington.

The Senior Project Manager will monitor construction projects for clients, with direct accountability for project delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct periodic site visits to monitor the progress of construction.
  • Review status of work completed during the period covered.
  • Review that work is generally proceeding in a good and workmanlike manner and in general accordance with the approved drawings and specifications.
  • Review contractors' direct cost payment requisitions and budget status.
  • Review of subcontracts, bonds/subcontractor default insurance.
  • Review of change orders.
  • Review of Developer's monthly job cost reports and opine on adequacy of contingency.
  • Review of construction and disbursement schedules.
  • Review of lien waiver and other documentation submitted by the Developer.
  • Prepare project status reports and recommend the release of construction funds.
  • Review contract drawings and specifications and opine for completeness and general compliance with commonly accepted architectural /engineering best practices.
  • Analyze the Developer's direct and indirect cost budget including cost estimate back-up.
  • Coordinate with the Cost Advisory group performing parameter estimates and spot quantity take-offs.
  • Review of supporting documentation submitted by the Developer, contractor and subcontractors.
  • Review and make relevant comments concerning the terms of the construction agreement, the submitted subcontracts, architectural and engineering design agreements.
  • Building loan agreements as well as review both Contractor and Architect's qualification statements.
  • Review and comment on construction and disbursement schedules as well as other submitted document including but not limited to:
    • Zoning approvals
    • Certified surveys
    • Building permits and approvals
    • Utility company approval letters
    • Soil and foundation engineering reports
    • Designer's certification of code and ADA compliance
  • Prepare Construction Risk Assessment Reports.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Experience managing construction projects in Eastern Oregon & Washington is required.
  • Preconstruction and construction management experience through entire project lifecycle
  • Project management information software (PMiS) experience
  • Experience with projects ranging in size from $7M to $50M +
  • Skilled with project budgeting, scheduling, reporting and leadership
  • OSHA 10 hour minimum / effective management of safety initiatives and priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Ability to provide efficient, timely, reliable and courteous service to customers.
  • Ability to effectively present information.
  • Requires in-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles.
  • Ability to calculate complex figures.
  • Ability to forecast and prepare budgets.
  • Conducts financial/business analysis including the preparation of reports.
  • Ability to solve advanced problems and deal with a variety of options in complex situations.
  • Requires expert level analytical and quantitative skills with proven experience in developing strategic solutions for a growing matrix-based multi-industry sales environment.
  • Draws upon the analysis of others and makes recommendations that have a direct impact on the company.
  • Intermediate skills with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to read and understand architectural drawings.
  • Knowledge in MS Project, leases, contracts, and construction practices.
  • Knowledge of the entitlement/permitting process and construction delivery methods and agreements.
  • Familiarity with construction best practices, general building codes, and various building types and systems.
  • Passion for being detail oriented and highly organized

Education and Experience:

  • Seven (7) years full time paid professional experience in Construction and/or a combination of Project and Construction Management of Commercial and/or Public/Educational Facility Construction.
  • Five (4) of the fifteen (7) years should have full responsibility for coordinating complex projects with construction values in excess of $20M.
  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred.
  • BS/BA Degree required
  • Minimum five or more years' construction administration, architecture, engineering or similar experience.

Security Clearance Status:

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The role of Director of Integrated Planning for an SBU (Strategic Business Unit) necessitates a sophisticated mix of skills, knowledge, and leadership to achieve the company's objectives. The individual must have expertise in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), Material Planning, transformation, financial planning, and other areas that drive the organization’s growth and resiliency goals.

This position requires a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate across functions and ensure the alignment of supply and demand within the SBU. Proficiency in S&OP and ERP systems like SAP and Kinaxis is crucial.

It is critical for this individual to be an effective leader who can mentor supply chain professionals while developing a talent pipeline.

What You Will Do:

  • This leader is responsible for driving the integrated business planning team for their SBU to optimize supply and demand for firm & non-firm throughout the 5-year horizon.
  • Takes full ownership of the entire planning process for the specific SBU.
  • Drives alignment of the MRP schedule, AOP execution, long term forecast, and is a strategic partner in the long-range plan (LRP) planning process.
  • Identifies and corrects systemic planning issues and improves KPIs.
  • Leads a robust sales and operations execution and planning process that is focused on decision making and actionable outcomes to meet business objectives.
  • Beyond these primary tasks, this individual must also demonstrate a strategic mindset when it comes to long term demand and supply planning.
  • This position demands excellent communication skills, as collaboration with colleagues from other functions is essential for aligning supply & demand for the SBU.
  • Own short-term planning execution & long-term strategic planning throughout the 5-year horizon
  • Be integrated into the SBU to understand business objectives ensuring the firm & non-firm schedule meets business requirements.
  • Collaborate to ensure MRP is healthy to align PRISM and Kinaxis credibility.
  • Be the planning representative during the LRP process to ensure a credible schedule is loaded into the LRP.
  • Facilitate quarterly S&OP Executive Reviews & monthly S&OE meetings.
  • Maintain accurate planning forecasts.
  • Be the focal point to solve any planning-related issue within the SBU.
  • Strategic partner in the LRP planning process, to ensure all demand/supply is aligned to meet commitments.
  • Articulate how capacity constraints affect specific programs for the SBU. Understand root cause and corrective actions for mitigation.
  • Drive MRP schedule integrity, predictability, and execution.
  • Understand lead-times of all major programs – work strategies to mitigate / reduce lead-time.


Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 14 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 12 years experience
  • Experience with executive stakeholder management.
  • Experience with S&OP and Planning elements/fundamentals
  • Leadership experience managing people/teams.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Master’s degree in a related field
  • Experience in Supply Chain (experience in Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Inventory Planning in an environment of both manufactured and sourced finished goods highly preferred).
  • Knowledge and experience in MRP and ERP systems - inventory control, materials requirements planning, item master, demand planning, and advanced supply chain planning and analytics preferred.
  • APICS Certification preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, project management and time management skills, including multi-tasking and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines, follow up and attention to details.
  • Adaptable to multiple requests, daily changes, while still delivering on commitments.
  • Data-driven with demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems and strong proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Must be able to work independently while still functioning well in a team environment.
  • Able to communicate effectively with senior management, peers, and colleagues cross-functionally.
  • People management experience including strong interpersonal and leadership skills: meeting facilitation, skill sharing and training, organization, conflict management, change agent, manage relationships.


Learn More & Apply Now!

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

  • Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 186,200 USD - 353,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.

Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

title: Grader Operator
description:
Grader Operator
Mildred Lake, Fort McMurray, Alberta | Full-Time, Rotational
Heavy Equipment Operation / Road Maintenance | Experienced | 14/14 Rotation, Camp Provided

Position TypeFull-Time, Rotational
LocationMildred Lake area, north of Fort McMurray, Alberta
Schedule14 days on, 14 days off, days and nights rotating
Hours12 hour shifts, year round operation
Compensation$29.00 to $40.00 per hour, based on verified seat time
ExperienceVerifiable motor grader seat time, oil sands or mine site preferred
CertificationCSTS-2020, H2S Alive, Standard First Aid, valid Class 5 licence
AccommodationsCamp room and board provided
EquipmentMotor grader. Time on dozer, loader, or water truck is an asset, not a requirement.
About GrizzlyTrek Group Ltd.
GrizzlyTrek Group is a Technical Workforce and Indigenous Employment Partner. We recruit skilled trades across Canada's industrial sector and place them with reputable employers offering long term work, fair pay, and room to advance. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and proudly support Indigenous employment.
The Role
GrizzlyTrek is hiring an experienced grader operator to join our valued client's team at the Mildred Lake site north of Fort McMurray, Alberta. This is a full time rotational position on a 14 days on, 14 days off schedule, paying $29.00 to $40.00 per hour based on verified seat time. Camp room and board is provided.
You will run a motor grader on active oil sands roads, keeping haul roads, ramps, and access roads crowned, drained, and safe for around the clock traffic. The grader is your seat, not a rotation through whichever machine is short that day.
What You'll Do
  • Run a motor grader on haul roads, access roads, ramps, and lease roads across the site
  • Blade, crown, and ditch road surfaces to hold shape, shed water, and keep drainage open
  • Cut and maintain in-pit ramps, berms, and windrows to the mine plan and site standards
  • Handle winter maintenance: snow removal, ice blading, and sanding to keep roads open through freeze up
  • Prep and finish grade for pads, laydown yards, and construction access
  • Complete pre-trip and post-trip inspections, grease the machine, change cutting edges, and report defects early
  • Follow dispatch and radio protocol around ultra class haul traffic, and take part in hazard assessments and toolbox talks
What You Bring
  • Verifiable motor grader seat time, mine site or heavy civil preferred
  • Able to hold grade and carry a crown on a haul road without someone standing over you
  • Valid Class 5 licence and reliable transportation to the pickup point
  • CSTS-2020, H2S Alive, and Standard First Aid, or the willingness to hold them before start
  • Able to pass a pre-access drug and alcohol test and work 12 hour shifts, days and nights
  • Able to live in camp and work a 14 days on, 14 days off rotation year round
Preferred Qualifications
  • Oil sands or mine site experience with a current regional site orientation
  • Seat time on Cat 16 or 24 class graders, and GPS or laser grade control
  • Dozer, loader, water truck, or rock truck time as a backup skill, plus Ground Disturbance Level 2
Work Environment
  • Active oil sands mine site in the Mildred Lake area north of Fort McMurray, worked year round in all weather.
  • Camp accommodation with room and board provided for the full rotation.
  • 12 hour shifts on a rotating day and night schedule across a 14 days on, 14 days off rotation, including weekends and holidays.
  • Site access requires a clear pre-access drug and alcohol test and a completed site orientation before your first shift.
What We Offer
  • Camp room and board provided for the full rotation
  • Year round road maintenance work rather than a seasonal spread
  • A dedicated grader seat rather than a rotation across whatever machine is short
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • Opportunities for overtime based on operational requirements
  • Life insurance: $100,000 employee / $10,000 spouse / $5,000 per child
  • AD&D insurance with critical illness and cancer coverage
  • Extended health care: drugs, hospital, hearing, orthotics, nursing
  • Paramedical services: chiro, physio, massage, mental health (annual coverage)
  • Vision care: glasses, contacts, laser surgery, and exams
  • Dental care: 80% basic ($2,500), 50% major ($2,500), $2,500 ortho for children
  • Travel insurance: up to $5,000,000 per incident (trips up to 90 days)
  • Ongoing training and career development support

Can you hold a crown on a haul road through a Fort McMurray winter? Apply today at www.grizzlytrekgroup.com. Qualified candidates will be contacted quickly.
Apply now at www.grizzlytrekgroup.com

Amsterdam, Berlin, Stockholm and Katowice

You bring solid experience from cloud engineering environments and enjoy combining technology, security and automation to create reliable services for users. You are communicative, collaborative and enjoy working together with colleagues from different disciplines to solve complex challenges.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer

What makes you the perfect fit

title: Design Director
description:
This is not a sit-back, review-the-work-and-nod-at-decks kind of role.

We’re working with an ambitious, award-winning independent brand and creative agency looking for a Design Director, or an exceptional emerging Creative Director of Brand, to lead its design team and help push the agency’s creative output to the next level.

They need someone with serious brand credentials, a portfolio that still feels fresh and a genuine desire to stay close to the work.

What you’ll be walking into

The agency is entering an exciting phase, with several major national rebrands and Tier 1 projects moving through the studio.

You’ll lead a team of three designers and take ownership of the agency’s brand and design discipline. The team has been through some change, so this person will play an important role in bringing stability, consistency and plenty of creative energy.

You’ll work closely with the founder and leadership team, with the potential to join the broader management team depending on your experience and how much agency-wide responsibility you want to take on.

The work

The main focus is brand identity, brand refresh and rebranding work, but they don’t want someone sitting in a neat little “brand only” box.

If you’ve helped create a brand and the agency then develops a major OOH campaign for it, you’ll have a creative voice in that too. The same goes for campaigns, pitches, digital experiences and the wider creative conversation across the agency.

You’ll be:

  • Leading major national brand projects from concept through to design systems and rollout.

  • Setting the creative bar across brand and design.

  • Staying hands-on and personally helping elevate the work.

  • Leading and mentoring a team of three designers.

  • Working closely with junior creatives to develop their craft and confidence.

  • Presenting and selling ideas to clients and senior stakeholders.

  • Running Brand Expression workshops.

  • Contributing to pitches and new business opportunities.

  • Improving design systems, processes and ways of working.

  • Managing multiple projects across deadlines and budgets.

  • Exploring AI tools that can make creative workflows smarter and faster without making the work feel generic.

  • Bringing ideas and opinions to campaigns, OOH and other creative outputs beyond branding.

You’ll probably be someone who...

  • Has around eight or more years of experience in a strong brand, design or creative agency.

  • Has led major rebrands or brand identity projects for recognized or national brands.

  • Still loves the work and hasn’t disappeared entirely into meetings and management.

  • Has a genuinely strong, current portfolio that clearly shows what you contributed.

  • Knows how to raise the standard without crushing the confidence of the people around you.

  • Is advanced in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.

  • Understands print, digital design, production and final art.

  • Has a working understanding of UX and UI principles.

  • Can present, facilitate workshops and sell a creative idea with confidence.

  • Can manage several projects without losing track of quality, timing or budget.

  • Is curious about new tools, technology and how AI can support better creative work.

  • Still has something to prove and is excited by the idea of making a visible impact.

Culture matters here

Once the portfolio box is ticked, personality is a huge part of this hire.

This is an independent agency with an open, collaborative and very human culture.

They want someone personable, energetic and creatively curious. Someone who can have a natural conversation with a founder, confidently lead a client workshop and then sit beside a junior designer to help make the work better.

Essentially, an excellent creative leader who is also an actually nice person.

Why it’s worth a look

  • You’ll lead significant Tier 1 brand work.

  • You’ll have real influence rather than becoming one senior creative among many.

  • You’ll work directly with the founder and leadership team.

  • You’ll have the freedom to innovate and push the agency’s creative standards.

  • You’ll help shape and grow a talented design team.

  • You’ll have a platform to create work worthy of awards and industry recognition.

  • If you’re a Design Director ready to step up, this could be a genuine progression opportunity.

The practical bits

  • Sydney-based.

  • Work from home on Mondays.

  • In the office Tuesday to Friday. This is important for mentoring, collaboration and team leadership.

  • Salary from approximately $140k + super, with flexibility depending on experience.

  • They’re moving quickly, but they won’t compromise on quality.

One important thing

Your portfolio matters more than the logos on your CV.

It should include recent brand identity or rebranding work, make your personal contribution clear and show that you’re still creatively current and hands-on.

If the work is great, the personality fits and you’re hungry to help shape an ambitious independent agency, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Postdoc: Weakly supervised ML-based Earth observation for climate extreme impact quantification
company: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
description:
Project Overview

The postdoc will develop an advanced Earth observation (EO) machine learning (ML) framework to identify, geolocalize, and quantitatively estimate the physical and socio-economic impacts of climate extremes such as floods, storms, wildfires, and landslides, using satellite image sequences.

A primary bottleneck in climate adaptation is that historical impact data is plagued by annotation sparsity: detailed pixel-level ground truth of damage is rare, while rich textual data from news, insurance disclosures, and humanitarian reports is unstructured, noisy, and spatially coarse. Furthermore, models trained in data-rich regions may face data distribution shifts when deployed across different geographic, infrastructural, or socio-economic contexts.

To address these challenges, the postdoc will develop annotation-efficient, weakly supervised ML-based Earth observation models that leverage unstructured data as a source of scalable distant supervision. The framework will incorporate uncertainty quantification techniques to ensure that the AI-derived impact estimates are reliable and actionable for decision-makers.

Core research task: Architecting data-efficient change detection for geospatial foundation models

Design and develop specialized, data-efficient architectural modules, built on top of frozen geospatial foundation models. The goal is to automatically detect and isolate large, extreme-event-related physical changes resulting from floods, storms, or wildfires, by modeling the contrast between pre- and post-event observations in heterogeneous, multi-sensor image sequences (Sentinel-1/2, Landsat/HLS, VIIRS/MODIS).

The development will focus on two major machine learning challenges:

  • Weak supervision under annotation sparsity. Engineering models to learn robust representations of rapid environmental transitions using minimal labeled instances and sparse, noisy text reports treated as distant supervision.

  • Distribution shifts and uncertainty quantification. Integrating strict geometric constraints (e.g., Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Processes [SNGP]) directly into the adapter layers so the model can inherently flag high epistemic uncertainty when encountering out-of-distribution geographical features or unprecedented extreme-event severities.

About Climes

The Swedish Centre for Impacts of Climate Extremes (climes) is a research and training platform building an interdisciplinary field on how climate extremes affect people, ecosystems and infrastructure in a changing world. The Centre brings together physical, medical, social and engineering sciences—disciplines rarely combined—to advance knowledge, shape the Swedish research landscape and strengthen societal resilience. Our work centres on three themes: compiling high-quality data on the impacts of climate extremes; analysing the physical–societal interactions that drive consequences; and developing policy-actionable scenarios to prepare for future extremes.

Who You Are

Beyond the specific requirements for each role, we are looking for curious, analytical individuals with a genuine passion for artificial intelligence and its potential to solve real-world problems in cross-disciplinary settings. You are a proactive problem-solver, motivated by contributing to impactful research with tangible outcomes. You combine methodological curiosity, the drive to innovate algorithmically amid real-world constraints like annotation sparsity, with the interdisciplinary agility to bridge machine learning and climate and environmental science, all in pursuit of using technology to tackle urgent challenges in climate adaptation and sustainability.

Requirements:

  • A PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a highly quantitative equivalent.

  • Strong theoretical understanding and hands-on coding mastery of deep learning architectures using PyTorch or TensorFlow, with a proven track record in computer vision or spatio-temporal modeling. Experience working with machine learning for remote sensing data.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken) are required.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Prior experience handling multi-spectral geospatial formats, radar (SAR) data, or standard satellite pipelines (Sentinel, Landsat/HLS, MODIS/VIIRS).

  • Familiarity with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT/LoRA frameworks), out-of-distribution detection, change-detection tasks, or single-pass Uncertainty Quantification methods (SNGP, Evidential DL, Conformal Prediction).

  • Peer-reviewed publications in top-tier ML conferences or major remote sensing journals.

  • Proficiency in Swedish or other Nordic languages is a welcome plus for stakeholder communication.

Are We a Good Match?

At RISE, we strive to create a workplace where diverse expertise and backgrounds converge to solve societal challenges. We offer a dynamic research environment where you will work on exciting projects with strong connections to industry and societal needs. With us, you'll have ample opportunities to learn, develop professionally, and contribute to meaningful innovation alongside experienced colleagues both within machine learning and application areas.

Welcome with your Application!

Curious to know more? For questions about specific roles, please contact Dr. Olof Mogren (olof.mogren@ri.se). The last application date is September 15th. Selection and interviews will be conducted continuously during and after the application period
