You’ll unload deliveries, handle equipment and hazardous materials safely, and make sure your area is prepped for daily success.

This role is physical and fast-paced, requiring safe lifting practices and attention to detail. You’ll spend most of your shift on your feet, working mornings, afternoons, evenings, or overnight depending on store needs. And when a customer or teammate needs help, you’ll be there with a friendly, professional attitude.

You may also assist customers in locating or loading products. Most shifts are physically active, and scheduling may include morning, evening, or overnight hours based on store needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Stock merchandise by unloading freight, down-stocking, organizing shelves, and setting up pallets

Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The following position is to join our Enterprise Services Team:


RTX has an opening for a Principal Specialist, Facilities Move Coordinator (Principal Specialist, Facilities) position

The Facilities Move Coordinator is responsible for workplace occupancy management, space planning, and move execution that support evolving business requirements across multiple Southwest locations. This role partners business leaders, Facilities Engineering, Operations, Digital Technology, Logistics, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and external service providers to coordinate workplace solutions that maximize space utilization while minimizing disruption to business operations.

Serving as a key liaison between customers and service partners, the Facilities Move Coordinator coordinates multiple concurrent workplace initiatives, maintains the integrity of occupancy and planning data, and supports the successful execution of workplace modernization projects. Success in this role requires strong project coordination, stakeholder engagement, organizational skills, IT competency, and the ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.


What You Will Do

  • Coordinate workplace planning initiatives, employee relocations, office reconfigurations, and occupancy changes across multiple Southwest facilities.
  • Partner with business leaders to understand operational requirements and coordinate workplace solutions that support evolving business needs.
  • Coordinate Move, Add, Change (MAC) activities, including employee relocations, office reconfigurations support, logistics support, and workplace readiness.
  • Maintain departmental SharePoint and collaboration sites to ensure planning resources, project documentation, schedules, and communications remain current.
  • Manage move work orders in the CMMS.
  • ​Assist with departmental reorganizations, large-scale restacks, and audits.
  • Provide drawing and document support for project teams, including updating facility drawings, space layouts, and move plans.
  • Provide IT support for project teams by coordinating software provisioning, software licensing, user access, and deploying software applications.
  • Coordinate the procurement, setup, and support of computer peripherals required for project execution.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • 2 years’ experience in workplace planning, move coordination, facilities operations, or project coordination.
  • 2 years’ experience supporting IT requirements, including software provisioning, software licensing, and user access coordination.
  • 2 years’ experience maintaining operational databases, reporting systems, and workplace planning information.
  • 2 years’ experience using AutoCAD to prepare, modify, and maintain engineering, architectural, and facility drawings.

  • Experience in conducting research into project-related issues and products.

title: Strategikonsulent
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens bank for privatkunder – med fokus på relationer, forretning og nærhed i en stærk og skaleret organisation. Har du erfaring fra finanssektoren, og brænder du for at omsætte strategi til konkrete resultater, der både skaber forretning og stærke kundeoplevelser. Så kan du være vores nye kollega i AL Sydbank.

Om stillingen

Som strategikonsulent/forretningsudvikler vil du arbejde med at udvikle og implementere betjeningsmodeller og forretningskoncepter, der sikrer nærhed og tillid i kundeoplevelsen – også i en større bank.

Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med data- og produktteams, de kundevendte områder, samt andre relevante forretningsenheder for at omsætte indsigter og analyser til konkrete løsninger, der adresserer kundernes behov effektivt og innovativt.

Vi er midt i en fusion og transformationsproces. Det betyder, at du vil få rig mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både den fremtidige bank og på, hvordan vi løser opgaver og samarbejder i teamet og på tværs af organisationen.

Om dig

Vi leder efter dig der:

  • Har solid erfaring fra den finansielle sektor, gerne med fokus på privatkunder og forretningsudvikling

  • Forstår at kombinere forretningsforståelse, analytisk sans og samarbejde i et dynamisk og foranderligt miljø

  • Har dokumenteret evne til at omsætte strategi og analyse til konkret handling og implementerede løsninger

  • Motiveres af at skabe løsninger, der styrker nærhed og tillidsrelationer til kunder – også når vi vokser

  • Arbejder struktureret og har erfaring med opfølgning, prioritering og rapportering

  • Trives med både selvstændigt ansvar og tværorganisatorisk projektarbejde

  • Kommunikerer effektivt på alle niveauer i organisationen

  • Bidrager aktivt og engageret til samarbejde og positiv udvikling af vores teamkultur

Bemærk: Vi lægger vægt på erfaring, men hvis du er i starten af din karriere og har det rette drive og faglige fundament, er vi åbne for at tilpasse ansvar og opgaver.

description:

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Clinical and Real World Evidence Digital Solution Lead (Technology Consultant), you possess a strong understanding of complex business and scientific workflows, data science workflows, AI/ML/GenAI technologies, and modern data platform capabilities including AI-ready data product requirements. You will support the identification, evaluation, development, and scaling of innovative data and AI capabilities across the real-world and clinical data ecosystem.

This role bridges business needs, data science expertise, evidence generation workflows, and platform engineering to ensure that new capabilities progress from idea and proof of concept into scalable, governed, and sustainable digital solutions.

Acting as a trusted technical and data science partner, you will contribute to PoCs, product evaluations, data product roadmaps, productisation of innovative solutions. You will help ensure that emerging capabilities are evaluated for business value, scientific relevance, technical feasibility, scalability, governance, cost-effectiveness, and fit with the broader RW&C data ecosystem.

The Real World & Clinical Data Innovation area focuses on accelerating the use of real-world data and clinical trial data, to support evidence generation, clinical development, study simulation, and AI-enabled decision-making. The area works at the intersection of data science, platform engineering, data products, GenAI, governance, and business strategy. Its mission is to identify and scale capabilities that improve access to high-quality data, enable reusable data products, support advanced analytics, and accelerate the generation of reliable evidence. Key focus areas include clinical insight layer development, reusable data product delivery, evaluation of external RWD analysis platforms, novel data licensing models, GenAI-enabled workflows, study simulation enablement, and AI-ready data foundations.

The Opportunity:

  • Accountability/Problem Solving: Frames complex business problems, drives root-cause analysis, manages scope, and ensures engineering deliverables align with organizational objectives, including AI-ready data and ethical AI requirements.

  • Stakeholder Management: Engages stakeholders across organizational boundaries, acts as a trusted advisor to leadership, and drives alignment across teams.

  • Impact/Strategy: Delivers high-value solutions aligned with business strategy, evaluates strategic options and risks, and helps shape long-term roadmaps.

  • Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at product or product-line level, navigating evolving requirements and translating complex problems into scalable, production-ready solutions.

  • Technical ability and hands-on expertise: Applies strong technical, data science, and AI/ML/GenAI expertise to define AI-ready data products, evaluate solutions, and build PoC prototypes, with particular focus on GenAI and agentic AI, including their application in sensitive and regulated data environments.

  • Data innovation and capability development: Identifies and shapes data and AI capabilities for RWD, clinical data reuse, study simulation, and evidence generation. Translates scientific and business needs into scalable, reusable, and governed platform capabilities from PoC through productisation.

Who You Are:

  • University degree or equivalent experience in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Life Sciences, or another relevant scientific or technical field.

  • Strong hands-on experience in one or more of the following: data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, applied AI, or GenAI, with the ability to independently evaluate solutions, build or contribute to PoC prototypes, and help progress capabilities toward scalable, production-ready solutions.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional data, AI, or digital initiatives, navigating ambiguity and aligning business, product, data science, and engineering stakeholders.

  • Practical understanding of GenAI application patterns, such as assistants, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, natural-language interfaces, semantic search, or AI-enabled data discovery.

  • Understanding of modern data platforms and data products, including data pipelines, metadata, semantic layers, ontologies, data quality, and cloud-based analytics environments.

  • Ability to evaluate data and AI solutions holistically and translate complex business and scientific needs into clear solution requirements, considering business value, technical feasibility, model performance, scalability, cost, governance, and long-term sustainability.

  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI, and compliance considerations in sensitive or regulated data environments.

Preferred:

  • Experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, clinical research, life sciences, or other regulated and data-intensive industries.

  • Experience with real-world data, clinical data, evidence generation, study simulation, or related scientific and analytical workflows.

  • Experience contributing to data product strategies, product roadmaps, innovation portfolios, or platform capability development.

  • Experience evaluating or working with external data providers, technology partners, vendor platforms, or emerging technologies.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or equivalent environments.

  • Experience with federated analytics, privacy-preserving analytics, synthetic data, or other approaches for working with sensitive data.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, adoption metrics, business case development, or cost-effectiveness evaluation.

  • Familiarity with GxP or regulated software development environments.

title: BCBA – Full-Time Remote
description:
Clinical Leadership, Supervision & Caregiver-Led ABA

A Different Kind of BCBA Role

At Beyou, we are intentionally designing the BCBA role differently.

Salary: $90,000–$120,000 annually, based on location and BCBA experience
Status: Full-Time
Location: Fully Remote – USA
Direct Client Hours: Approximately 10–15 hours per week
Required Availability: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday–Friday

Unlike traditional BCBA positions built around 25–30+ direct or billable clinical hours each week, this position is designed around clinical leadership, decision-making, supervision, and people development.

You will not be expected to do everything yourself.

For each client, you will work with a clinical team of approximately three clinicians who help execute the day-to-day work needed to move the case forward.

Your role is to provide the BCBA-level clinical oversight that only you can provide: analyzing progress, making clinical decisions, adjusting treatment, guiding the team, supporting caregivers, and ensuring high-quality implementation.

Our goal is simple: allow BCBAs to spend their time doing the work that truly requires a BCBA.

About Beyou

At Beyou, we believe the most important therapist in a child's life is already at home.

Our mission is to expand access to Applied Behavior Analysis through innovative, caregiver-led models that empower families, strengthen communities, and create meaningful, lasting change.

We are building more than an ABA provider. We are rethinking how behavioral healthcare can be delivered through caregiver partnership, telehealth, technology, strong clinical teams, and thoughtful use of BCBA expertise.

Everything we do is guided by our core values:

  • Power Through Knowledge

  • Cultural Awareness

  • One Team

What Makes This BCBA Position Different?

1. Approximately 10–15 Direct Client Hours Per Week

This is not a position built around maximizing your direct billable hours.

Your direct clinical work will generally average approximately 10–15 hours per week, allowing significant time for clinical oversight, supervision, decision-making, treatment review, team development, and other responsibilities associated with leading high-quality cases.

2. Every Client Has a Clinical Team

You are not expected to manage every component of a client's care alone.

Each client is supported by a multidisciplinary clinical structure of approximately three clinicians, which may include master's-level trainees, mid-level clinicians, behavior technicians, caregiver trainers, and other clinical team members depending on the client's program.

The team supports implementation, data collection, caregiver coaching, case preparation, and ongoing clinical activities within their scope of competence and supervision.

3. Your Team Helps Do the Work

At Beyou, our clinical structure is designed to support the BCBA in doing the work—not simply send more work to the BCBA.

Team members help prepare, implement, monitor, and organize clinical activities so that you can focus your expertise where it matters most.

You remain responsible for appropriate BCBA-level oversight and clinical decisions, but you are supported by a team that helps execute the plan.

4. You Develop Future Clinicians

A major component of this position is overseeing and developing master's-level ABA students, trainees, and mid-level clinicians who support case implementation.

We are therefore looking for someone who doesn't just enjoy working with clients.

You should genuinely enjoy developing people.

You will coach clinicians to think critically, analyze data, identify problems, propose solutions, communicate with caregivers, implement treatment effectively, and progressively develop stronger clinical judgment.

Position Overview

The BCBA serves as the clinical leader of assigned cases.

You will oversee program implementation, review clinical progress, guide treatment adjustments, supervise developing clinicians, support caregiver-led services, and make or approve clinical decisions within your scope of responsibility.

Rather than personally completing every clinical task, you will work through a structured clinical team and ensure that the team's work results in high-quality, ethical, evidence-based care.

This position is especially well suited for a BCBA who enjoys the intersection of:

Clinical Practice + Supervision + People Development + Caregiver Coaching + Clinical Leadership

What You'll Do

Clinical Leadership & Decision-Making

  • Maintain clinical responsibility for assigned cases within applicable professional, payer, and regulatory requirements.

  • Review client data and evaluate treatment effectiveness.

  • Make clinical decisions regarding treatment priorities and recommendations.

  • Review and approve appropriate program changes and treatment adjustments.

  • Monitor client progress and identify when intervention strategies require modification.

  • Review progress reports and clinical documentation prepared by the treatment team.

  • Ensure treatment remains individualized, evidence-based, ethical, and clinically appropriate.

  • Provide direct BCBA services when BCBA-level expertise is required.

Supervision & People Development

A significant part of your role will be developing the clinicians working underneath and alongside you.

You will:

  • Supervise master's-level ABA students, trainees, mid-level clinicians, BTs, and RBTs as applicable.

  • Review clinical work completed by team members.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Teach clinical reasoning rather than simply giving answers.

  • Help developing clinicians learn how to identify problems and recommend solutions.

  • Build clinical independence while maintaining appropriate supervision.

  • Support staff in translating treatment plans into effective day-to-day implementation.

  • Model ethical and evidence-based clinical decision-making.

We want BCBAs who see supervision as developing the next generation of clinicians, not simply completing a supervision requirement.

Caregiver-Led ABA

Caregivers are central to how we deliver care.

Beyou is developing and implementing innovative caregiver-led approaches designed to help families use behavioral strategies within everyday routines and environments.

As the BCBA, you will:

  • Guide clinical decision-making within caregiver-led services.

  • Support clinicians providing caregiver coaching and implementation support.

  • Review caregiver progress and treatment implementation.

  • Determine when strategies should be continued, modified, re-taught, or replaced.

  • Provide direct caregiver consultation when BCBA expertise is required.

  • Help ensure behavioral strategies are practical, culturally responsive, and sustainable within family life.

You should be comfortable seeing caregivers as active partners in intervention, not passive recipients of services.

Program Implementation & Quality Oversight

You will oversee rather than personally execute every component of the client's program.

Responsibilities include:

  • Monitoring treatment implementation.

  • Reviewing program fidelity.

  • Reviewing clinical data and trends.

  • Evaluating client progress toward treatment goals.

  • Reviewing proposed program adjustments.

  • Reviewing progress reports.

  • Identifying clinical barriers and determining next steps.

  • Ensuring treatment-team activities remain aligned with the treatment plan.

  • Escalating and addressing clinical risks appropriately.

  • Maintaining appropriate BCBA oversight of delegated activities.

Your Typical Week

Your week will look different from many traditional BCBA roles.

Rather than spending most of your schedule moving from one direct session to another, your time may include:

  • 10–15 hours of direct client/caregiver clinical services

  • Case review and clinical decision-making

  • Supervision of master's-level trainees and mid-level clinicians

  • Reviewing data and client progress

  • Reviewing and approving treatment adjustments

  • Reviewing progress reports

  • Clinical team meetings

  • Caregiver-led case consultation

  • Coaching clinicians through complex cases

  • Documentation and quality oversight

  • Professional development and clinical collaboration

The exact distribution may vary based on caseload, client needs, payer requirements, and clinical priorities.

Availability

Although this position is fully remote, it is a full-time clinical leadership role, not an asynchronous position.

BCBAs must be consistently available virtually between:

10:00 AM and 6:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday

Your schedule within this window will include client services, caregiver meetings, supervision, team collaboration, clinical reviews, and focused clinical work.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role when:

  • Clients demonstrate meaningful progress.

  • Caregivers feel supported and increasingly capable of implementing strategies.

  • Treatment decisions are timely and evidence-based.

  • Programs are adjusted based on data rather than allowed to stagnate.

  • Clinical documentation and progress reports are accurate and timely.

  • Master's-level students and mid-level clinicians become progressively stronger and more independent.

  • Team members bring you increasingly thoughtful clinical observations and possible solutions.

  • Cases move forward without requiring the BCBA to personally perform every task.

  • You maintain strong clinical oversight while effectively leveraging your team.

  • You model Beyou's values of Power Through Knowledge, Cultural Awareness, and One Team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification in good standing.

  • Master's degree in Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Education, or a related field.

  • Experience providing ABA services to children and families.

  • Strong clinical reasoning and data-based decision-making skills.

  • Experience supervising or mentoring clinicians.

  • Ability to oversee delegated clinical work while maintaining appropriate BCBA responsibility.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organization and documentation skills.

  • Comfortable providing services and supervision through telehealth.

  • Ability to work effectively within a team-based clinical model.

  • Ability to maintain consistent virtual availability 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time.

We'd Especially Love to Meet You If You...

  • Love teaching and developing other clinicians.

  • Enjoy supervising master's-level students and future behavior analysts.

  • Prefer clinical leadership over spending your entire week in direct sessions.

  • Believe caregivers can become powerful agents of change.

  • Enjoy complex cases and clinical problem-solving.

  • Look at data and naturally ask, “What should we do next?”

  • Are comfortable delegating appropriately while maintaining clinical accountability.

  • Want to help improve how ABA services are delivered.

  • Are interested in caregiver-mediated or caregiver-led intervention.

  • Have experience with telehealth.

  • Have worked with culturally and linguistically diverse families.

  • Want to contribute to a growing organization where new clinical models and systems are still being built.

Compensation & Position Details

Position: Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA)
Employment: Full-Time
Compensation: $90,000–$120,000 annually, based on geographic location and BCBA experience
Location: Fully Remote – USA
Required Availability: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday–Friday
Expected Direct Client Hours: Approximately 10–15 hours per week
Primary Focus: Clinical leadership, case oversight, supervision, people development, caregiver-led ABA, and clinical decision-making

Why Beyou?

Many BCBAs enter the field because they love behavior analysis—and eventually find themselves overwhelmed by large caseloads, constant direct billable expectations, documentation, supervision, caregiver communication, programming, and administrative responsibilities.

We believe BCBA expertise should be used differently.

At Beyou, the clinical team supports the BCBA so the BCBA can focus on the work that requires BCBA-level expertise.

You bring the clinical judgment.

Your team helps turn those decisions into action.

Together, you support the caregiver.

And the caregiver helps create change where it matters most: in everyday life.

Help Us Build the Future of Caregiver-Led ABA

If you want a BCBA position where you can remain deeply involved clinically while also teaching, supervising, developing people, and helping rethink how ABA is delivered, we'd love to meet you.

description:

title: Trimmaaja, Kuopio
description:
Musti Group on Pohjoismaiden johtava lemmikkieläinhoidon asiantuntija, joka toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa, sekä vuodesta 2024 lähtien myös Baltiassa. Missiomme on tehdä lemmikkien ja lemmikkivanhempien elämästä hauskempaa, turvallisempaa ja vaivattomampaa läpi lemmikin elämän. Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme täyden palvelun tuotetarjoaja ja toimija – sekä fyysisesti että digitaalisesti. Uskomme, että täyden palvelun ekosysteemi tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen arvolupauksen, joka parantaa ja vahvistaa hyviä asiakassuhteita ja erottaa meidät kilpailijoista.

Musti-konsernin liikevaihto oli 561 miljoonaa euroa tilikaudella 2024 (15 kk). Yhtiöllä oli
tilikauden 2024 lopussa 2 178 työntekijää, 1,9 miljoonaa asiakasta ja 415 myymälää.

Haemme nyt joukkoomme Kuopion myymälään sinua Trimmaaja

Trimmaajana teet laadukasta trimmaustyötä palvelukonseptimme mukaisesti. Käsittelet koiria varmoin ja lempein ottein ja ymmärrät kokonaisvaltaisen palveluelämyksen merkityksen asiakkaille. Asiakaspalvelu ja myyntityö ovat sinulle mieluisia tehtäviä. Kehität ja ylläpidät työpaikan myönteistä ilmapiiriä sekä työskentely-ympäristön viihtyisyyttä.

Toivomme sinulta

Hyväntuulisuutta, tiimihenkisyyttä sekä sitoutumista Mustin ja Mirrin arvoihin. Toivomme, että sinulla on palvelulähtöinen ja vastuuntuntoinen ajattelutapa. Trimmausosaaminen ja aito kiinnostus asiakaspalveluun ovat ehdottomia edellytyksiä tehtävässä menestymiselle. Muulle soveltuvalle koulutukselle ja työkokemukselle heilutamme aina häntää!

Toivomme, että sinulla on mahdollisuus tehdä töitä kaikkina myymälän aukioloaikoina, kun asiakkaat meitä tarvitsevat - myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuina.

Miksi kannattaa liittyä Mustijengiin?

Voimme sopia joustavasti, kuinka paljon työtä teet ja millaisella sopimuksella. Tarpeen mukaan sinulla on myös mahdollista työskennellä alueemme muissakin yksiköissä. Saat käyttöösi modernit ja viihtyisät monitoimitilat varmojen asiakasvirtojen äärellä. Vastassasi on motivoitunut, positiivinen ja huippuhauska työyhteisö. Sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittää omaa työtäsi ja koko Mustiketjua. Kohtaat joka päivä paljon karvaisia asiakkaita ja voit tuoda myös oman nelijalkaisesi mukaan töihin. Saat myös Mustin ja Mirrin uramahdollisuudet (katso uratarinoita) ja hyvät henkilökuntaedut.

Mikäli jaat kanssamme innostuksen trimmaukseen ja turkinhoitoon, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa myymäläpäällikkö Laura Tiihonen. Soittoajat torstaisin klo 14-15 numerosta 044 769 0590.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, jätä hakemuksesi 9.9.2026 mennessä. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuajalla ja tehtävä täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Pratt & Whitney is seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to join our Mechanical Systems, Externals, & Nacelles (MSEN) organization. In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our engine lubrication system, providing technical leadership across requirements, system modeling, validation, risk retirement, and the development of a small engineering team.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead system-level requirements, interfaces, and performance assessments for engine lubrication systems, coordinating with analysis teams, component owners, and customers to allocate requirements, resolve interfaces, and maintain system compliance throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Develop, execute, and validate steady-state and transient fluid-flow system models using Dymola, Easy5, MATLAB, Simulink, or comparable tools to evaluate system performance, support design decisions, and resolve technical issues across development and in-service engine programs.
  • Lead a small technical team through the development and validation of new or upgraded lubrication systems, coordinating technical activities, design reviews, engine/test-rig validation, data analysis, and delivery of results in support of program milestones.
  • Lead system-level risk identification, root-cause investigations, and technical problem resolution by analyzing engine and test data, executing system models, communicating findings, and driving mitigation strategies to closure.
  • Serve as a senior technical authority and mentor by guiding engineers, improving analytical tools and methods, managing system status to requirements, and presenting technical findings and recommendations to engineering leadership, customers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Travel Requirement: 10% (Domestic).

What You Will Learn:

  • Gain advanced experience in engine lubrication system architecture, requirements management, and system integration.
  • Develop expertise in fluid-flow system modeling and simulation using Dymola, Easy5, MATLAB, and Simulink.
  • Gain experience with engine and test-rig validation, test-data analysis, model correlation, and technical reporting.
  • Strengthen technical leadership, mentoring, risk management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Gain exposure to complex aerospace engine development programs, customer interactions, technical reviews, and next-generation propulsion technologies.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field and 10 years of relevant engineering experience, or an advanced degree in a related field and 7 years of relevant engineering experience.

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with internal flow modeling, fluid systems, lubrication systems, or propulsion systems.
  • Experience using Dymola, Easy5, MATLAB, Simulink, or comparable system-level modeling and simulation tools, including development and validation of component models.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting technical findings to engineering leadership, customers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, projects, or complex engineering activities.
  • Willingness to obtain a U.S. government-issued security clearance.

The QA/QC Technician - Electrical The role is an opportunity for experienced electrical professionals to expand beyond the tools and take on a technical quality role with real influence on project outcomes. In this position, you’ll work across all phases of construction—participating in project planning, inspecting electrical installations, assessing risk, and ensuring work meets contractual, regulatory, and OSHA safety standards. You’ll collaborate closely with construction teams, engineers, and subcontractors to identify issues early, drive corrective actions, and help ensure electrical systems are built right the first time. This role is ideal for detail-oriented electricians or field supervisors who want to elevate their careers, gain exposure to mission-critical data center infrastructure, and build a pathway into senior QA/QC, commissioning, or construction leadership roles.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in project planning and assist in determining appropriate installation techniques.
  • Conduct regular walk-through inspections to ensure conformance with contractual specifications, government regulations, and Walker/OSHA safety requirements.
  • Inspect manufactured products, on-site materials, equipment, and installation processes for compliance with specifications and standards.
  • Document and communicate inspection results; identify non-compliant situations, recommend corrective actions, and follow through to ensure full resolution.
  • Provide QA/QC feedback during each phase of the project to support continuous improvement.

  • Disseminate written policies and procedures related to QA/QC activities.
  • Interpret specifications and clarify procedural issues for field personnel.

Job Description:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Hardware Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of our Next Gen Storage products. As a Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a vital role in the design and development of PCB/PCA solutions, collaborating with both internal and outsourced development partners. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of low to moderately complex projects, applying your expertise in electrical engineering, design tools, and problem-solving skills.

Responsibilities:

  • PCB/PCA Development: Capture schematics for integrated circuit designs (PCAs), focusing on specific portions of the overall design. Utilize your knowledge of electrical engineering principles and design practices to create efficient and reliable solutions.
  • CPLD Code Development: Develop CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Device) code using Verilog. Contribute to enhancing the functionality and performance of the hardware through optimized code implementation.
  • CAD Library Management: Coordinate the submission of requests for new CAD library parts, including part numbers (PNs), footprints, and symbols. Ensure the availability of required components for successful hardware design.
  • Design Documentation and Validation: Generate comprehensive design documentation, build instructions, and rework procedures for Design Validation Testing (DVT). Collaborate with the team to validate designs and ensure adherence to specifications.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with internal and outsourced development partners, fostering effective collaboration on electrical hardware design and development. As a valuable member of the HW development project team, contribute to the development of reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Designs portions of engineering solutions for electrical and electronic parts, subsystems, integrated circuitry, and algorithms based on established engineering principles and in accordance with development technology practices and guidelines.
  • Develops and implements parameters and test plans for existing designs, including validation of tolerances, form/fit/function, shock and vibration, electromagnetic interference, safety, reliability, thermal generation, and system power measurements.
  • Collaborates and communicates with internal and outsourced development partners on electrical hardware design and development.
  • Participates as a member of project team of other electrical hardware engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high-quality solutions for low to moderately- complex products.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • Typically, 2-4 years' experience in hardware design, preferably in the field of electrical engineering.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Proficiency in using electrical design tools and software packages.
  • Prior experience with Cadence CAD and schematics capture tools is highly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, enabling you to tackle moderately complex hardware design challenges and provide effective solutions.
  • Expertise in designing integrated circuitry and algorithms, leveraging your knowledge of electrical engineering principles and best practices.
  • Ability to employ empirical analysis, modeling, and testing methodologies to validate components, circuits, and hardware designs.
  • Knowledge of thermal and emissions management is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with mastery in English and the local language.
  • Effective communication and negotiation abilities are essential for presenting design proposals and discussing options with team members and stakeholders.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

As the site’s primary contract coordinator, the Facilities Supervisor oversees a group of skilled trades and contractors, including electricians, welders, instrumentation technicians, plumbers, machinists, mechanics and other specialists. Playnetic is an innovative and fast-growing player in the iGaming industry. We create cutting-edge casino games and technology that entertain millions of players worldwide, combining creativity, quality, and innovation at every step. Our gaming content is built around our core values: quality gaming, dedicated customer service, and reliable delivery to our partners.

With a global mindset, we’re committed to building engaging products and an inspiring workplace where teams can thrive.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Lead Generator with previous gaming sales experience to support our Commercial team by researching, identifying and qualifying online casino operators and brands that do not currently offer our games.

This is an junior-level role combining lead generation, online research, sales support and administration. The ideal candidate has previous experience in a sales, business development or lead-generation environment and is comfortable researching potential customers, identifying relevant contacts and maintaining accurate sales data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research online casino operators and brands across different markets.

  • Identify potential operators that are not currently live with our games.

  • Research and identify relevant decision-makers and commercial contacts within target organisations.

  • Find, verify and record relevant company and contact information.

  • Assess and qualify potential leads based on agreed criteria.

  • Maintain an accurate and up-to-date database of potential leads.

  • Check leads to avoid duplication and confirm their commercial relevance.

  • Share qualified leads with the Commercial team for follow-up.

  • Track the status and progress of identified leads and opportunities.

  • Work towards agreed lead-generation and commercial targets.

  • Provide regular updates on lead-generation activity and results.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or a similar commercial role is required.

  • Experience researching and identifying potential customers or business opportunities.

  • Good online research skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Good organisational and administrative skills.

  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

  • Good written and spoken English (C1 level).

  • Russian language skills would be an advantage.

  • Ability to work independently and meet agreed targets.

  • Comfortable working in a target-driven commercial environment.

  • An interest in or basic understanding of the iGaming industry would be an advantage.

Success Measures

  • Number of relevant and qualified new leads identified.

  • Accuracy and completeness of lead and contact information.

  • Consistent maintenance of the lead database.

  • Achievement of agreed lead-generation targets.

  • Number of identified leads progressing into active commercial opportunities.

  • Number of generated opportunities converting into signed operators.

What we offer:

  • Supportive Leadership & Flat Hierarchy: A collaborative, open environment led by accessible managers who prioritize mentorship, psychological safety, and removing blockers.

  • Fast-Track Growth: As we scale, your career scales with us — we actively support professional development, training, and progression.

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and success bonus for each identified operator that progresses to signing.

title: Neighbourhood Property Officer
description:

Are you passionate about customer excellence? Want to be part of a brilliant team in a fantastic location? As a member of our established housing team and working within a strong performance culture, you will be responsible for delivering a high-quality maintenance and repairs service to SBHA Tenants.

Salary: £37,422 to £41,335 per year (pay award pending)
Location: Selkirk, Scottish Borders
Hours and terms: Permanent, full-time - Monday to Friday, 35 hours per week
Closing Date: 5.00pm, 10 September 2026


The Role:

This is role is to provide a high-quality maintenance and repairs service to SBHA Tenants. It is predominantly based in the community supporting Tenants to live in safe and healthy homes ensuring all necessary repairs are carried out to a high standard.

The Neighbourhood Property Officer assists in managing planned, cyclical, and reactive maintenance works for tenanted and empty homes, ensuring properties and estates are well maintained and compliant with relevant legislation. They work closely with Neighbourhood Housing Officers within designated areas.

Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Maintenance and compliance: Responsibilities include specifying, inspecting, and instructing maintenance works, ensuring contractor performance meets standards, and compliance with health and safety and CDM regulations.

  • Property inspections and asset management: The role involves inspecting properties and communal areas, managing voids and responsive repairs, contributing to asset management strategy updates, and preparing for handover of new properties.

  • Quality and performance monitoring: The officer champions work quality by monitoring contractors and suppliers, supports achievement of housing quality standards like SHQS and EESSH, and implements new technical standards. They also collect and report performance data and identify service improvements.

  • Information systems and reporting: Maintaining detailed housing stock condition databases, providing financial and performance data, and utilizing ICT tools for reporting are key duties. Accurate record-keeping compliant with data protection is emphasized.

  • Customer service and community engagement: The officer provides professional advice to tenants, handles service-related queries and complaints promptly, conducts estate inspections, monitors service contracts, and fosters tenant involvement and community partnerships.

  • General responsibilities: The role includes representing the association locally, promoting values and equal opportunities, committing to professional development, ensuring health and safety compliance, and participating in out-of-hours standby.

What we're looking for:

Experience of working in a similar role would be an advantage, as would experience of working in social housing or another regulated sector.

  • A strong knowledge, understanding and experience of building technology, construction and maintenance.

  • Experience of carrying out property and estate inspections and specifying works, contract supervision, monitoring and quality control.

  • Knowledge of legislation relevant to residential dwellings in Scotland and SHQS and EESSH standards.

  • Attention to detail.

  • Great communication skills.

  • Excellent IT skills – Word and Excel in particular.

  • Possession of a current full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle.

Please view the job description and person specification for full details of essential and desirable criteria.

Being part of the SBHA team, you will enjoy a fantastic range of benefits including a competitive salary, flexible working, generous annual leave, stability of employment and a good pension scheme. You will be part of a team that is interested in your wellbeing and development, and work in an environment where you can flourish.

If you are interested in working for SBHA and being part of a team providing a first-class service to the Association’s owned homes and properties in the area, please view job description and person specification before completing your application, and ensure your application demonstrates how you meet the essential criteria for the role.

title: RN Clinic - Eye Clinic - Full Time
description:
The Broadlawns Medical Center campus includes an acute care hospital, primary and specialty care clinics, urgent care and emergency services, lab, radiology, dentistry, inpatient and outpatient mental health, crisis team, and community-based behavioral support services. Broadlawns accepts all forms of insurance and its approach to healthcare and quality outcomes earned a Level 3 rating from the National Committee for Quality Assurance, the highest achievable status for a medical delivery model.

We are a safety net hospital and our Patients are our North Star! With a dedicated staff of over 160 physicians and 1,600 employees, Broadlawns Medical Center ensures that our community has access to high quality healthcare that is coordinated, compassionate and cost-effective. We provide our employees a top-rated benefits package, supportive work culture, and more!

Clinic Registered Nurse - Eye Clinic

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Registered Nurse (RN), Eye Clinic Procedure Nurse reports directly to the Eye Clinic Supervisor and supports the safe, efficient delivery of procedural eye care in both the operating room and clinic setting. This position accompanies the ophthalmologist in the operating room, assists with patient preparation and procedural support, and performs approved procedures in the clinic under the supervision of the ophthalmologist.

SCHEDULE

Full Time, M-F, 8A-4:30P

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

  • Works collaboratively and communicates professionally with the ophthalmologist, Eye Clinic Supervisor, providers, surgical team members, clinic staff, patients, families, and other departments to ensure coordinated, timely, and safe patient care and to promote a positive team environment. Assesses patients prior to procedures or surgery, including review of relevant clinical information, patient/family interview, observation, and input from other members of the health care team.

  • Performs and documents clinic intake data collection, including chief complaint, allergies, vital signs, weight, basic health history, identified learning considerations, and discharge planning needs as appropriate for the visit.

  • Collects, categorizes, and interprets age-related physical, psychosocial, and cultural data to develop an individualized plan of care in accordance with applicable standards, Medical Center policies, Nursing Services expectations, regulatory requirements, professional practice standards, and state law.

  • Serves as a patient advocate, resource, and contact person by providing patient education, emotional support, and reassurance to help address patient and family questions or concerns before, during, and after procedures or surgery.

  • Prepares examination, procedure, or operating room areas by gathering supplies, verifying equipment readiness, anticipating the needs of the ophthalmologist and care team, and assisting the provider with examinations and procedures.

  • Verifies patient identity, procedure, consent, and operative or procedural site in accordance with established safety standards and protocols. Plans, supervises, and assists with patient transfer and positioning to support access to the operative or procedural site while maximizing patient safety, comfort, and injury prevention.

  • Establishes and maintains a clean, safe, and sterile environment by applying principles of aseptic technique, antisepsis, decontamination, disinfection, sanitation, sterilization, and environmental monitoring.

  • Monitors the patient’s physiological and psychological status and the procedure environment, implementing safety procedures as needed to protect the patient and health care team.

  • Coordinates support service needs during procedures or surgery by anticipating, communicating, and responding to patient and surgical team needs.

  • Administers medications and intravenous solutions within scope of practice and applicable orders, performs lab or diagnostic testing as ordered, reports critical values to the provider, and evaluates and documents patient response and effectiveness.

  • Uses universal precautions when obtaining specimens and delivering patient care; performs applicable point-of-care or clinic-based testing, completes required quality controls, and maintains laboratory or diagnostic testing documentation and logs.

  • Documents nursing assessments, interventions, medications, patient responses, safety precautions, and other nursing activities to support continuity of care, quality improvement, and professional accountability.

  • Evaluates the effectiveness of care provided by the perioperative or procedural care team and communicates changes or concerns to the ophthalmologist and appropriate team members.

  • Participates in performance improvement activities and supports the development, review, and revision of clinic policies, procedures, workflows, and standards related to patient care and procedural services.

  • Participates in orientation, training, credentialing support, and ongoing education of new employees and serves as a clinical resource to other staff within the eye clinic and procedural care environment.

  • Performs approved eye clinic procedures under the supervision of the ophthalmologist, following established clinical protocols, scope of practice, infection prevention standards, and patient safety requirements.

  • Prepares and maintains the eye clinic procedure area, equipment, instruments, medications, and supplies to support safe, efficient, economical, and compliant clinic-based procedures, appropriate patient flow, and a clean and safe care environment.

  • Responds efficiently in emergency situations by following established protocols, maintaining patient safety, and communicating promptly with the care team.

  • Acts in a professional manner consistent with the Medical Center’s mission and maintains ongoing understanding of corporate compliance expectations, policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and professional standards.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Current RN license recognized by the State of Iowa Board of Nursing.

  • Certification in Basic Life Support (Health Care Provider), within 6 months of hire.

  • 1 year of experience in a perioperative or procedural setting.

Work Shift

8a-4:30p (United States of America)

Benefits (FT/PT)

  • Retirement - IPERS

  • Education Assistance

  • Employee Health & Wellness

  • PTO

  • Free Parking

  • Health Insurance

  • Supplemental Insurance

  • 529 College Savings Plan

  • And more!

title: Construction Supervisor - Network
description:
Job Type: Full-Time l Location: Sweetwater, TX l Department: Construction l Reporting to: Associate Director, Construction | Work Location: #onsite

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

The Construction Supervisor - Network is a career-advancing opportunity for experienced low-voltage and network infrastructure professionals ready to take ownership of complex, mission-critical data center projects. In this role, you’ll lead the installation and integration of structured cabling, fiber optic systems, and network hardware that form the backbone of high-performance computing environments. You’ll supervise field teams and subcontractors, coordinate across electrical, mechanical, and IT disciplines, and ensure all work meets stringent design, safety, and industry standards. If you’re a technically strong network professional looking to elevate your career into a leadership role with greater visibility, responsibility, and impact, this position places you at the forefront of next-generation, renewable-powered data center construction.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise and coordinate daily activities of subcontractors and technicians installing network infrastructure, including structured cabling, fiber optic systems, and related equipment.
  • Review construction drawings, specifications, and work packages to ensure installations meet design standards and client requirements.
  • Monitor progress against the project schedule and provide status updates to the Construction Manager or Project Manager.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks to confirm adherence to industry standards (e.g., TIA/EIA, BICSI), safety protocols, and company procedures.
  • Oversee material deliveries, equipment staging, and inventory tracking for network components.
  • Troubleshoot field issues and provide technical guidance to subcontractors as needed.
  • Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and IT teams to ensure proper integration of network systems within the overall data center build-out.
  • Maintain documentation of completed work, inspections, and change orders.
  • Support commissioning and testing activities to validate system performance prior to handover.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required; an associate degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering Technology, Construction Management, or Information Technology is preferred. A bachelor’s degree is advantageous for candidates overseeing larger teams or complex projects. Equivalent military or trade school experience in low-voltage systems or network infrastructure will also be considered.

title: Dozer Operator
description:
Dozer Operator
Fort McMurray, Alberta | Full-Time, Rotational
Heavy Equipment Operation / Earthworks and Reclamation | Experienced | 14/7 Rotation

Position TypeFull-Time, Rotational
LocationFort McMurray, Alberta (oil sands sites north of the city)
Schedule14 days on, 7 days off
Hours12 hour shifts, day and night rotation
Compensation$29.00 to $40.00 per hour, based on verified seat time
ExperienceVerifiable oil sands or heavy civil seat time required
CertificationCSO or CSTS-20, H2S Alive, Standard First Aid, valid Class 5 licence
AccommodationsCamp room and board provided. Travel covered from Edmonton or Fort McMurray.
EquipmentCrawler dozers, D6 through D11 class (Cat and Komatsu). GPS machine control is an asset.
About GrizzlyTrek Group Ltd.
GrizzlyTrek Group is a Technical Workforce and Indigenous Employment Partner. We recruit skilled trades across Canada's industrial sector and place them with reputable employers offering long term work, fair pay, and room to advance. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and proudly support Indigenous employment.
The Role
GrizzlyTrek is hiring experienced dozer operators to join our valued client's team on oil sands sites near Fort McMurray, Alberta. This is a full time rotational position on a 14 days on, 7 days off schedule, paying $29.00 to $40.00 per hour based on verified seat time. Camp room and board is provided and travel is covered, with pickup from Edmonton or Fort McMurray.
You will be pushing overburden and muskeg, building and maintaining haul roads, prepping pads and lease sites, and working reclamation and tailings areas. Machines run from D6 class up to D10 and D11 depending on the job. Work runs year round, so you are moving wet ground in the spring and frost in the winter on the same sites.
What You'll Do
  • Push overburden, muskeg, and sand on mine and construction spreads, holding grade and slope
  • Cut, crown, and maintain haul roads and access roads so truck traffic keeps moving
  • Build and level pads, lease sites, and laydown areas to stakes, laser, or GPS machine control
  • Rip frost and hardpan and work wet or soft ground without getting the machine stuck
  • Support reclamation and tailings work, including topsoil placement and contouring
  • Complete daily walkarounds, pre-trip inspections, and greasing before the machine moves
  • Take part in pre-job safety meetings, hazard assessments, and toolbox talks each shift
What You Bring
  • Verifiable dozer seat time in oil sands, mining, or heavy civil construction
  • Able to hold grade and slope without someone standing over you
  • Comfortable working around haul truck and shovel traffic, days and nights
  • Valid Class 5 licence and reliable transportation to the pickup point
  • Current CSO or CSTS-20, H2S Alive, and Standard First Aid
  • Able to pass a pre-access drug and alcohol test and live in camp on a 14 and 7 rotation
Preferred Qualifications
  • GPS machine control experience (Trimble or Topcon)
  • Time on large iron, D10 and D11 class
  • Previous oil sands site orientation already on file
Work Environment
  • Active oil sands mine and construction sites north of Fort McMurray, worked year round in all weather.
  • Camp accommodation with room and board provided. Travel to and from site is covered, with pickup from Edmonton or Fort McMurray.
  • 12 hour shifts on a rotating day and night schedule across a 14 days on, 7 days off rotation.
  • Site access requires a clear pre-access drug and alcohol test and a completed site orientation before your first shift.
What We Offer
  • Camp room and board provided for the full rotation
  • Travel to and from site covered, with pickup from Edmonton or Fort McMurray
  • Year round work rather than a single seasonal spread
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • Opportunities for overtime based on operational requirements
  • Life insurance: $100,000 employee / $10,000 spouse / $5,000 per child
  • AD&D insurance with critical illness and cancer coverage
  • Extended health care: drugs, hospital, hearing, orthotics, nursing
  • Paramedical services: chiro, physio, massage, mental health (annual coverage)
  • Vision care: glasses, contacts, laser surgery, and exams
  • Dental care: 80% basic ($2,500), 50% major ($2,500), $2,500 ortho for children
  • Travel insurance: up to $5,000,000 per incident (trips up to 90 days)
  • Ongoing training and career development support

Got verifiable dozer seat time and want a 14 and 7 with camp and travel covered? Apply today at www.grizzlytrekgroup.com. Qualified candidates will be contacted quickly.
Apply now at www.grizzlytrekgroup.com

title: Teamlead Data & Cybersecurity
description:
Je bent primair een leider die zijn of haar kracht haalt uit het begeleiden van teams in een organisatie die in beweging is. Je hebt ervaring met verandering en weet hoe je richting geeft zonder in de inhoud te duiken. Je creëert rust en overzicht en zorgt dat mensen weten waar ze naartoe werken.

Je neemt mensen mee in een transitie door helder te communiceren, verwachtingen uit te spreken en consequent te zijn in keuzes. Je stuurt op samenwerking tussen teams en zorgt voor verbinding met de business. Je bent zichtbaar, benaderbaar en duidelijk in wat je vraagt en wat je teruggeeft.

Je hebt affiniteit met data, IT en cybersecurity. Daardoor stel je de juiste vragen en maak je goede afwegingen, zonder zelf de specialist te hoeven zijn. Je richt je op het versterken van teams, het aanbrengen van structuur en het realiseren van duurzame verbeteringen. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen strategie en operatie en weet wat nodig is om een organisatie stap voor stap verder te brengen.

Jouw domeinverantwoordelijkheid

Data & Analytics

Je zorgt voor betrouwbare en hoogwaardige dataproducten en datastromen tussen IT systemen en OT platformen. Je helpt het team bij het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van datamodellen, dashboards en analyses en borgt datakwaliteit, eigenaarschap en standaarden binnen de organisatie.

Security & Compliance

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de regie op cybersecurity en compliance binnen IT en OT. Je helpt het team bij het maken van risicoanalyses, maatregelen en verbeterinitiatieven in lijn met corporate beleid. Je zorgt dat security structureel wordt meegenomen in de executie en dagelijkse operationele activiteiten aangaande veranderingen, besluitvorming en dagelijkse operatie.

Jouw rol in de praktijk

Leiderschap en teams

  • Je bouwt aan sterke, professionele teams die verdeeld zijn over verschillende locaties. In totaal heb je tussen de 5 - 10 direct reports. Je zorgt hierbij voor een open en veilige cultuur.
  • Je coacht collega’s in hun ontwikkeling en stimuleert samenwerking en kennisdeling.
  • Je bewaakt planning, capaciteit en prioriteiten en signaleert knelpunten tijdig.
  • Je verbindt teams met elkaar en met productie en business.

Structuur en volwassenheid

  • Je brengt duidelijkheid in rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en werkwijzen.
  • Je verhoogt de volwassenheid van de domeinen op het gebied van processen, standaarden en governance.
  • Je faciliteert projectmatig werken en continue verbetering.
  • Je verwijdert blokkades en bewaakt focus en voortgang.

Realisatie en borging

  • Je coördineert data en security initiatieven van intake tot implementatie.
  • Je bewaakt kwaliteit, risico’s en samenhang.
  • Je zorgt dat wijzigingen veilig, zorgvuldig en compliant worden doorgevoerd.
  • Je borgt documentatie en overdracht naar beheer.
  • HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau
  • Je vertaalt strategie naar resultaat, bouwt aan een sterke cultuur en helpt mensen én de organisatie groeien in een continu veranderende omgeving.
  • Ervaring met het aansturen, coachen of begeleiden teams. Liefst in het domein van data, security of IT / OT teams.
  • Affiniteit met data, security of IT / OT
  • Ervaring met het verhogen van volwassenheid binnen teams of domeinen.
  • Ervaring met agile werken is een pre echter ervaring met projectmatig werken is een must.
  • Je communiceert helder in het Nederlands en Engels. Duits is mooi meegenomen.
  • Bereidheid om zo nu en dan een productielocatie te bezoeken.
  • Een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die midden in een digitale transformatie zit.
  • Een salaris tussen €4.700 en €6.200 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.
  • 48 vrije dagen per jaar.
  • Een 13e maand.
  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling met 3% eigen bijdrage.

title: Technical Service Engineer
description:
This key Depot service support position requires an advanced Technical Engineer based skillset. Demonstrates the capability to perform advanced troubleshooting and repair of electronic mechanical equipment, and document best practices. Designs and creates test fixtures for full Quality Control of repaired product. The incumbent will be responsible to address difficult and or new technical depot service issues, as well as support depot teamwork, create technical procedures and train and develop technicians accordingly. This role engages technical writing projects by providing best practice technical procedures. Promotes teamwork and participates in regular meetings building teamwork and shares technical knowledge openly and co-ordinates repairs and develops new procedures as required. This role supports Quality Control and Leads test fixture creation and supports all fixture maintenance on existing fixtures to ensure fixture proper function - all for consistent Quality Control of Parts Reworks and Unit Repairs. Interacts with Manager for key projects as assigned. May be assigned special projects to support evolving department needs and utilize knowledge and experience to train and develop depot staff. May be assigned Projects requiring Travel for new depot site Set up and support and provides training at assigned sites and addresses. Openly shares best practice technical information for the team. Models Safety behavior in the Service Depot environment. Must be diplomatic, tactful and able to build team relationships. May engage ISO related or Continuous Improvement projects.

Responsibilities

Essential functions:

Job duties to include but are not limited to.

  • This Engineering role will create Test Fixtures to ensure full Quality Control of Reworked Parts
  • This Engineering role will diagnose and resolve electronic related failures
  • This Engineering role works with Technicians to support resolve issues and identify best practices
  • Works with Schematics and Technical Drawings to produce Fixtures
  • Develops and writes Technical Procedures for Fixture use
  • Provides regular maintenance of the Fixtures to ensure working order, and corrects as needed
  • Provides data summaries as requested
  • Troubleshoot and repair NV parts for RW orders at the Depot
  • Lead the technical training effort of depot technicians
  • Identify replacement EOL components needed for Rework processes
  • Develop new service procedures as necessary, for assemblies and components, and Smiths Product
  • Evolve new service procedures as necessary with emphasis on Quality Control
  • Complete all associated data entry / paperwork and documentation as necessary for Service
  • Complete all associated paperwork and documentation, including Quality Assurance Checklists
  • Helps maintain accurate Service Inventory, follows process and collaborates with team
  • Data Entry of all pertinent information into Service Management System
  • Data Entry to track Rework Cycles and any quality issues
  • Support all safety practices and initiatives, identify and report Safety issues
  • May be assigned cost savings or process improvement related projects
  • May be assigned to support Technical Set Up Projects in new depots requiring significant Travel
  • May be assigned to work load needs as necessary including units harvesting work

  • Technical Degree desired or extensive electronics and mechanical related experience.
  • Strong electronics service experience
  • Strong manual dexterity and ability to use small hand tools
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Presentation skills for Training
  • Strong technical problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of advanced electronics and mechanical assemblies
  • Ability to read blueprints and schematics
  • Must be diplomatic, tactful and understand the importance of team work
  • ISO related experience or Continuous Improvement or Lean methodology a plus

  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Access, and Outlook). Ability to produce technical reports and summaries. Knowledge of software and firmware for electronics. Python, PLC, FPGA and similar skills for electronics desired. Must be flexible and team oriented.

We offer…

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

Join us and work for a world-leader, with the benefits and training to reward your dedication and skills. Be part of a team where we are making the world a safer place.

Pratt & Whitney is working to once again transform the future of flight—designing, building and servicing engines unlike any the world has ever seen. And because transformation begins from within, we’re seeking the people to drive it. So, calling all curious.

Bring your passion and commitment and we’ll welcome you into a tight-knit team that takes our mission personally. Channel your drive to make a difference into shaping an organization and an industry that’s evolving fast to the future.

This is a 2nd Shift Opportunity. This is Monday - Friday , 3:30pm-11:30pm. 8 hour shifts

This position is designed to give individuals with little or no machining or grinding background the skills they need to become a Certified Operator at Pratt & Whitney.

Employees selected for this position will attend a 3-week training program and participate in 4-8 weeks of the on the job training.

Learn to set up and operate NC milling/grinding machines, vertical turret lathes or VTC’s to perform routine production operations on a variety of similar weldments and assemblies.

Obtain operator Certification to be able to accept/reject parts.

Learn to maintain machines by performing required total preventive maintenance (TPM)

Learn to work collaboratively with engineers, quality assurance, programmers and other production personnel or others to resolve machining problems and assist in part process development.

Skills, systems, and processes critical to aerospace manufacturing within a stat of the art facility.

Training and advancement opportunities at all levels through a supportive and collaborative employee experience.

On -the -job training using the most advanced technology in the industry today.

title: NKY Sports Contributor
description:
LINK Media is looking for Sports Contributors to help us deliver high school sports news coverage. We need folks who would like a contract, part-time engagement, covering specific teams or beats. We're a startup, so everyone we engage is a critical part of the team, and must be willing to work quickly, accept that we don't have everything figured out, remain flexible, and above all else, understand that what we are creating is bigger than any one person, or personality.

Compensation: Set pay rates for games covered/stories written

What We Expect from You:

  • Manage assigned stories and enterprise/pitch additional stories in your areas of interest
  • Publish digital and multimedia reports and creative stories
  • Accept assignments and follow up on news tips
  • Strong journalistic integrity and creativity
  • Maintain notes and audio recordings from stories/sources for review when necessary
  • Work in collaboration with managing editor and chief content officer

Skills We Need You to Have:

  • Experience or education as sports reporter
  • Strong writing and speaking skills
  • Multimedia knowledge (websites, photo, audio, video editing)

What You Can Expect from Us:

  • Bi-weekly pay for stories published
  • Editorial support and management to help you grow as a writer
  • Flexibility - write for us without having to keep full-time hours
  • Opportunities for growth and advancement, if you want them

You'll Need to Share Our Mission and Uphold Our Guiding Principles

Mission: With a focus on the public interest, LINK Media advances the Northern Kentucky Metro in the region, the commonwealth and the nation by providing transformative coverage of the news of the day with focus on the deeper issues that matter most to our community.

Guiding Principles:

We are:

Solutions-Focused: We don’t just report the news of the day. We dig deeper, informing our audience about how our community might solve its biggest issues.

Unapologetic NKY Fans: We believe in this community—in what it is today, and what it has the potential to become. We want to see this community advance, and we understand the part that we play in that advancement.

Inclusive: We explore the issues that affect all of Northern Kentucky, and give a voice to all segments of our diverse community.

Good Stewards: It is our responsibility to make good use of our resources and to maintain a sustainable business model, so that we may serve the community long into the future.

Independent: The publication does not make endorsements, or publish our own opinions, about the issues that are facing Northern Kentucky. description:

As our Influencer Marketing Coordinator, you will be responsible for the smooth execution of influencer marketing campaigns. H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

title: Myyjä Synsam Seppä -liikkeeseen Jyväskylään!
description:
Hei sinä valovoimainen myyntistara!

Jatkamme kasvua etsimme nyt vakituiseen työsuhteeseen HUIPPUMYYJÄÄ Jyväskylässä kauppakeskus Sepässä sijaitsevaan Synsam Seppä -optikkoliikkeeseen!

Oletko koskaan miettinyt toimivasi alalla, jossa yhdistyy muoti, tyyli, terveys ja laatu? Haluatko olla auttamassa ihmisiä antamalla vinkkejä ja ratkaisuja sekä näkemiseen että tyyliin liittyvissä kysymyksissä? Onko sinulle sydämen asia, että asiakas lähtee liikkeestä iloisena ja uudistuneena? Jos vastasit kyllä, olet todennäköisesti hakemamme henkilö!

Mitä etsimme

Etsimme huippumyyjää, jolla on erinomaiset sosiaaliset taidot, ja joka on kaupallinen, sanavalmis, sekä reipas ja energinen. Inspiroidut ja olet parhaimmillasi muodin, tyylin ja myynnin maailmassa. Olet tähtiainesta ja haluat ylittää odotukset:

  • Olet tuloshakuinen ja tavoitteellinen

  • Olet kilpailuhenkinen ja asetat tavoitteet korkealle

  • Näet mahdollisuuksia ja nautit, kun asiat tapahtuvat

  • Olet innovatiivinen ja luot positiivista fiilistä ympärillesi

Olet loistava asiakaspalvelija, etkä ujostele lähestyä asiakkaita, kartoittaa heidän tarpeitaan ja ehdottaa rohkeitakin ratkaisuja, ensisijaisesti toki erinomaista Lifestyle-sopimustamme. Toimit sujuvasti suomen, ruotsin ja englannin kielillä, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksesi. Motivoidut monipuolisista optikkoliikkeen tehtävistä. Ei haittaa, vaikkei sinulla olisi alan kokemusta, me perehdytämme sinut työhön!

Mitä tarjoamme

Synsam on tunnettu rennosta, nuorekkaasta ilmapiiristä sekä kannustavasta, mahdollistavasta johtamiskulttuurista. Meillä pääset osaksi iloista ja asiantuntevaa tiimiä, ja saat mielekkään ja monipuolisen tehtävän nopeasti kasvavassa ja kehittyvässä kansainvälisessä yrityksessä, jossa arvomme, asiakas on ykkönen, vastuullisuus ja innovatiivisuus, näkyvät arjen tekoina.

Tarjoamme sinulle mm.:

  • Edenredin lounas-, virike- ja hierontaedun

  • Mehiläisen kattavat työterveyspalvelut

  • Kansainvälisen ketjun koulutus- ja uramahdollisuudet

  • Loistavat henkilöstöedut

  • Ja paljon muuta!

Palkkaus tehtävässä on n. 2200-3000 e/kk pohjautuen kaupan työehtosopimukseen ja riippuen mm. aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Työ on kokoaikainen n. 37,5 h/vko, ja työajat sijoittuvat liikkeen aukioloaikojen mukaisesti. Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva (vakituinen) ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan syksyllä 2026.

Tunnistitko itsesi?

Siinä tapauksessa esittele itsesi lähettämällä hakemuksesi ja CV palkkatoivomuksineen mahdollisimman pian työpaikkailmoituksen kautta kohdasta "Jätä hakemus tästä", kuitenkin viimeistään 20.9.2026. Pyrimme käsittelemään hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, ja olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakijoihin rekrytointiprosessin edetessä. Etenemme rekrytoinnissa mahdollisesti heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten kannattaa lähettää hakemus mahdollisimman pian!

Tarvittaessa lisäkysymyksiin vastaavat myymäläpäällikkö Sessi Nieminen (4.10.26 jälkeen), sessi.nieminen@synsam.fi ja aluejohtaja Eveliina Jalkanen (välillä 26.8.-3.10.26), eveliina.jalkanen@synsam.fi.

Huomioithan ystävällisesti, että vastaanotamme työhakemukset vain hakusivun kautta. Ethän siis lähetä työhakemustasi sähköpostitse, kiitos.

Katso myös

Vuonna 1968 perustettu Synsam Group on yksi Euroopan johtavia optisen vähittäiskaupan ketjuja ja tarjoaa laajan valikoiman ainutlaatuisia silmänterveyden ja silmälasimuodin ratkaisuja, jotka rakentuvat asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja elämäntyylin mukaisesti. Synsam-ketjussa työskentelee Pohjoismaissa n. 4000 ammattilaista ja sen liikevaihto on n. 6,6 miljardia SEK. Ketjuun kuuluu 600 optikkoliikettä, jotka toimivat Synsamin, AI Eyewear ja Tanskassa Profil Optikin brändien alla. Synsam Group on onnistunut toiminnan digitalisoinnin ja innovatiivisten konseptien kautta saavuttamaan toimialansa parasta kasvua ja kannattavuutta Euroopassa.
