title: Commercial Strategy Consultant, Life Sciences
description:
Commercial Strategy Consultant, Life Sciences (Internally Title Referred to as: Business Acceleration Partner)
Full-Time / Permanent

ABOUT ODAIA
ODAIA noun
o·da·ia | \ 'oh-day-yeah \
An Ancient Greek word referring to “ ōdē”, the word for song, and the root of melody, harmony, and orchestra. We chose it deliberately: the best commercial intelligence doesn't just inform it orchestrates.

To learn more visit .

ODAIA delivers AI-powered commercial intelligence for life sciences - unifying data, accelerating results, and helping commercial teams deepen engagement to enhance care for providers and patients. ODAIA's AI platform transforms complex data into predictive, personalized insights, enabling commercial leaders to understand their customers, anticipate prescribing behaviors, and make the informed, strategic decisions that bring therapies to patients faster.

OUR MISSION

Reducing patients’ time to therapy by facilitating meaningful interactions with healthcare providers, through human-centric software powered by AI.

WHAT’S ON OFFER

Reporting to the Director, Business Acceleration, the Commercial Strategy Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and analytical partner to ODAIA's pharma and life sciences clients - bridging the gap between commercial strategy and data-driven execution.

In this role, you will translate complex market dynamics, brand strategies, and commercial data into structured, insight-led recommendations that directly influence how clients deploy their salesforces, engage HCPs, and bring therapies to patients faster. You'll lead structured engagements across the client lifecycle - from initial discovery through ongoing strategic planning - and be counted on to deliver clear, hypothesis-driven analysis and actionable roadmaps.

This is the right role for you if you thrive on unstructured problem-solving, bring a consultant's rigor to every engagement, and are energized by translating data into strategy for senior commercial stakeholders in life sciences.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Lead with a Consultant Mindset
  • Define project scope, develop structured approaches, and guide clients through complex commercial challenges
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven analysis - framing the problem, designing the analytical approach, and synthesizing findings into clear recommendations
  • Communicate with BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front) clarity to both technical and executive audiences
  • Understand the strategic "why" behind client requests and translate ambiguous business needs into coherent analytical plans
Deliver Strategy, Insights & Commercial Planning
  • Design and execute qualitative and quantitative analyses to address brand strategy, market sizing, segmentation, and commercial effectiveness questions
  • Synthesize findings from primary research, secondary data sources, and ODAIA's AI platform into integrated, insight-rich deliverables
  • Support pipeline strategy and launch planning - including competitive landscaping, opportunity sizing, go-to-market frameworks, and targeting strategy
  • Enable Dynamic Targeting and Segmentation to sharpen commercial execution and HCP engagement
  • Define success metrics, track ROI, and present findings through structured QBRs and executive briefings
Apply Data & Analytical Depth
  • Assess client data maturity, workflows, and analytics infrastructure to design fit-for-purpose solutions
  • Leverage health and claims data, prescribing data, and market research to build robust, insight-driven analyses
  • Interpret and apply prescribing metrics - including NBRx (New-to-Brand Prescriptions) and TRx (Total Prescriptions) datasets to assess brand performance, track launch trajectories, and identify HCP targeting opportunities
  • Ensure compliance with data quality, privacy, and regulatory standards across all deliverables
  • Bring working knowledge of omnichannel strategy, Next Best Action (NBA) orchestration, and AI-enabled CRM workflows (Veeva/Salesforce)
Drive Engagement & Account Success
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships across commercial, analytics, and leadership stakeholders at client organizations
  • Align cross-functional touchpoints between the client and ODAIA to ensure consistent strategic direction
  • Proactively identify growth opportunities and surface value throughout the customer lifecycle
Manage Structured, High-Impact Projects
  • Lead requirements gathering, solution design, and project governance across multi-workstream engagements
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies while running effective, outcome-driven client meetings and workshops
  • Liaise with internal ODAIA teams (Engineering, Product, Sales) to translate client feedback into platform and roadmap priorities
Enable Change & Adoption
  • Drive organizational and process change within client commercial teams, supporting transitions to data-driven decision-making
  • Educate stakeholders on analytical methodologies, best practices, and ODAIA's AI-powered capabilities
  • Ensure successful onboarding from sales handoff through sustained adoption and value realization

WHAT YOU BRING
  • 5+ years in management consulting, strategy, or a client-facing analytics role — ideally within life sciences, pharma, or healthcare (e.g., Engagement Manager, Consultant, etc.)
  • Strong command of commercial pharma: brand strategy, market access, launch planning, competitive intelligence, or commercial excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, design rigorous analyses, and synthesize findings into actionable recommendations
  • Experience leading multi-stakeholder engagements with a high degree of independence and accountability
  • Exceptional communication skills - able to craft compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proficiency in analytical tools (Excel, Access, or equivalent); hands-on experience with prescribing datasets such as NBRx, TRx, and NRx; familiarity with visualization platforms (Tableau, PowerBI) and life sciences data sources (IQVIA, Symphony, claims data)
  • Exposure to AI-powered platforms, predictive analytics, or digital commercial tools is a strong asset
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, life sciences, engineering, applied mathematics, or a related field
  • Grand vision, low ego, and a genuine drive to make an impact for patients and healthcare systems

WHAT WE OFFER

Values-Based Culture
  • We Ignite Innovation, Own It, and Stand Together
AI-Native Environment
  • At ODAIA, we don't just deliver AI - we live it. We use AI and agentic automation to 10x our efficiency and impact, encouraging constant curiosity in leveraging and integrating AI
Comprehensive Rewards
  • Meaningful stock option grants, immediate medical/dental enrollment, and flexible time off
Remote-First Flexibility
  • WFH flexibility with intentional, high-value in-person collaboration and socials

LOCATION & BUSINESS TRAVEL

ODAIA is a remote first organization, with employees located across Canada and the U.S. Our primary office hub is located in central downtown Toronto and walking distance from Union Station.

This role requires travel within the US and Canada to support strategic customer meetings, industry conferences and internal meetings and offsites.

EMPLOYMENT VERIFICATION

Any conditional offer of employment made to a successful candidate will be subject to the full satisfaction with the results of any background and reference checks.

JOB PROCESS & INTERVIEW DISCLOSURE

ODAIA does not use artificial intelligence (AI) to review applications, filter or analyze resumes.
Our recruitment team may use an AI-powered meeting assistant to record and transcribe interviews for note-taking purposes only. This tool helps our recruiters to be fully present during conversations with candidates who provide consent to this tool being used during an interview. This tool is used in compliance with privacy and employment laws across Canada and the U.S.

We respect the time candidates invest into participating in our recruitment process. ODAIA is committed to providing timely status updates on hiring decisions to all candidates following their final interview, in accordance with applicable employment laws.

Compensation Range:
New Hire - The anticipated base salary for candidates stepping into this role ranges from $130,000 - $135,000 CAD
Experienced - The anticipated base salary for candidates with demonstrated, specialized expertise ranges from $132,000 - $145,000 CAD

Compensation ranges represent ODAIA's good-faith estimate based on current market data and internal equity. Final compensation is determined through a comprehensive review of the successful candidate’s unique skill set, specialized experience, certifications and other relevant considerations. As such, the final offer may vary based on these specific factors. Salary expectations will be discussed collaboratively early in the process to ensure alignment. This role is also eligible for health benefits, stock options, and flexible time off policies as mentioned above.

Position Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

ODAIA is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an environment where everyone feels included, valued, respected and heard. We are committed to creating a diverse workplace, free from discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations or ordinances.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY

Accommodations are available upon request. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us at hr@odaia.ai.

title: Team member QC Micro
description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an individual for the Quality Control team, responsible for the sampling and analysis of water samples, preparation of water reports, and maintenance of microbiological reference cultures. The role includes GLP (Good Laboratory Practices) compliance, trend preparation for water analysis, and various tasks such as media preparation, growth promotion tests, and autoclave operation.

Roles & Responsibilities
• You will be responsible for Sampling & Analysis of water samples and preparation of water reports.
• You will be responsible for maintenance and records of microbiological reference cultures, GLP maintenance and compliance, prepare the trend of water analysis and environment monitoring.
• You will be responsible for the preparation of laboratory reagents, disinfectants, indicators and volumetric solutions.
• You will perform isolation and identification of reference cultures, and environmental and water isolates.
• You will perform media preparation, growth promotion test, autoclave operation, and maintenance of relevant documents.
• You will be responsible for biological indicator stock maintenance and spore enumeration study.

Educational qualification: A Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Biology, or a related field

Minimum work experience: 2 to 5 years of experience in microbiological analysis, preferably in a laboratory setting related to water quality

Skills & attributes:

Technical Skills
• Proficiency in sampling and analysis of water samples, including the preparation of water reports.
• Knowledge about GLP (Good Laboratory Practices) maintenance and compliance, ensuring accurate records and trend analysis for water analysis and environment monitoring.
• Experience in the preparation of laboratory reagents, disinfectants, indicators, and volumetric solutions.
• Skilled in the isolation and identification of reference cultures, as well as environmental and water isolates.
• Proficiency preferred in media preparation, growth promotion tests, autoclave operation, maintenance of relevant documents, maintenance of biological indicator stock and conducting spore enumeration studies.

Behavioural Skills
• Keen attention to detail in microbiological analysis and documentation.
• Organisational skills to manage microbiological reference cultures, laboratory reagents, and related materials efficiently.
• Problem-solving skills for applying in isolation, identification, and other microbiological tasks.
• Collaborates effectively with team members to ensure smooth laboratory operations.
• Effective communication skills for conveying microbiological findings, trends, and reports within the laboratory team.
• Adheres to safety protocols and practices in microbiological analysis, ensuring a safe working environment.

About the Department
Global Manufacturing Organisation (GMO)
At Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, we are dedicated to making a meaningful impact on global healthcare through precision manufacturing and innovation. With a legacy of excellence, we are a leading force in the pharmaceutical industry.
We operate 19 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants across Hyderabad, Vizag, Baddi, Mexico, Shreveport, and Mirfield, comprising 8 OSD facilities, 3 Injectables facilities, and 8 API facilities.
Benchmarking manufacturing processes and continuous operational excellence are at the core of our capability to deliver quality medicines to our patients in 66 countries. We manufacture a portfolio of complex APIs and 1,150+ drug master files across key therapy areas such as Oncology, Cardio-vascular, Central Nervous System and Anti-Diabetes. he World Economic Forum has recognised our largest manufacturing facility in Bachupally, Hyderabad, as part of its Global Lighthouse Network. We aspire to be the most efficient pharma operations in the world. Our productivity improvement and digitalisation efforts are key to staying competitive, meeting business imperatives, and meeting our ambitious ESG goals. Building such ‘factories of the future’ is integral to innovation and to build healthcare of the future.


Benefits Offered
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

Our Work Culture
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/

title: Byggledare inom garantiskötsel och växtlighet
description:
Vi söker en Byggledare inom garantiskötsel och växtlighet till en offentlig aktör med ansvar för trafik- och stadsmiljö.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag. Stationeringsort är Stockholm.

Tjänsten omfattar ca 10 % av en heltid.

Uppdraget innebär ett nära samarbete med kunden vilket ställer stora krav på flexibilitet och samarbetsförmåga.

Uppdraget

I rollen som grön byggledare ansvarar du för byggledning och kontroll av garantiskötsel och underhåll av växtlighet inom ett infrastrukturprojekt. Du följer upp entreprenörens åtaganden under garantitiden och arbetar i nära samarbete med projektledaren. Rollen kräver god kunskap om växtlighet och vad som krävs för växters välmående och tillväxt.

Arbetsuppgifter

Byggleda garantiskötsel och underhåll av växtlighet inom projektet

Kontrollera att entreprenören fullgör sina åtaganden avseende skötsel av växtligheten

Ta beslut om eventuella nödvändiga ändringar av det som föreskrivits

Läsa in och sätta dig in i handlingar som rör växtlighet

Hålla i startmöte för garantiskötseln och föra protokoll

Informera och kommunicera med beställaren

Leda och ansvara för byggledningen av uppdraget samt planera och precisera uppdraget tillsammans med beställaren

Krav (OBS, obligatoriska)

Du ska ha kännedom om stadens handbok ”Växtbäddar i Stockholms stad”.

Du ska ha arbetat som byggledare för mark och anläggningsentreprenader i minst 5 år.

Du ska ha erfarenhet av arbete med grönytor, växt- och trädplantering.

Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

Du har genomgått Stockholm stads utbildning "Trafikanordningar och markarbeten i offentlig mark.

Du har minst fem (5) års erfarenhet av arbete i parkmiljö.

Du har minst fem (5) års erfarenhet av arbete med grönytor, växt- och trädplantering.

Du har erfarenhet av kontroll/byggledning av entreprenörers garantiskötsel av växtlighet, i rollen som byggledare.

Om oss

Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt.

Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov.

Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerad personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet.

För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst.

Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se.

Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: AV & IT Specialist
description:
M+C Saatchi is looking for an AV & IT Specialist to join our IT team in London. This is a hands-on role at the heart of our business, responsible for ensuring our meeting rooms, audio-visual technology, events and IT services run seamlessly across the Group. You'll play a key role in delivering exceptional support to employees, clients and visitors, combining AV expertise, event coordination and IT support to create a smooth and reliable workplace experience.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The AV & IT Specialist will be responsible for delivering efficient operational support across the Group, ensuring high-quality management of meeting rooms, AV equipment, and events both internal and external.

The role requires close collaboration with internal teams, stakeholders, and external suppliers to maintain a best-in-class working environment. This position is critical in supporting compliance, maintaining infrastructure, and driving operational excellence, while also overseeing event coordination for both internal and external engagements.

In addition to AV and event responsibilities, this role also involves providing 1st and 2nd line IT support as needed. This includes resolving service desk tickets, delivering deskside technical assistance, and supporting end users with hardware, software, and system-related issues to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.

What you'll do:

  • Meeting Room Management (Microsoft Teams Rooms) – Monitor, support, check and maintain all meeting rooms. Includes Q-Sys, Logitech, Sennheiser and other similar technologies

  • Event & Pitch Coordination – Lead planning, execution, and support for internal and external events and pitches. Willingness to travel offsite around London to assist the business with pitches and other events

  • Digital Signage & Office Environment Services – Manage audio streaming, events, and presentations across office spaces

  • Equipment Maintenance – Ensure all AV and operational equipment is in working order, reporting faults via onsite procedures

  • Confidentiality & Data Security – Safeguard sensitive materials related to presentations, events, and broadcasts

  • Operations Support – Provide administrative assistance, including responding to requests and tickets, information gathering meetings, and handling inquiries relating to events/pitches/setups

  • AV Setup & Technical Assistance – Assist staff and clients in using fixed and portable AV equipment for meetings and conferences

  • Diary & Calendar Management – Support scheduling of AV services, events, and meetings

  • Asset Management – Maintain operational databases for all AV and Meeting room hardware

  • Daily Operational Support – Act as the IT/AV point of contact for operational event support needs, responding to tickets from end users in an efficient manner

  • AV System Setup & Operation – Lead the setup and management of AV equipment and systems including off-site pitches

  • General IT Support (2nd Line) – Assist with IT support duties including incident response, troubleshooting, imaging devices, user onboarding/offboarding employees, Office 365 admin, and troubleshooting hardware/software issues

  • Work closely with our vendors and suppliers to ensure events and meetings run seamlessly for the organisation

  • Meet regularly with cross-functional teams to ensure all bases are covered for events, off-site pitches and general meeting room functionality

What you'll bring:

  • Expertise in Microsoft Teams Rooms, audio-visual technologies and a CTS certification

  • Deep understanding of IT networks and the technology ‘behind’ the AV equipment, notably QSys, Logitech, network patching/troubleshooting

  • ITIL 4 Foundation Certified or a good understanding of ITIL principles, specifically Incident Management when handling meeting room/end user issues

  • Best-in-class user service and communication with the ability to remove technical jargon when communicating with users

  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 support (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)

  • Hardware diagnostics and troubleshooting (Windows and Mac laptops and peripherals)

  • Windows 11 and macOS support experience

  • Incident and ticket management using tools like ServiceNow or Fresh Service

  • Printer troubleshooting

  • Experience of events and conferences, including operating sound desks, visuals and cameras

  • Hands-on knowledge of the procedures used in the installation, modification, maintenance and repair of IT/AV hardware and software

  • Strong communication skills and ability to build positive relationships

  • A proactive team player, actively contributing to the workplace culture

  • A meticulous attention to detail, somebody who takes pride in their work

  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly in AV and event technologies

What you'll get:

For the right candidate, we will offer a competitive salary and benefits package which includes:

  • 27 days Annual Leave

  • Private Healthcare

  • Employer Contributory Pension

  • Life Assurance and Income Protection.

We also offer a host of benefits that support wellbeing including subsidised gym membership, whilst our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion sees us offer learning opportunities around D&I, mentoring programmes and the opportunity for all to participate in a number of active Employee Led Networks and associated events.

ABOUT M+C SAATCHI GROUP

M+C Saatchi Group has pledged its commitment to create a company that values difference, with an inclusive culture. As part of this M+C Saatchi Group continues to be an Equal Opportunity Employer which does not and shall not discriminate, celebrates diversity and bases all hiring and promotion decisions solely on merit, without regard for any personal characteristics.

If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment and selection process, please make us aware as part of your application.

All employee information is kept confidential according to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

title: Monteur WTB
description:
In deze rol als Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde maak je, onder leiding van de Teamleider Onderhoud WTB, deel uit van het assetteam Sapzuivering en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud aan onze werktuigbouwkundige installaties. Je werkt in dagdienst en draagt samen met je collega’s bij aan een betrouwbare en veilige productieomgeving. Tijdens de productiecampagne werken binnen het team ook collega’s in een 2- of 5-ploegendienst.

Je lokaliseert, analyseert en verhelpt storingen aan onder andere pompen, kleppen, warmtewisselaars en transportsystemen. Daarnaast voer je inspecties, reparaties en revisies uit en zorg je ervoor dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens de geldende kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen blijven functioneren.

Dankzij jouw technische kennis en praktische aanpak lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de continuïteit en prestaties van onze fabriek.

Maar je doet meer dan alleen onderhoud:

  • Je denkt actief mee over verbeteringen aan installaties en processen
  • Je werkt verbetervoorstellen uit en helpt bij de implementatie
  • Je legt alle werkzaamheden en bevindingen vast in SAP
  • Je neemt deel aan verbeterteams en draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van onderhoudsstrategieën
  • Je borgt technische kennis en stuurt externe monteurs aan waar nodig
  • Je kunt onderdeel worden van onze bedrijfsnoodorganisatie, bijvoorbeeld als First Responder
  • Voor deze functie kan deelname aan een consignatierooster van toepassing zijn.

title: Deal Desk / Renewals and Usage Expert
location: Remote (Preference for candidates located within Eastern or Central Time Zones), us
description:
Deal Desk Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior Sales Leadership, the sales community, and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop innovative deal structures, manage risk within contractual terms, and educate the sales team on product bundles and offerings.
  • Improve pricing methodologies and business terms based on data and market knowledge.
  • Provide deal financial modeling and proposal support to senior team members.
  • Offer deal structure guidance and recommendations to Sales, balancing data-driven approaches with creative thinking for strategic accounts.
  • Drive contract execution by collaborating with Sales, Legal, Accounting, and Operations teams.
  • Independently scope and complete project work to meet management goals.
  • Partner with product teams on optimal pricing models and strategies for new products and bundled solutions.
  • Collaborate with Sales leadership to manage month- and quarter-end deal closures.
  • Review and vet sophisticated deals for Strategic Business Practices Management.
  • Develop relationships to understand products, competition, and market trends.
  • Create sales enablement materials to train Sales on pricing and positioning best practices.
  • Work with Finance, Legal, and Operations to optimize contract terms and close deals.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of customers and how they use Unit4 products.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls.
  • Ensure timely delivery of compliant and commercially sound offers with Account Executives.
  • Handle day-to-day transactional deal pricing requests.

Renewals Responsibilities:

Renewal Readiness & Entitlement Compliance:

  • Create renewal quotes and orders to ensure alignment with customer entitlements, contract terms, and usage data.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Deal Desk, and Customer Success to proactively resolve discrepancies in licensing, usage, and contract terms prior to renewal execution.
  • Ensure that all renewal transactions comply with SaaS licensing policies, pricing models, and entitlements.
  • Conduct pre-renewal compliance reviews, verifying that customers are correctly licensed and that any necessary true-ups or adjustments are incorporated into the renewal process.
  • Monitor and enforce Day 1 compliance by ensuring customers have the correct entitlements and access to their subscribed services immediately after renewal

Process Optimization & Stakeholder Collaboration:

  • Act as the liaison between Sales, Deal Desk, Customer Success teams, ensuring all parties have accurate entitlement and usage information before the renewal closes.
  • Identify inefficiencies in renewal processes and recommend improvements to enhance accuracy and reduce manual effort.
  • Collaborate with product and pricing teams to stay up to date on new product, package and price book releases and provide mapping of old contract terms to new packaging options, ensuring alignment with the pricing book.
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system updates that impact renewal processing and entitlement compliance.
  • Support the automation of usage and entitlement validation to streamline the renewal process.
  • Train and support internal teams on best practices related to renewal structuring, compliance checks, and entitlement validation.

Special Projects:

  • Be responsible for short term revenue operations related projects.

Usage & Compliance:

  • The License Compliance Specialist is responsible for creating and driving License Compliance activities across UNIT4’s customers to protect Unit4's Intellectual Property.
  • Other objectives include protecting the value of Unit4’s intellectual property, protecting and enhancing customer relationships, and serving as resident experts of Unit4’s software licensing.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute a product or regional specific compliance engagement strategy and process that balances the protection of Unit4’s intellectual property, customer relationships, revenue recovery, and other cross functional needs
  • Develop and maintain related product use questionnaires to be used during compliance assessments.
  • Review the effectiveness of compliance tools and drive the development of new features and functionality as necessary in order to improve compliance coverage.
  • Identify internal key team members (and maintain these relationships) who will contribute specific technical expertise (database queries, custom reports, product understanding, etc.) for customer compliance assessments.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to assess product, contract, and relationship specific risk factors for each customer engagement. Analyze contractual, financial, and other documentation to understand customer entitlements.
  • Manage customer engagements with primary responsibility for all phases of assessment from initial interactions to close-out of each assessment.
  • Negotiate appropriate resolution of non-compliance issues directly with customer and internal stakeholders.
  • Support customer and internal requests for information related to licensing of Unit4 software products.
  • Maintain an appropriate communication plan with business management and key stakeholders to inform them with details of upcoming audits and assessment results.

General:

Holiday & empty position coverage:

  • Provide support for Revenue Operations Team members along with coverage for roles that we are actively recruiting for.

Deal Desk Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years’ experience in Pricing Strategy, Deal Desk, Bid Management, Commercial Finance, Sales financial analysis, Renewals or relevant experience preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Outstanding analytical background with strong problem-solving skills
  • Great interpersonal skills, including written and verbal communication
  • Ability to build relationships and work collaboratively to get results
  • Capable of explaining concepts clearly and credibly across all levels of the organization
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) in English (French would be a nice-to-have)
  • Ideally, experienced at working in a multinational environment
  • Experience in Dynamics 365 / Dealhub (Or other CPQ tools)

Who we are

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated.

We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

  • a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
  • balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
  • growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
  • talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
  • a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

  • Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are

title: Student – Events & Sampling Crew | Vitamin Well, Barebells & NOCCO
description:
Vitamin Well Group develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.

Vitamin Well Spain is growing fast — and we are looking for students who want to help grow Vitamin Well, Barebells and NOCCO by bringing our brands directly to consumers. Join us alongside your studies and gain hands-on experience working with events, activations and sampling.

We are currently hiring students for our Events & Sampling crew in Madrid and Barcelona, with opportunities in Málaga and Valencia potentially coming up.
About the opportunity

You will represent NOCCO, Vitamin Well and Barebells across your city, bringing our products directly to consumers through sampling, events and activations. Working closely with our local team, you will take responsibility on the ground and help make sure our brands show up with the right energy wherever we meet consumers.

You will:

  • Bring our brands to consumers: Represent NOCCO, Vitamin Well and Barebells through sampling and activations across your city

  • Connect with people: Approach and engage consumers, introduce our products and create positive interactions with our brands

  • Support events and activations: Take part in events, pop-ups, collaborations and other local brand activities

  • Know what you represent: Build strong brand and product knowledge and communicate it naturally and confidently

  • Take ownership: Work responsibly on the ground, take initiative and adapt when plans change

The essentials:

  • Part-time student position, approximately 20 hours per week

  • You must be currently enrolled in studies and able to combine the role with your studies

  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends when our events and activations take place

  • Valid driver’s licence

What you can expect

  • Learn by doing: Gain hands-on experience across sampling, events and brand activations while completing your studies

  • Take real responsibility: Work independently on activations and represent our brands directly with consumers

  • Grow with us: Become part of a fast-growing team, build your network and gain experience that can create opportunities for the future

Who you are

  • Outgoing and confident, comfortable approaching new people and starting conversations throughout the day

  • Energetic and engaging, bringing positive energy to the people around you

  • Proactive and comfortable taking initiative and making things happen

  • Reliable and responsible, showing up prepared and following through on commitments

  • Genuinely interested in our brands and the world of sports, wellness, events and active lifestyles

How to Apply

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.

Life at Vitamin Well Group

At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.

Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.

Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.

As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.

title: Front End Developer Sr - TS required to apply - Wash DC + Hybrid
description:

You will lead the development of scalable, high‑performance front‑end solutions using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and AWS‑hosted environments, ensuring seamless integration with .NET back‑end services. In this role, you will mentor mid‑level developers, set engineering standards, and champion best practices in code quality, accessibility, and performance. Drawing on deep technical expertise and strong problem‑solving skills, you will help guide architectural decisions, drive continuous improvement, and ensure front‑end components operate effectively within enterprise‑grade systems.

•Architect modular, maintainable, and scalable UI component libraries aligned with modern engineering standards
•Mentor and provide technical guidance to mid level and junior frontend developers, including reviewing code, coaching on best practices, and supporting skill development
•Integrate frontend applications with backend .NET services using REST APIs, JSON, and XML

•Promote a culture of high-quality engineering through code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions

•Partner with teams to ensure frontend solutions meet accessibility, security, and performance requirements
•Review code and container scans and remediate both code and package vulnerabilities on a regular basis.
What you'll need:
•8+ years of experience developing modern frontend applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js
•Advanced experience building UI components with HTML, CSS, Sass, and responsive design frameworks
•Strong experience integrating with REST APIs and working with JSON and XML data formats
•Proficiency with Git and GitLab for source control, collaboration, and code review workflows
•Ability to design, refactor, and maintain scalable frontend architectures in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
•Deep understanding of frontend performance optimization, browser behavior, debugging techniques, and application profiling
•Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and lead best-practice discussions across the engineering team
•Experience building cloud-native solutions in AWS
•Experience with YAML and CI/CD pipeline development (GitLab CI preferred)
•Experience with package scan vulnerability remediation
•Experience with integration with .NET APIs or full stack environments
•Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical decisions and collaborate with cross-functional teams

Bonus points if you have:
•Experience with automated UI testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress)
•Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG)
•Familiarity with JFrog Artifactory
•Familiarity with Jira for DevOps

title: Food Sourcing and Acquisition Specialist - Midlands
description:
About Harvest Hope Food Bank

Embark on a fulfilling journey at Harvest Hope Food Bank, where your talents play a vital role in our mission to end hunger. As the largest hunger-relief organization in South Carolina, serving 20 counties, we annually distribute 30 million pounds of food across the Midlands, Pee Dee, and Upstate regions. Our dynamic nonprofit values innovation, collaboration, and diversity, offering a uniquely rewarding experience for employees dedicated to making a meaningful difference in their communities. Join our dedicated team in building a hunger-free tomorrow through active engagement with nearly 400 partner agencies. Together, we strive to address food insecurity and positively impact lives across the state.

Logistics & Work Environment:

This full-time position is based at our Midlands (Columbia) Branch. This role will require travel and active engagement within the community to support various initiative and building meaningful connections.

The hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00am - 4:00 pm, totaling 37.5 hours per week.

Occasionally, the role requires responding to organizational needs outside of normal working hours.

A Day in the Life:

The Food Sourcing and Acquisition Specialist formulates strategy and develops plans to solicit food and other products from the food industry including manufacturers, distributors, and supermarkets. This position is responsible for assisting in securing a steady flow of food donations from local food donors by cultivating existing relationships by developing new relationships with and between local network partners and food donors.

  • Develops and cultivates new food donors including retailers, restaurants, cafeterias (schools, hospitals, etc.), and Specialty Ethic locations throughout the HHFB network to ensure food donation percentage increases annually.
  • Cultivates current food donors with the goal of receiving more pounds per donation and more frequent donations, preventing a percentage of attrition.
  • Collaborates with Operations to make the most efficient use of transportation and other logistics needed for handling donations.
  • Provides required monthly, quarterly, and annual reports as required by food donors, FANO, USDA, and HHFB.
  • Develops and maintains donor recognition program and awards for major food donors.
  • Provides oversight and communication of product recall program.
  • Determines form and frequency of solicitations and develops a system of donor tracking, reporting and acknowledgments.
  • Works with Food Procurement Specialist to ensure inventory needs are met.
  • Works with the Warehouse and Fulfillment Teams to communicate incoming shipments and create strategies to reduce waste.
  • Facilitates and maintains Agency Store Donation Program.
  • Provides ongoing training to retail partners and agency staff involved in the store donation program.
  • Hosts industry visits and tours demonstrating HHFB's mission and the importance of donors to impact the communities HHFB serves.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field preferred.
  • Three years or more related experience in customer relations or the food industry.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Bi-lingual communication is preferred.
  • Excellent communications, interpersonal and customer service skills; comfortable with public speaking.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Self-starter, strong organizational skills, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to attend work functions outside of normal work hours, on weekends and evenings, as needed.
  • Must be able to clearly articulate HHFB's mission.
  • Ability to relate effectively and professionally with other staff, volunteers, agency representatives and the public.
  • Sales background strongly desired.
  • Ability to travel across entire HHFB footprint.

Thrive

SOME OF THE VAST REWARDS OF WORKING HERE

As we work to eliminate hunger throughout, we state, we also work to care for our teams' professional and personal growth and well-being.

  • Full support and career development resources to expand your skills, enhance your expertise and maximize your potential along your career journey.
  • A diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates empower each other.
  • Generous Total Rewards Plan - comprising health, finance, and wealth work/life balance.
  • 13 Paid Holidays
  • Paid Annual Leave - the longer you work here, the more you earn.

Harvest Hope Food Bank is an equal opportunity employer and embraces a philosophy that recognizes and values diversity. Our goal is to attract, develop, retain and promote a talented diverse workforce in a culture where all employees will contribute to their full potential.

title: OT Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van OT en cybersecurity en écht impact maken op industriële omgevingen? In deze rol zorg je ervoor dat onze productielocaties veilig en toekomstbestendig blijven. Daarbij ben jij degene die techniek en praktijk met elkaar verbindt.

In deze functie werk je zowel centraal als op locatie Roosendaal & Puttershoek en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verbeteren van de OT security binnen onze organisatie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met
• Begeleiden van OT-projecten, waarbij je leveranciers aanstuurt en de kwaliteit van oplossingen beoordeelt
• Zorgen dat de security meetings en overleggen op locatie goed gaan lopen
• Bijdragen aan het ontwikkelen en implementeren van securitybeleid
• Fungeren als aanspreekpunt en “gezicht” vanuit de centrale organisatie op de locaties
• Meewerken aan grote OT-verbeter- en migratieprojecten

Ongeveer het grootste deel van je werk zit aan de OT-kant, waarbij je dicht op de techniek en de praktijk zit.

De rol is ontstaan omdat er op sommige locaties geen OT-specialisten aanwezig zijn, waardoor jouw kennis essentieel is om projecten goed te begeleiden en security naar een hoger niveau te brengen.

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Elektrotechniek of Industriële Automatisering
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in OT-omgevingen, bijvoorbeeld met PLC of SCADA
  • Ervaring met of duidelijke interesse in cybersecurity (bijv. trainingen, projecten of rolstap richting security)
  • Ervaring met OT-implementaties (must)
  • Je begrijpt hoe je leveranciers en projecten aanstuurt zonder zelf te hoeven programmeren

Wie ben jij?

Je bent iemand die makkelijk schakelt tussen techniek en mensen. Je weet wanneer je zelf moet handelen en wanneer je anderen betrekt.

  • Communicatief sterk en in staat vertrouwen op te bouwen op locatie
  • Zelfstandig en zelfsturend, maar weet hulp te vragen wanneer nodig
  • Praktisch ingesteld: je wilt dingen voor elkaar krijgen

Succes in deze rol betekent vooral dat jij het vertrouwen wint van de mensen op de locaties en gezien wordt als dé expert vanuit de centrale organisatie.

  • Een rol met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid
  • De kans om OT en cybersecurity verder vorm te geven binnen de organisatie
  • Werken aan zichtbare projecten die direct impact hebben op de operatie
  • Een salaris tussen de €4.300 en €5.600 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring
  • 48 vrije dagen per jaar (25 vakantiedagen & 23 ADV). ADV dagen zijn tevens te verkopen: 10 dagen tegen (4%) & 20 dagen tegen (8%) extra salairs
  • 13e maand
  • Een pensioenregeling met lage eigen bijdrage en hierdoor een mooie bruto / netto verhouding
  • Hybride werken met standplaats Dinteloord, Puttershoek & Roosendaal en vanuit thuis

We staan open voor zowel meer ervaren kandidaten als professionals die vanuit OT al de stap naar cybersecurity maken en zich verder willen ontwikkelen.

title: People Team Administrator
description:
About Intent HQ

Intent HQ redefines customer understanding for the agentic era, enabling enterprises to influence customer decisions at the moments that determine growth, loyalty, and competitive advantage. As the Human-to-AI Context Company, we offer groundbreaking AI technology that creates the missing context of human behaviour and individuality, transforming data into confident decisions that reflect how people actually act in the real world. We enable brands to Act With Intent.

Trusted by global enterprises, Intent HQ manages 325M+ profiles and processes 250B events daily. We won AI Business of the Year (National AI Awards 2025), Analytics Company of the Year (British Data Awards 2025), and winner of Best AI Ethics & Diversity Strategy (AI World Series Awards 2025), recognising Intent HQ’s AI innovation, analytics excellence, and ethical leadership. Intent HQ is a proven partner for leaders seeking measurable growth, faster decision velocity, and responsible AI-driven advantage.

To learn more,

Why Join Us:

  • Exciting Work Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology at the intersection of AI and data analytics.

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in a fast-paced, innovative industry.

  • Hybrid working: Based in our London office 4 days per week and the rest of the week remote, depending on your location.

Recent Awards & Recognition:

  • Best AI Ethics & Diversity Award 2025 - AI World Series Awards

  • AI Business of the Year 2025 - The National AI Awards

  • Analytics Company of the Year 2025 – British Data Awards

  • AI Company of the Year 2024 – British Data Awards

  • FT1000 Europe’s Fastest Growing Companies 2022–2024 – Financial Times & Statista

  • Top 100 Edge Computing Company 2024 – STL Partners

Why Join Us:

  • Impactful Role part of a high performing team

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in a fast-paced, innovative industry

  • Hybrid role: 4 days per week in our state-of-the-art London office plus access to the onsite gym (including towel serviced showers and changing facilities)

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented People & Office Administrator to join our team. One half of the role will focus on working within well-defined processes, using checklists and systems to ensure accuracy and consistency. The other half of the role will focus on ensuring the smooth and efficient running of the London office.

In this varied and fast-paced role, you will provide comprehensive administrative support across the People Team, including general HR administration, recruitment coordination and maintaining compliance with our policies and procedures. You will act as a first point of contact for employees and managers, offering initial guidance and directing queries appropriately.

A core element of the role will involve using AI-enhanced tools to streamline People processes, improve documentation, and support data accuracy — as well as contributing ideas for how generative AI can be used to improve workflow efficiency and employee experience.

The position also has responsibility for the London Office Experience, helping to ensure a welcoming, well-run working environment for all colleagues and visitors.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the success of our organisation and support the growth and development of our employees whilst accelerating your own career in a fast paced, cutting edge, technology organisation. The People team is a collaborative, supportive and professional team and we are looking for a like minded individual to add to our mix! If you are a motivated and proactive team player with a passion for People administration and ensuring employees have a great working experience, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

People Administration

  • Supporting the People Team by accurately maintaining employee records, ensuring they are up-to-date and stored securely within our People tools. This will include the full spectrum of HR / People administration and the complete employee lifecycle such as drafting various update letters, background checks and references for new joiners and employee leaving processes and records.

  • Recruitment support: Assist the recruitment process by scheduling interviews, candidate liaison, and supporting the Global Head of Talent as required.

  • HR compliance: Together with the team, ensure our administration is in compliance with company policies and procedures and external requirements such as local employment law, ISO 27001 and SOC2 audits.

  • Assist with various People projects and initiatives, such as employee engagement surveys, performance management processes, and office experience programs.

People Office Experience

  • Responsible for employee experience activities within the London office. These duties may include, but are not limited to, arranging weekly office lunches, weekly brunches, and various social events.

  • Handling office orders including the weekly food shop

  • Coordinating on-site events and meetings, including the quarterly Senior Leadership Onsite meetings

  • Supporting the Procurement (Facilities) team on an ad hoc basis,

  • Generally helping to maintain a positive and engaging workplace atmosphere.

    *Guidance and training on the above will be provided to you where necessary.


What we’re looking for

  • A “can do” proactive attitude and the ability to thrive under competing priorities and deadlines

  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail & accuracy are essential

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to multitask and prioritise tasks effectively

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion

  • To be able to work from our Holborn based office a minimum of 4 days per week

Desirable but not essential:

  • Entry level experience (ideally 1-3 year) working in an HR / People administrative role or similar position. We are also open to hear from proactive recent graduates.

  • Proficient in the use of Google drive and use of Macbook Pro

  • HiBob or other HRIS experience a bonus

  • Basic knowledge of employment laws and regulations

  • Experience in SME / Start up environment

  • Familiar with ISO27001 and or SOC2 audits & standards

Our Culture

Working for Intent HQ, you have the opportunity to work with cutting edge technology in an environment where you are encouraged to think and act outside traditional methods. We are a growing business with a flat structure meaning everyone is visible and able to make an impact, not just in their own role, but across the business on a daily basis. We promote a collaborative, innovative and sociable culture, oriented towards performance and competitive advantage. Our DNA is made up of flexibility to all staff with a family friendly approach and focus on personal development. We have high expectations and pride ourselves on our cultural standards.

Diversity & Inclusion

Intent HQ is an equal opportunities employer with an ethos of commitment to promoting and practicing diversity, equality and inclusion at work. At IHQ, different perspectives, ideas and experiences are valued and respected, with fair and equal opportunities provided for all. Our diversity and inclusion efforts have been recognised with us winning two consecutive Women in Tech UK Awards, under the Best Tech Employer (51-149 Employees)’ category & being shortlisted for the Best Employer for Parental Support award - an achievement we are very proud of. This year in 2024 we have been nominated again for the Best Tech Employer and our in house recruiter has been shortlisted for the Best In house Recruiter award!


Benefits

  • Flexible working

  • Private medical insurance, depending on eligibility

  • Free breakfast daily (when in the office)

  • 26 days holiday (increasing with service)

  • Pension scheme

  • Income Protection with Employee Assistance Programme

  • Life Assurance

  • Oliva Mental Health platform and counselling

  • Higher than statutory maternity/paternity benefits

  • Work socials

  • Wellbeing programme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Training opportunities

title: Senior Inventory Control Specialist
description:
SEAKR Engineering is seeking a highly experienced, self-directed Senior Inventory Control Specialist (Property Administrator Level 5) with deep expertise in Government Property management to join our team. This role is intended for a senior-level individual contributor who can operate as a subject matter expert in a fast-paced aerospace environment, with a strong focus on compliance, accountability, and audit readiness.

This position serves as a key resource within Property and Planning, responsible for executing complex inventory and material functions while providing leadership, mentoring, and process improvement support across the team. This role is expected to independently manage Government Property requirements and help drive consistency and accuracy across programs.

Responsibilities include:
· Creating, maintaining, and ensuring accuracy of inventory locations, including Government Furnished Property (GFP) and Customer Furnished Property (CFP)
· Serving as a primary resource for Government Property compliance, including supporting FAR/DFARS requirements, audit readiness, and property accountability across programs
· Supporting customer inquiries, and compliance activities; responding to data requests and ensuring documentation is accurate and complete
·Coordinate and participate in internal and external audits to meet company, contractual, and government requirements, ensuring full alignment with Federal Acquisition Regulations and government contract standards.
·Independently managing and executing complex inventory and materials functions, including high-level shop order kitting, material requisitions and loans, material POs, shortage resolution, and material transfers
· Assuring material availability against program schedules; identifying discrepancies and working cross-functionally to resolve supply gaps and mitigate risk
· Identifying process gaps and driving continuous improvement efforts across inventory and material handling workflows
· Serving as a technical expert in ERP/MRP systems and reporting tools(PIEE); proactively implementing improvements to systems and processes
· Leading and supporting specialized functions such as shipping/receiving, Kanban systems, inventory accuracy initiatives, and test equipment management
· Mentoring and training Property Administrators; providing guidance, and support for team development
· Participating in hiring, onboarding, and performance development of team members
· Providing input into team strategy, workload planning, and resource allocation
· Acting as back-up to the Property Manager as needed, including coverage during absences

This role requires minimal supervision and a high level of accountability. The ideal candidate consistently demonstrates strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate independently while supporting broader team success.

· Minimum 5+ years of experience in materials management, inventory administration, or property management within aerospace, defense, or a similarly regulated environment
· Demonstrated hands-on experience with Government Property regulations (FAR/DFARS), including accountability and audit readiness for GFP/CFP (required)
· Proven ability to operate independently as a subject matter expert in Government Property with minimal oversight
· Experience supporting audits, customer inquiries, and compliance-related activities
· Strong understanding of inventory control processes, material traceability, and property accountability
·Demonstrated experience with program closeout procedures, including the disposition of excess/residual property in accordance with FAR/DFARS property lifecycle requirements.
· Experience mentoring or training team members and contributing to team development
· Solid experience with ERP/MRP systems and reporting tools (IFS or similar preferred, PIEE ideal)
· Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvements
· Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally across programs and teams
· High attention to detail with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

Compensation: Base pay range is $40-45/hour, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA.

This position will work a day shift on a 9/80 schedule (alternating Fridays off).

SEAKR is an Equal Opportunity Employer - All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

US Citizenship Required

Applications will be accepted until 9/11/26.

title: CNC Swiss Engineering Lead

As a CNC Swiss Engineering Lead, you will serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert in Swiss-style CNC machining applications.   • Develop and implement custom machining demonstrations and proof-of-concept applications to validate proposed solutions and demonstrate machine capabilities.

  • Provide on-site engineering assistance, process support, troubleshooting, and training at customer facilities as required.

  • Support Applications Engineers with complex applications, technical troubleshooting, project planning, and process development.

  • Share technical knowledge and best practices with the Applications Engineering team to promote consistency, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, engineering reports, cycle-time analyses, and other technical documentation.

  • Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, GD&T, and customer manufacturing requirements to develop appropriate machining solutions.

  • Collaborate with Sales and other internal teams to evaluate opportunities, develop technical recommendations, and ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements.

  • Stay current on Swiss machining technology, tooling, controls, programming techniques, and industry trends to maintain a high level of technical expertise.

  • Strong understanding of CNC lathe processes and tooling applications.

  • Advanced knowledge of CNC programming and Fanuc-based controls; 5-axis machining experience strongly preferred.

  • Experience developing and optimizing machining processes, including cycle-time reduction and productivity improvements.

  • Experience with CAD/CAM software preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects from initial evaluation through implementation and customer acceptance.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex applications, identify potential issues, and develop effective solutions.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and effectively to customers, Sales, Applications Engineering, Service, and other internal stakeholders.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance, coaching, and support to less experienced Applications Engineers.

  • Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to establish and maintain effective professional relationships.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound technical decisions in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to travel regularly to customer locations for demonstrations, training, engineering support, and project implementation.

description:

The Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) serves as the primary cybersecurity authority for assigned classified and controlled information systems. This role is responsible for the end-to-end execution and oversight of cybersecurity activities in compliance with applicable U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) laws, regulations, and contractual requirements.

As an advanced individual contributor, the ISSM independently leads system authorization, continuous monitoring, inspection readiness, and risk management activities, while providing technical oversight and mentorship to Information Systems Security Officers (ISSOs) and maintaining accountability for cybersecurity outcomes. Responsibilities include implementing and sustaining cybersecurity requirements defined by government frameworks and guidance, including the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Joint Special Access Program Implementation Guide (JSIG) for SAP systems, NIST publications, NISPOM, and the DCSA Assessment and Authorization Guide (DAAG), and associated assessment and authorization guidance.

** This position is onsite in Cedar Rapids. IA. **

What YOU will do:

  • Independently own cybersecurity responsibilities for assigned information systems, ensuring security objectives are achieved and organizational risk is effectively managed.

  • Serve as the primary cybersecurity authority for inspections, assessments, audits, and continuous monitoring, leading preparation, execution, and response activities to maintain authorization and inspection readiness.

  • Execute and maintain system authorization using the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and applicable guidance, including the Joint Special Access Program Implementation Guide (JSIG) for Special Access Program systems and the DCSA Assessment and Authorization Guide (DAAG) for DoD collateral systems.

  • Maintain awareness and working knowledge of DD Form 254s and contractual security requirements, ensuring cybersecurity controls, inspection scope, and authorization boundaries align with approved mission and program objectives.

  • Develop, maintain, and validate cybersecurity plans, authorization artifacts, and compliance documentation to support audit-ready operations.

  • Identify, assess, and communicate cybersecurity risk to senior leadership and Authorizing Officials, including the impact of system changes, vulnerabilities, inspection findings, and authorization conditions.

  • Lead continuous monitoring activities, including evaluation of security posture, validation of control effectiveness, and tracking of security-relevant data.

  • Develop, manage, and drive closure of Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) resulting from inspections, assessments, and continuous monitoring activities.

  • Lead and oversee cybersecurity Change Control Boards (CCBs), evaluating proposed system changes for security impact, authorization implications, and alignment with RMF requirements.

  • Execute or coordinate corrective and protective security actions resulting from inspections, continuous monitoring, or identified cybersecurity incidents.

  • Engage with Program Managers to integrate cybersecurity requirements into program execution, schedules, and decision-making, and to address risk impacts to cost, scope, and mission delivery.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Information Technology, Facilities, and Industrial Security, to ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into technical, physical, and operational environments.

  • Coordinate with other cybersecurity teams across the enterprise to ensure consistent implementation of cybersecurity processes, standards, and authorization practices.

  • Provide technical direction and mentoring to ISSOs to ensure consistent execution of RMF activities, inspection readiness, and quality of authorization artifacts, while remaining accountable for cybersecurity outcomes.

  • Prepare and deliver cybersecurity status reporting to senior leadership, summarizing authorization posture, inspection readiness, risk trends, POA&Ms, and significant cybersecurity issues.

Qualifications YOU Must Have:

  • Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience.

  • U.S. Citizen is required as only U.S. Citizen are able to obtain a clearance.

  • Active DOD Top Secret Security Clearance day one.

  • IAM Level III certification compliant with DoD 8570 / DoD 8140 (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GSLC).

  • Experience performing ISSM responsibilities for classified or controlled information systems.

  • Advanced knowledge of RMF and DoD system authorization processes.

  • Experience executing authorization and continuous monitoring using JSIG and/or DAAG.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity regulations, contractual requirements, and DD Form 254 interpretation.

  • Experience supporting inspections, assessments, and audit activities.

  • Ability to independently assess risk and communicate cybersecurity status to leadership.

  • Must be willing to travel domestically up to 20%, generally supporting other company facilities.

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Experience as the primary ISSM for SAP and/or DoD collateral systems.

  • Experience owning ATOs and driving POA&M closure.
