title: Social Work Clinician - Outpatient GI Onc
description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This role is open to both licensed (LCSW) and non-licensed applicants. If selected for the role, the position will reflect your License status.

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
Social Work Clinician is the entry, developmental, and first working level of professional social work for employees who are recent graduates as well as those who have professional social work experience, but are not yet licensed as Licensed Clinical Social Workers (LCSW) by the State of California. Employees initially work under close clinical supervision and are expected to develop casework and treatment skills as training and experience are gained. As increasing knowledge and competency are demonstrated, supervision is correspondingly reduced. The Social Work Job Family consists of three levels of professional non-supervisory social work in a health care institutional setting at LPCH and SHC: Social Work Clinician, Licensed Clinical Social Worker, and Advanced Clinical Social Worker. This job family is limited to those positions that require a Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) from an accredited school of social work. As a member of a multidisciplinary health care team, Medical Social Workers provide appropriate intervention services and/or discharge planning to patients and/or clients as well as their families receiving services within any department of the Stanford University Medical Center. Work typically involves a variety of bio-psycho-social issues, assessment of the social needs as related to the patient's/client's health status, and the development of a plan of services, including advocacy, discharge planning, referrals and practical assistance necessary to accomplish desired objectives. Provides consultation, orientation and training to health care staff on the effects of bio-psycho-social, cultural and economic issues on the management of patient/client health needs.

This job description covers all classifications for Social Workers within the organization. All Social Workers must meet all elements of the Essential Functions, and Qualifications.

There is a Voluntary professional development program designed to recognize and reward professional excellence in the role of Social Worker. Promotion is determined based on the Social Worker Professional Development Program. Here is a description of the various levels:
Level I: Social Worker
Level II: Advanced Social Worker
Level III: Expert Social Worker

Locations
Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Collaborates with interdisciplinary health care teams to treat and plan for the social and medical needs of patients by consulting with other providers and making referrals. Devises, develops and implements treatment plans as necessary. May make a diagnosis as part of a treatment plan.

  • Conducts initial assessment of all new patients to evaluate social, emotional and physical needs by applying social work theories and techniques; interviews and evaluates patients and family members. Identifies factors which may interfere with obtaining maximum benefits from treatment.

  • Develops and implements patient management plans, including the coordination of referrals to specialty and social services, the recording of progress notes and the provision of continuity of care. Helps clients cope with environmental and psychological issues of illness by explaining options and treatments as well as making appropriate referrals.

  • Manages assigned caseload. Prepares and maintains records and makes written and oral reports to document case activity concerning patient care, counseling and therapeutic activities in accordance with department, hospital, medical center and/or health system policies. Prepares reports and other documents concerning patients.

  • Participates in monitoring and evaluating the quality and appropriateness of patient care.

  • Provides supportive counseling, grief counseling, crisis intervention and other appropriate therapeutic services to assist patients and families in coping with presenting symptoms and problems such as, for example, coping with illness, accepting medical recommendations, and loss of function. Provides education to patients and families around issues related to adaptation to the patient's diagnosis, illness, treatment and/or life situation.


Education Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) from an accredited college or university; OR be within forty-five (45) days of completion of the requirements for graduation with an MSW from an accredited college or university. Candidates who meet this qualification and furnish a letter from the Dean of the School Work where they are a student in good standing attesting to this may receive a conditional offer of employment. Such new hires must provide proof of possession of an MSW degree from an accredited college or university within forty-five (45) days of their date of hire, as a condition of continued employment.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to apply theories, principles and practices of medical social work and of social services delivery
    systems in a hospital or medical center setting

  • Ability to gather data needed to needed to assess needs of patients and families

  • Ability to manage a caseload, recall case details; maintain confidentiality of information; determine the
    appropriate course of action in emergencies and other stressful situations

  • Ability to provide written case narratives and reports

  • Knowledge of and ability to apply effective assessment, interviewing, and counseling techniques

  • Knowledge of and ability to apply social work theories, principles and techniques

  • Knowledge of hospital and medical center resources to access and provide for patient care needs, and act on
    behalf of client needs to obtain necessary services

  • Knowledge of needs, problems, attitudes, and behavior of hospital patients and their families



These principles apply to ALL employees:

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience


Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.



You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:

  • Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care

  • Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health

  • Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

Equal Opportunity Employer Stanford Health Care (SHC) strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including the area of employment. Accordingly, SHC does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity and/or expression, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.

Base Pay Scale: Generally starting at $45.94 - $59.73 per hour

The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.

title: Agile Delivery Lead
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for an outcomes-driven Agile Delivery Lead to join our Delivery team.

This role combines Agile delivery leadership with a strong technical understanding of software and data projects. You will be responsible for delivery predictability, planning, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement while working closely with technical and product teams.

The ideal candidate has a solid technical background and is comfortable engaging in technical discussions, challenging estimates, identifying dependencies and delivery risks, and translating business priorities into realistic delivery plans.

The position requires visiting the Kyiv office once a week.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Delivery Ownership & Timeliness: Take full responsibility for end-to-end delivery results, ensuring all committed scope is delivered on time and to the expected quality. Proactively plan, monitor, and resolve risks before they impact deadlines.

  • Delivery Management: Drive the team towards outcomes with minimal guidance, managing capacity planning and commitments to maintain momentum and uninterrupted execution.

  • Agile Facilitation for Delivery: Lead Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, with a delivery-first mindset focused on actionable planning and execution.

  • Release Planning & Execution: Translate the roadmap into realistic and achievable team delivery plans. Coordinate scope, timelines, and dependencies upfront and manage release execution to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule and meet acceptance criteria.

  • Delivery Tracking, Metrics & Accountability: Continuously monitor delivery metrics such as velocity, lead time, cycle time, and due dates to track progress against commitments and enable early corrective action.

  • Cross-Team Delivery Coordination: Ensure smooth handoffs and cooperation between teams to prevent dependency-driven delays. Align expectations with technical, product, and business stakeholders and manage escalations when required.

  • Continuous Improvement: Lead retrospectives and process improvements that increase delivery predictability, efficiency, and team autonomy.

Scope of Authority & Decision Rights

  • Propose and lock sprint goals and team commitments together with the PO and Tech Lead.

  • Enforce WIP limits, negotiate capacity, and reject work that is not ready according to the Definition of Ready.

  • Raise and escalate delivery risks and dependencies.

  • Organize unblock sessions and ensure blocked items are escalated within 24 hours.

IF YOU ARE

  • Technical background — prior hands-on experience in software engineering, data engineering, BI development, QA, or a similar technical discipline, with the ability to hold credible technical conversations with engineers and stakeholders.

  • Power BI knowledge — understanding of Power BI report and dataset lifecycle, deployment, and CI/CD.

  • Practical AI tools experience and familiarity with using AI to support productivity and delivery.

  • 6+ years of experience leading Agile delivery in software or data teams, including sprint planning, capacity management, release coordination, and delivery tracking.

  • Strong understanding of delivery metrics, including velocity, lead time, cycle time, forecasting, and delivery predictability.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar work-management tools.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence communicating with technical teams, stakeholders, and senior management.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with Azure Databricks or similar data-pipeline platforms.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and Data Warehouse concepts, including fact/dimension modelling, views, data quality, and load performance.

  • Experience managing delivery against SLAs and producing Root Cause Analyses (RCAs).

  • Familiarity with ticketing and support workflows feeding into delivery backlogs.

  • Experience working with distributed or cross-functional technical teams.

  • Experience managing complex technical dependencies across multiple teams.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach: Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model: Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects: Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise: Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

  • Join the Best Team Ever: Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

  • Initial Interview: If your background fits the role, we’ll invite you for an interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.

  • Technical Interview (2 stages): Depending on the position, you may complete a technical assessment or test task.

  • Final Decision: After all steps, we’ll get back to you with the result and next steps.

You will lead a team of Subject Leads and Lecturers, fostering a culture of academic excellence, innovation and continuous improvement.

Working closely with academic and professional services colleagues, you will ensure students receive a supportive and inspiring educational experience that develops their creativity, confidence, academic readiness and discipline-specific skills.

Academic Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Creative Foundation curriculum across Graphic Design, Fashion Design and Games Art & Design pathways.

  • Drive excellence in teaching, assessment, quality assurance and student outcomes.

  • Lead course teams, examination boards and curriculum review activities.

People Leadership

  • Support staff development, appraisal and performance enhancement.

Industry Engagement & Innovation

  • Maintain strong links with the creative industries and professional bodies.

  • Embed current industry practice, employability and external perspectives into the curriculum.

  • Contribute to scholarly activity, professional practice and pedagogic innovation.

  • Support cross-college initiatives that enhance learning and teaching excellence.

About You

We're looking for a passionate educator and academic leader who combines strong creative industry knowledge with a commitment to student success.

Essential Requirements

  • Relevant undergraduate degree and postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience of teaching and assessment within Higher Education.

  • Experience of leading and managing academic teams, curriculum development, quality assurance and student outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of inclusive teaching, learning and assessment practices.

  • Ability to motivate, inspire and develop both students and colleagues.

  • Experience of curriculum design and delivery within a creative discipline.

  • Strong organisational, leadership and stakeholder management skills.

  • Commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion in education.

Desirable

  • Teaching qualification (PGCert or equivalent).

  • Fellowship of Advance HE (or higher).

  • Doctoral qualification or equivalent research experience.

  • Experience of research, knowledge exchange or professional practice within the creative industries.

  • Established industry networks and external partnerships.

Why Join LCCA?

At LCCA, creativity, innovation and student success are at the heart of everything we do. You'll join a vibrant academic community committed to transforming lives through education and providing students with the skills, confidence and opportunities to thrive in their future careers.

We offer:

  • A supportive and collaborative working environment.

  • Opportunities for professional development and academic progression.

  • The chance to influence the future of creative education.

  • A diverse and inclusive community that values innovation and excellence.

Apply Today

If you're an ambitious academic leader with a passion for creative education and student success, we'd love to hear from you.

Join LCCA and help shape the next generation of creative talent.

title: Insight Analyst- Performance & Growth Insights
description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the consumer and market story for priority countries, producing the fact-packs, competitive analysis and consumer-behaviour synthesis that guide local strategy and growth, with direction from the Performance & Growth Insights Manager.
  • Act as the day-to-day contact for Primark’s external data providers, coordinating briefs, deliverables and quality across the relationship.
  • Analyse Primark’s transactional data for your countries, connecting sales and customer behaviour to the wider market picture to explain what is driving performance.
  • Support the Performance & Growth Insights Manager in feeding consistent, comparable country inputs into the KPI frameworks and scorecards used across Strategy, Finance and Leadership.

Data Sources & Vendor Management

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship with external data providers including Kantar/Worldpanel, SITA (for the respective countries) and Oxford Economics; brief requests, track deliverables and quality-check outputs.
  • Combine syndicated data, transactional data and primary research into a single, clear view per market, connecting brand tracking, value and price perception, market share and consumer trends
  • Keep source documentation, definitions and processes up to date so analysis stays consistent and repeatable across markets.

Reporting, Dashboards & Storytelling

  • Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting for your countries in Power BI, working with Data/Tech teams to reduce manual effort.
  • Produce clear, relevant insight deliverables including reports and presentations, getting to the “so what” rather than reporting numbers.
  • Present findings to country and central stakeholders in a way they can act on, helping answer “how we win with customers” for each market.

Market & Competitor Tracking

  • Track competitor moves, pricing and market indicators across your markets, using Edited as a tool, flagging opportunities and risks early enough for local teams to act on them.
  • Maintain a “finger on the pulse” understanding of your countries through self-initiated desk research and competitive monitoring

Essential knowledge and experience:

  • 2–4 years’ experience in consumer insights, customer analytics or market research, ideally within retail, ecommerce or Fashion.
  • Hands-on experience with syndicated data sources such as Kantar/Worldpanel, and Oxford Economics, and comfortable combining them with transactional data.
  • Able to build effective working relationships with external data providers, coordinate deliverables and quality-check their work.
  • Strong analytical and dashboarding skills, proficient in Excel and Power BI, comfortable with automation and curious about AI-assisted analytics.
  • Storytelling: able to interpret data and get to the “so what”, not just report numbers.
  • Highly organised, with the project-management discipline to maintain reference documents, logs and processes.
  • Comfortable working across markets and with a geographically dispersed team.
  • Proficiency in Spanish, Italian or French is a plus.

Personal Attributes:

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to prioritise across projects and deliverables while meeting deadlines.
  • Able to analyse high volumes of data while keeping sight of the higher-level picture.
  • Articulate, with clear presentation skills and the ability to make complex information understandable to different audiences.
  • Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills and high emotional intelligence.
  • Curious, resilient, able to work independently and proactively in a fast-paced environment.

Excited? Good. Because it’s energising to put your skills to work, in a growing global business committed to encouraging people to express themselves – and feel a sense of belonging. Apply to be part of Primark’s future, today… and enjoy career growth, our way.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle.

Let’s talk lifestyle: 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

About Primark

Primark was founded on a mission that everyone deserves to look and feel good – without paying more. We stand for great value without compromise, offering affordable fashion and everyday essentials that are made to last. Founded in Ireland in 1969, Primark is now an international fashion retailer with more than 470 stores across 18 countries in Europe, the US and the Middle East, employing more than 80,000 colleagues. Millions of shoppers trust Primark every week for everything from everyday essentials like t-shirts and socks, to the latest fashion trends – all at unbeatable prices.

Primark is built on a belief and passion for physical stores – helping to bring high streets and retail centres to life and creating joyful, social experiences. The company is focused on driving positive change by giving clothing a longer life, protecting life on the planet and supporting the livelihoods of the people who make Primark clothes.

title: Myyjä 10h/vko, Jyväskylä ja Jämsä
description:
Myyjä Jyväskylän ja Jämsän Mustiin ja Mirriin 10 h/vko

Musti Group on Pohjoismaiden johtava lemmikkieläinhoidon asiantuntija, joka toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa, sekä vuodesta 2024 lähtien myös Baltiassa. Missiomme on tehdä lemmikkien ja lemmikkivanhempien elämästä hauskempaa, turvallisempaa ja vaivattomampaa läpi lemmikin elämän. Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme täyden palvelun tuotetarjoaja ja toimija – sekä fyysisesti että digitaalisesti. Uskomme, että täyden palvelun ekosysteemi tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen arvolupauksen, joka parantaa ja vahvistaa hyviä asiakassuhteita ja erottaa meidät kilpailijoista.

Musti-konsernin liikevaihto oli 561 miljoonaa euroa tilikaudella 2024 (15 kk).
Yhtiöllä oli tilikauden 2024 lopussa 2 178 työntekijää, 1,9 miljoonaa asiakasta ja 415 myymälää.

Millaista on myyjän työ Mustissa ja Mirrissä?

"Musti ja Mirri ei ole kuin mikä tahansa kauppa, vaan eläinihmisten kohtaamispaikka. Asiakkaiden pulmien ratkominen on äärimmäisen palkitsevaa. Minulla on ilo ja kunnia olla tukena nelijalkaisten asiakkaideni arjessa – sillä jokainen kuono on loistavan palvelun arvoinen.

Voin päästää luovuuteni valloilleen luomalla uusia esillepanoja tai päivittämällä myymälän sometilejä. Mikäli haluan skipata kuntosalin tällä(kin) viikolla, nappaan vastuun isoimpien ruokasäkkien hyllyttämisestä. Kun haluan haastaa itseäni, otan hoitaakseni myymälätapahtuman järjestämisen. Mustissa ja Mirrissä mahdollisuudet ovat rajattomat ja jokainen idea on esittämisen arvoinen. "

- Manta, Mustin ja Mirrin myyjä

Lue lisää myymälätyöstä täältä

Mustilla ja Mirrillä myyjän työhön kuuluu muun muassa

  • Asiakaslähtöinen ja myyntihenkinen asiakaspalvelu

  • Myymälän siisteydestä ja konseptin noudattamisesta huolehtiminen

  • Kuormien vastaanottaminen ja tuotteiden hyllytys

  • Esillepanojen rakentaminen

  • Myymäläpalveluiden (mm. kynnenleikkuu, pentutreffit ja MustiEskari) vetäminen

Odotamme sinulta

  • Iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

  • Itsenäistä työotetta ja organisointikykyä

  • Kiinnostusta kaupan alaa ja asiakaspalvelua kohtaan

  • Kykyä tarttua myös myymälän fyysisiin työtehtäviin

  • Joustavuutta työskennellä myymälän kaikkina aukioloaikoina, myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin

  • Joustavuutta työskennellä seudun kaikissa myymälöissä tarvittaessa

Myyjänä haluat omalta osaltasi edistää iloista ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Omakohtainen kokemus lemmikkien kanssa harrastamisesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä asenne ratkaisee! Aikaisempi työkokemus myynnistä ja asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme myyjiltämme vähintään 18 vuoden ikää.

Miksi kannattaa liittyä Mustilaumaan?

Vastassa sinulla on motivoitunut, positiivinen ja huippuhauska työyhteisö. Tarjoamme sinulle kattavat henkilöstöedut, muun muassa

  • Kulttuuri- ja liikuntaetu

  • Kilpailukykyiset henkilökunta-alennukset

  • Palkallinen pentuvapaa

  • Kaupan- ja lemmikkialan koulutusta

  • Laadukas työterveyshuolto

Lisäksi heilutamme häntää urapoluille – Musti ja Mirri tarjoaa mielenkiintoisia kehittymismahdollisuuksia organisaation sisällä (katso uratarinoita). Meillä kohtaat työssäsi paljon karvaisia asiakkaita ja lähes kaikkiin toimipisteisiimme voit tuoda oman nelijalkaisesi mukaan töihin.

Kaikissa toimipisteissämme on päivittäin lemmikkejä, joten työ ei välttämättä sovi lemmikkiallergiselle. Työsuhteeseen sovelletaan kaupan työehtosopimusta.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa myymäläpäällikkö Nea Palva-aho, puhelimitse maanantaisin klo 16-17 numerosta 044 769 0510.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, jätä hakemuksesi meille mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 9.9.2026. Huomioithan, että haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajan aikana, joten älä suotta aikaile hakemuksen jättämisen kanssa.

Katso videolta, millaista on myyjän arki myymälässä! MIikäli video ei näy, tarkasta evästeasetuksesi.

title: Senior Performance & Optimisation Consultant
description:
Job Purpose

As our Senior Performance & Optimisation Consultant, you'll proactively help customers improve business performance, adoption and value realisation across their full journey with U4F by Coda.

Working pre and post go live, you'll spot performance risks and optimisation opportunities early, combining SaaS expertise, process thinking, data insight and hands on AI experience to help customers get more value from Unit4.

You'll work alongside a Support Specialist and a Database Administrator, giving customers a proactive performance and optimisation capability.

Accountabilities & Responsibilities

  • Run proactive performance reviews and customer health checks across implementation, transition and live service.
  • Assess pre go live readiness across business process, adoption, data and productivity.
  • Spot performance risks and improvement opportunities before they become escalations.
  • Set baselines and success criteria tied to adoption and value realisation goals.
  • Analyse post go live adoption and process data to recommend clear, actionable improvements.
  • Advise customers on practical ways to use AI to automate work and boost productivity.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Consulting, Support, Managed Services and Product to drive measurable outcomes.
  • Build repeatable playbooks and templates, and track the impact of your work.

Experience Requirements

  • 8+ years in business consulting, operational excellence, customer success, performance optimisation, or SaaS/ERP consulting.
  • Strong SaaS expertise: adoption, value realisation, retention and customer health.
  • A track record of improving customer business processes and outcomes.
  • Practical experience using AI to automate work and drive measurable results.
  • Strong stakeholder management, including influencing senior leaders and customer executives.

Required Tools and Technology

  • Microsoft 365, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Power BI or equivalent for reporting and data visualisation.
  • Hands on use of AI productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot.
  • Experience with ERP, HCM, FP&A or adjacent SaaS platforms.

Required Skills

  • A flair for customer lifecycle thinking: driving adoption, value realisation and long term customer health.
  • Business process optimisation, with an eye for turning clunky workflows into slick ones.

title: Vientiassistentti, T-DRILL Oy
description:
T-DRILL Oy on maailman johtavia putkentyöstökoneiden valmistajia ja ratkaisutoimittajia. Yrityksen patentoidut ratkaisut putken liitoksiin ja katkaisuun sekä putken pään muotoiluun soveltuvat lukuisiin teollisuussovellutuksiin eri asiakastoimialoille. T-DRILLin juuret ovat Suomessa, markkinat maailmalla. Tuotteita viedään vuosittain yli 50 maahan ja viennin osuus on 98 %. Pääkonttori sijaitsee Laihialla, osavalmistus Isossakyrössä ja tytäryhtiö Atlantassa, USA:ssa. Työntekijöitä on kaikkiaan n. 150. T-Drill Oy kuuluu Leinolat Group konserniin. Lue lisää T-DRILL ja Leinolat Group


Haemme asiakkaallemme T-DRILL Oy:lle vientiassistenttia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Vientiassistenttina vastaat monipuolisista myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun tukitehtävistä osana kokenutta asiantuntijatiimiä. Työpäiväsi koostuvat mm. tilausten ja takuulähetysten vastaanotosta, toimitusaikojen selvittämisestä, tilausten käsittelystä ja syöttämisestä järjestelmään sekä tilausvahvistusten laatimisesta asiakkaille. Lisäksi vastaat lähetysdokumenttien, laskujen ja komissiomuistioiden valmistelusta sekä kuljetusten järjestämisestä.

Työskentelet päivittäin sekä kansainvälisten että kotimaisten asiakkaiden kanssa. Asiakasyhteydenpito tapahtuu sähköpostitse ja puhelimitse, joten pääset hyödyntämään kielitaitoasi ja asiakaspalveluosaamistasi monipuolisesti erilaisissa tilanteissa. Tehtävä tarjoaa näköalapaikan kansainväliseen vientikauppaan ja mahdollisuuden olla tärkeässä roolissa sujuvan asiakaskokemuksen varmistamisessa.

Kyseessä on vakituinen kokopäivätyö liukuvalla työajalla (klo 6.30–9.00 / 15.00–17.00), työsuhde solmitaan suoraan T-DRILL Oy:n kanssa. Pääasiallinen työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee Laihialla ja sinulla on käytössäsi osittainen etätyömahdollisuus tai mahdollisuus ajoittaiseen työskentelyyn Seinäjoen toimipisteellämme.

Mitä odotamme?
Tehtävässä menestyt, jos sinulla on kaupallinen koulutus, esimerkiksi tradenomin tai merkonomin tutkinto, sekä kiinnostusta kansainvälistä liiketoimintaa ja asiakaspalvelua kohtaan. Työ edellyttää hyvää organisointikykyä, huolellista työotetta sekä kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, ratkaisukeskeisyyttä ja kykyä toimia myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

Englannin kielen sujuva suullinen ja kirjallinen taito on tehtävässä välttämätön, sillä kommunikoit päivittäin kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?
T-DRILL tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä kansainvälisessä yrityksessä, jossa luottamus, yhteistyö ja kollegoiden tuki näkyvät aidosti arjen tekemisessä. Pääset kehittämään osaamistasi uusimman teknologian parissa osana asiantuntevaa, rentoa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, jolle on myönnetty Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti.

Tarjoamme lisäksi kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten laajan työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa, ePassin liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin sekä mahdollisuuden käyttää kuntosalia. Meillä omaa osaamista arvostetaan ja kehittymishalua tuetaan pitkäjänteisesti.

Kiinnostuitko?
Laitahan hakemusta tulemaan! Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 9.9.2026. Hakuprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan T-DRILL Oy:n omille kirjoille.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä saat Johannalta Biisonilta, johanna.paloneva@biisoni.fi

title: Vi søker tømrer og hjelpearbeider i Åsane /Nord-Hordaland!
description:
Trives du med ansvar, varierte oppdrag og godt håndverk? Da kan dette være jobben for deg!

Er du tømrer og liker å bruke faget ditt på ulike typer oppdrag? Eller har du praktisk erfaring fra bygg og anlegg og ønsker å utvikle deg videre?

Hos Ocab Åsane og Nord-Hordaland får du en arbeidshverdag hvor ingen dager er helt like.

Vi hjelper mennesker når uhellet er ute – etter vannskader, brann, storm, naturskader og andre uforutsette hendelser. For kunden kan dette være en krevende situasjon. For deg blir det en jobb hvor fagkunnskap, problemløsning og godt håndverk virkelig gjør en forskjell.

Vi søker først og fremst dyktige tømrere, men er også åpne for å ta inn en hjelpearbeider med riktig innstilling og praktisk erfaring. Det viktigste for oss er at du er arbeidsvillig, lærevillig og ønsker å gjøre en god jobb.

Hva skal du jobbe med?

Som tømrer hos Ocab vil du blant annet:

  • Utføre rehabilitering etter vann-, brann-, storm- og naturskader.

  • Utføre tradisjonelt tømrerarbeid med fokus på kvalitet og godt håndverk.

  • Vurdere skader og finne praktiske og gode løsninger.

  • Samarbeide tett med prosjektledere, skadesanerere og andre faggrupper.

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre arbeid på en effektiv og ryddig måte.

  • Ha kontakt med kunder og bidra til en trygg og profesjonell opplevelse.

Som hjelpearbeider vil du blant annet bidra med:

  • Riving og rydding etter skader.

  • Bistå tømrere og andre fagarbeidere på ulike oppdrag.

  • Enklere tømrer- og monteringsarbeid.

  • Lasting, lossing og håndtering av materialer og utstyr.

  • Sikring og klargjøring av arbeidsområder.

  • Andre praktiske oppgaver som bidrar til at prosjektene gjennomføres effektivt.

Har du erfaring fra bygg, rehabilitering eller annet praktisk arbeid, er det en fordel – men riktig innstilling og vilje til å lære er minst like viktig.

Hvem ser vi etter?

For tømrerstillingen ser vi gjerne at du:

  • Har fagbrev som tømrer eller relevant erfaring.

  • Har førerkort klasse B.

  • Jobber selvstendig og strukturert.

  • Er praktisk anlagt, løsningsorientert og kvalitetsbevisst.

  • Trives med ansvar og varierte arbeidsdager.

  • Behersker norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk.

For hjelpearbeiderstillingen ser vi etter deg som:

  • Er praktisk anlagt og liker fysisk arbeid.

  • Har gjerne erfaring fra bygg, håndverk eller lignende.

  • Er arbeidsvillig og lærevillig.

  • Kan jobbe både selvstendig og sammen med andre.

  • Har førerkort klasse B.

  • Behersker norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk.

Derfor velger mange Ocab

Vi vet at flinke håndverkere har flere muligheter. Derfor ønsker vi å være en arbeidsgiver du både trives hos og har lyst til å bli værende hos.

Hos oss får du:

  • Fast jobb i et solid selskap.

  • Varierte arbeidsdager og ulike typer oppdrag.

  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår.

  • Firmabil i arbeidstiden.

  • Telefon og nødvendig arbeidsutstyr.

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

  • Kurs, kompetanseheving og muligheter for faglig utvikling.

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer og høy fagkompetanse.

Hvorfor Ocab?

Ocab er en av Norges største aktører innen skadeservice og servicehåndverk. Hver dag hjelper vi privatpersoner, bedrifter og forsikringsselskaper med å begrense skader og bygge opp igjen hjem, arbeidsplasser og verdier.

Når skaden først har skjedd, handler jobben vår om mer enn å reparere en vegg eller et gulv. Vi skal gjøre en vanskelig situasjon litt enklere for kunden – og hjelpe dem tilbake til hverdagen.

Våre verdier – proaktive, kvalitetsbevisste og omsorgsfulle – preger både hvordan vi møter kundene våre og hvordan vi jobber sammen.

Har du lyst til å bli en del av laget?

Du trenger ikke bruke lang tid på søknaden. Send oss noen ord om deg selv og en oversiktlig CV.

Er du tømrer – eller har du praktisk erfaring og ønsker å utvikle deg videre som hjelpearbeider? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

title: Senior Solution Architect (Telecoms, GCP, GenAI & Microservices)
description:
About Zinkworks

Zinkworks is a global leader in innovation, headquartered in Athlone, Ireland, with three office locations worldwide. We utilise the latest cutting-edge technologies to bring industry-leading expertise to our Telecommunication and Financial Services clients. We are adept at developing custom innovations that streamline our clients’ workflows and improve operational efficiency. With a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we have earned a reputation as a trusted partner for businesses seeking reliable software services.

The Opportunity

We are partnering with a major UK Telecommunications provider to deliver their flagship "Agentic AI" transformation program. Operating from our Innovation Hub in Athlone, we are building a "CTO 2.0" ecosystem moving our client from legacy, manual workflows to an intelligent, automated operating model powered by Autonomous AI Agents.

We need a Senior Architect to lead the design of the core platform that will host and orchestrate AI agents across the enterprise, defining the architecture, security standards, and microservices patterns that underpin this transformation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the high-level design of the "Agentic Platform" on Google Cloud (GCP).

  • Define how microservices, AI models, and data pipelines interact securely.

  • Establish governance patterns for Generative AI, including RAG frameworks and TSA compliance.

  • Define API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) and event-driven patterns (Pub/Sub).

  • Act as the Design Authority, reviewing and approving architectural artefacts across teams.

  • Lead solution design of the integration and orchestration frameworks across telecom environments.

Must-Have Skills:

  • 5+ years operating as a Senior/Lead Solution Architect.

  • Deep expertise in architecting on GCP (Cloud Run, GKE, Apigee, IAM).

  • Proven experience designing platforms integrating Vector Databases, LLMs, and Big Data pipelines.

  • Mastery of microservices architecture and distributed systems.

  • Deep domain expertise across RAN, Core, OSS/BSS, and network automation.

  • Demonstrated capability designing large-scale, distributed telecom systems.

  • Hands-on proficiency with cloud services across GCP/AWS/Azure.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • A platform thinker who builds frameworks that solve problems at scale.

  • Comfortable working with senior client stakeholders.

  • Capable of defending architectural decisions clearly and confidently.

Inclusion & Diversity at Zinkworks:

At Zinkworks, we are deeply committed to fostering a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that our strength lies in the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. By embracing an inclusive environment, we empower innovation and collaboration across all levels of our organisation. Based in Ireland, we are proud to support and engage with our local communities through meaningful initiatives that promote equity and opportunity. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, as we actively contribute to creating a more inclusive and connected society for all.

description:
The Position

The Kentucky Distribution Center (KDC) Site Head is a vital part of our Supply Chain and Logistics network, which is committed to ensuring the safe, compliant, and uninterrupted delivery of life-changing medicines to patients across the US market. This position is responsible for leading all operational teams in Louisville and serving as the face of Genentech within the local community. You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Customer Operations, US Commercial, Quality, Safety, Health & Environment (SHE), and global network leadership to drive operational excellence and business continuity.

The Opportunity

As the KDC Site Head (Sr. Director), you are directly accountable for the safe, cost-effective, and cGMP-compliant operation of our primary US distribution center, driving strategic vision and network alignment while inspiring a high-performing organization through servant leadership, personal transformation, and clear vision to optimize the contributions of all employees. Key responsibilities include:

  • Set the strategic vision and define long-range business strategies for commercial finished goods and site assets, aligning site capabilities with the broader global network.

  • Direct all site operations including staffing, facilities, logistics, warehousing, inventory management, technology, and Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) compliance.

  • Serve as the face of Genentech in the Louisville, Kentucky region, driving local community initiatives, government affairs, and media representation.

  • Ensure full compliance with cGMP, SOPs, and Roche Quality standards while meeting operational, financial, and OTIF (On-Time, In-Full) delivery targets.

  • Establish and continuously exercise robust Business Continuity and risk mitigation plans to ensure resilient delivery of medicines representing significant revenue.

  • Act as an active change agent, fostering a culture of trust, agility, continuous improvement, and professional development across direct and non-direct reports.

  • Partner with Customer Operations, Hillsboro distribution leadership, and Commercial stakeholders to streamline delivery processes and maximize customer satisfaction.

Who You Are

  • Education: Bachelor of Science (BS) or Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Business, Engineering, Materials Management, Packaging, Life Sciences, or a related field.

  • Leadership & Industry Experience: Proven track record as a site head in distribution, warehouse, or manufacturing operations within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare distribution space (15+ years of total supply chain/distribution experience preferred, with 10–12+ years of relevant leadership experience, including cold-chain management).

  • Technical Expertise: Expert knowledge of cGMP standards, pharmaceutical distribution regulations, warehousing, facilities management, and ERP or integrated inventory management systems.

  • Strategic & Risk Management Acumen: Demonstrated enterprise mindset with experience developing long-range operational strategies, driving business continuity planning, and executing risk mitigation in complex environments.

  • Operational Excellence & Change Leadership: Strong background in driving continuous improvement (Lean/Six Sigma preferred) and acting as a visible change agent who adapts strategies to evolving network needs.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional executives, build high-performing diverse teams, and communicate effectively with front-line execution staff.

The MAC Move Management Lead is responsible for overseeing the team planning, coordination, and execution of Moves, Adds, and Changes (MAC) activities across a multi-site portfolio of office, laboratory, research, and operational facilities throughout Southeastern Pennsylvania.

This position leads a team of three direct reports and serves as the primary point of contact for business-as-usual (BAU) moves, occupancy-driven relocations, and project-related move activities. The role works closely with Occupancy Planning, client stakeholders, Project Teams, Facilities Management, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and service providers to ensure moves are executed safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to business operations.

The ideal candidate is an experienced move management professional with strong leadership, project coordination, vendor management, and customer service skills who can effectively manage multiple priorities across a geographically dispersed portfolio.

This is a full time onsite role in West Point, PA.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and manage the day-to-day MAC Move Management Program across multiple campuses and locations.
  • Supervise, coach, and develop a team of three move management professionals.
  • Manage all weekly BAU move activity and project-related relocations.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for move-related issues and customer concerns.
  • Partner closely with Occupancy Planning, client stakeholders, Project Teams, Facilities Management, and service providers to develop and execute move plans.
  • Provide move management leadership for major relocations, building occupancy initiatives, renovations, restacks, and departmental moves.

  • Facilitate move planning meetings and communicate schedules, milestones, risks, and status updates to stakeholders.
  • Provide post-move hyper-care support and ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues.
  • Maintain move schedules, documentation, metrics, and reporting.

  • Experience leading teams and managing operational workloads.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale relocations, occupancy initiatives, and project-related moves.
  • Experience coordinating activities across multiple sites, campuses, or complex facility environments.
  • Experience managing vendors, contractors, and cross-functional stakeholder groups.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and customer relationship management abilities.

title: ARMO Tech - Electro Mech IV
description:
ARMO Tech - Electro Mech IV

Do you enjoy working hands-on with electro-mechanical equipment, assembly, and maintenance?

Are you passionate about troubleshooting, repairing, and preparing critical inspection equipment for field operations?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

Fuel your passion

As an ARMO Tech - Electro Mech IV, you will play a vital role in supporting equipment readiness and operational excellence through mechanical assembly, maintenance, inspection, and testing activities. You will work closely with technicians and engineers to ensure equipment is prepared, maintained, and deployed safely and efficiently while contributing to high-quality service delivery and operational success.

As an ARMO Tech - Electro Mech IV, you will be responsible for:

  • Performing mechanical assembly, repair, inspection, and testing of equipment and components.

  • Receiving, inspecting, cleaning, and preparing field inspection equipment for service and deployment.

  • Maintaining shop supplies, tools, and equipment while ensuring a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

  • Assisting with the modification and fabrication of parts and components to ensure proper fit, function, and finish.

  • Packaging, labeling, and preparing equipment and materials for shipment to project locations.

  • Completing required documentation, inspection records, and inventory transactions accurately.

  • Following all company safety policies, procedures, and quality standards.

  • Collaborating with technicians, engineers, and cross-functional teams to support shop operations and project activities.

  • Support troubleshooting and maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability and performance.

  • Demonstrating commitment to the Company's Guiding Principles, Core Values, and safety culture.

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent qualification.

  • Have 2+ years of experience in mechanical assembly, manufacturing, maintenance, equipment repair, or a related field.

  • Have strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to learn new technical skills quickly.

  • Have experience using hand tools, power tools, measuring instruments, and shop equipment.

  • Have the ability to read and interpret work instructions, technical drawings, and operational procedures.

  • Have troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in a mechanical or manufacturing environment.

  • Have proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Word, Excel, and other basic computer applications.

  • Have strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality workmanship.

  • Have effective communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Have the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

  • Have basic reading, writing, and mathematical skills.

  • Have the physical ability to safely lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.

  • Have experience in manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, or repair environments preferred.

  • Have familiarity with measuring tools such as tape measures, calipers, and micrometers preferred.

  • Have forklift certification or the willingness to obtain certification preferred.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

  • Comprehensive private medical care options

  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

title: Databricks SME
description:
What we are looking for…
We are looking for a highly skilled Data Engineer with expert-level knowledge to assume a key role in managing data, both at rest and in streaming, and to lead efforts in data management and optimization. Your proficiency in ETL pipeline development, data tools and your deep understanding of data management principles will be instrumental in ensuring our data infrastructure operates efficiently.

What you will do...
  • Data Management Leadership: Provide technical leadership in data management, overseeing data at rest and data streaming, and guiding the team.
  • ETL Pipeline Development: Design, develop, and maintain efficient ETL pipelines to process and transform data, ensuring data quality, integrity, and consistency.
  • Databricks Expertise: Optimize data processing by using your expertise in Databricks, develop Spark-based solutions, and enhance data integration and analytics capabilities.
  • Streaming Data: Manage streaming data sources and implement real-Ime data processing solutions using tools like Apache Kana or similar technologies.
  • Data Transformation: Implement and manage data routing, transformation, and enrichment using Cribl or similar data pipeline orchestration tools.
  • Data Optimization: Work on data optimization initiatives, including performance tuning, indexing, and data compression, to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Data Security and Compliance: Collaborate with security teams to ensure data security and compliance with data privacy regulations.
  • Documentation: Build comprehensive documentation for data management processes, ETL pipelines, and facilitating knowledge transfer within the team.

What you will bring…
  • 5+ years’ experience as a Data Engineer with a deep understanding of data management, ETL pipelines and streaming data.
  • 5+ years’ experience writing code using Python, Scala and/or Java.
  • Consultant-level, expert experience in Databricks.
  • Apache Spark experience (mandatory).
  • 2+ years’ expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, Snowflake and/or similar data processing frameworks.
  • BA / BS degree with 4+ years of experience (or) MS degree with 2+ years of experience as a data engineer.

Stand Out With…
  • Experience with data streaming technologies (e.g., Apache Kafka, Apache Flink) and real-time data processing.
  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts and the ability to work with data scientists and AI engineers.
  • Experience working on SQL or NoSQL data stores.
  • Proficiency in tools like Cribl, Airflow or similar for data pipeline orchestration and transformation.
  • Knowledge of data security and compliance principles.

Who we are...
August Schell offers 30 years of experience in providing our customers innovative solutions and engineering services to their most challenging needs. We thrive on navigating complex IT difficulties and are driven to find the best solutions for our customers. Our team delivers expert knowledge in cyber security, big data, endpoint security and cloud solutions. Our ability to serve our customers with continued excellence is a direct reflection of our dedicated and exceptional people. At August Schell, we are not only a team, we are family.

All are welcome…
August Schell is a proud Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and recognizing that our employees bring unique differences, perspectives, and ideals that are the backbone of our success. We welcome all persons and the talent they have to offer regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

title: Construction Supervisor - Electrical
description:
Job Type: Full-time | Location: Sweetwater, Texas | Department: Construction | Reporting to: Associate Director, Construction | Work Location: #onsite

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

The Construction Supervisor – Electrical offers an opportunity to elevate your electrical career while working on some of the most technically advanced, mission-critical data center projects in the industry. In this hands-on leadership role, you will oversee electrical construction activities involving medium-voltage systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), and critical power distribution infrastructure that supports high-performance computing environments. You will lead field crews, coordinate across trades, and ensure all work is executed safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with NEC and project requirements. If you are an experienced electrical professional ready to expand your leadership responsibilities and take on complex technical challenges in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, this role places you at the forefront of sustainable, high-performance infrastructure development.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain a safe working environment by administering and adhering to company safety protocols and OSHA requirements.
  • Delegate and perform work based on blueprints, charts, tables, work orders, and verbal instructions; organize assigned tasks from start to finish.
  • Supervise all activities of electricians and apprentices to ensure quality and efficiency.
  • Diagnose and repair electrical issues by installing or replacing wiring, devices, and components in a timely and effective manner.
  • Conduct routine jobsite inspections and evaluate the performance of the electrical team.
  • Communicate clearly with other trades, team members, subcontractors, and customers regarding job progress, needs, and concerns.

Requirements

  • Valid Journeyman Electrician License
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical construction, with proven experience working on medium voltage systems, switchgears, and motor control centers (MCCs).
  • Strong ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, mechanical plans, and blueprints.
  • Exceptional supervisory and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with managers, peers, customers, and subcontractors.
  • Proficient in applying local electrical codes and the National Electrical Code (NEC).
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and reporting.
  • Valid state driver’s license required.

Other important requirements:

  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
  • Must provide own steel-toed work boots; other PPE will be supplied.
  • Must be able to reliably commute to the work site daily or have plans to relocate before starting work.
  • Must be comfortable working a rotational schedule, which includes day and night shifts as well as weekend work, based on project needs.
  • Employees working night shifts will receive a 15% premium added to their hourly rate only for hours worked during night shifts.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a comprehensive, market-competitive total rewards package designed to support employees’ well-being, career advancement, and financial wealth. Our offerings reflect our commitment to Proceed with Purpose while rewarding high performance and long-term growth.

title: Creative Specialist —  Social-first  Strategy & Creative Direction (Barcelona)
description:

What is Zurich Duo?

Operating like a startup within a major global corporation, Zurich Duo combines an agile, dynamic, and entrepreneurial environment with the resources, expertise, and stability of a leading global company.

It brings together the best of both worlds: the energy and flexibility of a young, fast-moving company, with the scale, support, and opportunities of an established industry leader.

About the Role

We are looking for a Creative Strategist with solid experience in digital and social-first environments, capable of transforming business objectives, audience insights, and the evolution of the social ecosystem into powerful creative strategies, content territories, and actionable briefs.

In this role, you will ensure that Duo’s social-first work is culturally relevant, platform-native, and strictly aligned with our brand and business priorities. What will your mission be?

To translate business objectives, audience insights, and the social media landscape into clear creative strategies, content territories, and briefs, ensuring every proposal is relevant, platform-native, and strategically aligned with business goals.

  • Strategic Strategy: Translate client and business objectives into social-first creative strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Support content calendar direction at a strategic level—defining themes, priorities, key moments, and overarching narratives.

Requirements & Key Skills

  • Platform Mastery: Deep, native understanding of the social media ecosystem, particularly platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit, including platform-first behaviors and formats.

  • Genuine passion for internet culture, social trends, and platform evolution.

title: Systems Administrator Lead (Night Shift)
description:
5C DATA CENTERS

Join the Future of Digital Infrastructure

Are you a passionate Systems Administrator Lead (Night Shift) looking to make a meaningful impact? We're building the next generation of digital infrastructure powering hyperscalers, AI innovation, and high-performance computing across North America.

JOB TITLE

Systems Administrator Lead (Night Shift)

DEPARTMENT

Infrastructure Operations

LOCATION

Remote (Ohio, USA)

WORK ARRANGEMENT

Remote

SALARY RANGE

$115,000 – $145,000

Role Summary

As a Systems Administrator Lead covering the Night Shift (1AM– 10:00 AM EST), you will support, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize large-scale HPC and AI infrastructure across our data center and cloud environments.

This role is primarily focused on the infrastructure and hardware layer, including Linux operating systems, GPU servers, high-speed networking, storage connectivity, firmware, drivers, and out-of-band management. This position provides critical overnight coverage, ensuring infrastructure issues are resolved quickly outside standard business hours.

You will serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents affecting GPU clusters, compute nodes, networking, storage, and supporting management services, working closely with Network Engineering, Data Center Operations, Deployment Engineering, vendors, and customer technical teams to restore service and improve the reliability of production HPC environments.

How We Work at 5C

Our core values guide how we collaborate, make decisions, support one another, and serve our customers. We're looking for people who embrace them and help us build something great.

What You Will Do

HPC Infrastructure Operations

  • Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux-based HPC and AI compute environments, including large-scale GPU clusters built on NVIDIA HGX, DGX, or equivalent accelerated computing platforms.
  • Diagnose hardware, OS, driver, firmware, networking, and storage-related failures, and perform root-cause analysis to develop corrective actions for recurring issues.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex incidents affecting production compute infrastructure, troubleshooting degraded or unstable compute/GPU nodes to restore service.
  • Support infrastructure across heterogeneous environments - bare-metal, virtualized, containerized, and cloud-hosted - and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and shift-handoff notes.

GPU and Accelerated Computing Systems

  • Install, configure, validate, and troubleshoot NVIDIA GPU drivers, CUDA components, firmware, and supporting system software using tools such as Nvidia Smi, DCGM, and NVIDIA Fabric Manager.
  • Investigate GPU Xid errors, NVLink/NVSwitch faults, PCIe errors, ECC events, GPU resets, and thermal or power-related issues.
  • Diagnose communication and performance issues involving NCCL, GPUDirect RDMA, PCIe topology, NUMA placement, and multi-GPU systems, validating GPU-to-GPU, GPU-to-network, and GPU-to-storage communication after repairs.
  • Coordinate replacement and RMA activities for GPUs, GPU trays, baseboards, NVSwitch components, system boards, and NICs.

Linux Systems Administration

  • Administer enterprise Linux distributions across the production fleet, troubleshooting boot failures, kernel issues, systemd services, filesystems, and OS performance.
  • Analyze system and kernel logs (journalctl, dmesg, lspci, dmidecode, ipmitool, ethtool, ss, sar, perf) and manage kernel modules, device drivers, DKMS packages, and OS updates.
  • Support Linux networking, storage mounts, authentication, and security controls, and investigate OS crashes, kernel panics, and out-of-memory conditions.

Server Hardware, Firmware, and Out-of-Band Management

  • Support enterprise server platforms from vendors such as Dell, HPE, ASUS, Supermicro, and NVIDIA, troubleshooting processors, memory, PCIe devices, NICs, storage controllers, and other hardware components.
  • Manage BIOS, BMC, CPLD, NIC, GPU, switch, and drive firmware, and perform remote console troubleshooting, power cycling, and log bundle generation.
  • Partner with on-site Data Center technicians on component replacement, cabling validation, break-fix activity, and post-repair testing.

High-Performance Networking

  • Troubleshoot Ethernet, InfiniBand, and RoCE connectivity within HPC and AI environments, including link state, VLAN/bonding issues, MTU mismatches, packet loss, and RDMA/GPUDirect RDMA connectivity.
  • Collaborate with Deployment Engineering to troubleshoot fabric instability, link degradation, congestion, and node-level connectivity issues.

Storage and Filesystem Support

  • Troubleshoot server connectivity to parallel, distributed, and enterprise storage platforms such as NFS, Lustre, BeeGFS, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, and Ceph, diagnosing mount failures, throughput degradation, and capacity issues.
  • Validate storage network paths and coordinate with storage and networking teams during service-impacting events

Incident, Problem, and Change Management

  • Lead or support incident response for critical infrastructure events, participating in technical bridges and providing clear status updates during outages.
  • Create detailed timelines, root-cause analyses, and corrective-action plans, maintaining accurate records in Jira Service Management or similar ITSM platforms.

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Mentor junior and mid-level Systems Administrators and HPC Engineers, providing technical guidance during complex troubleshooting and infrastructure changes.
  • Promote consistent troubleshooting methods, documentation standards, and operational discipline across shift handoffs.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Linux systems administration, HPC/AI infrastructure or data center operations, including hands-on troubleshooting in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience supporting enterprise server hardware, bare-metal compute systems, and large-scale NVIDIA GPU infrastructure or accelerated computing platforms.
  • Strong understanding of server hardware, firmware, BIOS, BMC, PCIe, NUMA, memory, storage, and network interfaces, with experience diagnosing failures using OS logs, BMC logs, and vendor diagnostics.
  • Experience with NVIDIA drivers, CUDA compatibility, and GPU-management tools such as DCGM, Fabric Manager, or nvidia-smi.
  • Working knowledge of high-performance networking (InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, NVIDIA/Mellanox adapters) and out-of-band management tools (Redfish, IPMI, iDRAC, or iLO).
  • Proficiency in one or more automation/scripting languages (Python, Bash, or Ansible) and familiarity with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot across hardware, firmware, OS, network, storage, and cluster-management layers, backed by strong documentation and communication skills.
  • Willingness to work a fixed, recurring shift and participate in scheduled on-call escalation.

Why Join 5C Data Centers?

At 5C, we believe great people build great companies. You'll build a rewarding career while helping shape the future of digital infrastructure - one of the fastest-growing industries in the world.

Career Growth

Build a rewarding career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

Industry Leadership

Help power the infrastructure behind AI and high-performance computing.

Entrepreneurial Culture

Your ideas matter - we empower employees to help shape our future.

Comprehensive Rewards

Competitive pay plus meaningful, lasting impact on the work you do.

Life at 5C

We're more than a workplace - we're a team of builders, innovators, and problem-solvers united by a shared purpose: creating infrastructure that powers the technologies transforming our world. Your voice matters here, and we encourage fresh ideas at every level.

Ready to Apply?

If this opportunity sounds like the right fit for you, we'd love to hear your story. Apply today and discover what your future could look like at 5C Data Centers.

5C Data Centers is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Detaljberedare till tillverkande industri
description:
Beskrivning

Vår klient i Landskrona söker nu en Detaljberedare inom skärning och bränning för ett konsultuppdrag inom avancerad tillverkande industri. I rollen blir du en viktig länk mellan konstruktion, teknisk beredning och produktion och arbetar med att omsätta konstruktionsunderlag till effektiva och genomförbara produktionslösningar.

Vi söker dig med teknisk bakgrund och erfarenhet av beredning inom tillverkande industri. Du trivs i en produktionsnära roll där du kombinerar tekniskt arbete med samarbete och löpande dialog med flera olika funktioner.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Detaljberedare ansvarar du för att ta fram produktionsunderlag och beredningar för skärning och bränning. Du arbetar med att skapa och hantera DXF-filer, ta fram nestningar och säkerställa att underlagen är anpassade efter produktionsanläggningens utrustning, processer och förutsättningar.

Du planerar och bereder arbetet med fokus på ett effektivt produktionsgenomförande och lämnar därefter över färdiga beredningar till produktionen. När tillverkningen startar fungerar du som ett tekniskt stöd och hanterar frågor och eventuella justeringar som uppkommer i samband med produktionsstart.

I rollen har du ett nära samarbete med produktion, tekniska beredare, produktionstekniker och konstruktörer. Du deltar även i löpande avstämningar och bidrar till utveckling och integration av nya tekniska lösningar i produktionen.

Kvalifikationer

  • Teknisk bakgrund och erfarenhet av arbete inom tillverkande industri.

  • Erfarenhet av detaljberedning eller produktionsberedning.

  • Erfarenhet av att ta fram och hantera DXF-filer.

  • Erfarenhet av nestning och framtagning av produktionsunderlag för skärning.

  • Kunskap om skär- och brännprocesser inom industriell produktion.

  • Erfarenhet av att ta fram och kvalitetssäkra produktionsunderlag.

  • Erfarenhet av produktionsnära arbete och samarbete mellan konstruktion, produktion och produktionsteknik.

  • God förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och självständigt.

  • God samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att kommunicera med olika tekniska funktioner.

Meriterande kvalifikationer

  • Erfarenhet från komplex tillverkande industri.

  • Erfarenhet från verksamheter med höga krav på kvalitet och teknisk precision.

  • Erfarenhet av arbete med utveckling och implementering av nya tekniska lösningar i produktion.

Villkor

Placering: Landskrona
Arbetsform: På plats
Sysselsättningsgrad: Heltid
Period: 1 november 2026 till 30 april 2027 med goda möjligheter till förlängning.

title: Service Technician
description:
Elliott Aviation, a leader in aircraft solutions, has an exciting opportunity for a Service Technician. Since 1936, Elliott Aviation has been a world-class provider of customer-focused solutions for business aviation.

In the world of business aviation, where precision, reliability, and world‑class service define every mission, our Technicians play a pivotal role in keeping aircraft looking and performing at their best. If you're energized by cutting‑edge technology, thrive in fast‑paced environments, and take pride in ensuring every detail and system is flawless, this is your opportunity to join a team that values expertise, initiative, and a passion for excellence. With every aircraft you touch, you'll help deliver the safety, performance, and experience that our clients expect.

GENERAL SUMMARY:

In this essential role, you'll be part of a skilled service team responsible for inspecting, troubleshooting, and servicing aircraft to ensure peak performance and regulatory compliance. From routine checks to hands‑on mechanical repairs, you'll play a critical part in maintaining the integrity and safety of every aircraft that enters our facility.

As an Aircraft Service Technician, you'll work with advanced tools, technical manuals, and diagnostic equipment to identify issues, perform preventive maintenance, and support a wide range of mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems. Every day brings new challenges, new skills to learn, and the opportunity to directly impact operational excellence.

If you're mechanically inclined, safety‑focused, and excited to grow your career in aviation maintenance, this role offers a dynamic environment where your expertise truly matters.

PRIMARY RESPONSBILITIES:

  • Perform routine and scheduled aircraft inspections in accordance with FAA regulations and company maintenance programs.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance to ensure aircraft are safe, airworthy, and ready for service.
  • Read and interpret technical manuals, engineering documents, service bulletins, and maintenance logs.
  • Remove, repair, and reinstall aircraft components such as panels, control surfaces, and landing gear.
  • Utilize specialized tools and diagnostic equipment to verify system performance and resolve discrepancies.
  • Accurately complete maintenance records, work orders, and compliance documentation.
  • Collaborate with fellow technicians, inspectors, and supervisors to meet project timelines and operational requirements.
  • Ensure proper use of PPE and adherence to all safety protocols, including hazardous material handling.

Top candidates will possess:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 4+ years related experience in aircraft maintenance, mechanical systems repair, or technical troubleshooting
  • Experience in an MRO, airline, or aerospace maintenance environment
  • FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) certificate or enrollment in an A&P program
  • Familiarity with FAA Part 145 operations and documentation
  • Strong understanding of basic mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic principles
  • Ability to read and follow technical manuals, schematics, and regulatory documentation
  • Proficiency using hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
  • Basic computer skills for documentation and work order entry
  • Strong safety awareness and ability to handle tools and materials safely
  • Ability to work independently and within a team

Other requirements include:

  • Ability to routinely lift up to 50 lbs., work in confined spaces and in noisy environments
  • Ability to occasionally travel for work assignments
  • Ability to maintain a tool inventory in alignment with shop requirements
  • Ability to obtain and retain an airport AOA badge
  • Ability to work overtime and various shifts as business needs require
WHY JOIN ELLIOTT:
At Elliott Aviation, you're not just joining a company, you are becoming part of a legacy built on service, craftsmanship, and trust. For over eight decades, we've set the standard in aircraft services, delivering world-class craftsmanship and personalized solutions that keep our customers soaring. Here, your ideas matter, your expertise shines, and your career takes flight.
We offer:
  • Benefits on Day 1
  • Sign-On Bonus
  • Relocation assistance
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • FREE Generic prescriptions
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • 401(k) Company Match
  • Technical and professional development
  • FUN!

Join a team where passion for aviation meets a culture of excellence and help us shape the future of flight.
